+def rig_parts():
+    """Every part made so far onto its bone (rigid)."""
+    arm = obj("Rig")
+    for ob, bn in PARTS:
+        if bn is None:
+            ob.parent = obj("Root")
+            continue
+        ob.parent = arm
+        ob.parent_type = "BONE"
+        ob.parent_bone = bn
+        b = arm.data.bones[bn]
+        # (a bone parent's origin is the bone's TAIL)
+        ob.matrix_parent_inverse = (b.matrix_local @ Matrix.Translation((0, b.length, 0))).inverted()

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the main parts
+
+# The few parts the model is made of in the end (merge_parts): each a mesh of its
+# own, skinned to the bones it covers - the many rigid pieces it's built from
+# joined into them. A skin's extra bones (the pirate's coat tails) go to "Coat".
+REGIONS = {
+    "Head": ["head"],
+    "Torso": ["pelvis", "spine", "chest"],
+    "Arm.L": ["pauldron.L", "upper.L", "fore.L", "hand.L", "fingers.L"],
+    "Arm.R": ["pauldron.R", "upper.R", "fore.R", "hand.R", "fingers.R"],
+    "Leg.L": ["thigh.L", "shin.L", "foot.L"],
+    "Leg.R": ["thigh.R", "shin.R", "foot.R"],
+    "Rifle": ["gun"],
+}
+INK_MAX = 0.007          # the thickest outline (m, before INK): the "ink" vertex group's weight 1
+
+
+def merge_parts():
+    """Joins every rigid part into the REGIONS' meshes: their bevels and
+    thickness applied, each part's vertices held by its own bone (a vertex
+    group: the mesh is skinned, an Armature modifier), its outline's thickness
+    kept as the "ink" vertex group's weight - one Ink modifier (the inverted
+    hull) for the whole part. The model looks as before; in Blender it's a
+    handful of objects to select and edit."""
+    arm = obj("Rig")
+    arm.data.pose_position = "REST"
+    bpy.context.view_layer.update()
+    region_of = {}
+    for reg, bones in REGIONS.items():
+        for b in bones:
+            region_of[b] = reg
+    pieces = {}
+    for ob in list(coll().objects):
+        if ob.type != "MESH" or ob.parent != arm or ob.parent_type != "BONE":
+            continue
+        ink = ob.modifiers.get("Ink")
+        thick = abs(ink.thickness) / INK if ink else 0.0
+        if ink:
+            ob.modifiers.remove(ink)
+        bpy.context.view_layer.update()
+        dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get()
+        me = bpy.data.meshes.new_from_object(ob.evaluated_get(dg))
+        me.transform(ob.matrix_world)
+        if len(me.materials) and me.materials[-1] == M.get("ink"):
+            me.materials.pop()                   # (the outline's slot: the region's Ink modifier has its own)
+        t = bpy.data.objects.new(ob.name, me)
+        coll().objects.link(t)
+        t.vertex_groups.new(name=ob.parent_bone).add(list(range(len(me.vertices))), 1.0, "REPLACE")
+        t.vertex_groups.new(name="ink").add(list(range(len(me.vertices))), min(1.0, thick / INK_MAX), "REPLACE")
+        pieces.setdefault(region_of.get(ob.parent_bone, "Coat"), []).append(t)
+        old = ob.data
+        bpy.data.objects.remove(ob, do_unlink=True)
+        if old.users == 0:
+            bpy.data.meshes.remove(old)
+    made = []
+    for reg, obs in pieces.items():
+        bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="DESELECT")
+        for t in obs:
+            t.select_set(True)
+        bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active = obs[0]
+        if len(obs) > 1:
+            bpy.ops.object.join()
+        part = bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active
+        part.name = reg
+        part.data.name = reg
+        part.data.materials.append(M["ink"])
+        part.parent = arm
+        part.matrix_parent_inverse = arm.matrix_world.inverted()
+        am = part.modifiers.new("Armature", "ARMATURE")
+        am.object = arm
+        s = part.modifiers.new("Ink", "SOLIDIFY")
+        s.thickness = -INK_MAX * INK
+        s.offset = -1.0
+        s.use_flip_normals = True
+        s.use_rim = False
+        s.material_offset = len(part.data.materials) - 1
+        s.vertex_group = "ink"
+        s.thickness_vertex_group = 0.0
+        made.append(part)
+    skin_chains(made)
+    _SAMPLES.clear()
+    _PAD.clear()
+    arm.data.pose_position = "POSE"
+    bpy.ops.object.select_all(action="DESELECT")
+    return made

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the solver
+
+def V(side, fwd, up):
+    """A point given as (to the character's left, forward, up) -> Blender's."""
+    return Vector((side, -fwd, up))
+
+
+def _rz(deg):
+    return Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(deg), 3, "Z")
+
+
+def _rx(deg):
+    return Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(deg), 3, "X")
+
+
+def _ry(deg):
+    return Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(deg), 3, "Y")
+
+
+def _m4(r, t):
+    m = r.to_4x4()
+    m.translation = t
+    return m
+
+
+def _two_bone(root, target, l1, l2, pole):
+    """The middle joint (knee / elbow) of a two-bone chain from root to target,
+    bent toward `pole` (a direction); the end is pulled in if out of reach."""
+    d = target - root
+    dist = d.length
+    reach = (l1 + l2) * 0.999
+    if dist > reach:
+        d = d * (reach / dist)
+        dist = reach
+    if dist < abs(l1 - l2) + 1e-4:
+        dist = abs(l1 - l2) + 1e-4
+        d = d.normalized() * dist if d.length > 1e-6 else Vector((0, 0, -dist))
+    end = root + d
+    n = d.normalized()
+    a = (l1 * l1 - l2 * l2 + dist * dist) / (2 * dist)
+    h = math.sqrt(max(0.0, l1 * l1 - a * a))
+    p = Vector(pole) - n * Vector(pole).dot(n)
+    if p.length < 1e-5:
+        p = n.orthogonal()
+    p.normalize()
+    return root + n * a + p * h, end, p
+

+}

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- cloth chains (coat tails)
+# A long cloth panel (a coat's tail) hangs on a chain of bones - name, name.2, name.3 ... end to end, each under the
+# same parent (not each other: one may be gathered alone) - its vertices skinned smoothly along it (skin_chains).
+# drape_chain() bends the chain to hang the panel clear of the legs, the pelvis, a seat's proxies (SEATS) and the
+# floor: segment by segment from the top, the turn of each (pitch / roll, the first also a yaw; the back one in a
+# chair a little gathered) found by trying them out on points of the panel itself.
+
+def chain(name, parent, head, lengths, d=(0, 0, -1), hint=(0, -1, 0)):
+    """A cloth chain's bones (EXTRA_BONES entries): `lengths` segments from `head` along d."""
+    out = {}
+    h = Vector(head)
+    for k, ln in enumerate(lengths):
+        out[name if k == 0 else "%s.%d" % (name, k + 1)] = (parent, tuple(h), tuple(d), tuple(hint), ln)
+        h = h + Vector(d).normalized() * ln
+    return out
+
+
+def chains():
+    """{root: [its segments' bone names, from the top]} of the skin's extra bones."""
+    out = {}
+    for name in EXTRA:
+        k = 2
+        names = [name]
+        while "%s.%d" % (name, k) in EXTRA:
+            names.append("%s.%d" % (name, k))
+            k += 1
+        if len(names) > 1:
+            out[name] = names
+    return out
+
+
+CHAIN_BLEND = 0.3        # (the blend round a joint of a chain: that share of the shorter segment, each side)
+
+
+def chain_weights(s, lengths):
+    """Each segment's weight for a point s (m) down a chain of `lengths`: smooth across the joints."""
+    w = [0.0] * len(lengths)
+    j = 0.0
+    edges = []
+    for ln in lengths[:-1]:
+        j += ln
+        edges.append(j)
+    lo = 1.0
+    for k, e in enumerate(edges):
+        b = CHAIN_BLEND * min(lengths[k], lengths[k + 1])
+        t = max(0.0, min(1.0, (s - (e - b)) / (2 * b)))
+        t = t * t * (3 - 2 * t)                 # (0 above the joint's blend, 1 below it)
+        w[k] = lo * (1.0 - t)
+        lo *= t
+    w[-1] = lo
+    return w
+
+
+def skin_chains(made):
+    """The chains' cloth (made on its root bone) skinned along its segments, by each vertex's place at rest."""
+    ch = chains()
+    if not ch:
+        return
+    for part in made:
+        _cut_chains(part, ch)
+        for root, names in ch.items():
+            g = part.vertex_groups.get(root)
+            if g is None:
+                continue
+            groups = [part.vertex_groups.get(n) or part.vertex_groups.new(name=n) for n in names]
+            head = REST[root].translation
+            d = REST[root].to_3x3() @ Vector((0, 1, 0))
+            lengths = [EXTRA[n][4] for n in names]
+            mw = part.matrix_world
+            hit = 0
+            for v in part.data.vertices:
+                if not any(gr.group == g.index and gr.weight > 0.5 for gr in v.groups):
+                    continue
+                hit += 1
+                ws = chain_weights((mw @ v.co - head).dot(d), lengths)
+                for gr, x in zip(groups, ws):
+                    if x > 1e-4:
+                        gr.add([v.index], x, "REPLACE")
+                    else:
+                        gr.remove([v.index])
+            print("CHAIN %s: %d vertices along %d bones" % (root, hit, len(names)))
+
+
+CHAIN_CUT = 0.045        # (m: the chains' cloth cut across this often, so it bends smoothly - and is tried out closely)
+
+
+def _cut_chains(part, ch):
+    """The part's cloth on the chains cut across (level cuts at rest: its shape kept)."""
+    idx = set(part.vertex_groups[r].index for r in ch if part.vertex_groups.get(r))
+    if not idx:
+        return
+    mw = part.matrix_world
+    zs = [(mw @ v.co).z for v in part.data.vertices if any(g.group in idx and g.weight > 0.5 for g in v.groups)]
+    if not zs:
+        return
+    bm = bmesh.new()
+    bm.from_mesh(part.data)
+    inv = mw.inverted()
+    nrm = (mw.to_3x3().transposed() @ Vector((0, 0, 1))).normalized()
+    z = max(zs) - CHAIN_CUT
+    while z > min(zs):
+        bmesh.ops.bisect_plane(bm, geom=bm.verts[:] + bm.edges[:] + bm.faces[:], dist=1e-5, plane_co=inv @ Vector((0, 0, z)),
+                               plane_no=nrm)
+        z -= CHAIN_CUT
+    bm.to_mesh(part.data)
+    bm.free()
+
+
+CLOTH_PART = "Coat"                        # (the merged part the chains' cloth is in: its points are tried out)
+CLOTH_CLEAR = 0.014                        # (m: how far the cloth's middle keeps off what it hangs over - half its thickness, a gap)
+CLOTH_LEGS = (0.10, 0.09, 0.06)            # (the legs' proxies' radii: thigh, shin, foot - a skin with boots sets its own)
+CLOTH_PELVIS = (0.075, 0.105)              # (... and the pelvis's: a capsule across the hips (half-length, radius))
+_SAMPLES = {}
+
+
+def _chain_samples(root, names):
+    """Points of the chain's cloth at rest (armature space; a few hundred) and their weights on its segments."""
+    import numpy as np
+    key = (root, tuple(names))
+    if key in _SAMPLES:
+        return _SAMPLES[key]
+    part = obj(CLOTH_PART)
+    pts, ws = [], []
+    if part is not None and part.type == "MESH":
+        idx = {part.vertex_groups[n].index: k for k, n in enumerate(names) if part.vertex_groups.get(n)}
+        mw = part.matrix_world
+        for v in part.data.vertices:
+            w = [0.0] * len(names)
+            for gr in v.groups:
+                if gr.group in idx:
+                    w[idx[gr.group]] = gr.weight
+            if sum(w) > 0.5:
+                pts.append(tuple(mw @ v.co))
+                ws.append([x / sum(w) for x in w])
+    step = max(1, len(pts) // 1500)
+    out = (np.array(pts[::step]).reshape(-1, 3), np.array(ws[::step]).reshape(-1, len(names)))
+    _SAMPLES[key] = out
+    return out
+
+
+def cloth_proxies(P, mats):
+    """What the cloth keeps off: capsules (a, b, r) - the legs, the pelvis - and boxes (lo, hi) - a seat's -
+    and the floor (z = 0)."""
+    caps = []
+    rt, rs, rf = CLOTH_LEGS
+    for sf in (".L", ".R"):
+        hip, knee, ankle = mats["thigh" + sf].translation, mats["shin" + sf].translation, mats["foot" + sf].translation
+        toe = ankle + mats["foot" + sf].to_3x3() @ Vector((0, FOOT * 0.8, 0))
+        caps += [(hip, knee, rt), (knee, ankle, rs), (ankle, toe, rf)]
+    pel = mats["pelvis"]
+    hl, hr = CLOTH_PELVIS
+    caps.append((pel @ Vector((hl, -0.01, 0.0)), pel @ Vector((-hl, -0.01, 0.0)), hr))
+    boxes = list(SEATS.get(P.get("seat") or "", {}).values())
+    return caps, boxes
+
+
+def _cloth_cost(pts, caps, boxes, clear):
+    """Sum over the points (..., 3) of the squared depth (m) they're inside the proxies grown by `clear`."""
+    import numpy as np
+    pen = np.zeros(pts.shape[:-1])
+    for a, b, r in caps:
+        a, b = np.array(a), np.array(b)
+        ab = b - a
+        t = np.clip(((pts - a) @ ab) / max(ab @ ab, 1e-9), 0.0, 1.0)
+        d = np.linalg.norm(pts - (a + t[..., None] * ab), axis=-1) - r
+        pen += np.maximum(0.0, clear - d) ** 2
+    for lo, hi in boxes:
+        lo, hi = np.array(lo), np.array(hi)
+        c, h = (lo + hi) * 0.5, (hi - lo) * 0.5
+        q = np.abs(pts - c) - h
+        d = np.linalg.norm(np.maximum(q, 0.0), axis=-1) + np.minimum(q.max(axis=-1), 0.0)
+        pen += np.maximum(0.0, clear - d) ** 2
+    pen += np.maximum(0.0, clear - pts[..., 2]) ** 2
+    return pen.sum(axis=-1)
+
+
+def _turns(pitch, roll, yaw, side, fwd):
+    import numpy as np
+    out = []
+    for p in pitch:
+        for r in roll:
+            for y in yaw:
+                m = (Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(y), 3, "Z") @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(p), 3, -side)
+                     @ Matrix.Rotation(math.radians(r), 3, -fwd))
+                out.append(((p, r, y), np.array(m)))
+    return out
+
+
+def drape_chain(root, P, mats, head, prefs, side, fwd, reach=(90.0, 60.0, 0.0), gather=(1.0,), stiff=1.0, follow=0.0,
+                stretch=(1.0,), down=None, sag=0.0, body=1.0):
+    """A cloth chain's matrices {bone: matrix}: from `head`, each segment turned from its preferred rotation
+    (prefs[k]: a 3x3 - or None: straight on from the segment above) as little as it can while its cloth keeps
+    clear of cloth_proxies(). reach: how far it may turn (pitch, roll, and - the first segment only - yaw, degrees);
+    gather: the widths each segment may be gathered to; stiff: how much a turn costs against a clash;
+    follow: how much a bend from the segment above costs (so what can't hang down - on the floor - goes on its way);
+    stretch: the lengths the lower segments may be gathered up to (cloth bunching on the floor);
+    down, sag: a segment going straight on from the one above turns that share of the way to `down` (a 3x3: hanging
+    straight) - the cloth sags; body: the share of the legs' and the pelvis's proxies' size (0: only the floor, the
+    seat - lying down, the cloth lies with the body)."""
+    import numpy as np
+    names = chains()[root]
+    caps, boxes = cloth_proxies(P, mats)
+    caps = [(a, b, r * body) for a, b, r in caps if body > 0.0]
+    key = (root, _rkey([head]), _rkey([c[0] for c in caps] + [c[1] for c in caps]),
+           tuple(_rkey([m.col[i] for i in range(3)]) for m in prefs if m is not None), len(prefs), P.get("seat") or "",
+           reach, gather, stiff, follow, stretch, round(sag, 3), round(body, 3),
+           _rkey([down.col[i] for i in range(3)]) if down is not None else None)
+    if key in _DRAPED:              # (a still pose - a seat's - the same frame after frame)
+        return {n: m.copy() for n, m in _DRAPED[key].items()}
+    sp, sw = _chain_samples(root, names)
+    out = {}
+    fixed = np.zeros_like(sp)          # (the points' share carried by the segments posed so far)
+    h = Vector(head)
+    prev = None
+    for k, n in enumerate(names):
+        pref = prefs[k] if k < len(prefs) and prefs[k] is not None else prev
+        if (k >= len(prefs) or prefs[k] is None) and down is not None and sag > 0:
+            pref = prev.to_quaternion().slerp(down.to_quaternion(), sag).to_matrix()
+        pref_np = np.array(pref)
+        rest = (sw[:, k:].sum(1) > 0.02) & (sw[:, :k + 1].sum(1) > 0.02)   # (the points this segment moves)
+        cw = sw[rest, k:].sum(1)[:, None]          # (as the segments below go straight on with it)
+        ri = np.array(REST[n].inverted())
+        q = sp[rest] @ ri[:3, :3].T + ri[:3, 3]
+        fx = fixed[rest]
+        ln = EXTRA[n][4]
+        hn = np.array(h)
+        best = None
+        gs = [(g, x) for g in gather for x in ((1.0,) if k == 0 else stretch)]
+        for rnd in range(3):
+            if rnd == 0:
+                step = 10.0
+                rng = [np.arange(-reach[i], reach[i] + 0.1, step) if reach[i] > 0 else np.array([0.0]) for i in range(3)]
+            else:
+                step = 10.0 / (3.0 ** rnd)
+                c = best[1]
+                rng = [np.array([c[i] - step, c[i], c[i] + step]) if reach[i] > 0 else np.array([0.0]) for i in range(3)]
+            yaw = rng[2] if k == 0 else np.array([0.0])
+            turns = _turns(rng[0], rng[1], yaw, side, fwd)
+            for g, sy in gs:
+                sc = np.diag([g, sy, g])
+                R = np.array([t[1] @ pref_np for t in turns])                  # (n, 3, 3)
+                if len(q):
+                    pts = fx + cw * (np.einsum("nij,mj->nmi", R @ sc, q) + hn)
+                    cost = 1e4 * _cloth_cost(pts, caps, boxes, CLOTH_CLEAR) / max(1, len(q)) * 90.0
+                else:
+                    cost = np.zeros(len(turns))
+                ang = np.array([t[0] for t in turns])
+                cost = cost + stiff * ((ang / 30.0) ** 2).sum(axis=1) + 6.0 * (1.0 - g) ** 2 + 3.0 * (1.0 - sy) ** 2
+                if follow > 0 and prev is not None:
+                    up_prev = np.array(prev.col[1])
+                    bend = np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip(R[:, :, 1] @ up_prev, -1.0, 1.0)))
+                    cost = cost + follow * (bend / 30.0) ** 2
+                i = int(np.argmin(cost))
+                if best is None or cost[i] < best[0] - 1e-9:
+                    best = (float(cost[i]), tuple(float(x) for x in turns[i][0]), Matrix(R[i].tolist()), g, sy)
+        r = best[2]
+        m = _m4(r, h) @ Matrix.Diagonal((best[3], best[4], best[3], 1.0))
+        out[n] = m
+        mm = np.array(m @ REST[n].inverted())
+        fixed += sw[:, k:k + 1] * (sp @ mm[:3, :3].T + mm[:3, 3])
+        prev = r
+        h = h + r @ Vector((0, ln * best[4], 0))
+    if len(_DRAPED) > 4000:
+        _DRAPED.clear()
+    _DRAPED[key] = {n: m.copy() for n, m in out.items()}
+    return out
+
+
+_DRAPED = {}
+
+
+def _rkey(vs):
+    return tuple(round(float(x), 4) for v in vs for x in v)
+
+
+# The seats' collision proxies (the game's furniture - CosmosHangar._chair / _stool - round the root: the sitter's
+# origin 0.02 m behind the seat's middle): boxes (min, max) in Blender's axes (x its left, -y forward, z up).
+SEAT_Y = -0.02
+SEATS = {
+    "sit": {"seat": ((-0.24, SEAT_Y - 0.23, 0.28), (0.24, SEAT_Y + 0.23, 0.465)),          # (cushion, board, rail)
+            "postL": ((0.175, SEAT_Y + 0.195, 0.43), (0.225, SEAT_Y + 0.275, 0.995)),       # (the back: two posts,
+            "postR": ((-0.225, SEAT_Y + 0.195, 0.43), (-0.175, SEAT_Y + 0.275, 0.995)),     #  a padded panel,
+            "panel": ((-0.212, SEAT_Y + 0.205, 0.565), (0.212, SEAT_Y + 0.265, 0.915)),     #  its top rail; open under
+            "rail": ((-0.232, SEAT_Y + 0.22, 0.94), (0.232, SEAT_Y + 0.28, 0.995)),         #  the panel, between the posts)
+            "legs": ((-0.226, SEAT_Y - 0.226, 0.0), (0.226, SEAT_Y + 0.226, 0.40))},
+    "stool": {"seat": ((-0.20, SEAT_Y - 0.20, 0.74), (0.20, SEAT_Y + 0.20, 0.80)),          # (its round cushion, as a box)
+              "column": ((-0.045, SEAT_Y - 0.045, 0.0), (0.045, SEAT_Y + 0.045, 0.74))},
+}

+def _space_point(space, p, mats):
+    if space == "c":
+        return mats["chest"] @ Vector((0, NECK_Z - CHEST_Z, 0)) + mats["chest"].to_3x3() @ _local(p)
+    if space == "p":
+        return mats["pelvis"].translation + mats["pelvis"].to_3x3() @ _local(p)
+    return V(*p)
+
+
+def _local(p):
+    """(left, forward, up) in a spine bone's axes (x = left, y = up, z = forward)."""
+    return Vector((p[0], p[2], p[1]))
+
+
+def _space_dir(space, d, mats):
+    if space == "c":
+        return mats["chest"].to_3x3() @ _local(d)
+    if space == "p":
+        return mats["pelvis"].to_3x3() @ _local(d)
+    return V(*d)
+
+
+def solve(pose, extra=True):
+    """Every bone's matrix (armature space) for a pose (DEFAULT's controls) - a skin's extra bones' (its cloth)
+    too and the pauldrons fitted to the chest, unless `extra` is False (only where the limbs go is wanted)."""
+    P = dict(DEFAULT)
+    P.update(pose)
+    mats = {}
+    rest_r = frame((0, 0, 1), (0, -1, 0))          # the spine bones' rest rotation
+    # The pelvis.
+    pr = _rz(P["pyaw"]) @ rest_r @ _rx(P["ppitch"]) @ _rz(P["proll"])
+    ppos = Vector((0, 0, PELVIS_Z)) + V(*P["pelvis"])
+    mats["pelvis"] = _m4(pr, ppos)
+    # Spine and chest: half the twist / lean / bend each.
+    half = _ry(P["twist"] * 0.5) @ _rx(P["lean"] * 0.5) @ _rz(-P["bend"] * 0.5)
+    sr = pr @ half
+    spos = ppos + pr @ Vector((0, SPINE_Z - PELVIS_Z, 0))
+    mats["spine"] = _m4(sr, spos)
+    cr = sr @ half
+    cpos = spos + sr @ Vector((0, CHEST_Z - SPINE_Z, 0))
+    mats["chest"] = _m4(cr, cpos)
+    hy = max(-85.0, min(85.0, P["hyaw"] - P["pyaw"] - P["twist"])) if P["hfree"] < 0.5 else P["hyaw"]
+    hr = cr @ _ry(hy) @ _rx(P["hpitch"]) @ _rz(P["htilt"])
+    mats["head"] = _m4(hr, cpos + cr @ Vector((0, NECK_Z - CHEST_Z, 0)))
+    # The rifle.
+    gun = P["gun"]
+    grip_pts = {}
+    if gun is not None:
+        space, grip, fwd, top, hands = gun
+        gp = _space_point(space, grip, mats)
+        gr = frame(_space_dir(space, fwd, mats), _space_dir(space, top, mats))
+        mats["gun"] = _m4(gr, gp)
+        grip_pts["R"] = gp + gr @ Vector(GUN_HAND_R)
+        if hands == "both":
+            grip_pts["L"] = gp + gr @ Vector(GUN_HAND_L)
+    else:
+        mats["gun"] = _m4(frame((0, -1, 0), (0, 0, 1)), Vector((0, 0, -5.0)))   # (out of sight)
+    # Arms.
+    for sx, sf, s in ((1.0, ".L", "L"), (-1.0, ".R", "R")):
+        sh = cpos + cr @ Vector((SHOULDER.x * sx, SHOULDER.z - CHEST_Z, -SHOULDER.y))
+        space, p = P["hand" + s]
+        tgt = grip_pts.get(s)
+        if tgt is None:
+            tgt = _space_point(space, p, mats)
+        pole = _space_dir(space, P["elbow" + s], mats)
+        elbow, wrist, pp = _two_bone(sh, tgt, UPPER, FORE, pole)
+        ur = frame(elbow - sh, -pp)
+        mats["upper" + sf] = _m4(ur, sh)
+        fr_ = frame(wrist - elbow, -pp)
+        mats["fore" + sf] = _m4(fr_, elbow)
+        if s in grip_pts:        # (on the rifle: a fist round the grip)
+            hr_ = fr_
+            grip = 1.0
+        else:
+            hr_ = fr_ @ _rx(P["wrist" + s])
+            grip = P["grip" + s]
+        mats["hand" + sf] = _m4(hr_, wrist)
+        mats["fingers" + sf] = _m4(hr_ @ _rz(-95.0 * grip * sx), wrist + hr_ @ Vector((0, HAND * 0.55, 0)))
+        # The pauldron: between the chest and the upper arm.
+        rest_p = cr @ rest_r.inverted() @ frame((0, 0, -1), (0, -1, 0))
+        qa = rest_p.to_quaternion()
+        qb = ur.to_quaternion()
+        mats["pauldron" + sf] = _m4(qa.slerp(qb, 0.4).to_matrix(), sh)
+        if extra:                # (kept clear of the chest)
+            mats["pauldron" + sf] = fit_pauldron(sf, sx, mats["pauldron" + sf], mats["chest"])
+    # Legs.
+    for sx, sf, s in ((1.0, ".L", "L"), (-1.0, ".R", "R")):
+        hip = ppos + pr @ Vector((HIP_X * sx, HIP_Z - PELVIS_Z, 0))
+        space, p = P["foot" + s]
+        if space == "w":
+            ankle = V(p[0], p[1], p[2] + ANKLE_Z)
+            base = Matrix.Identity(3)
+        else:
+            ankle = hip + pr @ _local(p)
+            base = pr @ rest_r.inverted()
+        pole = _space_dir("p" if space == "p" else "w", P["knee" + s], mats)
+        if space == "w":       # (the knee follows the foot's turn and half the pelvis's)
+            pole = _rz(P["fyaw" + s] * sx * 0.7 + P["pyaw"] * 0.5) @ pole
+        knee, ankle, pp = _two_bone(hip, ankle, THIGH, SHIN, pole)
+        mats["thigh" + sf] = _m4(frame(knee - hip, pp), hip)
+        mats["shin" + sf] = _m4(frame(ankle - knee, pp), knee)
+        fr2 = base @ _rz(P["fyaw" + s] * sx) @ _rx(P["fpitch" + s]) @ frame((0, -1, 0), (0, 0, 1))
+        mats["foot" + sf] = _m4(fr2, ankle)
+    # A skin's extra bones.
+    for name in (EXTRA if extra else ()):
+        if name not in mats:          # (a tail solver may pose a whole chain at its root)
+            mats[name] = TAIL_SOLVER[0](name, P, mats) if TAIL_SOLVER[0] else mats[EXTRA[name][0]] @ (REST[EXTRA[name][0]].inverted() @ REST[name])
+    if P["air"]:
+        for k in mats:
+            mats[k] = Matrix.Translation((0, 0, P["air"])) @ mats[k]
+    return mats
+

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the pauldrons' fit
+# A pauldron turns with the arm (part of the way) about the shoulder: turned, its inner end could sink into the
+# chest's side. fit_pauldron() slides it out along the chest's side axis just as far as it takes to keep it clear
+# of the chest's rigid parts (both ways: none of its points in them, none of theirs in it) - tried out on the
+# merged parts themselves (Torso, Arm.L / Arm.R; their rest shapes), when there are any.
+
+PAD_CLEAR = 0.004            # (m: the gap kept)
+_PAD = {}

+def _islands(me, keep_vert):
+    """The mesh's loose parts whose vertices all pass keep_vert(index): (vertex indices, polygons)."""
+    import numpy as np
+    n = len(me.vertices)
+    parent = np.arange(n)
+
+    def find(i):
+        while parent[i] != i:
+            parent[i] = parent[parent[i]]
+            i = parent[i]
+        return i
+    for e in me.edges:
+        a, b = find(e.vertices[0]), find(e.vertices[1])
+        if a != b:
+            parent[a] = b
+    roots = np.array([find(i) for i in range(n)])
+    out = {}
+    for i in range(n):
+        out.setdefault(roots[i], []).append(i)
+    polys = {}
+    for p in me.polygons:
+        polys.setdefault(roots[p.vertices[0]], []).append(p)
+    res = []
+    for r, vs in out.items():
+        if all(keep_vert(i) for i in vs) and r in polys:
+            res.append((vs, polys[r]))
+    return res
+
+
+def _solids(me, isl, co):
+    """BVH trees of islands (a list of (vertices, polygons)), with their bounding boxes."""
+    import numpy as np
+    from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
+    out = []
+    for vs, ps in isl:
+        pts = co[vs]
+        out.append((pts.min(0), pts.max(0), BVHTree.FromPolygons([tuple(c) for c in co], [tuple(p.vertices) for p in ps])))
+    return out
+
+
+def _depth(solids, pts):
+    """The deepest any of the points (n, 3) is inside any of the solids (m)."""
+    import numpy as np
+    best = 0.0
+    for lo, hi, tree in solids:
+        inb = np.where(((pts > lo) & (pts < hi)).all(1))[0]
+        for i in inb:
+            v = Vector(pts[i])
+            loc, nrm, _k, dist = tree.find_nearest(v)
+            if loc is not None and (v - loc).dot(nrm) < 0 and dist > best:
+                best = dist
+    return best
+
+
+def _pad_data(sf):
+    import numpy as np
+    if sf in _PAD:
+        return _PAD[sf]
+    torso, part = obj("Torso"), obj("Arm" + sf)
+    data = None
+    if torso is not None and part is not None and torso.type == "MESH" and part.type == "MESH" and part.vertex_groups.get("pauldron" + sf):
+        def co_of(ob):
+            a = np.zeros(len(ob.data.vertices) * 3)
+            ob.data.vertices.foreach_get("co", a)
+            a = a.reshape(-1, 3)
+            mw = np.array(ob.matrix_world)
+            return a @ mw[:3, :3].T + mw[:3, 3]
+
+        def weight(ob, name):
+            g = ob.vertex_groups.get(name)
+            w = np.zeros(len(ob.data.vertices))
+            if g is None:
+                return w
+            for v in ob.data.vertices:
+                for gr in v.groups:
+                    if gr.group == g.index:
+                        w[v.index] = gr.weight
+            return w
+        pco, tco = co_of(part), co_of(torso)
+        pw = weight(part, "pauldron" + sf)
+        cw = weight(torso, "chest")
+        pad_isl = _islands(part.data, lambda i: pw[i] > 0.99)
+        cloth = set(k for k, m in enumerate(torso.data.materials) if m and any(w in m.name.lower() for w in ("coat", "cloth", "cape")))

+def _ease(kind, t):

+    if kind == "i":       # slow, then fast (winding up into a strike)

+    if kind == "o":       # fast, then slow
+        return 1 - (1 - t) * (1 - t)

+        return 1 - (1 - t) ** 3

+    if a is None or b is None:

+        return a + (b - a) * t
+    if isinstance(a, str):
+        return b if t >= 0.5 else a
+    if isinstance(a, (tuple, list)):
+        if len(a) and isinstance(a[0], str):       # (space, point...)
+            if a[0] != b[0]:
+                return b if t >= 0.5 else a
+            return (a[0],) + tuple(_lerp(x, y, t) for x, y in zip(a[1:], b[1:]))

+def frames_of(keys):

+PX_PER_M = 100.0       # the sprites' scale: the automaton (1.9 m) about 190 px tall

+def render_poses(poses, out_dir, name, dirs=DIRS):

+        return fwd, up, pitch
+    s = (ph - st) / (1 - st)
+    e = s * s * (3 - 2 * s)
+    fwd = L * (-0.5 + e)
+    up = 0.035 * (1 - s) + lift * math.sin(math.pi * s) ** 1.2
+    pitch = 28.0 * (1 - s) ** 2 * (1 - s) + 30.0 * math.sin(math.pi * s) * (1 - s) - 14.0 * s * s

+def walk(n, gun=None, L=0.62, arm=0.17, hx=0.29, hz=-0.625, grip=0.35):
+    """hx / hz: the hands' swing line (chest space; out clear of the thighs), grip: the fingers' curl."""
+    out = []
+    for i in range(n):
+        u = i / n
+        c, s2 = math.cos(TAU * u), math.sin(TAU * u)
+        fl = _foot_walk(u % 1.0, L, 0.10)
+        fr = _foot_walk((u + 0.5) % 1.0, L, 0.10)
+        p = dict(
+            pelvis=(0.012 * s2, 0.0, -0.04 + 0.018 * math.cos(2 * TAU * u + 0.5)),
+            pyaw=-5.0 * c, proll=2.5 * s2, twist=11.0 * c, lean=4.0,
+            footL=("w", (0.10, fl[0], fl[1])), fpitchL=fl[2], fyawL=6,
+            footR=("w", (-0.10, fr[0], fr[1])), fpitchR=fr[2], fyawR=6,
+            handL=("c", (hx, 0.03 - arm * c, hz + 0.03 * abs(c))),
+            handR=("c", (-hx, 0.03 + arm * c, hz + 0.03 * abs(c))),
+            gripL=grip, gripR=grip)

+            p["gun"] = gun["gun"]
+            p["twist"] = 4.0 * c
+            g = p["gun"]
+            p["gun"] = (g[0], (g[1][0], g[1][1], g[1][2] + 0.01 * math.cos(2 * TAU * u)), g[2], g[3], g[4])

+def _foot_run(ph, L, lift):
+    st = 0.36
+    if ph < st:
+        s = ph / st
+        return L * (0.36 - 0.86 * s), 0.02 * max(0.0, (s - 0.7) / 0.3), -8.0 * max(0.0, 1 - s / 0.2) + 45.0 * max(0.0, (s - 0.55) / 0.45)
+    s = (ph - st) / (1 - st)
+    e = s * s * (3 - 2 * s)
+    fwd = L * (-0.5 + 0.86 * e)
+    up = 0.02 + lift * math.sin(math.pi * min(1.0, s * 1.15)) ** 1.1 + 0.16 * math.sin(math.pi * s) * (1 - s)
+    pitch = 45.0 * (1 - s) + 35.0 * math.sin(math.pi * s) - 8.0 * s
+    return fwd, up, pitch
+

+# ------------------------------------------------------------------ a crate in both hands
+# The crate as the game holds it (CosmosHangar / the walker: EmpireKit.crate_mesh scaled (0.33, 0.36, 0.25)):
+# 0.396 m wide, 0.317 high, 0.325 deep; carried with its middle at CARRY_BOX (the game's CARRY_AT = (0, 1.06, 0.33)
+# in the character's space). The palms lie flat on its two sides (fitted, frame by frame: box_hands), the fingers
+# along the side, a little curled - the arms' planes upright, so the palms face each other.
+BOX_SIZE = (0.396, 0.317, 0.325)            # (wide, high, deep; m)
+CARRY_BOX = (0.0, 0.33, 1.06)               # the crate's middle while carried (left, forward, up)
+FLOOR_BOX = (0.0, 0.50, BOX_SIZE[1] * 0.5)  # ... and set down on the ground: its bottom on the floor, 0.50 m in front (its near side 0.34, just clear of the knees)
+PALM_GAP = 0.006                            # (m: the palms off the crate's sides - the fingers' slight curl meets it)
+HOLD_AT = (-0.02, -0.01)                    # (where on a side the palm goes: from its middle, forward / up)
+PALM = (0.02, 0.035, 0.004)                 # (the palm's inner face from the wrist, in the hand bone's axes: x * side = inward)
+
+
+def _palm(mats, s):
+    sx = 1.0 if s == "L" else -1.0
+    return mats["hand." + s] @ kit.Vector((PALM[0] * sx, PALM[1], PALM[2]))
+
+
+LOW_GRIP = 0.06    # (m: on the floor the palms hold the sides that much higher - nearer the top edges; up at the hold, the middle)
+
+
+def box_hands(pose, centre, out=0.0, up=0.0):
+    """The pose with its wrists (root-space targets) moved so the palms lie on the sides of a crate whose middle
+    is at `centre` (left, forward, up) - `out` m off them (letting go / reaching for it), `up` m higher."""
+    p = kit.full(pose)
+    up += LOW_GRIP * max(0.0, min(1.0, (CARRY_BOX[2] - centre[2]) / (CARRY_BOX[2] - FLOOR_BOX[2])))
+    want = {}
+    for s, sx in (("L", 1.0), ("R", -1.0)):
+        want[s] = kit.V(centre[0] + sx * (BOX_SIZE[0] * 0.5 + PALM_GAP + out), centre[1] + HOLD_AT[0], centre[2] + HOLD_AT[1] + up)
+        w = want[s] + kit.Vector((sx * 0.02, 0.03, 0.03))         # (a first guess: the wrist a little out, back and up)
+        p["hand" + s] = ("w", (w.x, -w.y, w.z))
+    for _ in range(10):
+        mats = kit.solve(p, extra=False)
+        for s in ("L", "R"):
+            e = want[s] - _palm(mats, s)
+            q = p["hand" + s][1]
+            p["hand" + s] = ("w", (q[0] + e.x, q[1] - e.y, q[2] + e.z))
+    return p
+
+
+def box_path(c0, c1, t, fwd_lead=0.0):
+    """The crate's middle from c0 to c1 (t 0..1, eased); fwd_lead > 0: it comes forward that much ahead of coming
+    down (< 0: it goes up first, then back) - an arc round the knees."""
+    e = kit._ease("io", t)
+    tf = t * (1 + fwd_lead) if fwd_lead > 0 else (t * (1 - fwd_lead) + fwd_lead)
+    ef = kit._ease("io", max(0.0, min(1.0, tf)))
+    return (c0[0] + (c1[0] - c0[0]) * e, c0[1] + (c1[1] - c0[1]) * ef, c0[2] + (c1[2] - c0[2]) * e)
+
+
+def _fit(poses, centres):
+    """box_hands on each frame where the crate is in the hands (centres[i] not None): the palms stay on its sides
+    all the way, however the body's key poses blend."""
+    return [box_hands(p, c, up=0.0) if c is not None else p for p, c in zip(poses, centres)]
+

+# The hold (carry, carry_idle): the elbows down at the sides, a little out and back; the fingers forward along the sides.
+CARRY_ARMS = dict(elbowL=(0.15, -0.45, -1.0), elbowR=(-0.15, -0.45, -1.0), wristL=12, wristR=12, gripL=0.12, gripR=0.12)
+CARRY_HANDS = dict(CARRY_ARMS, handL=("c", (0.22, 0.30, -0.52)), handR=("c", (-0.22, 0.30, -0.52)))   # (a first guess; fitted)

+def seated(base, n):
+    """Sitting still: the chest breathing slowly, the head now and then looking a little aside."""
+    out = []
+    for i, p in enumerate(breathe(base, n, amp=0.0, arms=0.0)):
+        a = TAU * i / n
+        p["hyaw"] = 7.0 * math.sin(a) * abs(math.sin(a))
+        p["hpitch"] = p["hpitch"] + 1.0 * math.sin(2 * a)
+        out.append(p)

+def carry(n=30):
+    """Walking with a crate held in both hands: no arm swing, the shoulders kept square, leaning back a little;
+    the palms stay on the crate's sides (the game holds it still at CARRY_AT while the body bobs)."""
+    out = []
+    for i, p in enumerate(walk(n, L=0.56)):
+        u = i / n
+        p.update(CARRY_HANDS)
+        p["twist"] = 3.0 * math.cos(TAU * u)
+        p["pyaw"] = -3.5 * math.cos(TAU * u)
+        p["lean"] = -3.0
+        out.append(p)

+def carry_idle(n=48):

+# Setting the crate down / picking it up: a squat - the knees and hips bent deep, the back straight but leaning
+# (the pelvis back, the chest over the knees), the head up, the feet planted where they stand (root-space, the same
+# in every key: no sliding). Each 1.4 s (43 frames, 30 fps), not looping. "box": the crate's middle each frame.
+SQUAT = P(STAND, pelvis=(0.0, -0.20, -0.56), ppitch=40, lean=22, hpitch=-36,
+          kneeL=(0.05, 1.0, 0.0), kneeR=(-0.05, 1.0, 0.0),
+          elbowL=(0.12, -1.0, 0.3), elbowR=(-0.12, -1.0, 0.3), wristL=-4, wristR=-4, gripL=0.12, gripR=0.12)
+RISE = P(STAND, pelvis=(0.0, -0.07, -0.26), ppitch=16, lean=8, hpitch=-12,
+         handL=("c", (0.28, 0.16, -0.60)), handR=("c", (-0.28, 0.16, -0.60)), gripL=0.4, gripR=0.4)
+PUT_RELEASE = 22    # put_down: the frame the hands let go (0.733 s) - the crate is on the floor at FLOOR_BOX from frame 16
+PICK_GRIP = 18      # pick_up: the frame the hands close on it (0.6 s) - it leaves the floor at frame 22

+def _hold():
+    return box_hands(P(STAND, lean=-3, **CARRY_HANDS), CARRY_BOX)

+
+def put_down():
+    """From the carry hold: down into the squat (the crate's bottom touches the floor at frame 16, FLOOR_BOX), the
+    palms let go at PUT_RELEASE (frame 22, 0.733 s: the game leaves the crate there), out off its sides and up,
+    standing again empty-handed (STAND - the idle's pose) at frame 42 (1.4 s)."""
+    down = box_hands(SQUAT, FLOOR_BOX)
+    let = box_hands(P(SQUAT, gripL=0.0, gripR=0.0, wristL=-14, wristR=-14), FLOOR_BOX, out=0.06, up=0.04)
+    poses = K((0, _hold()), (16, down), (PUT_RELEASE, down), (27, let, "o"), (34, RISE), (42, STAND, "o"))
+    box = [box_path(CARRY_BOX, FLOOR_BOX, min(1.0, i / 16.0), 0.5) for i in range(len(poses))]
+    return _fit(poses, [b if i < PUT_RELEASE else None for i, b in enumerate(box)]), box
+
+
+def pick_up():
+    """From standing (STAND): down into the squat, the open hands to the crate's sides (it on the floor, FLOOR_BOX),
+    gripping it at PICK_GRIP (frame 18, 0.6 s: the game takes it then), lifting it from frame 22 to the carry hold
+    (carry_idle's pose) at frame 42 (1.4 s)."""
+    reach = box_hands(P(SQUAT, gripL=0.0, gripR=0.0, wristL=-14, wristR=-14), FLOOR_BOX, out=0.06, up=0.04)
+    down = box_hands(SQUAT, FLOOR_BOX)
+    lift = 22
+    poses = K((0, STAND), (8, RISE), (13, reach), (PICK_GRIP, down, "o"), (lift, down), (42, _hold()))
+    box = [box_path(FLOOR_BOX, CARRY_BOX, max(0.0, (i - lift) / 20.0), -0.5) for i in range(len(poses))]
+    return _fit(poses, [b if i >= PICK_GRIP else None for i, b in enumerate(box)]), box

+# ------------------------------------------------------------------ at a console
+# A terminal in front of it: a sloped desk top (keys, a touch panel) ~1.06 m up, 0.30-0.45 m in front of the
+# feet, and a tilted screen above it (1.5-2.1 m up, 0.5 m forward). The wrists are root-space ("w") targets
+# on the panel - they stay put while the body breathes and shifts its weight.

+CONSOLE_WRIST = (0.155, 0.305, 1.085)    # (the left wrist; the palm ~6 cm further on, ~1.06 m up, ~0.36 m forward)
+CONSOLE = dict(pelvis=(0.0, 0.02, -0.025), lean=8, hpitch=17,
+               footL=("w", (0.14, 0.01, 0)), fyawL=12, footR=("w", (-0.15, -0.03, 0)), fyawR=15,
+               handL=("w", CONSOLE_WRIST), elbowL=(0.32, -0.40, -1.0), wristL=-8, gripL=0.35,
+               handR=("w", (-CONSOLE_WRIST[0], CONSOLE_WRIST[1], CONSOLE_WRIST[2])), elbowR=(-0.32, -0.40, -1.0),
+               wristR=-8, gripR=0.35)

+
+def console(n=120):
+    """Working a console (a 4 s loop): typing / touching the panel, the left hand sliding out along it and back,
+    a glance up at the screen and the right hand reaching up to touch it once, the weight shifting between the feet."""
+    b = CONSOLE
+    wl, wr = b["handL"][1], b["handR"][1]
+    slide = P(b, handL=("w", (wl[0] + 0.09, wl[1] + 0.02, wl[2] - 0.004)), hyaw=6, hpitch=19)
+    look = P(b, hpitch=-3, lean=7)
+    reach = P(look, twist=-4, handR=("w", (-0.10, 0.43, 1.555)), elbowR=(-1.0, -0.2, -0.5), wristR=-18, gripR=0.55)
+    touch = P(reach, handR=("w", (-0.10, 0.445, 1.56)))
+    keys = K((0, b), (28, b), (40, slide), (48, slide), (60, b), (66, b), (72, look, "o"), (83, reach),
+             (87, touch, "o"), (90, reach), (103, look), (110, b), (n, b))[:n]
+    # how much each hand is typing (on the panel, not on its way)
+    def on(i, spans):
+        for a, c in spans:
+            if a - 4 <= i <= c + 4:
+                return max(a - i, i - c, 0) / 4.0
+        return 1.0
+    out = []
+    for i, p in enumerate(keys):
+        t = i / float(n)
+        p = dict(p)
+        # the weight from one foot to the other and back, one breath
+        p["pelvis"] = (p["pelvis"][0] + 0.016 * math.sin(TAU * t), p["pelvis"][1], p["pelvis"][2] + 0.004 * math.sin(TAU * 2 * t))
+        p["proll"] = p["proll"] + 1.6 * math.sin(TAU * t)
+        p["lean"] = p["lean"] + 0.9 * math.sin(TAU * t + 1.0)
+        p["hpitch"] = p["hpitch"] + 1.2 * math.sin(TAU * 3 * t)
+        # the fingers' taps: short lifts of the wrist and quick curls, at rates that come round in the loop
+        for s, rate, ph, spans in (("L", 13, 0.0, ((30, 58),)), ("R", 17, 1.7, ((68, 106),))):
+            w = on(i, spans) * (0.65 + 0.35 * math.sin(TAU * 3 * t + ph))
+            tap = max(0.0, math.sin(TAU * rate * t + ph)) ** 6
+            tap2 = max(0.0, math.sin(TAU * (rate + 6) * t + ph * 2.3)) ** 8
+            sp, q = p["hand" + s]
+            p["hand" + s] = (sp, (q[0] + 0.004 * w * math.sin(TAU * 5 * t + ph), q[1] + 0.003 * w * tap2, q[2] + 0.011 * w * tap))
+            p["wrist" + s] = p["wrist" + s] + 5.0 * w * tap - 3.0 * w * tap2
+            p["grip" + s] = p["grip" + s] + 0.14 * w * tap2 + 0.06 * w * tap
+        out.append(p)
+    return out

files.explanation: Heavy background jobs in one place: on the desktop the worker pool's own tasks; in a browser the low-priority ones run one at a time - several at once held the main thread back (the page's one memory allocator).

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,73 @@ 
+class_name Jobs
+extends RefCounted
+## Heavy background jobs (a town's buildings, a ship's design or hull or rooms, a
+## station's bake, a dungeon, a monster, a trader's rooms): WorkerThreadPool tasks,
+## asked for the same way (add / done / wait in place of add_task /
+## is_task_completed / wait_for_task_completion).
+##
+## On the desktop they're the pool's own tasks. In a browser the low-priority ones
+## run ONE AT A TIME, in the order asked: there several at once - each making
+## hundreds of thousands of vertices - held the main thread back (the page's one
+## memory allocator, its lock), the game at ~40 frames a second for ten seconds as
+## it came in; one at a time it stays at 60. A job waited for (wait) starts at once.
+
+static var _n := 0
+static var _jobs := {}         # id -> {task: pool task (-1: not started), f, name}
+static var _queue: Array = []  # (a browser) ids not started yet, in order
+static var _running := -1      # (a browser) the one started from the queue
+static var _hooked := false
+
+
+## A job (as WorkerThreadPool.add_task): its id.
+static func add(f: Callable, high_priority := false, description := "") -> int:
+	_n += 1
+	if high_priority or not OS.has_feature("web"):
+		_jobs[_n] = {"task": WorkerThreadPool.add_task(f, high_priority, description)}
+		return _n
+	_jobs[_n] = {"task": -1, "f": f, "name": description}
+	_queue.append(_n)
+	if not _hooked:
+		_hooked = true
+		(Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree).process_frame.connect(_pump)
+	_pump()
+	return _n
+
+
+## Done (as WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed) - collect it with wait().
+static func done(id: int) -> bool:
+	var j = _jobs.get(id)
+	if j == null:
+		return true
+	return int(j["task"]) >= 0 and WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(int(j["task"]))
+
+
+## Waited for (as WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion): one not started yet starts now.
+static func wait(id: int) -> void:
+	var j = _jobs.get(id)
+	if j == null:
+		return
+	if int(j["task"]) < 0:
+		_queue.erase(id)
+		j["task"] = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(j["f"], true, str(j["name"]))
+	WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(int(j["task"]))
+	_jobs.erase(id)
+	if _running == id:
+		_running = -1
+		_pump()
+
+
+## (A browser, each frame) The next job started once the last is done.
+static func _pump() -> void:
+	if _running >= 0:
+		var r = _jobs.get(_running)
+		if r != null and not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(int(r["task"])):
+			return
+		_running = -1
+	while not _queue.is_empty():
+		var id: int = _queue.pop_front()
+		var j = _jobs.get(id)
+		if j == null or int(j["task"]) >= 0:
+			continue
+		j["task"] = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(j["f"], false, str(j["name"]))
+		_running = id
+		return
hunks.title: Jobs
hunks.note: add / done / wait in place of WorkerThreadPool's add_task / is_task_completed / wait_for_task_completion.

bubbles.text: The desktop (or a high-priority job): straight to the pool. A browser: queued, started one at a time by _pump each frame.
A job waited for that hadn't started yet starts at once, high priority - nothing waits behind the queue.
Starts the next queued job only when the running one is done: one big build at a time in a browser.

files.explanation: Mods: user://mods/<id>/ (mod.json + files laid out like res://, .json.merge patches). As the game starts: the turned-on mods' files packed into one zip, mounted over res://, plus a resource loader in front of Godot's for what's load()ed from raw files; a mark that catches a start that never reaches the title screen.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,499 @@ 
+extends Node
+## Mods: your changes to the game, any of it - its data, scripts, scenes, shaders,
+## models, pictures, sounds, fonts - kept apart from it and laid over it as it
+## starts. The first autoload: the mods are in place before anything else of the
+## game loads.
+##
+## A mod is a folder, user://mods/<id>/:
+##   mod.json   {id, name, version, author, description, main}   (main: a script of the
+##              mod's, "res://..." - run once the game's up: a Node added to the root)
+##   files/     laid out like the game (files/data/galaxy.json is res://data/galaxy.json):
+##              a file the game has replaces it, a new one is added.
+##              <file>.merge (a JSON object) is merged into the game's JSON file of that
+##              name (dictionaries key by key, deep; other values replaced) - a mod
+##              changing a few entries of a big data file without copying all of it.
+## Turned on, in order (a later mod wins): user://mods/mods.cfg. Changes apply at the
+## next start (restart()).
+##
+## How: every mod's files (and the merged JSON) go into one zip mounted over res://
+## (ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack) - what the game reads as files (JSON, text)
+## and lists (DirAccess) - and a resource loader in front of Godot's own (Loader)
+## loads what the game load()s from the mod's own files: scripts and scenes from their
+## text, pictures, models, sounds and fonts from their raw files (an exported game
+## knows only its own imported copies).
+##
+## Safety: a start that never reached the title screen (a mod breaking it) leaves
+## a mark; the next start runs without mods (safe_mode) and says so. `--no-mods`
+## starts without them too.
+
+const DIR := "user://mods/"
+const CONFIG := "user://mods/mods.cfg"
+const CACHE := "user://mods/.cache/"
+const BOOTING := "user://mods/.cache/booting"
+const FILES := "files/"
+## Loaded from the mod's own file by Loader (Godot's loader would load the game's import).
+const FRONT := ["gd", "tscn", "scn", "tres", "res", "gdshader", "gdshaderinc", "png", "jpg", "jpeg", "webp", "svg",
+	"bmp", "tga", "glb", "gltf", "ogg", "wav", "mp3", "ttf", "otf", "woff", "woff2"]
+const TYPES := {"gd": "GDScript", "tscn": "PackedScene", "scn": "PackedScene", "tres": "Resource", "res": "Resource",
+	"gdshader": "Shader", "gdshaderinc": "ShaderInclude", "glb": "PackedScene", "gltf": "PackedScene",
+	"ogg": "AudioStreamOggVorbis", "wav": "AudioStreamWAV", "mp3": "AudioStreamMP3",
+	"ttf": "FontFile", "otf": "FontFile", "woff": "FontFile", "woff2": "FontFile"}
+
+## The mods running (in order): their mod.json, with "dir".
+var active: Array = []
+## res:// path -> the mod file that replaces / adds it (the last mod's).
+var files := {}
+## res:// path -> the mod ids touching it (in order) - two mods on one file shown in the Mods screen.
+var touched := {}
+## Problems met loading them (shown in the Mods screen).
+var errors: PackedStringArray = []
+## This start runs without mods: the last start with them never reached the title screen.
+var safe_mode := false
+## The mods' main scripts' nodes (or objects), by mod id.
+var mains := {}
+var _loader: Loader
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(CACHE)
+	if "--no-mods" in OS.get_cmdline_user_args() or "--no-mods" in OS.get_cmdline_args():
+		return
+	var ids := enabled()
+	if ids.is_empty():
+		return
+	if FileAccess.file_exists(BOOTING):
+		safe_mode = true
+		DirAccess.remove_absolute(BOOTING)
+		errors.append("The last start with mods didn't reach the title screen: started without them. Turn them on again in Mods.")
+		return
+	var f := FileAccess.open(BOOTING, FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if f:
+		f.store_string(",".join(ids))
+		f.close()
+	_mount(ids)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	if active.is_empty():
+		return
+	# (after every autoload's _ready: the game's up - each mod's own script runs)
+	_run_mains.call_deferred()
+
+
+## The title screen's up: this start with mods worked (main_menu calls it).
+func started() -> void:
+	if FileAccess.file_exists(BOOTING):
+		DirAccess.remove_absolute(BOOTING)
+
+
+# --- The mods installed ----------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Every mod in user://mods/: its mod.json (with "dir", "enabled"), in load order
+## (the turned-on ones first, in theirs; then the rest by name).
+func installed() -> Array:
+	var on := enabled()
+	var out: Array = []
+	var d := DirAccess.open(DIR)
+	if d == null:
+		return out
+	for id in d.get_directories():
+		if id.begins_with("."):
+			continue
+		var m := info(id)
+		if m.is_empty():
+			continue
+		m["enabled"] = id in on
+		out.append(m)
+	out.sort_custom(func(a, b):
+		var ia := on.find(a["id"])
+		var ib := on.find(b["id"])
+		if ia >= 0 and ib >= 0:
+			return ia < ib
+		if (ia >= 0) != (ib >= 0):
+			return ia >= 0
+		return str(a["name"]).naturalnocasecmp_to(str(b["name"])) < 0)
+	return out
+
+
+## A mod's mod.json (with "dir", "id"), or {} when it isn't one.
+func info(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var path := DIR + id + "/mod.json"
+	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
+		return {}
+	var m = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(path))
+	if not m is Dictionary:
+		m = {"name": id, "broken": "mod.json isn't valid JSON"}
+	m["id"] = id
+	m["dir"] = DIR + id + "/"
+	for k in ["name", "version", "author", "description", "main"]:
+		if not m.has(k):
+			m[k] = id if k == "name" else ""
+	return m
+
+
+func save_info(m: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var out := m.duplicate()
+	for k in ["dir", "enabled", "broken"]:
+		out.erase(k)
+	var f := FileAccess.open(DIR + str(m["id"]) + "/mod.json", FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if f:
+		f.store_string(JSON.stringify(out, "\t"))
+
+
+## The turned-on mods' ids, in load order.
+func enabled() -> PackedStringArray:
+	var c := ConfigFile.new()
+	if c.load(CONFIG) != OK:
+		return PackedStringArray()
+	var out := PackedStringArray()
+	for id in c.get_value("mods", "enabled", []):
+		if DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(DIR + str(id)):
+			out.append(str(id))
+	return out
+
+
+func set_enabled_list(ids: PackedStringArray) -> void:
+	var c := ConfigFile.new()
+	c.load(CONFIG)
+	c.set_value("mods", "enabled", Array(ids))
+	c.save(CONFIG)
+
+
+func set_enabled(id: String, on: bool) -> void:
+	var ids := enabled()
+	if on and not id in ids:
+		ids.append(id)
+	elif not on and id in ids:
+		ids.remove_at(ids.find(id))
+	set_enabled_list(ids)
+
+
+## Moves a turned-on mod `d` places in the load order (later wins).
+func move(id: String, d: int) -> void:
+	var ids := enabled()
+	var i := ids.find(id)
+	if i < 0:
+		return
+	var j := clampi(i + d, 0, ids.size() - 1)
+	ids.remove_at(i)
+	ids.insert(j, id)
+	set_enabled_list(ids)
+
+
+## The mods to run differ from the ones running: a restart applies them.
+func needs_restart() -> bool:
+	var now := PackedStringArray()
+	for m in active:
+		now.append(str(m["id"]))
+	return now != enabled()
+
+
+## A new, empty mod: its id (from `name`, made unique).
+func create(name: String, author := "") -> String:
+	var base := name.to_snake_case().replace(" ", "_").validate_filename()
+	base = base.replace(".", "_")
+	if base == "":
+		base = "mod"
+	var id := base
+	var n := 2
+	while DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(DIR + id):
+		id = "%s_%d" % [base, n]
+		n += 1
+	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(DIR + id + "/" + FILES)
+	save_info({"id": id, "name": name, "version": "1.0", "author": author, "description": "", "main": ""})
+	return id
+
+
+## Deletes a mod's folder (and turns it off).
+func remove(id: String) -> void:
+	set_enabled(id, false)
+	_rm_tree(DIR + id)
+
+
+func _rm_tree(path: String) -> void:
+	var d := DirAccess.open(path)
+	if d == null:
+		return
+	for f in d.get_files():
+		d.remove(f)
+	for sub in d.get_directories():
+		_rm_tree(path.path_join(sub))
+	DirAccess.remove_absolute(path)
+
+
+## The folder of a mod's game files (res://x is <this>x).
+func files_dir(id: String) -> String:
+	return DIR + id + "/" + FILES
+
+
+## A mod's files: res:// paths, sorted (merges as "<path>.merge").
+func mod_files(id: String) -> PackedStringArray:
+	var out := PackedStringArray()
+	_walk(files_dir(id), "", out)
+	out.sort()
+	return out
+
+
+func _walk(base: String, rel: String, out: PackedStringArray) -> void:
+	var d := DirAccess.open(base + rel)
+	if d == null:
+		return
+	d.include_hidden = false
+	for f in d.get_files():
+		out.append("res://" + rel + f)
+	for sub in d.get_directories():
+		_walk(base, rel + sub + "/", out)
+
+
+## Packs a mod into a zip (mod.json + files/) to share: true when written.
+func export_zip(id: String, to: String) -> bool:
+	var z := ZIPPacker.new()
+	if z.open(to) != OK:
+		return false
+	var root := DIR + id + "/"
+	var all := PackedStringArray()
+	_walk(root, "", all)
+	for p in all:
+		var rel := p.trim_prefix("res://")
+		z.start_file(id + "/" + rel)
+		z.write_file(FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(root + rel))
+		z.close_file()
+	z.close()
+	return true
+
+
+## Installs a mod from a zip (one made by export_zip: <id>/mod.json ...; or mod.json
+## at its root): its id, or "" (and why in `errors`).
+func install_zip(path: String) -> String:
+	var z := ZIPReader.new()
+	if z.open(path) != OK:
+		errors.append("Can't open %s" % path)
+		return ""
+	var names := z.get_files()
+	var prefix := ""
+	for n in names:
+		if n.get_file() == "mod.json" and n.count("/") <= 1:
+			prefix = n.get_base_dir()
+			break
+	if not (prefix + "/mod.json").trim_prefix("/") in names:
+		errors.append("%s has no mod.json" % path.get_file())
+		z.close()
+		return ""
+	var m = JSON.parse_string(z.read_file((prefix + "/mod.json").trim_prefix("/")).get_string_from_utf8())
+	var id := str(m.get("id", prefix if prefix != "" else path.get_file().get_basename())) if m is Dictionary else path.get_file().get_basename()
+	id = id.validate_filename().replace(".", "_")
+	_rm_tree(DIR + id)
+	for n in names:
+		if n.ends_with("/") or (prefix != "" and not n.begins_with(prefix + "/")):
+			continue
+		var rel := n.trim_prefix(prefix + "/") if prefix != "" else n
+		if rel.contains(".."):
+			continue   # (nothing written outside the mod's folder)
+		var to := DIR + id + "/" + rel
+		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(to.get_base_dir())
+		var f := FileAccess.open(to, FileAccess.WRITE)
+		if f:
+			f.store_buffer(z.read_file(n))
+	z.close()
+	return id
+
+
+## Restarts the game (the mods turned on now load).
+func restart() -> void:
+	if OS.has_feature("web"):
+		JavaScriptBridge.eval("location.reload()")
+		return
+	OS.set_restart_on_exit(true, OS.get_cmdline_args())
+	get_tree().quit()
+
+
+# --- Laying the mods over the game -------------------------------------------------
+
+func _mount(ids: PackedStringArray) -> void:
+	var merges := {}   # res path -> [mod file...]
+	for id in ids:
+		var m := info(id)
+		if m.is_empty():
+			errors.append("%s: no mod.json - left out" % id)
+			continue
+		if m.has("broken"):
+			errors.append("%s: %s - left out" % [id, m["broken"]])
+			continue
+		active.append(m)
+		for p in mod_files(id):
+			var src := files_dir(id) + p.trim_prefix("res://")
+			if p.ends_with(".merge"):
+				var target := p.trim_suffix(".merge")
+				if not merges.has(target):
+					merges[target] = []
+				merges[target].append(src)
+				_touch(target, id)
+				continue
+			files[p] = src
+			_touch(p, id)
+	if active.is_empty():
+		return
+	# The zip: built again only when a mod's files changed (their names, sizes and times).
+	var sig := PackedStringArray()
+	for p in files:
+		sig.append("%s|%d|%d" % [files[p], FileAccess.get_size(files[p]), FileAccess.get_modified_time(files[p])])
+	for p in merges:
+		for src in merges[p]:
+			sig.append("%s|%d" % [src, FileAccess.get_modified_time(src)])
+	sig.sort()
+	var key := str(hash(";".join(sig)))
+	var zip := CACHE + "active.zip"
+	var old := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(CACHE + "active.key")
+	if old != key or not FileAccess.file_exists(zip):
+		var merged := {}
+		for target in merges:   # (from the game's file - or a mod's that replaces it - before the zip's mounted)
+			var base_text := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(files[target]) if files.has(target) else FileAccess.get_file_as_string(target)
+			var base = JSON.parse_string(base_text) if base_text != "" else {}
+			if base == null:
+				base = {}
+			for src in merges[target]:
+				var add = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(src))
+				if add == null:
+					errors.append("%s: not valid JSON - not merged" % src.trim_prefix(DIR))
+					continue
+				base = merge(base, add)
+			merged[target] = JSON.stringify(base, "\t").to_utf8_buffer()
+		var z := ZIPPacker.new()
+		if z.open(zip) != OK:
+			errors.append("Can't write %s" % zip)
+			return
+		for p in files:
+			if merged.has(p):
+				continue
+			z.start_file(p.trim_prefix("res://"))
+			z.write_file(FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(files[p]))
+			z.close_file()
+		for p in merged:
+			z.start_file(p.trim_prefix("res://"))
+			z.write_file(merged[p])
+			z.close_file()
+		z.close()
+		var kf := FileAccess.open(CACHE + "active.key", FileAccess.WRITE)
+		if kf:
+			kf.store_string(key)
+	if not ProjectSettings.load_resource_pack(zip, true):
+		errors.append("Couldn't mount the mods' files")
+		return
+	_loader = Loader.new()
+	for p in files:
+		if str(p.get_extension()).to_lower() in FRONT:
+			_loader.over[p] = files[p]
+	for p in merges:   # (a merged .tres / .json loaded with load(): from the zip, as the game's own path)
+		_loader.over.erase(p)
+	ResourceLoader.add_resource_format_loader(_loader, true)
+
+
+func _touch(p: String, id: String) -> void:
+	if not touched.has(p):
+		touched[p] = []
+	if not id in touched[p]:
+		touched[p].append(id)
+
+
+## `add` merged into `base`: dictionaries key by key (deep), anything else replaced.
+static func merge(base: Variant, add: Variant) -> Variant:
+	if base is Dictionary and add is Dictionary:
+		var out: Dictionary = base.duplicate()
+		for k in add:
+			out[k] = merge(base[k], add[k]) if base.has(k) else add[k]
+		return out
+	return add
+
+
+func _run_mains() -> void:
+	for m in active:
+		var main := str(m.get("main", ""))
+		if main == "":
+			continue
+		if not main.begins_with("res://"):
+			main = "res://" + main
+		var s = load(main)
+		if not s is Script or not (s as Script).can_instantiate():
+			errors.append("%s: its main script %s doesn't load" % [m["id"], main])
+			continue
+		var o = s.new()
+		mains[m["id"]] = o
+		if o is Node:
+			o.name = "Mod_" + str(m["id"])
+			get_tree().root.add_child(o)
+
+
+## Godot's loader for the mods' files, in front of its own: a path a mod replaces or
+## adds is loaded from the mod's file.
+class Loader extends ResourceFormatLoader:
+	var over := {}   # res path -> mod file
+
+	func _get_recognized_extensions() -> PackedStringArray:
+		return PackedStringArray(FRONT)
+
+	func _recognize_path(path: String, _type: StringName) -> bool:
+		return over.has(path)
+
+	func _handles_type(_type: StringName) -> bool:
+		return true
+
+	func _get_resource_type(path: String) -> String:
+		if not over.has(path):
+			return ""
+		var ext := path.get_extension().to_lower()
+		if ext in ["png", "jpg", "jpeg", "webp", "svg", "bmp", "tga"]:
+			return "ImageTexture"
+		return str(TYPES.get(ext, "Resource"))
+
+	func _exists(path: String) -> bool:
+		return over.has(path)
+
+	func _load(path: String, _original: String, _sub: bool, _cache: int) -> Variant:
+		var src: String = over[path]
+		var ext := path.get_extension().to_lower()
+		match ext:
+			"gd":
+				var s := GDScript.new()
+				s.source_code = FileAccess.get_file_as_string(src)
+				var err := s.reload()
+				if err != OK:
+					push_error("Mod script %s doesn't compile (%s)" % [path, error_string(err)])
+				return s
+			"png", "jpg", "jpeg", "webp", "bmp", "tga", "svg":
+				var img := Image.new()
+				var err := img.load_svg_from_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(src)) if ext == "svg" else img.load(src)
+				if err != OK:
+					return err
+				img.generate_mipmaps()
+				return ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+			"glb", "gltf":
+				var doc := GLTFDocument.new()
+				var st := GLTFState.new()
+				var err := doc.append_from_file(src, st)
+				if err != OK:
+					return err
+				var root := doc.generate_scene(st)
+				var ps := PackedScene.new()
+				_own(root, root)
+				ps.pack(root)
+				root.free()
+				return ps
+			"ogg":
+				return AudioStreamOggVorbis.load_from_file(src)
+			"wav":
+				return AudioStreamWAV.load_from_file(src)
+			"mp3":
+				var mp := AudioStreamMP3.new()
+				mp.data = FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(src)
+				return mp
+			"ttf", "otf", "woff", "woff2":
+				var font := FontFile.new()
+				font.load_dynamic_font(src)
+				return font
+		return ResourceLoader.load(src, "", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_IGNORE)
+
+	## (a generated scene's nodes owned by its root, so pack() keeps them)
+	func _own(n: Node, root: Node) -> void:
+		for c in n.get_children():
+			c.owner = root
+			_own(c, root)

bubbles.text: Packs every turned-on mod's files (and the merged JSON) into one zip - rebuilt only when a mod's files change - and mounts it.
Mounted over res://: what the game reads as files (JSON, lists of a folder) comes from the mods.
A .merge deep-merges into the game's JSON: dictionaries key by key, other values replaced - two mods can patch one file.
In front of Godot's loaders: a script, scene, picture, model or sound load()ed from a mod's raw file - an exported game only knows its imported copies.
The title screen reached: the start's mark is cleared. Left there, the next start runs without mods and says why.

+## The ground grid: 4 x 4 m, a line each 25 cm, the axes brighter.
+func _grid() -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
+	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_LINES)
+	for i in range(-8, 9):
+		var c := Color(0.5, 0.55, 0.65, 0.55) if i == 0 else (Color(0.4, 0.42, 0.5, 0.35) if i % 4 == 0 else Color(0.35, 0.37, 0.45, 0.18))
+		var x := i * 0.25
+		for seg in [[Vector3(x, 0, -2), Vector3(x, 0, 2)], [Vector3(-2, 0, x), Vector3(2, 0, x)]]:
+			st.set_color(c)
+			st.add_vertex(seg[0])
+			st.set_color(c)
+			st.add_vertex(seg[1])
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.mesh = st.commit()
+	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
+	m.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true
+	m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
+	mi.material_override = m
+	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	return mi

+# --- Characters ------------------------------------------------------------------
