+## Shows character `id` (its model loaded on a worker the first time, not headless).
+func open_character(id: String) -> void:
+	if id == "" or not Stage3D.has_model(id):
+		return
+	if _chars:
+		for i in _chars.item_count:
+			if _chars.get_item_text(i) == id:
+				_chars.select(i)
+	if not Stage3D._scenes.has(id) and DisplayServer.get_name() != "headless":
+		var path := Stage3D.model_dir(id) + id + ".glb"
+		if ResourceLoader.load_threaded_request(path) == OK:
+			_loading = id
+			_say("loading %s..." % id)
+			return
+	_show_model(id)
+
+
+func _show_model(id: String) -> void:
+	_loading = ""
+	char_id = id
+	if _model:
+		_model.queue_free()
+	var model: Node3D = Stage3D._scene(id).instantiate()
+	var mats: Dictionary = Stage3D.info(id).get("materials", {})
+	var hide: Array = HIDE_MIN if mats.keys().any(func(m): return str(m).begins_with("MIN_")) else []
+	CosmosModels.apply(model, id, [], hide)   # (as the game draws it: merged, physically based)
+	_vp.add_child(model)
+	_model = model
+	_sk = model.find_child("Skeleton3D", true, false)
+	_ap = model.find_child("AnimationPlayer", true, false)
+	var mi: MeshInstance3D = model.find_child("Body", true, false)
+	if mi:
+		mi.extra_cull_margin = 4.0
+	_fps = float(Stage3D.info(id)["fps"])
+	if not _docs.has(id):
+		Stage3D.forget_clips(id)   # (the clip files listed afresh: the target may have changed)
+	if _ap:
+		Stage3D.loop_clips(_ap, id)    # (the clips as the game has them: lengths, loops, glitches mended, files used)
+		_ap.callback_mode_process = AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_MANUAL
+		_ap.active = false             # (the editor poses the skeleton itself)
+		_prefix = str(_ap.get_node(_ap.root_node).get_path_to(_sk)) if _sk else _prefix
+	_children = []
+	for b in _sk.get_bone_count():
+		_children.append([])
+	for b in _sk.get_bone_count():
+		var p := _sk.get_bone_parent(b)
+		if p >= 0:
+			_children[p].append(b)
+	if not _docs.has(id):
+		_docs[id] = _new_doc(id)
+	bone = -1
+	sel_keys.clear()
+	pose.clear()
+	var doc := _doc()
+	select_clip(clip if doc["clips"].has(clip) else ("idle" if doc["clips"].has("idle") else (str(doc["order"][0]) if not doc["order"].is_empty() else "")))
+	_say("")
+
+
+func _new_doc(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var doc := {"clips": {}, "order": [], "base": {}, "files": {}, "changed": {}, "removed": {}, "undo": [], "redo": []}
+	var names: Array = Stage3D.info(id).get("clips", {}).keys()
+	if _ap:
+		for n in _ap.get_animation_list():
+			if not names.has(str(n)):
+				names.append(str(n))
+	var files := Stage3D.custom_clips(id)
+	for n in names:
+		var a := Stage3D.base_clip(_ap, id, n)
+		if a != null:
+			doc["base"][n] = true
+			doc["clips"][n] = files.get(n, a)
+			doc["order"].append(n)
+	for n in files:
+		doc["files"][n] = true
+		if not doc["clips"].has(n):
+			doc["clips"][n] = files[n]
+			doc["order"].append(n)
+	return doc
+
+
+func _doc() -> Dictionary:
+	return _docs.get(char_id, {})
+
+
+## The clip showing (null: none).
+func anim() -> Animation:
+	var d := _doc()
+	return d.get("clips", {}).get(clip)
+
+
+# --- Clips -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func select_clip(name: String) -> void:
+	var d := _doc()
+	if d.is_empty() or not d["clips"].has(name):
+		clip = ""
+	else:
+		clip = name
+	playing = false
+	sel_keys.clear()
+	pose.clear()
+	time = 0.0
+	frame = 0
+	_fill_clips()
+	_refresh_keys()
+	_sync_clip_fields()
+	_apply()
+
+
+## Frames in the clip (a loop: its length; else its last frame included).
+func frames() -> int:
+	var a := anim()
+	if a == null:
+		return 0
+	return maxi(1, roundi(a.length * _fps) + (0 if a.loop_mode != Animation.LOOP_NONE else 1))
+
+
+func _fill_clips() -> void:
+	if _clip_list == null:
+		return
+	_clip_list.clear()
+	var d := _doc()
+	if d.is_empty():
+		return
+	for n in d["order"]:
+		var a: Animation = d["clips"][n]
+		var nf := maxi(1, roundi(a.length * _fps) + (0 if a.loop_mode != Animation.LOOP_NONE else 1))
+		var mark := " [own]" if not d["base"].has(n) else (" [file]" if d["files"].has(n) and not d["removed"].has(n) else "")
+		var i := _clip_list.add_item("%s%s   %d f%s%s" % ["* " if d["changed"].has(n) else "", n, nf, "  loop" if a.loop_mode != Animation.LOOP_NONE else "", mark])
+		_clip_list.set_item_metadata(i, n)
+		if n == clip:
+			_clip_list.select(i)
+			_clip_list.ensure_current_is_visible()
+
+
+func _sync_clip_fields() -> void:
+	if _name_edit == null:
+		return
+	_syncing = true
+	var d := _doc()
+	var own: bool = clip != "" and not d["base"].has(clip)
+	_name_edit.text = clip
+	_name_edit.editable = own
+	_len_spin.value = frames()
+	_loop_check.button_pressed = anim() != null and anim().loop_mode != Animation.LOOP_NONE
+	_del_btn.disabled = clip == "" or not (own or (d["files"].has(clip) and not d["removed"].has(clip)) or d["changed"].has(clip))
+	_syncing = false
+	_frame_label.text = "%d / %d" % [frame, maxi(0, frames() - 1)]
+
+
+## A new clip of your own: empty (the rest pose), or a copy of the selected one.
+func new_clip(copy: bool) -> void:
+	var d := _doc()
+	if d.is_empty():
+		return
+	var base := (clip + "_copy") if copy and clip != "" else "clip"
+	var name := base
+	var n := 2
+	while d["clips"].has(name):
+		name = "%s_%d" % [base, n]
+		n += 1
+	_edit()
+	var a: Animation
+	if copy and anim() != null:
+		a = anim().duplicate(true)
+	else:
+		a = Animation.new()
+		a.length = 29.0 / _fps
+		a.step = 1.0 / _fps
+	d["clips"][name] = a
+	d["order"].append(name)
+	d["changed"][name] = true
+	_fresh = a
+	select_clip(name)
+	_after_edit()
+
+
+## Renames your own clip.
+func rename_clip(to: String) -> void:
+	var d := _doc()
+	to = to.strip_edges().replace(" ", "_").validate_filename()
+	if clip == "" or d["base"].has(clip) or to == "" or to == clip:
+		_sync_clip_fields()
+		return
+	if d["clips"].has(to):
+		_say("there's a clip called %s already" % to)
+		_sync_clip_fields()
+		return
+	_edit()
+	var old := clip
+	d["clips"][to] = d["clips"][old]
+	d["clips"].erase(old)
+	d["order"][d["order"].find(old)] = to
+	d["changed"].erase(old)
+	d["changed"][to] = true
+	if d["files"].has(old):
+		d["removed"][old] = true
+	clip = to
+	_after_edit()
+
+
+## Deletes your own clip; the model's clip goes back to the model's own (its file deleted on Save).
+func delete_clip() -> void:
+	var d := _doc()
+	if clip == "":
+		return
+	_edit()
+	var name := clip
+	d["changed"].erase(name)
+	if d["files"].has(name):
+		d["removed"][name] = true
+	if d["base"].has(name):
+		d["clips"][name] = Stage3D.base_clip(_ap, char_id, name)
+		_after_edit()
+		select_clip(name)
+		return
+	d["clips"].erase(name)
+	d["order"].erase(name)
+	select_clip(str(d["order"][0]) if not d["order"].is_empty() else "")
+	_after_edit()
+
+
+func set_length(n: int) -> void:
+	var a := anim()
+	if a == null or n == frames():
+		return
+	_edit()
+	a = _writable()
+	a.length = (n if a.loop_mode != Animation.LOOP_NONE else n - 1) / _fps
+	_after_edit()
+
+
+func set_loop(on: bool) -> void:
+	var a := anim()
+	if a == null or (a.loop_mode != Animation.LOOP_NONE) == on:
+		return
+	var n := frames()
+	_edit()
+	a = _writable()
+	a.loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_LINEAR if on else Animation.LOOP_NONE
+	a.length = (n if on else n - 1) / _fps
+	_after_edit()
+
+
+# --- Edits and undo --------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Starts an edit of the clip showing: an undo step (the document as it is), marked changed.
+func _edit() -> void:
+	var d := _doc()
+	d["undo"].append(_snap(d))
+	if d["undo"].size() > UNDO_MAX:
+		d["undo"].pop_front()
+	d["redo"].clear()
+	_fresh = null
+	if clip != "":
+		d["changed"][clip] = true
+
+
+## The clip showing, ready to change (a copy the first time in an edit: what undo holds stays as it was).
+func _writable() -> Animation:
+	var d := _doc()
+	var a: Animation = d["clips"][clip]
+	if a != _fresh:
+		a = a.duplicate(true)
+		d["clips"][clip] = a
+		_fresh = a
+	return a
+
+
+func _after_edit() -> void:
+	_update_dirty()
+	_fill_clips()
+	_refresh_keys()
+	_sync_clip_fields()
+	_apply()
+
+
+func _snap(d: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"clips": d["clips"].duplicate(), "order": d["order"].duplicate(), "changed": d["changed"].duplicate(),
+		"removed": d["removed"].duplicate(), "clip": clip, "frame": frame}
+
+
+func _restore(d: Dictionary, s: Dictionary) -> void:
+	for k in ["clips", "order", "changed", "removed"]:
+		d[k] = s[k].duplicate()
+	_fresh = null
+	var f: int = s["frame"]
+	select_clip(str(s["clip"]) if d["clips"].has(s["clip"]) else (str(d["order"][0]) if not d["order"].is_empty() else ""))
+	set_frame(f)
+	_update_dirty()
+
+
+func undo() -> void:
+	var d := _doc()
+	if d.is_empty() or d["undo"].is_empty():
+		return
+	d["redo"].append(_snap(d))
+	_restore(d, d["undo"].pop_back())
+	_say("undone")
+
+
+func redo() -> void:
+	var d := _doc()
+	if d.is_empty() or d["redo"].is_empty():
+		return
+	d["undo"].append(_snap(d))
+	_restore(d, d["redo"].pop_back())
+	_say("redone")
+
+
+func _update_dirty() -> void:
+	dirty = false
+	for id in _docs:
+		var d: Dictionary = _docs[id]
+		if not d["changed"].is_empty() or not d["removed"].is_empty():
+			dirty = true
+	_refresh_header()
+
+
+func _refresh_header() -> void:
+	if _save_btn == null:
+		return
+	_save_btn.disabled = not EditTarget.writable()
+	var d := _doc()
+	_undo_btn.disabled = d.is_empty() or d["undo"].is_empty()
+	_redo_btn.disabled = d.is_empty() or d["redo"].is_empty()
+
+
+func _say(msg: String) -> void:
+	if _note:
+		_note.text = (msg + "  -  " if msg != "" else "") + "saving into " + EditTarget.label() + ("  (unsaved changes)" if dirty else "")
+
+
+# --- Saving ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Writes every changed clip (art/<id>_3d/clips/<clip>.tres, through EditTarget) and
+## deletes the files of clips deleted; the game's models use them from now on.
+func save() -> bool:
+	if not EditTarget.writable():
+		_say("can't save here: make a mod (the Mod Editor)")
+		return false
+	var wrote := 0
+	var failed := 0
+	for id in _docs:
+		var d: Dictionary = _docs[id]
+		if d["changed"].is_empty() and d["removed"].is_empty():
+			continue
+		var dir := Stage3D.clips_dir(id)
+		for name in d["removed"]:
+			if d["changed"].has(name):
+				continue
+			var p := EditTarget.write_path(dir + name + ".tres")
+			if FileAccess.file_exists(p):
+				DirAccess.remove_absolute(p)
+			d["files"].erase(name)
+		for name in d["changed"]:
+			var a: Animation = d["clips"][name]
+			var p := EditTarget.write_path(dir + name + ".tres")
+			DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(p.get_base_dir())   # (the game's own clips/ folder, the first time)
+			var out: Animation = a.duplicate(true)   # (a clean resource: no path, the model's or another file's)
+			out.resource_name = name
+			if ResourceSaver.save(out, p) == OK:
+				d["files"][name] = true
+				wrote += 1
+			else:
+				failed += 1
+		d["changed"].clear()
+		d["removed"].clear()
+		Stage3D.forget_clips(id)   # (the game's models take the files from now on)
+		if id == char_id and _ap:
+			Stage3D.use_clips(_ap, id)
+	_update_dirty()
+	_fill_clips()
+	_sync_clip_fields()
+	_say(("saved %d clip%s" % [wrote, "" if wrote == 1 else "s"]) + (" (%d failed)" % failed if failed > 0 else ""))
+	return failed == 0
+
+
+## Drops every unsaved edit (the clips as saved).
+func discard() -> void:
+	_docs.clear()
+	dirty = false
+	_fresh = null
+	if char_id != "":
+		Stage3D.forget_clips(char_id)
+		_show_model(char_id)
+	_refresh_header()
+
+
+## Asks about unsaved changes (save / discard / stay), then `next`.
+func guard(next: Callable) -> void:
+	if not dirty:
+		next.call()
+		return
+	UI.unsaved(self, "The animation editor", func(): save(), discard, next)
+
+
+## The Mod Editor switched mods: save into the new one (re-read when nothing's unsaved).
+func target_changed() -> void:
+	if not dirty and char_id != "":
+		_docs.clear()
+		Stage3D.forget_clips(char_id)
+		_show_model(char_id)
+	_refresh_header()
+	_say("")
+
+
+func talos_shown() -> void:
+	_redraw()
+	_refresh_header()
+
+
+# --- Keys ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _bone_name(b: int) -> String:
+	return _sk.get_bone_name(b) if _sk and b >= 0 and b < _sk.get_bone_count() else ""
+
+
+## The track of `type` for bone `b` in `a` (-1: none).
+func _track(a: Animation, b: int, type: int) -> int:
+	return a.find_track(NodePath(_prefix + ":" + _bone_name(b)), type)
+
+
+## The bone's tracks in `a` (position, rotation, scale).
+func _bone_tracks(a: Animation, b: int) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	for type in [Animation.TYPE_POSITION_3D, Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D, Animation.TYPE_SCALE_3D]:
+		var t := _track(a, b, type)
+		if t >= 0:
+			out.append(t)
+	return out
+
+
+func _key_at(a: Animation, t: int, f: int) -> int:
+	for k in a.track_get_key_count(t):
+		if roundi(a.track_get_key_time(t, k) * _fps) == f:
+			return k
+	return -1
+
+
+func _add_track(a: Animation, b: int, type: int) -> int:
+	var t := a.add_track(type)
+	a.track_set_path(t, NodePath(_prefix + ":" + _bone_name(b)))
+	a.track_set_interpolation_type(t, Animation.INTERPOLATION_LINEAR)
+	return t
+
+
+## Sets bone `b`'s key of `type` at frame `f` (a track made when it has none).
+func _set_key(a: Animation, b: int, type: int, f: int, value: Variant) -> void:
+	var t := _track(a, b, type)
+	if t < 0:
+		t = _add_track(a, b, type)
+	var k := _key_at(a, t, f)
+	if k >= 0:
+		a.track_set_key_value(t, k, value)
+	else:
+		a.track_insert_key(t, f / _fps, value)
+
+
+## Bone `b`'s key value of `type` at frame `f` in the clip showing (null: no key there).
+func key_value(b: Variant, f: int, type := Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D) -> Variant:
+	var a := anim()
+	var i: int = _sk.find_bone(b) if b is String else int(b)
+	if a == null or i < 0:
+		return null
+	var t := _track(a, i, type)
+	if t < 0:
+		return null
+	var k := _key_at(a, t, f)
+	return a.track_get_key_value(t, k) if k >= 0 else null
+
+
+## The bone's pose shown now: {rot, pos}.
+func bone_pose(b: int) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"rot": _sk.get_bone_pose_rotation(b), "pos": _sk.get_bone_pose_position(b)}
+
+
+func _keys_bone(a: Animation, b: int) -> void:
+	var p := bone_pose(b)
+	_set_key(a, b, Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D, frame, p["rot"])
+	if _track(a, b, Animation.TYPE_POSITION_3D) >= 0 or (pose.has(b) and pose[b].has("pos")):
+		_set_key(a, b, Animation.TYPE_POSITION_3D, frame, p["pos"])
+
+
+## Keys the selected bone (or `b`) at this frame - its pose as shown.
+func key_bone(b := -2) -> void:
+	if b == -2:
+		b = bone
+	if anim() == null or b < 0:
+		_say("select a bone first" if anim() != null else "no clip")
+		return
+	_edit()
+	_keys_bone(_writable(), b)
+	pose.erase(b)
+	_after_edit()
+	_say("keyed %s at %d" % [_bone_name(b), frame])
+
+
+## Keys every bone at this frame.
+func key_all() -> void:
+	if anim() == null:
+		return
+	_edit()
+	var a := _writable()
+	for b in _sk.get_bone_count():
+		_keys_bone(a, b)
+	pose.clear()
+	_after_edit()
+	_say("keyed every bone at %d" % frame)
+
+
+## Gives bone `b` a pose (not keyed till K - or at once with Auto-key).
+func pose_bone(b: int, rot: Variant = null, pos: Variant = null) -> void:
+	if b < 0:
+		return
+	var p: Dictionary = pose.get(b, {})
+	if rot != null:
+		p["rot"] = (rot as Quaternion).normalized()
+	if pos != null:
+		p["pos"] = pos
+	pose[b] = p
+	_apply()
+	if auto_key and anim() != null:
+		key_bone(b)
+
+
+func clear_pose() -> void:
+	pose.clear()
+	_apply()
+
+
+func rest_bone() -> void:
+	if bone >= 0:
+		var r := _sk.get_bone_rest(bone)
+		pose_bone(bone, r.basis.get_rotation_quaternion(), r.origin)
+
+
+func set_interpolation(i: int) -> void:
+	var a := anim()
+	if a == null or bone < 0 or _bone_tracks(a, bone).is_empty():
+		return
+	_edit()
+	a = _writable()
+	for t in _bone_tracks(a, bone):
+		a.track_set_interpolation_type(t, [Animation.INTERPOLATION_LINEAR, Animation.INTERPOLATION_CUBIC, Animation.INTERPOLATION_NEAREST][i])
+	_after_edit()
+
+
+## The selected keys (or the bone's key at this frame): every track of the bone there.
+func _picked() -> Array:
+	if not sel_keys.is_empty():
+		return sel_keys.keys()
+	return [Vector2i(bone, frame)] if bone >= 0 else []
+
+
+func delete_keys() -> void:
+	var a := anim()
+	var picked := _picked()
+	if a == null or picked.is_empty():
+		return
+	_edit()
+	a = _writable()
+	for v in picked:
+		for t in _bone_tracks(a, v.x):
+			var k := _key_at(a, t, v.y)
+			if k >= 0:
+				a.track_remove_key(t, k)
+	sel_keys.clear()
+	_after_edit()
+
+
+## Moves the selected keys `by` frames (keys where they land replaced).
+func move_keys(by: int) -> void:
+	var a := anim()
+	if a == null or by == 0 or sel_keys.is_empty():
+		return
+	_edit()
+	a = _writable()
+	var moving: Array = []                # [track, to frame, value]
+	for v in sel_keys:
+		for t in _bone_tracks(a, v.x):
+			var k := _key_at(a, t, v.y)
+			if k >= 0:
+				moving.append([t, maxi(0, v.y + by), a.track_get_key_value(t, k)])
+				a.track_remove_key(t, k)
+	for m in moving:
+		var k := _key_at(a, m[0], m[1])
+		if k >= 0:
+			a.track_remove_key(m[0], k)
+		a.track_insert_key(m[0], m[1] / _fps, m[2])
+	var moved := {}
+	for v in sel_keys:
+		moved[Vector2i(v.x, maxi(0, v.y + by))] = true
+	sel_keys = moved
+	_after_edit()
+
+
+func copy() -> void:
+	var a := anim()
+	if a == null:
+		return
+	if sel_keys.is_empty():
+		copy_pose()
+		return
+	var lo := 1 << 30
+	for v in sel_keys:
+		lo = mini(lo, v.y)
+	var items: Array = []
+	for v in sel_keys:
+		for t in _bone_tracks(a, v.x):
+			var k := _key_at(a, t, v.y)
+			if k >= 0:
+				items.append({"bone": _bone_name(v.x), "type": a.track_get_type(t), "df": v.y - lo, "value": a.track_get_key_value(t, k)})
+	clipboard = {"kind": "keys", "items": items}
+	_say("copied %d keys" % sel_keys.size())
+
+
+func copy_pose() -> void:
+	if _sk == null:
+		return
+	var bones := {}
+	var a := anim()
+	for b in _sk.get_bone_count():
+		var p := bone_pose(b)
+		var e := {"rot": p["rot"]}
+		if a != null and _track(a, b, Animation.TYPE_POSITION_3D) >= 0:
+			e["pos"] = p["pos"]
+		bones[_bone_name(b)] = e
+	clipboard = {"kind": "pose", "bones": bones}
+	_say("copied the pose at %d" % frame)
+
+
+func paste() -> void:
+	if anim() == null or clipboard.is_empty():
+		return
+	_edit()
+	var a := _writable()
+	if clipboard["kind"] == "keys":
+		for it in clipboard["items"]:
+			var b := _sk.find_bone(it["bone"])
+			if b >= 0:
+				_set_key(a, b, it["type"], frame + int(it["df"]), it["value"])
+	else:
+		for n in clipboard["bones"]:
+			var b := _sk.find_bone(n)
+			if b < 0:
+				continue
+			var e: Dictionary = clipboard["bones"][n]
+			_set_key(a, b, Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D, frame, e["rot"])
+			if e.has("pos"):
+				_set_key(a, b, Animation.TYPE_POSITION_3D, frame, e["pos"])
+	pose.clear()
+	_after_edit()
+	_say("pasted at %d" % frame)
+
+
+## Each bone's key frames, for the dope sheet.
+func _refresh_keys() -> void:
+	_rows = []
+	var a := anim()
+	if _sk == null:
+		return
+	for b in _sk.get_bone_count():
+		var fs := {}
+		if a != null:
+			for t in _bone_tracks(a, b):
+				for k in a.track_get_key_count(t):
+					fs[roundi(a.track_get_key_time(t, k) * _fps)] = true
+		var arr := PackedInt32Array(fs.keys())
+		arr.sort()
+		_rows.append(arr)
+	if _sheet:
+		_sheet.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func rows() -> Array:
+	return _rows
+
+
+# --- Time ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func set_frame(f: int) -> void:
+	var n := frames()
+	f = clampi(f, 0, maxi(0, n - 1))
+	frame = f
+	time = f / _fps
+	pose.clear()
+	_apply()
+
+
+func step(by: int) -> void:
+	playing = false
+	var n := frames()
+	if n <= 0:
+		return
+	set_frame(posmod(frame + by, n) if loop_play else frame + by)
+
+
+func jump_key(dir: int) -> void:
+	var fs := {}
+	for b in _rows.size():
+		if bone >= 0 and b != bone:
+			continue
+		for f in _rows[b]:
+			fs[f] = true
+	var best := -1
+	for f in fs:
+		if (dir > 0 and f > frame and (best < 0 or f < best)) or (dir < 0 and f < frame and (best < 0 or f > best)):
+			best = f
+	if best >= 0:
+		playing = false
+		set_frame(best)
+
+
+func toggle_play() -> void:
+	if anim() == null:
+		return
+	playing = not playing
+	pose.clear()
+	if playing and frame >= frames() - 1 and not loop_play:
+		time = 0.0
+	_play_btn.icon = EditorIcons.get_icon("stop" if playing else "play")
+	_apply()
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if _loading != "":
+		var path := Stage3D.model_dir(_loading) + _loading + ".glb"
+		var st := ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get_status(path)
+		if st == ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_LOADED:
+			Stage3D._scenes[_loading] = ResourceLoader.load_threaded_get(path)
+			_show_model(_loading)
+		elif st != ResourceLoader.THREAD_LOAD_IN_PROGRESS:
+			_show_model(_loading)   # (failed on the worker: loaded here)
+		return
+	if not playing:
+		return
+	var a := anim()
+	if a == null:
+		playing = false
+		return
+	time += delta * speed
+	var end := a.length
+	if time >= end:
+		if loop_play and end > 0.0:
+			time = fmod(time, end)
+		else:
+			time = end
+			playing = false
+			_play_btn.icon = EditorIcons.get_icon("play")
+	frame = clampi(int(time * _fps + 0.0001), 0, maxi(0, frames() - 1))
+	_apply()
+
+
+# --- The pose and the view -------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Poses the skeleton as the clip has it at `t` (Godot's own interpolation).
+func _sample(a: Animation, t: float) -> void:
+	_sk.reset_bone_poses()
+	if a == null:
+		return
+	for tr in a.get_track_count():
+		if a.track_get_key_count(tr) == 0 or not a.track_is_enabled(tr):
+			continue
+		var b := _sk.find_bone(String(a.track_get_path(tr).get_concatenated_subnames()))
+		if b < 0:
+			continue
+		match a.track_get_type(tr):
+			Animation.TYPE_POSITION_3D:
+				_sk.set_bone_pose_position(b, a.position_track_interpolate(tr, t))
+			Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D:
+				_sk.set_bone_pose_rotation(b, a.rotation_track_interpolate(tr, t))
+			Animation.TYPE_SCALE_3D:
+				_sk.set_bone_pose_scale(b, a.scale_track_interpolate(tr, t))
+
+
+## The pose shown now: the clip at this time, plus the pose not keyed yet.
+func _apply() -> void:
+	if _sk == null:
+		return
+	_sample(anim(), time)
+	for b in pose:
+		if pose[b].has("rot"):
+			_sk.set_bone_pose_rotation(b, pose[b]["rot"])
+		if pose[b].has("pos"):
+			_sk.set_bone_pose_position(b, pose[b]["pos"])
+	_sync_bone_fields()
+	if _frame_label:
+		_frame_label.text = "%d / %d" % [frame, maxi(0, frames() - 1)]
+	_redraw()
+
+
+func _redraw() -> void:
+	if _vp:
+		_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+	if _view:
+		_view.queue_redraw()
+	if _sheet:
+		_sheet.head.queue_redraw()
+	_refresh_header()
+
+
+## Every bone's place on screen now (Vector2 per bone).
+func screen_bones() -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	if _sk == null or _cam == null:
+		return out
+	var g := _sk.global_transform
+	for b in _sk.get_bone_count():
+		var p := g * _sk.get_bone_global_pose(b).origin
+		out.append(_cam.unproject_position(p) if not _cam.is_position_behind(p) else Vector2(-9999, -9999))
+	return out
+
+
+## Bone `b` drawn from its place to its first child's (a leaf: a short stub along it).
+func bone_tail(b: int, pts: Array) -> Vector2:
+	if not _children[b].is_empty():
+		return pts[_children[b][0]]
+	var g := _sk.global_transform * _sk.get_bone_global_pose(b)
+	var tip := g * Vector3(0, 0.08, 0)
+	return _cam.unproject_position(tip)
+
+
+## The ghosts' bones on screen: [[frame offset, points]...] (the onion skin).
+func onion_bones() -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	var a := anim()
+	if not onion or a == null:
+		return out
+	var n := frames()
+	for off in ONION:
+		var f: int = frame + off
+		if a.loop_mode != Animation.LOOP_NONE:
+			f = posmod(f, n)
+		elif f < 0 or f >= n:
+			continue
+		_sample(a, f / _fps)
+		out.append([off, screen_bones()])
+	_apply_quiet()
+	return out
+
+
+## The pose put back without a redraw (after the onion skin's sampling).
+func _apply_quiet() -> void:
+	_sample(anim(), time)
+	for b in pose:
+		if pose[b].has("rot"):
+			_sk.set_bone_pose_rotation(b, pose[b]["rot"])
+		if pose[b].has("pos"):
+			_sk.set_bone_pose_position(b, pose[b]["pos"])
+
+
+## The bone nearest `at` on screen (within 14 px), or -1.
+func pick(at: Vector2) -> int:
+	var pts := screen_bones()
+	var best := -1
+	var best_d := 14.0
+	for b in pts.size():
+		var a: Vector2 = pts[b]
+		var d := Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(at, a, bone_tail(b, pts)).distance_to(at)
+		d = minf(d, a.distance_to(at) - 2.0)
+		if d < best_d:
+			best_d = d
+			best = b
+	return best
+
+
+func select_bone(b: Variant) -> void:
+	bone = _sk.find_bone(b) if b is String else int(b)
+	_sync_bone_fields()
+	_redraw()
+	if _sheet:
+		_sheet.show_bone(bone)
+		_sheet.queue_redraw()
+
+
+func _sync_bone_fields() -> void:
+	if _bone_label == null:
+		return
+	_syncing = true
+	var on := bone >= 0 and _sk != null
+	_bone_label.text = (_bone_name(bone) + ("  (not keyed)" if pose.has(bone) else "")) if on else "(click a bone)"
+	if on:
+		var p := bone_pose(bone)
+		var e: Vector3 = (p["rot"] as Quaternion).get_euler()
+		for i in 3:
+			_rot[i].value = rad_to_deg(e[i])
+			_pos[i].value = p["pos"][i]
+		var a := anim()
+		var ts := _bone_tracks(a, bone) if a else []
+		if not ts.is_empty():
+			var it := a.track_get_interpolation_type(ts[0])
+			_interp.select(2 if it == Animation.INTERPOLATION_NEAREST else (1 if it in [Animation.INTERPOLATION_CUBIC, Animation.INTERPOLATION_CUBIC_ANGLE] else 0))
+	for s in _rot + _pos:
+		s.editable = on
+	_interp.disabled = not on
+	_syncing = false
+
+
+func _fields_changed(which: String) -> void:
+	if bone < 0:
+		return
+	if which == "rot":
+		var e := Vector3(deg_to_rad(_rot[0].value), deg_to_rad(_rot[1].value), deg_to_rad(_rot[2].value))
+		pose_bone(bone, Quaternion.from_euler(e))
+	else:
+		pose_bone(bone, null, Vector3(_pos[0].value, _pos[1].value, _pos[2].value))
+
+
+## The camera: orbiting `target` at `dist`, `yaw` round, `pitch` up.
+func _aim() -> void:
+	if _cam == null:
+		return
+	var dir := Vector3(sin(yaw) * cos(pitch), sin(pitch), cos(yaw) * cos(pitch))
+	_cam.look_at_from_position(target + dir * dist, target, Vector3.UP)
+	_redraw()
+
+
+## Front / side / top.
+func view(which: String) -> void:
+	match which:
+		"front":
+			yaw = 0.0
+			pitch = 0.0
+		"side":
+			yaw = -PI * 0.5
+			pitch = 0.0
+		"top":
+			yaw = 0.0
+			pitch = deg_to_rad(89.0)
+	_aim()
+
+
+## The bone's parent's turn in the world (identity-free: the skeleton's own too).
+func _parent_xf(b: int) -> Transform3D:
+	var g := _sk.global_transform
+	var p := _sk.get_bone_parent(b)
+	return g * _sk.get_bone_global_pose(p) if p >= 0 else g
+
+
+## R / G: starts turning or moving the selected bone with the mouse.
+func start_modal(kind: String) -> void:
+	if bone < 0 or _sk == null:
+		return
+	var p := bone_pose(bone)
+	_modal = {"kind": kind, "axis": -1, "start": _view.get_local_mouse_position(), "rot": p["rot"], "pos": p["pos"], "had": pose.get(bone, {}).duplicate()}
+
+
+func _modal_update(at: Vector2) -> void:
+	var d: Vector2 = at - _modal["start"]
+	var ax: int = _modal["axis"]
+	if _modal["kind"] == "rot":
+		var ang := d.x * deg_to_rad(0.5)
+		var q0: Quaternion = _modal["rot"]
+		var q: Quaternion
+		if ax >= 0:
+			q = q0 * Quaternion([Vector3.RIGHT, Vector3.UP, Vector3.BACK][ax], ang)
+		else:
+			var pb := _parent_xf(bone).basis.orthonormalized()
+			var w := -_cam.global_transform.basis.z
+			q = Quaternion(pb.transposed() * Basis(w, ang) * pb) * q0
+		pose[bone] = {"rot": q.normalized(), "pos": _sk.get_bone_pose_position(bone)} if pose.get(bone, {}).has("pos") else {"rot": q.normalized()}
+		_say("turning %s%s: %.1f deg" % [_bone_name(bone), (" round " + "XYZ"[ax]) if ax >= 0 else "", rad_to_deg(ang)])
+	else:
+		var s := dist * 0.0015
+		var pb := _parent_xf(bone).basis
+		var delta: Vector3
+		if ax >= 0:
+			delta = [Vector3.RIGHT, Vector3.UP, Vector3.BACK][ax] * d.x * s
+		else:
+			var cb := _cam.global_transform.basis
+			delta = pb.inverse() * (cb.x * d.x * s - cb.y * d.y * s)
+		var e: Dictionary = pose.get(bone, {}).duplicate()
+		e["pos"] = (_modal["pos"] as Vector3) + delta
+		pose[bone] = e
+		_say("moving %s%s" % [_bone_name(bone), (" along " + "XYZ"[ax]) if ax >= 0 else ""])
+	_apply()
+
+
+func end_modal(keep: bool) -> void:
+	if _modal.is_empty():
+		return
+	if not keep:
+		if (_modal["had"] as Dictionary).is_empty():
+			pose.erase(bone)
+		else:
+			pose[bone] = _modal["had"]
+		_modal = {}
+		_apply()
+		_say("")
+		return
+	_modal = {}
+	if auto_key and anim() != null:
+		key_bone(bone)
+	else:
+		_apply()
+		_say("%s posed - K keys it" % _bone_name(bone))
+
+
+func view_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
+	if mb and mb.pressed:
+		if not _modal.is_empty():
+			end_modal(mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT)
+			return
+		match mb.button_index:
+			MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+				if mb.alt_pressed:
+					_drag = "orbit"
+				else:
+					var b := pick(mb.position)
+					if b >= 0 or not mb.shift_pressed:
+						select_bone(b)
+			MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
+				_drag = "pan" if mb.shift_pressed else "orbit"
+			MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE:
+				_drag = "pan"
+			MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
+				dist = maxf(0.4, dist * 0.9)
+				_aim()
+			MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
+				dist = minf(30.0, dist * 1.1)
+				_aim()
+	elif mb and not mb.pressed:
+		_drag = ""
+	var mm := event as InputEventMouseMotion
+	if mm:
+		if not _modal.is_empty():
+			_modal_update(mm.position)
+		elif _drag == "orbit":
+			yaw -= mm.relative.x * 0.01
+			pitch = clampf(pitch + mm.relative.y * 0.01, deg_to_rad(-89.0), deg_to_rad(89.0))
+			_aim()
+		elif _drag == "pan":
+			var cb := _cam.global_transform.basis
+			target += (-cb.x * mm.relative.x + cb.y * mm.relative.y) * dist * 0.0015
+			_aim()
+
+
+# --- Keys ------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not is_visible_in_tree() or has_meta("talos_parked"):
+		return
+	var k := event as InputEventKey
+	if k == null or not k.pressed:
+		return
+	if k.echo and k.keycode not in [KEY_LEFT, KEY_RIGHT]:
+		return
+	var handled := true
+	if not _modal.is_empty():
+		match k.keycode:
+			KEY_X, KEY_Y, KEY_Z:
+				_modal["axis"] = {KEY_X: 0, KEY_Y: 1, KEY_Z: 2}[k.keycode]
+				_modal_update(_view.get_local_mouse_position())
+			KEY_ENTER, KEY_KP_ENTER:
+				end_modal(true)
+			KEY_ESCAPE:
+				end_modal(false)
+			_:
+				handled = false
+	elif k.ctrl_pressed:
+		match k.keycode:
+			KEY_S:
+				save()
+			KEY_Z:
+				if k.shift_pressed:
+					redo()
+				else:
+					undo()
+			KEY_Y:
+				redo()
+			KEY_C:
+				if k.shift_pressed:
+					copy_pose()
+				else:
+					copy()
+			KEY_V:
+				paste()
+			KEY_LEFT:
+				jump_key(-1)
+			KEY_RIGHT:
+				jump_key(1)
+			_:
+				handled = false
+	else:
+		match k.keycode:
+			KEY_SPACE:
+				toggle_play()
+			KEY_LEFT:
+				step(-1)
+			KEY_RIGHT:
+				step(1)
+			KEY_HOME:
+				set_frame(0)
+			KEY_END:
+				set_frame(frames() - 1)
+			KEY_K:
+				if k.shift_pressed:
+					key_all()
+				else:
+					key_bone()
+			KEY_R:
+				if k.alt_pressed:
+					clear_pose()
+				else:
+					start_modal("rot")
+			KEY_G:
+				start_modal("pos")
+			KEY_DELETE, KEY_BACKSPACE:
+				delete_keys()
+			KEY_L:
+				_loop_play_check.button_pressed = not loop_play
+			KEY_O:
+				_onion_check.button_pressed = not onion
+			KEY_KP_1:
+				view("front")
+			KEY_KP_3:
+				view("side")
+			KEY_KP_7:
+				view("top")
+			KEY_F1:
+				EditorDocs.open(self, "anim")
+			KEY_ESCAPE:
+				if not sel_keys.is_empty() or bone >= 0:
+					sel_keys.clear()
+					select_bone(-1)
+				elif not embedded:
+					get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()   # (before: leaving may free the scene)
+					TalosNav.go(get_tree(), "menu", guard)
+					return
+				else:
+					handled = false
+			_:
+				handled = false
+	if handled:
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+# --- The view's overlay: the skeleton, picking, the camera -----------------------
+
+class Overlay extends Control:
+	var ed
+
+	func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+		ed.view_input(event)
+		if event is InputEventMouseButton or event is InputEventMouseMotion:
+			accept_event()
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		if ed._sk == null:
+			return
+		for g in ed.onion_bones():
+			var c := Color(0.45, 0.7, 1.0, 0.35) if g[0] < 0 else Color(1.0, 0.7, 0.3, 0.35)
+			_bones(g[1], c, c, 1.5)
+		_bones(ed.screen_bones(), Color(0.9, 0.95, 1.0, 0.75), NeonTheme.PINK, 2.0)
+		if ed.char_id != "" and ed.anim() == null:
+			draw_string(get_theme_default_font(), Vector2(12, 24), "no clip", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, ed.FS, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+
+	func _bones(pts: Array, c: Color, sel: Color, w: float) -> void:
+		for b in pts.size():
+			var a: Vector2 = pts[b]
+			if a.x < -9000:
+				continue
+			var on: bool = b == ed.bone
+			var col: Color = sel if on else c
+			var t: Vector2 = ed.bone_tail(b, pts)
+			draw_line(a, t, Color(0, 0, 0, col.a * 0.6), w + 2.0, true)
+			draw_line(a, t, col, w + (1.5 if on else 0.0), true)
+			draw_circle(a, 3.5 if on else 2.5, col)
+
+
+# --- The dope sheet: bones down the side, keys along time ------------------------
+
+class Sheet extends Control:
+	var ed
+	var head: Control
+	var top_row := 0
+	var _press := ""                   # "scrub" / "keys"
+	var _from := Vector2.ZERO
+	var _by := 0
+
+	func _init() -> void:
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		focus_mode = FOCUS_CLICK   # (a click here takes the keys back from a typed field)
+		head = Head.new()
+		head.sheet = self
+		head.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+		head.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+		add_child(head)
+
+	func px() -> float:
+		return (size.x - ed.NAME_W - 16.0) / float(maxi(1, ed.frames() - 1))
+
+	func fx(f: float) -> float:
+		return ed.NAME_W + 8.0 + f * px()
+
+	func frame_at(x: float) -> int:
+		return clampi(roundi((x - ed.NAME_W - 8.0) / px()), 0, maxi(0, ed.frames() - 1))
+
+	func visible_rows() -> int:
+		return maxi(1, int((size.y - ed.RULER_H) / ed.ROW_H))
+
+	func row_at(y: float) -> int:
+		var r := top_row + int((y - ed.RULER_H) / ed.ROW_H)
+		return r if y >= ed.RULER_H and r < ed.rows().size() else -1
+
+	func show_bone(b: int) -> void:
+		if b < 0:
+			return
+		if b < top_row:
+			top_row = b
+		elif b >= top_row + visible_rows():
+			top_row = b - visible_rows() + 1
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		var font := get_theme_default_font()
+		var fs: int = ed.FS
+		draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color(0.03, 0.025, 0.02, 0.9))
+		var n: int = ed.frames()
+		# The ruler.
+		draw_rect(Rect2(0, 0, size.x, ed.RULER_H), Color(0.08, 0.055, 0.03))
+		var every := 1
+		while every * px() < 34.0:
+			every = [1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 90, 150, 300][mini(9, [1, 2, 5, 10, 15, 30, 60, 90, 150, 300].find(every) + 1)]
+			if every >= 300:
+				break
+		for f in range(0, n, every):
+			var x := fx(f)
+			draw_line(Vector2(x, ed.RULER_H - 6), Vector2(x, ed.RULER_H), UI.TEXT_DIM)
+			draw_string(font, Vector2(x + 2, ed.RULER_H - 7), str(f), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+		draw_string(font, Vector2(6, ed.RULER_H - 7), "bones / frames", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+		# The rows.
+		var rows: Array = ed.rows()
+		var dk := Vector2(5, 0)
+		for i in visible_rows():
+			var b := top_row + i
+			if b >= rows.size():
+				break
+			var y: float = ed.RULER_H + i * ed.ROW_H
+			if b == ed.bone:
+				draw_rect(Rect2(0, y, size.x, ed.ROW_H), Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.22))
+			elif i % 2 == 1:
+				draw_rect(Rect2(0, y, size.x, ed.ROW_H), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.025))
+			draw_string(font, Vector2(6, y + ed.ROW_H - 5), ed._bone_name(b), HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, ed.NAME_W - 10, fs,
+				NeonTheme.PINK if b == ed.bone else NeonTheme.TEXT)
+			var cy: float = y + ed.ROW_H * 0.5
+			for f in rows[b]:
+				if f >= n:
+					continue
+				var picked: bool = ed.sel_keys.has(Vector2i(b, f))
+				var x := fx(f + (_by if picked and _press == "keys" else 0))
+				var r := 5.0 if picked else 4.0
+				draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([Vector2(x, cy - r), Vector2(x + r, cy), Vector2(x, cy + r), Vector2(x - r, cy)]),
+					NeonTheme.PINK if picked else Color(0.85, 0.75, 0.6))
+		draw_line(Vector2(ed.NAME_W, 0), Vector2(ed.NAME_W, size.y), Color(NeonTheme.CYAN, 0.4))
+
+	func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+		var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
+		if mb and mb.pressed:
+			if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN or mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
+				top_row = clampi(top_row + (2 if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN else -2), 0, maxi(0, ed.rows().size() - visible_rows()))
+				queue_redraw()
+				accept_event()
+				return
+			if mb.button_index != MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+				return
+			accept_event()
+			if mb.position.y < ed.RULER_H:
+				_press = "scrub"
+				ed.playing = false
+				ed.set_frame(frame_at(mb.position.x))
+				return
+			var b := row_at(mb.position.y)
+			if b < 0:
+				return
+			if mb.position.x < ed.NAME_W:
+				ed.select_bone(b)
+				return
+			var f := frame_at(mb.position.x)
+			var hit: bool = (ed.rows()[b] as PackedInt32Array).has(f) and absf(fx(f) - mb.position.x) <= 7.0
+			if hit:
+				var v := Vector2i(b, f)
+				if mb.shift_pressed:
+					if ed.sel_keys.has(v):
+						ed.sel_keys.erase(v)
+					else:
+						ed.sel_keys[v] = true
+				elif not ed.sel_keys.has(v):
+					ed.sel_keys = {v: true}
+				ed.bone = b
+				ed._sync_bone_fields()
+				ed._redraw()
+				if not ed.sel_keys.is_empty():
+					_press = "keys"
+					_from = mb.position
+					_by = 0
+			else:
+				if not mb.shift_pressed:
+					ed.sel_keys.clear()
+				ed.select_bone(b)
+				ed.playing = false
+				ed.set_frame(f)
+			queue_redraw()
+		elif mb and not mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+			if _press == "keys" and _by != 0:
+				var by := _by
+				_by = 0
+				ed.move_keys(by)
+			_press = ""
+			_by = 0
+			queue_redraw()
+		var mm := event as InputEventMouseMotion
+		if mm:
+			if _press == "scrub":
+				ed.set_frame(frame_at(mm.position.x))
+			elif _press == "keys":
+				var by := roundi((mm.position.x - _from.x) / px())
+				if by != _by:
+					_by = by
+					queue_redraw()
+
+
+## The playhead (its own layer: the sheet isn't drawn again as it moves).
+class Head extends Control:
+	var sheet
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		var ed = sheet.ed
+		if ed.frames() <= 0:
+			return
+		var x: float = sheet.fx(ed.time * ed._fps) if ed.playing else sheet.fx(ed.frame)
+		draw_line(Vector2(x, 0), Vector2(x, size.y), NeonTheme.CYAN, 2.0)
+		draw_rect(Rect2(x - 12, 2, 24, ed.RULER_H - 4), NeonTheme.CYAN)
+		var s := str(ed.frame)
+		var font := get_theme_default_font()
+		var w := font.get_string_size(s, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, ed.FS).x
+		draw_string(font, Vector2(x - w * 0.5, ed.RULER_H - 7), s, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, ed.FS, NeonTheme.INK)

files.explanation: Where Talos's tools read and save: the game (from its project folder) or the mod the Mod Editor is on.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,60 @@ 
+class_name EditTarget
+extends RefCounted
+## Where Talos's tools (the mesh and animation editors) read and save: the game
+## itself (res://, when it runs from its project folder) or a mod (the Mod Editor
+## sets `mod_id`: user://mods/<id>/files/, laid out like the game - Mods lays it
+## over the game as it starts).
+##   EditTarget.write_path("res://art/x.glb")  -> where saving x.glb goes now
+##   EditTarget.read_path("res://art/x.glb")   -> the mod's copy if it has one, else the game's
+
+## "" - the game itself; else the mod being made.
+static var mod_id := ""
+
+
+static func is_mod() -> bool:
+	return mod_id != ""
+
+
+## The game's own files can be saved: running from the project folder (not an exported game).
+static func game_writable() -> bool:
+	return not OS.has_feature("template")
+
+
+## Saving's possible now (a mod - always; the game - from its project folder).
+static func writable() -> bool:
+	return is_mod() or game_writable()
+
+
+## The folder res:// maps to now.
+static func root() -> String:
+	return Mods.files_dir(mod_id) if is_mod() else "res://"
+
+
+## Where `res_path` (res://...) is saved now (its folder made).
+static func write_path(res_path: String) -> String:
+	if not is_mod():
+		return res_path
+	var p := root() + res_path.trim_prefix("res://")
+	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(p.get_base_dir())
+	return p
+
+
+## Where `res_path` is read from now: the mod's copy, if it has one.
+static func read_path(res_path: String) -> String:
+	if is_mod():
+		var p := root() + res_path.trim_prefix("res://")
+		if FileAccess.file_exists(p):
+			return p
+	return res_path
+
+
+## The mod has its own copy of `res_path`.
+static func overridden(res_path: String) -> bool:
+	return is_mod() and FileAccess.file_exists(root() + res_path.trim_prefix("res://"))
+
+
+## Saving now goes to (for a tool's header): "the game" / "mod: <name>".
+static func label() -> String:
+	if not is_mod():
+		return "the game" if game_writable() else "nowhere (an exported game: make a mod)"
+	return "mod: " + str(Mods.info(mod_id).get("name", mod_id))

+## again and again, a looping one running; orbit, zoom, a ground under it or

+	sc.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Preview scale", "", "Plays it this many times its size (as the game scales an explosion to a ship's).\nOnly the view: not saved.")
+	sc.value_changed.connect(func(v): preview_scale = v; replay())
+	row.add_child(sc)
+	row.add_child(_btn("Frame", "fit_all", "F", "Zooms to fit the effect.", frame))
+	var hint := UI.label("drag: orbit - wheel: zoom", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	hint.clip_text = true
+	hint.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	row.add_child(hint)
+	box.add_child(row)
+	var holder := Control.new()
+	holder.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	holder.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(320, 240)
+	holder.clip_contents = true
+	box.add_child(holder)
+	var vpc := SubViewportContainer.new()
+	vpc.stretch = true
+	vpc.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	vpc.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	holder.add_child(vpc)
+	_vp = SubViewport.new()
+	_vp.own_world_3d = true
+	_vp.msaa_3d = Viewport.MSAA_2X
+	_vp.positional_shadow_atlas_size = 0
+	_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+	vpc.add_child(_vp)
+	var env := Environment.new()
+	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
+	env.background_color = Color(0.02, 0.022, 0.03)
+	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
+	env.ambient_light_color = Color(0.55, 0.6, 0.7)
+	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.5
+	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_FILMIC
+	env.glow_enabled = true
+	env.glow_bloom = 0.1

+	pm.size = Vector2(400, 400)
+	_ground.mesh = pm

+	gm.albedo_color = Color(0.42, 0.38, 0.32)

+	_ground.material_override = gm
+	_ground.visible = ground

+	_stage.name = "Stage"
+	_vp.add_child(_stage)

+
+
+func _btn(name: String, icon: String, keys: String, help: String, cb: Callable) -> Button:
+	var b := UI.button("", cb, 14)
+	b.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	return EditorIcons.dress(b, icon, EditorIcons.tip(name, keys, help))
+
+
+# --- The effects ------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _fill_list() -> void:
+	if _list == null:
+		return
+	_list.clear()
+	for n in Fx.names():
+		var d := Fx.def(n)
+		var i := _list.add_item("%s  (%d)" % [n, (d.get("emitters", []) as Array).size()])
+		_list.set_item_metadata(i, n)
+		_list.set_item_tooltip(i, str(d.get("about", "")))
+		if n == current:
+			_list.select(i)
+
+
+func select(name: String) -> void:
+	current = name
+	if _name_edit:
+		_name_edit.text = name
+	_fill_list()
+	if _params:
+		_params.show_effect(name)
+	replay()
+	frame()
+	_refresh_header()
+
+
+func _unique(base: String) -> String:
+	var n := base
+	var k := 2
+	while Fx.has(n):
+		n = "%s_%d" % [base, k]
+		k += 1
+	return n
+
+
+func new_effect(copy: bool) -> void:
+	_push("")
+	var d: Dictionary
+	var n: String
+	if copy and current != "":
+		d = Fx.def(current).duplicate(true)
+		n = _unique(current + "_copy")
+	else:
+		var e := Fx.new_emitter()
+		e["name"] = "glow"
+		e["velocity"] = [0.0, 0.0]
+		e["scale"] = [3.0, 3.0]
+		e["amount"] = 1
+		e["lifetime"] = 0.6
+		e["colors"] = [[0.0, "#ffd8a0ff"], [1.0, "#ff804000"]]
+		e["emissive"] = 2.0
+		d = {"about": "", "emitters": [e]}
+		n = _unique("effect")
+	Fx.set_def(n, d)
+	_after_edit()
+	select(n)
+	_say("new effect: " + n)
+
+
+func rename_effect(to: String) -> void:
+	to = to.strip_edges().replace(" ", "_")
+	if current == "" or to == current:
+		return
+	if to == "" or Fx.has(to):
+		_say("can't rename: that name's taken" if to != "" else "")
+		_name_edit.text = current
+		return
+	_push("")
+	Fx.rename(current, to)
+	if _fx and is_instance_valid(_fx):
+		_fx.effect = to
+	current = to
+	_after_edit()
+	_fill_list()
+
+
+func delete_effect() -> void:
+	if current == "":
+		return
+	_push("")
+	var i := Fx.names().find(current)
+	Fx.remove(current)
+	_after_edit()
+	var names := Fx.names()
+	select(str(names[clampi(i, 0, names.size() - 1)]) if not names.is_empty() else "")
+
+
+# --- The view ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Plays the effect again: a one-shot from its start, a looping one attached.
+func replay() -> void:
+	if _stage == null:
+		return
+	if _fx and is_instance_valid(_fx):
+		_fx.queue_free()
+	_fx = null
+	_gap = 0.0
+	if current == "" or not Fx.has(current):
+		return
+	if looping(current):
+		_fx = Fx.attach(current, _stage)
+		_fx.scale = Vector3.ONE * preview_scale
+		_fx.scale_k = preview_scale
+	else:
+		_fx = Fx.new()
+		_fx.effect = current
+		_fx.keep = true   # (replayed here: never pooled for the game's use)
+		_stage.add_child(_fx)
+		_fx.scale = Vector3.ONE * preview_scale
+		_fx.scale_k = preview_scale
+		_fx.play()
+
+
+## The effect has emitters that keep emitting.
+static func looping(name: String) -> bool:
+	for e in Fx.def(name).get("emitters", []):
+		if e is Dictionary and not bool(Fx.val(e, "one_shot")):
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## How far the effect reaches (m, at scale 1): its fastest particles' flight, its biggest.
+static func reach(name: String) -> float:
+	var r := 1.0
+	for e in Fx.def(name).get("emitters", []):
+		if not e is Dictionary:
+			continue
+		var v := Fx._rng2(Fx.val(e, "velocity"))
+		var s := Fx._rng2(Fx.val(e, "scale"), Vector2.ONE)
+		var dm := Fx._rng2(Fx.val(e, "damping"))
+		var life := float(Fx.val(e, "lifetime"))
+		var sp := (v.x + v.y) * 0.5
+		var fly := sp * life if dm.x <= 0.0 else minf(sp * life, sp * sp / (2.0 * dm.x))
+		if str(Fx.val(e, "material")) == "spark":
+			fly *= 0.3   # (sparks fly far, thin: framed on the body of it)
+		r = maxf(r, float(Fx.val(e, "size")) + fly * 0.7 + s.y * 0.5)
+	return r
+
+
+func frame() -> void:
+	dist = clampf(reach(current) * preview_scale * 2.4, 3.0, 1500.0)
+	_aim()
+
+
+func _aim() -> void:
+	if _cam == null:
+		return
+	var at := Vector3(0, reach(current) * preview_scale * 0.25 if ground else 0.0, 0)
+	var from := at + Vector3(cos(pitch) * sin(yaw), sin(pitch), cos(pitch) * cos(yaw)) * dist
+	_cam.transform = Transform3D(Basis.looking_at(at - from, Vector3.UP), from)
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if _vp:
+		_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE   # (drawn while showing; a parked tool stops processing - and drawing)
+	if _fx and is_instance_valid(_fx) and not _fx.attached and not _fx.playing and loop_play:
+		_gap += delta
+		if _gap > 0.4:
+			_gap = 0.0
+			_fx.play()
+
+
+# --- Edits and undo ---------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _before_edit(key: String) -> void:
+	var now := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	if key != "" and key == _last_key and now - _last_t < int(MERGE_S * 1000.0):
+		_last_t = now
+		return
+	_last_key = key
+	_last_t = now
+	_push(key)
+
+
+func _push(_key: String) -> void:
+	_undo.append({"defs": Fx.snapshot(), "current": current})
+	if _undo.size() > UNDO_MAX:
+		_undo.pop_front()
+	_redo.clear()
+	if _key == "":
+		_last_key = ""
+
+
+func _after_edit() -> void:
+	dirty = Fx.dirty
+	_fill_list()
+	_refresh_header()
+	_say("")
+	if _fx and is_instance_valid(_fx) and looping(current) != _fx.attached:
+		replay()
+
+
+func undo() -> void:
+	if _undo.is_empty():
+		return
+	_redo.append({"defs": Fx.snapshot(), "current": current})
+	_restore(_undo.pop_back())
+	_say("undone")
+
+
+func redo() -> void:
+	if _redo.is_empty():
+		return
+	_undo.append({"defs": Fx.snapshot(), "current": current})
+	_restore(_redo.pop_back())
+	_say("redone")
+
+
+func _restore(s: Dictionary) -> void:
+	Fx.restore(s["defs"])
+	_last_key = ""
+	dirty = true
+	var c := str(s["current"])
+	select(c if Fx.has(c) else (str(Fx.names()[0]) if not Fx.names().is_empty() else ""))
+
+
+func _refresh_header() -> void:
+	if _save_btn == null:
+		return
+	_save_btn.disabled = not EditTarget.writable()
+	_undo_btn.disabled = _undo.is_empty()
+	_redo_btn.disabled = _redo.is_empty()
+
+
+func _say(msg: String) -> void:
+	if _note:
+		_note.text = (msg + "  -  " if msg != "" else "") + "saving into " + EditTarget.label() + ("  (unsaved changes)" if dirty else "")
+
+
+# --- Saving -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func save() -> bool:
+	if not EditTarget.writable():
+		_say("can't save here: make a mod (the Mod Editor)")
+		return false
+	if not Fx.save():
+		_say("couldn't write data/effects.json")
+		return false
+	dirty = false
+	_refresh_header()
+	_say("saved %d effects" % Fx.names().size())
+	return true
+
+
+## Drops every unsaved edit (the effects as saved).
+func discard() -> void:
+	Fx.reload_all()
+	dirty = false
+	_undo.clear()
+	_redo.clear()
+	select(current if Fx.has(current) else (str(Fx.names()[0]) if not Fx.names().is_empty() else ""))
+
+
+## Asks about unsaved changes (save / discard / stay), then `next`.
+func guard(next: Callable) -> void:
+	if not dirty:
+		next.call()
+		return
+	UI.unsaved(self, "The effects editor", func(): save(), discard, next)
+
+
+## The Mod Editor switched mods: save into the new one (re-read when nothing's unsaved).
+func target_changed() -> void:
+	if not dirty:
+		Fx.reload_all()
+		_undo.clear()
+		_redo.clear()
+		select(current if Fx.has(current) else (str(Fx.names()[0]) if not Fx.names().is_empty() else ""))
+	_refresh_header()
+	_say("")
+
+
+func talos_shown() -> void:
+	dirty = Fx.dirty
+	if _params and current != "":
+		_params.show_effect(current)   # (the Live Editor may have changed it meanwhile)
+	_fill_list()
+	_refresh_header()
+	_say("")
+
+
+# --- Keys -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _unhandled_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	if not is_visible_in_tree() or has_meta("talos_parked"):
+		return
+	var k := event as InputEventKey
+	if k == null or not k.pressed or k.echo:
+		return
+	var handled := true
+	if k.ctrl_pressed:
+		match k.keycode:
+			KEY_S:
+				save()
+			KEY_Z:
+				if k.shift_pressed:
+					redo()
+				else:
+					undo()
+			KEY_Y:
+				redo()
+			_:
+				handled = false
+	else:
+		match k.keycode:
+			KEY_SPACE:
+				replay()
+			KEY_F:
+				frame()
+			KEY_L:
+				(find_child("LoopCheck", true, false) as CheckBox).button_pressed = not loop_play
+			KEY_G:
+				(find_child("GroundCheck", true, false) as CheckBox).button_pressed = not ground
+			KEY_F1:
+				EditorDocs.open(self, "fx")
+			KEY_ESCAPE:
+				if not embedded:
+					get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()   # (before: leaving may free the scene)
+					TalosNav.go(get_tree(), "menu", guard)
+					return
+				handled = false
+			_:
+				handled = false
+	if handled:
+		get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+
+
+## The view's mouse: drag to orbit, the wheel to zoom.
+class View extends Control:
+	var ed
+	var _drag := false
+
+	func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+		var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
+		if mb:
+			if mb.button_index in [MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT, MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT, MOUSE_BUTTON_MIDDLE]:
+				_drag = mb.pressed
+			elif mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_UP:
+				ed.dist = maxf(0.5, ed.dist * 0.88)
+				ed._aim()
+			elif mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_WHEEL_DOWN:
+				ed.dist = minf(3000.0, ed.dist / 0.88)
+				ed._aim()
+			accept_event()
+		var mm := event as InputEventMouseMotion
+		if mm and _drag:
+			ed.yaw -= mm.relative.x * 0.008
+			ed.pitch = clampf(ed.pitch + mm.relative.y * 0.008, -1.4, 1.4)
+			ed._aim()
+			accept_event()

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,614 @@ 
+class_name FxParams
+extends VBoxContainer
+## An effect's parameters as widgets (Talos's Effects editor and the Live Editor's
+## Particles tab): the effect's own (about, duration, its flash of light), then
+## each emitter - every key of Fx.PARAMS as a slider, a min-max pair, a switch, a
+## choice, a vector, a colour ramp (RampEdit) or a curve (CurveEdit) - with its
+## name, on / off, duplicate, move up / down and delete. Each change goes straight
+## into the definition (Fx.set_def: every live effect of it rebuilt at once).
+##   var p := FxParams.new(); p.compact = true; add_child(p); p.show_effect("explosion")
+##   p.before_edit -> the host's undo step (key: what's about to change); p.changed -> after.
+
+signal before_edit(key: String)
+signal changed()
+
+const LABEL_W := 118
+const FS := 13
+
+## Narrow (the Live Editor's dock): fewer, smaller widgets a row.
+var compact := false
+var effect := ""
+var _open := {}                 # emitter index -> its parameters shown
+var _body: VBoxContainer
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+
+
+func show_effect(name: String) -> void:
+	effect = name
+	rebuild()
+
+
+func rebuild() -> void:
+	UI.clear(self)
+	if effect == "" or not Fx.has(effect):
+		add_child(UI.label("No effect chosen.", 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+		return
+	var d := Fx.def(effect)
+	add_child(UI.section("EFFECT"))
+	var g := _grid()
+	add_child(g)
+	_text_row(g, "about", str(d.get("about", "")), Fx.EFFECT_PARAMS[0], func(v): _set_effect("about", v))
+	_float_row(g, Fx.EFFECT_PARAMS[1], float(d.get("duration", 1.0)), func(v): _set_effect("duration", v))
+	var l: Dictionary = d.get("light", {}) if d.get("light") is Dictionary else {}
+	for p in Fx.LIGHT_PARAMS:
+		var cur = l.get(p[0], p[2])
+		if p[1] == "color":
+			_color_row(g, p, Fx.color_of(cur), func(c: Color): _set_light(p[0], "#" + c.to_html(true)))
+		else:
+			_float_row(g, p, float(cur), func(v): _set_light(p[0], v))
+	var ems: Array = d.get("emitters", [])
+	for i in ems.size():
+		_emitter(i, ems[i] if ems[i] is Dictionary else {})
+	var add := _btn("Add emitter", "add", "A new emitter in this effect (a soft glow, to start from).", func(): add_emitter())
+	add.name = "AddEmitter"
+	add_child(add)
+
+
+# --- Edits ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Emitter `i`'s `key` as the definition has it now.
+func _cur(i: int, key: String) -> Variant:
+	var ems: Array = Fx.def(effect).get("emitters", [])
+	return Fx.val(ems[i], key) if i < ems.size() and ems[i] is Dictionary else null
+
+
+func _def() -> Dictionary:
+	return Fx.def(effect).duplicate(true)
+
+
+func _commit(d: Dictionary) -> void:
+	Fx.set_def(effect, d)
+	changed.emit()
+
+
+func _set_effect(key: String, v: Variant) -> void:
+	before_edit.emit(key)
+	var d := _def()
+	d[key] = v
+	_commit(d)
+
+
+func _set_light(key: String, v: Variant) -> void:
+	before_edit.emit("light." + key)
+	var d := _def()
+	var l: Dictionary = d.get("light", {}) if d.get("light") is Dictionary else {}
+	l[key] = v
+	d["light"] = l
+	_commit(d)
+
+
+## Emitter `i`'s `key` set to `v` (the definition changed, every live effect rebuilt).
+func set_value(i: int, key: String, v: Variant) -> void:
+	var d := _def()
+	var ems: Array = d.get("emitters", [])
+	if i < 0 or i >= ems.size():
+		return
+	before_edit.emit("%d.%s" % [i, key])
+	(ems[i] as Dictionary)[key] = v
+	_commit(d)
+
+
+func add_emitter(from: Dictionary = {}) -> void:
+	before_edit.emit("+emitter")
+	var d := _def()
+	var ems: Array = d.get("emitters", [])
+	var e := from.duplicate(true) if not from.is_empty() else Fx.new_emitter()
+	if from.is_empty():
+		e["name"] = "glow %d" % (ems.size() + 1)
+		e["velocity"] = [0.0, 0.0]
+		e["scale"] = [2.0, 2.0]
+		e["amount"] = 1
+		e["lifetime"] = 0.5
+	ems.append(e)
+	d["emitters"] = ems
+	_open[ems.size() - 1] = true
+	_commit(d)
+	rebuild()
+
+
+func _remove(i: int) -> void:
+	before_edit.emit("-emitter")
+	var d := _def()
+	(d["emitters"] as Array).remove_at(i)
+	_open.clear()
+	_commit(d)
+	rebuild()
+
+
+func _move(i: int, by: int) -> void:
+	var d := _def()
+	var ems: Array = d["emitters"]
+	var j := i + by
+	if j < 0 or j >= ems.size():
+		return
+	before_edit.emit("~emitter")
+	var e = ems[i]
+	ems[i] = ems[j]
+	ems[j] = e
+	var oi = _open.get(i, false)
+	_open[i] = _open.get(j, false)
+	_open[j] = oi
+	_commit(d)
+	rebuild()
+
+
+# --- Widgets ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _emitter(i: int, e: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var head := HBoxContainer.new()
+	head.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	var fold := Button.new()
+	fold.toggle_mode = true
+	fold.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	fold.button_pressed = bool(_open.get(i, false))
+	fold.text = "v" if fold.button_pressed else ">"
+	fold.custom_minimum_size.x = 28
+	fold.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", FS)
+	fold.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Show its parameters", "", "Opens (or folds) this emitter's parameters.")
+	fold.name = "Fold%d" % i
+	head.add_child(fold)
+	var on := CheckBox.new()
+	on.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	on.button_pressed = bool(Fx.val(e, "on"))
+	on.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("On", "", Fx.param("on")[6])
+	on.toggled.connect(func(v): set_value(i, "on", v))
+	head.add_child(on)
+	var nm := LineEdit.new()
+	nm.text = str(Fx.val(e, "name"))
+	nm.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	nm.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
+	nm.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Emitter name", "Enter", Fx.param("name")[6])
+	nm.text_submitted.connect(func(t): set_value(i, "name", t); nm.release_focus())
+	nm.focus_exited.connect(func(): if nm.text != str(_cur(i, "name")): set_value(i, "name", nm.text))
+	head.add_child(nm)
+	var mat := UI.label("(%s)" % str(Fx.val(e, "material")), FS, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	head.add_child(mat)
+	add_child(head)
+	var body := VBoxContainer.new()
+	body.name = "Emitter%d" % i
+	body.visible = fold.button_pressed
+	add_child(body)
+	fold.toggled.connect(func(v):
+		_open[i] = v
+		fold.text = "v" if v else ">"
+		body.visible = v
+		if v and body.get_child_count() == 0:
+			_emitter_body(body, i, e))
+	if body.visible:
+		_emitter_body(body, i, e)
+
+
+func _emitter_body(body: VBoxContainer, i: int, e: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var acts := HBoxContainer.new()
+	acts.add_child(_btn("Duplicate emitter", "duplicate", "A copy of this emitter, after it.", func(): add_emitter(Fx.def(effect)["emitters"][i]), "Copy"))
+	acts.add_child(_btn("Move up", "up", "Earlier in the list (drawn under the ones after it).", func(): _move(i, -1), "Up"))
+	acts.add_child(_btn("Move down", "down", "Later in the list (drawn over the ones before it).", func(): _move(i, 1), "Down"))
+	acts.add_child(_btn("Delete emitter", "delete", "Takes this emitter out of the effect (Undo puts it back).", func(): _remove(i), "Delete"))
+	body.add_child(acts)
+	var g := _grid()
+	body.add_child(g)
+	for p in Fx.PARAMS:
+		var key: String = p[0]
+		if key in ["name", "on"]:
+			continue
+		var cur = Fx.val(e, key)
+		match str(p[1]):
+			"enum":
+				_enum_row(g, p, str(cur), func(v): set_value(i, key, v); rebuild())
+			"bool":
+				_bool_row(g, p, bool(cur), func(v): set_value(i, key, v))
+			"int":
+				_float_row(g, p, float(cur), func(v): set_value(i, key, int(v)), true)
+			"float":
+				_float_row(g, p, float(cur), func(v): set_value(i, key, v))
+			"range":
+				_range_row(g, p, Fx._rng2(cur), func(v: Vector2): set_value(i, key, [v.x, v.y]))
+			"vec3":
+				_vec3_row(g, p, Fx._vec3(cur), func(v: Vector3): set_value(i, key, [v.x, v.y, v.z]))
+			"colors":
+				var r := RampEdit.new()
+				r.stops = (cur as Array).duplicate(true) if cur is Array else []
+				r.name = "Ramp_%d" % i
+				r.edited.connect(func(stops): set_value(i, key, stops))
+				_row(g, p, r)
+			"curve":
+				var c := CurveEdit.new()
+				c.points = (cur as Array).duplicate(true) if cur is Array else []
+				c.name = "Curve_%d" % i
+				c.edited.connect(func(pts): set_value(i, key, pts))
+				_row(g, p, c)
+
+
+func _grid() -> GridContainer:
+	var g := GridContainer.new()
+	g.columns = 2
+	g.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 8)
+	g.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 4)
+	g.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	return g
+
+
+func _row(g: GridContainer, p: Array, w: Control) -> void:
+	var l := UI.label(str(p[5]), FS, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	l.custom_minimum_size.x = LABEL_W - (16 if compact else 0)
+	var t := tip_of(p)
+	l.tooltip_text = t
+	l.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	l.clip_text = true
+	g.add_child(l)
+	w.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	if w.tooltip_text == "":
+		w.tooltip_text = t
+	for c in w.find_children("*", "Control", true, false):   # (the slider and the box in a number's row)
+		if (c is Range or c is BaseButton or c is LineEdit) and (c as Control).tooltip_text == "":
+			(c as Control).tooltip_text = t
+	g.add_child(w)
+
+
+## A parameter's tooltip ([key, kind, default, least, most, label, what it is]):
+## what it is, then its range and default.
+static func tip_of(p: Array, which := "") -> String:
+	var more := ""
+	if (p[3] is float or p[3] is int) and (p[4] is float or p[4] is int):
+		more = "\nFrom %s to %s; default %s." % [str(p[3]), str(p[4]), str(p[2])]
+	return EditorIcons.tip(str(p[5]) + which, "", str(p[6]) + more)
+
+
+func _spin(lo: float, hi: float, v: float, whole := false) -> SpinBox:
+	var s := SpinBox.new()
+	s.min_value = lo
+	s.max_value = hi
+	s.step = 1.0 if whole else 0.01   # (snapped from its least value: a coarser step turned 1.0 into 1.05)
+	s.allow_greater = true
+	s.allow_lesser = lo < 0.0
+	s.value = v
+	s.custom_minimum_size.x = 64 if compact else 78
+	s.select_all_on_focus = true
+	s.get_line_edit().add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", FS)
+	return s
+
+
+func _float_row(g: GridContainer, p: Array, v: float, set_v: Callable, whole := false) -> void:
+	var lo := float(p[3])
+	var hi := float(p[4])
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	var sl := HSlider.new()
+	sl.min_value = lo
+	sl.max_value = hi
+	sl.step = 1.0 if whole else 0.001
+	sl.value = v
+	sl.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	sl.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	sl.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	var sp := _spin(lo, hi, v, whole)
+	sl.value_changed.connect(func(x):
+		sp.set_value_no_signal(x)
+		set_v.call(snappedf(x, 0.001)))
+	sp.value_changed.connect(func(x):
+		sl.set_value_no_signal(x)
+		set_v.call(snappedf(x, 0.001)))
+	row.add_child(sl)
+	row.add_child(sp)
+	row.name = "P_" + str(p[0])
+	_row(g, p, row)
+
+
+func _range_row(g: GridContainer, p: Array, v: Vector2, set_v: Callable) -> void:
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.name = "P_" + str(p[0])
+	var a := _spin(float(p[3]), float(p[4]), v.x)
+	var b := _spin(float(p[3]), float(p[4]), v.y)
+	a.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	b.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	a.tooltip_text = tip_of(p, " (least)")
+	b.tooltip_text = tip_of(p, " (most)")
+	var go := func(_x): set_v.call(Vector2(snappedf(a.value, 0.001), snappedf(b.value, 0.001)))
+	a.value_changed.connect(go)
+	b.value_changed.connect(go)
+	row.add_child(a)
+	row.add_child(UI.label("-", FS, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	row.add_child(b)
+	_row(g, p, row)
+
+
+func _vec3_row(g: GridContainer, p: Array, v: Vector3, set_v: Callable) -> void:
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.name = "P_" + str(p[0])
+	var s: Array = []
+	for k in 3:
+		var sp := _spin(float(p[3]), float(p[4]), v[k])
+		sp.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		sp.custom_minimum_size.x = 56
+		sp.prefix = ["x", "y", "z"][k]
+		s.append(sp)
+		row.add_child(sp)
+	var go := func(_x): set_v.call(Vector3(snappedf(s[0].value, 0.001), snappedf(s[1].value, 0.001), snappedf(s[2].value, 0.001)))
+	for sp in s:
+		sp.value_changed.connect(go)
+	_row(g, p, row)
+
+
+func _bool_row(g: GridContainer, p: Array, v: bool, set_v: Callable) -> void:
+	var c := CheckBox.new()
+	c.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	c.button_pressed = v
+	c.name = "P_" + str(p[0])
+	c.toggled.connect(func(x): set_v.call(x))
+	_row(g, p, c)
+
+
+func _enum_row(g: GridContainer, p: Array, v: String, set_v: Callable) -> void:
+	var o := OptionButton.new()
+	o.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	o.name = "P_" + str(p[0])
+	o.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", FS)
+	for x in p[3]:
+		o.add_item(str(x))
+	o.select(maxi(0, (p[3] as Array).find(v)))
+	o.item_selected.connect(func(k): set_v.call(str(p[3][k])))
+	_row(g, p, o)
+
+
+func _color_row(g: GridContainer, p: Array, v: Color, set_v: Callable) -> void:
+	var c := ColorPickerButton.new()
+	c.color = v
+	c.edit_alpha = false
+	c.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(60, 24)
+	c.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	c.color_changed.connect(func(x): set_v.call(x))
+	_row(g, p, c)
+
+
+func _text_row(g: GridContainer, _key: String, v: String, p: Array, set_v: Callable) -> void:
+	var t := LineEdit.new()
+	t.text = v
+	t.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", FS)
+	t.text_submitted.connect(func(x): set_v.call(x); t.release_focus())
+	t.focus_exited.connect(func(): if t.text != str(Fx.def(effect).get(p[0], "")): set_v.call(t.text))
+	_row(g, p, t)
+
+
+func _btn(name: String, icon: String, help: String, cb: Callable, label := "") -> Button:
+	var b := UI.button("", cb, 14)
+	b.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	return EditorIcons.dress(b, icon, EditorIcons.tip(name, "", help), label)
+
+
+# --- The colour ramp -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A colour ramp: the colours along a particle's life (a bar, checked under to show
+## the opacity), a handle under each stop. Click a handle to pick it (its colour in
+## the picker beside), drag it along; double-click the bar for a new stop there;
+## right-click a handle to take it away (two at least).
+class RampEdit extends VBoxContainer:
+	signal edited(stops: Array)
+	var stops: Array = []
+	var sel := 0
+	var _bar: Bar
+	var _pick: ColorPickerButton
+
+	func _ready() -> void:
+		var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+		_bar = Bar.new()
+		_bar.ed = self
+		_bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(120, 34)
+		_bar.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		_bar.mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		_bar.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Colour over life", "", "Click a handle to pick it, drag it along; double-click for a new stop; right-click a handle to remove it.")
+		row.add_child(_bar)
+		_pick = ColorPickerButton.new()
+		_pick.edit_alpha = true
+		_pick.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(44, 30)
+		_pick.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+		_pick.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Stop colour", "", "The picked stop's colour and opacity.")
+		_pick.color_changed.connect(func(c):
+			if sel < stops.size():
+				stops[sel][1] = "#" + c.to_html(true)
+				_bar.queue_redraw()
+				edited.emit(stops.duplicate(true)))
+		row.add_child(_pick)
+		add_child(row)
+		_sync()
+
+	func _sync() -> void:
+		sel = clampi(sel, 0, maxi(0, stops.size() - 1))
+		if _pick and sel < stops.size():
+			_pick.color = Fx.color_of(stops[sel][1])
+		if _bar:
+			_bar.queue_redraw()
+
+	func pick(i: int) -> void:
+		sel = i
+		_sync()
+
+	func add_at(t: float) -> void:
+		var g := Fx.gradient(stops)
+		stops.append([snappedf(t, 0.001), "#" + g.sample(t).to_html(true)])
+		stops.sort_custom(func(a, b): return float(a[0]) < float(b[0]))
+		for i in stops.size():
+			if absf(float(stops[i][0]) - snappedf(t, 0.001)) < 0.0005:
+				sel = i
+		_sync()
+		edited.emit(stops.duplicate(true))
+
+	func remove(i: int) -> void:
+		if stops.size() <= 2:
+			return
+		stops.remove_at(i)
+		_sync()
+		edited.emit(stops.duplicate(true))
+
+	func move(i: int, t: float) -> void:
+		stops[i][0] = snappedf(clampf(t, 0.0, 1.0), 0.001)
+		_bar.queue_redraw()
+		edited.emit(stops.duplicate(true))
+
+	class Bar extends Control:
+		var ed
+		var _drag := -1
+
+		func _x(t: float) -> float:
+			return 6.0 + t * (size.x - 12.0)
+
+		func _t(x: float) -> float:
+			return clampf((x - 6.0) / maxf(size.x - 12.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0)
+
+		func _draw() -> void:
+			var h := size.y - 12.0
+			var w := size.x - 12.0
+			var n := 12
+			for k in n:   # (the checks under: opacity shows)
+				for r in 2:
+					draw_rect(Rect2(6.0 + w * k / n, r * h * 0.5, w / n, h * 0.5), Color(0.32, 0.32, 0.34) if (k + r) % 2 == 0 else Color(0.18, 0.18, 0.2))
+			var g := Fx.gradient(ed.stops)
+			var steps := 64
+			for k in steps:
+				var c := g.sample((k + 0.5) / steps)
+				draw_rect(Rect2(6.0 + w * k / steps, 0, w / steps + 1.0, h), c)
+			draw_rect(Rect2(6, 0, w, h), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.35), false, 1.0)
+			for i in ed.stops.size():
+				var x := _x(float(ed.stops[i][0]))
+				var col := Fx.color_of(ed.stops[i][1])
+				var pts := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(x, h), Vector2(x - 6, h + 11), Vector2(x + 6, h + 11)])
+				draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(col, 1.0))
+				pts.append(pts[0])
+				draw_polyline(pts, Color(1, 0.85, 0.4) if i == ed.sel else Color(0.9, 0.9, 0.9, 0.8), 2.0 if i == ed.sel else 1.0)
+
+		func _hit(x: float) -> int:
+			var best := -1
+			var bd := 9.0
+			for i in ed.stops.size():
+				var d := absf(_x(float(ed.stops[i][0])) - x)
+				if d < bd:
+					bd = d
+					best = i
+			return best
+
+		func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+			var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
+			if mb and mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+				if mb.double_click:
+					ed.add_at(_t(mb.position.x))
+				else:
+					var i := _hit(mb.position.x)
+					if i >= 0:
+						ed.pick(i)
+						_drag = i
+				accept_event()
+			elif mb and not mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+				_drag = -1
+			elif mb and mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
+				var i := _hit(mb.position.x)
+				if i >= 0:
+					ed.remove(i)
+				accept_event()
+			var mm := event as InputEventMouseMotion
+			if mm and _drag >= 0 and _drag < ed.stops.size():
+				ed.move(_drag, _t(mm.position.x))
+
+
+# --- The scale curve -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A curve over a particle's life (x: age 0-1, y: times its scale). Drag a point;
+## double-click for a new one; right-click one to take it away. Empty: the same
+## size all its life (double-click to start one).
+class CurveEdit extends Control:
+	signal edited(points: Array)
+	var points: Array = []
+	var _drag := -1
+
+	func _init() -> void:
+		custom_minimum_size = Vector2(120, 84)
+		mouse_filter = MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+		tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Scale over life", "", "Drag a point (x: age, y: times the scale); double-click for a new one,\nright-click one to remove it. Empty: the same size all its life.")
+
+	func _top() -> float:
+		var hi := 2.0
+		for p in points:
+			hi = maxf(hi, float(p[1]) * 1.15)
+		return hi
+
+	func _pos(p: Array) -> Vector2:
+		return Vector2(6.0 + float(p[0]) * (size.x - 12.0), size.y - 6.0 - float(p[1]) / _top() * (size.y - 12.0))
+
+	func _val(at: Vector2) -> Array:
+		return [snappedf(clampf((at.x - 6.0) / maxf(size.x - 12.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0), 0.001),
+			snappedf(clampf((size.y - 6.0 - at.y) / maxf(size.y - 12.0, 1.0), 0.0, 1.0) * _top(), 0.001)]
+
+	func _draw() -> void:
+		draw_rect(Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, size), Color(0.05, 0.05, 0.07, 0.8))
+		var one := _pos([0.0, 1.0]).y
+		draw_line(Vector2(6, one), Vector2(size.x - 6, one), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.18), 1.0)
+		for k in 5:
+			var x := 6.0 + (size.x - 12.0) * k / 4.0
+			draw_line(Vector2(x, 6), Vector2(x, size.y - 6), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.07), 1.0)
+		if points.size() < 2:
+			draw_line(Vector2(6, one), Vector2(size.x - 6, one), Color(1, 0.75, 0.4, 0.7), 2.0)
+			draw_string(get_theme_default_font(), Vector2(10, size.y - 10), "none - double-click to start", HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, 12, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.5))
+			return
+		var s := points.duplicate()
+		s.sort_custom(func(a, b): return float(a[0]) < float(b[0]))
+		var line := PackedVector2Array()
+		line.append(Vector2(6, _pos(s[0]).y))
+		for p in s:
+			line.append(_pos(p))
+		line.append(Vector2(size.x - 6, _pos(s[-1]).y))
+		draw_polyline(line, Color(1, 0.75, 0.4), 2.0)
+		for i in points.size():
+			draw_circle(_pos(points[i]), 5.0 if i == _drag else 4.0, Color(1, 0.9, 0.6))
+
+	func _hit(at: Vector2) -> int:
+		for i in points.size():
+			if _pos(points[i]).distance_to(at) < 9.0:
+				return i
+		return -1
+
+	func _emit() -> void:
+		var s := points.duplicate(true)
+		s.sort_custom(func(a, b): return float(a[0]) < float(b[0]))
+		edited.emit(s)
+
+	func _gui_input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+		var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
+		if mb and mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+			if mb.double_click:
+				if points.size() < 2:
+					points = [[0.0, 1.0], [1.0, 1.0]]
+				else:
+					points.append(_val(mb.position))
+				_emit()
+			else:
+				_drag = _hit(mb.position)
+			queue_redraw()
+			accept_event()
+		elif mb and not mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+			_drag = -1
+			queue_redraw()
+		elif mb and mb.pressed and mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
+			var i := _hit(mb.position)
+			if i >= 0:
+				points.remove_at(i)
+				if points.size() < 2:
+					points = []
+				_emit()
+				queue_redraw()
+			accept_event()
+		var mm := event as InputEventMouseMotion
+		if mm and _drag >= 0 and _drag < points.size():
+			points[_drag] = _val(mm.position)
+			_emit()
+			queue_redraw()
