files.explanation: Parts from bones: a rounded loft from each bone's head to its child's (12 sides, 6 fitted rings), its cross-sections ellipses fitted to the body vertices weighted to that bone; skinned 100% to it.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,327 @@ 
+extends RefCounted
+## The mesh editor's Parts from bones: a character's skeleton given simple body parts - one a
+## bone, a rounded loft from the bone's head to its child's head (the child the bone points
+## at; an end bone: a short cap along its own axis), its cross-sections fitted to the Body's
+## vertices weighted to that bone (their spread around the bone's axis, ring by ring: an
+## ellipse each, centred on them), or - none weighted to it - a fraction of the bone's length.
+## Each part is named after its bone and skinned all to it, so it moves with the animations
+## (the game merges parts bound to the skeleton into the Body). Made where the bones are drawn
+## now: in the character's T-pose (the part then carries the Body's T-pose metas and is turned
+## back with it when saved) or in its own pose.
+##   BoneParts.make(rig, "children", bind, material) -> [{"name", "bone", "bind", "mesh"}...]
+
+const TPose := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/tpose.gd")
+const MeshBind := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/mesh_bind.gd")
+const Shapes := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/shapes.gd")
+
+## Which bones: the one picked, it and every bone below it, or every bone of the skin.
+const SCOPES := ["bone", "children", "all"]
+const RINGS := 6        # cross-sections fitted along a bone
+const SIDES := 12       # points around each
+const CAP_RINGS := 3    # rings rounding each end (the last a point)
+const MIN_WEIGHT := 0.35   # a vertex counts for its strongest bone when weighted at least this
+const SPREAD := 0.85    # the part's radius: this share of the vertices within it
+
+
+## The skin binds scope `scope` covers from bind `k`: "bone" - k; "children" - k and every
+## bind whose bone descends from k's; "all" - every bind with a bone. Weapon bones only when
+## picked themselves.
+static func binds_in(rig: Dictionary, k: int, scope: String) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var bs := MeshBind.binds(rig)
+	var skel: Skeleton3D = rig["skel"]
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	if scope == "bone":
+		if k >= 0 and k < bs.size() and int(bs[k][0]) >= 0:
+			out.append(k)
+		return out
+	var top := int(bs[k][0]) if scope == "children" and k >= 0 and k < bs.size() else -1
+	if scope == "children" and top < 0:
+		return out
+	for j in bs.size():
+		var b: int = bs[j][0]
+		if b < 0:
+			continue
+		if (scope == "all" or j != k) and str(bs[j][1]).to_lower() in TPose.WEAPON_BONES:
+			continue
+		if scope == "children":
+			var c := b
+			while c >= 0 and c != top:
+				c = skel.get_bone_parent(c)
+			if c != top:
+				continue
+		out.append(j)
+	return out
+
+
+## The Body's vertices as drawn now (the skeleton's space), each under the bind weighing on
+## it most (when at least MIN_WEIGHT) - for binds `want` only: {bind: PackedVector3Array}.
+static func weighted(rig: Dictionary, want: PackedInt32Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	var acc := {}   # (Arrays while gathering: appended in place)
+	for k in want:
+		acc[k] = []
+		out[k] = PackedVector3Array()
+	var body: MeshInstance3D = rig["body"]
+	var skel: Skeleton3D = rig["skel"]
+	var body_to_skel := skel.global_transform.affine_inverse() * body.global_transform
+	var m: Mesh = body.mesh
+	if m == null:
+		return out
+	_gather(rig, m, body_to_skel, acc)
+	for k in want:
+		out[k] = PackedVector3Array(acc[k])
+	return out
+
+
+static func _gather(rig: Dictionary, m: Mesh, body_to_skel: Transform3D, acc: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var mats: Array = rig["mats"]
+	for si in m.get_surface_count():
+		var a := m.surface_get_arrays(si)
+		var vs: PackedVector3Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+		if a[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES] == null or a[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS] == null or vs.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var bones: PackedInt32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES]
+		var ws: PackedFloat32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS]
+		var per := bones.size() / vs.size()
+		if per <= 0:
+			continue
+		for i in vs.size():
+			var best := -1
+			var bw := MIN_WEIGHT
+			for j in per:
+				if ws[i * per + j] >= bw:
+					bw = ws[i * per + j]
+					best = bones[i * per + j]
+			if best < 0 or not acc.has(best):
+				continue
+			var q: Vector3
+			if rig["tpose"]:   # (the T-posed Body's mesh is as it's drawn)
+				q = body_to_skel * vs[i]
+			else:
+				q = MeshBind._blend(mats, bones.slice(i * per, i * per + per), ws.slice(i * per, i * per + per)) * vs[i]
+			(acc[best] as Array).append(q)
+
+
+## The `p`-th share (0..1) of the values `xs`.
+static func _quantile(xs: PackedFloat32Array, p: float) -> float:
+	if xs.is_empty():
+		return 0.0
+	var s := xs.duplicate()
+	s.sort()
+	return s[clampi(int(round(p * (s.size() - 1))), 0, s.size() - 1)]
+
+
+## Bind `k`'s part fitted (the skeleton's space): {"a": its head, "axis", "len", "u", "w" (the
+## cross-sections' axes), "rings": [[along, centre u, centre w, radius u, radius w]...],
+## "end": no child to reach}. `verts`: the Body's vertices weighted to it (drawn).
+static func fit(rig: Dictionary, k: int, verts: PackedVector3Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var skel: Skeleton3D = rig["skel"]
+	var g: Array = rig["g"]
+	var b: int = MeshBind.binds(rig)[k][0]
+	var gb: Transform3D = g[b]
+	var a := gb.origin
+	var y := gb.basis.y.normalized()
+	if y.length_squared() < 0.5:
+		y = Vector3.UP
+	# the child the bone points at (most along its own axis; heads on top of it don't count)
+	var axis := y
+	var length := 0.0
+	var best := 0.7
+	for c in skel.get_bone_children(b):
+		var d: Vector3 = (g[c] as Transform3D).origin - a
+		if d.length() < 1e-3 or d.dot(y) <= 0.0:
+			continue
+		var al := d.dot(y) / d.length()
+		if al > best:
+			best = al
+			axis = d.normalized()
+			length = d.length()
+	var end := length <= 0.0
+	if end:   # (an end bone: as far as its vertices go along it, or a short cap)
+		var along := PackedFloat32Array()
+		for v in verts:
+			along.append(maxf(0.0, (v - a).dot(axis)))
+		length = _quantile(along, 0.9) if verts.size() >= 8 else 0.0
+		if length < 0.02:
+			var p := skel.get_bone_parent(b)
+			var pl := (g[p] as Transform3D).origin.distance_to(a) if p >= 0 else 0.0
+			length = clampf(pl * 0.3, 0.02, 0.12) if pl > 0.0 else 0.06
+	var u := gb.basis.x - axis * gb.basis.x.dot(axis)
+	if u.length_squared() < 1e-8:
+		u = axis.cross(Vector3.RIGHT if absf(axis.x) < 0.9 else Vector3.FORWARD)
+	u = u.normalized()
+	var w := axis.cross(u).normalized()
+	# each cross-section: the vertices within half a step either side of it, from where they sit
+	var step := length / float(RINGS - 1)
+	var rows := []   # per ring: [its vertices' u offsets, their w offsets] (Arrays: appended in place)
+	for r in RINGS:
+		rows.append([[], []])
+	for v in verts:
+		var rel := v - a
+		var s := rel.dot(axis)
+		if s < -step * 0.75 or s > length + step * 0.75:
+			continue
+		var r := clampi(int(round(s / step)), 0, RINGS - 1)
+		rows[r][0].append(rel.dot(u))
+		rows[r][1].append(rel.dot(w))
+	var fall := clampf(length * (0.45 if end and verts.size() < 8 else 0.16), 0.01, 0.09)
+	var rings := []
+	var have := []
+	for r in RINGS:
+		var pu := PackedFloat32Array(rows[r][0])
+		var pw := PackedFloat32Array(rows[r][1])
+		if pu.size() < 6:
+			rings.append([step * r, 0.0, 0.0, fall * (1.0 - 0.2 * r / (RINGS - 1)), fall * (1.0 - 0.2 * r / (RINGS - 1))])
+			have.append(false)
+			continue
+		var cu := 0.0
+		var cw := 0.0
+		for i in pu.size():
+			cu += pu[i]
+			cw += pw[i]
+		cu /= pu.size()
+		cw /= pw.size()
+		var du := PackedFloat32Array()
+		var dw := PackedFloat32Array()
+		for i in pu.size():
+			du.append(absf(pu[i] - cu))
+			dw.append(absf(pw[i] - cw))
+		rings.append([step * r, cu, cw, _quantile(du, SPREAD), _quantile(dw, SPREAD)])
+		have.append(true)
+	# rings without vertices: from their nearest neighbours that have some
+	if have.has(true):
+		for r in RINGS:
+			if have[r]:
+				continue
+			var lo := r - 1
+			while lo >= 0 and not have[lo]:
+				lo -= 1
+			var hi := r + 1
+			while hi < RINGS and not have[hi]:
+				hi += 1
+			var src: Array = rings[lo] if hi >= RINGS else (rings[hi] if lo < 0 else [])
+			if src.is_empty():
+				var t := float(r - lo) / float(hi - lo)
+				src = []
+				for q in 5:
+					src.append(lerpf(rings[lo][q], rings[hi][q], t))
+			for q in range(1, 5):
+				rings[r][q] = src[q]
+	# smoothed a little (no lumps), kept round enough, not too thin, centres near the bone
+	var smooth := []
+	for r in RINGS:
+		var row: Array = rings[r].duplicate()
+		for q in range(1, 5):
+			var n := 0.0
+			var sum := 0.0
+			for o in [-1, 0, 1]:
+				if r + o >= 0 and r + o < RINGS:
+					var wt := 2.0 if o == 0 else 1.0
+					sum += float(rings[r + o][q]) * wt
+					n += wt
+			row[q] = sum / n
+		var rmin := maxf(0.006, length * 0.04)
+		row[3] = clampf(row[3], rmin, 0.6)
+		row[4] = clampf(row[4], rmin, 0.6)
+		row[3] = minf(row[3], row[4] * 3.0)
+		row[4] = minf(row[4], row[3] * 3.0)
+		var off := Vector2(row[1], row[2])
+		var lim := maxf(row[3], row[4]) * 1.5
+		if off.length() > lim:
+			off = off.normalized() * lim
+		row[1] = off.x
+		row[2] = off.y
+		smooth.append(row)
+	return {"a": a, "axis": axis, "len": length, "u": u, "w": w, "rings": smooth, "end": end}
+
+
+## A fitted part's surface (fit()): a closed loft through its rings, each end rounded to a
+## point - in the skeleton's space.
+static func loft(f: Dictionary) -> Array:
+	var a: Vector3 = f["a"]
+	var axis: Vector3 = f["axis"]
+	var u: Vector3 = f["u"]
+	var w: Vector3 = f["w"]
+	var length: float = f["len"]
+	var rings: Array = f["rings"]
+	# the rows from end to end: [along, centre u, centre w, radius u, radius w]
+	var rows := []
+	var r0: Array = rings[0]
+	var r1: Array = rings[rings.size() - 1]
+	var d0 := clampf(minf(r0[3], r0[4]) * 0.9, 0.004, length * 0.45)
+	var d1 := clampf(minf(r1[3], r1[4]) * 0.9, 0.004, length * 0.45)
+	for c in range(CAP_RINGS, 0, -1):
+		var th := PI * 0.5 * c / CAP_RINGS
+		rows.append([r0[0] - d0 * sin(th), r0[1], r0[2], r0[3] * cos(th), r0[4] * cos(th)])
+	rows += rings
+	for c in range(1, CAP_RINGS + 1):
+		var th := PI * 0.5 * c / CAP_RINGS
+		rows.append([r1[0] + d1 * sin(th), r1[1], r1[2], r1[3] * cos(th), r1[4] * cos(th)])
+	# a sheet: columns around (u towards w - with the rows along the axis, faces outwards)
+	var P := []
+	for i in SIDES + 1:
+		var ang := TAU * float(i % SIDES) / SIDES
+		var col := PackedVector3Array()
+		for row: Array in rows:
+			var rr := Vector2(float(row[3]) * cos(ang), float(row[4]) * sin(ang))
+			if rr.length() < 1e-6:
+				rr = Vector2.ZERO   # (a pole: one point)
+			col.append(a + axis * float(row[0]) + u * (float(row[1]) + rr.x) + w * (float(row[2]) + rr.y))
+		P.append(col)
+	var b := Shapes.B.new()
+	var vv := PackedFloat32Array()
+	for j in rows.size():
+		vv.append(float(j) / (rows.size() - 1))
+	b.sheet(P, PackedInt32Array(), PackedInt32Array(), true, false, PackedFloat32Array(), vv)
+	return b.commit()
+
+
+## Surface `arr` (the skeleton's space) skinned all to bind `k` of `rig`: its vertices where the
+## bind draws them as they are now - the Body's mesh space (T-posed: as drawn; else by the
+## inverse of the bind's matrix).
+static func bound(rig: Dictionary, k: int, arr: Array, mat: Material) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var body: MeshInstance3D = rig["body"]
+	var skel: Skeleton3D = rig["skel"]
+	var to: Transform3D = body.global_transform.affine_inverse() * skel.global_transform if rig["tpose"] \
+		else (rig["mats"][k] as Transform3D).affine_inverse()
+	var vs: PackedVector3Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+	var ns: PackedVector3Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL]
+	var nb := to.basis.inverse().transposed()
+	var bones := PackedInt32Array()
+	var weights := PackedFloat32Array()
+	for i in vs.size():
+		vs[i] = to * vs[i]
+		ns[i] = (nb * ns[i]).normalized()
+		bones.append_array([k, 0, 0, 0])
+		weights.append_array([1.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = vs
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = ns
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT] = null
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES] = bones
+	arr[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS] = weights
+	var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+	m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, arr)
+	m.surface_set_material(0, mat)
+	return m
+
+
+## The parts for scope `scope` from bind `k` ("all": any k): [{"name": the part's name (the
+## bone's made a node name, + "_part": a saved model's nodes and bones share their names, the
+## bone would keep it), "bone", "bind", "mesh": bound (bound())}...].
+static func make(rig: Dictionary, scope: String, k: int, mat: Material) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	if rig.is_empty():
+		return out
+	var want := binds_in(rig, k, scope)
+	if want.is_empty():
+		return out
+	var verts := weighted(rig, want)
+	var bs := MeshBind.binds(rig)
+	for j in want:
+		var f := fit(rig, j, verts[j])
+		var arr := loft(f)
+		if arr.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var bone := str(bs[j][1])
+		out.append({"name": bone.validate_node_name() + "_part", "bone": bone, "bind": j, "mesh": bound(rig, j, arr, mat)})
+	return out

@@ -1,0 +1,632 @@ 
+extends Node
+## The mesh editor's deforming tools for edit mode (a node of the editor, `ed`):
+## - **Curve deform** (V; transform kind "CRV"): a cubic curve laid along the selection, from one
+##   end of its longest extent to the other - two end points and two handles dragged in the view.
+##   Each moved point keeps its offset from the straight line, carried (and turned) by the curve
+##   at its place along it: a straight row of points bends into the curve.
+## - **Flatten** (Shift+Alt+F; kind "FLT"): the selected points pushed onto a plane through their
+##   middle - the best fit (least squares; the selected faces' average normal when faces are
+##   selected) or, X / Y / Z typed, the part's own axis plane - by a strength from the mouse or a digit.
+## Both are transforms of the editor's (begin_transform / _xf_update / confirm_transform /
+## _cancel_xf): proportional editing, symmetry and the mirror's clipping apply, one undo step.
+## Their state lives in the editor's `xf`; while one runs a small bar shows in the view
+## (keep / cancel; Flatten's plane), and the curve is drawn over the model (MeshView.curve_pts).
+
+const MeshView := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/mesh_view.gd")
+const KINDS := ["CRV", "FLT"]
+const HANDLE_PX := 12.0   # (how near the mouse picks an end point or handle)
+
+var ed: Control
+var _bar: PanelContainer
+var _crv_btns: Array = []
+var _flt_btns: Array = []   # fit, X, Y, Z
+var _shown := ""
+## Curve deform: the selected points snapped exactly onto the curve (spaced along it as they were
+## along the straight line) - off: each keeps its offset from the line (an area bent by the curve).
+## (Kept as a meta, not a variable: hot reloaded into an open editor.)
+func snaps() -> bool:
+	return bool(get_meta("snap_on_curve", true))
+
+
+func setup(editor: Control) -> void:
+	ed = editor
+	name = "DeformTools"
+
+
+# --- starting -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Curve deform (V): the curve along the selection, its ends and handles dragged in the view.
+func begin_curve() -> void:
+	if ed.mode != "edit" or ed.em == null:
+		ed._say("Curve deform works on points: Tab into edit mode and select some.")
+		return
+	if ed.selected_points().size() < 2:
+		ed._say("Curve deform needs at least two points selected.")
+		return
+	ed.begin_transform("CRV")
+	if ed.xf.get("kind", "") != "CRV":
+		return
+	var line := curve_line(ed.em.points, ed.xf["sel"])
+	if line.is_empty():
+		ed._cancel_xf()
+		ed._say("Curve deform: the selected points are all in one place.")
+		return
+	for k in line:
+		ed.xf[k] = line[k]
+	# (the curve fitted through the selected points - and each point bound to its place on it: none
+	# moves till the curve is changed)
+	# (faces selected - face mode, or Auto with whole faces picked: the curve goes through their
+	# middles and carries the faces whole, every point keeping its offset - no snapping)
+	var centres := face_centres(ed.em, ed.sel_t) if ed.sel_kind in [2, 3] else PackedVector3Array()
+	ed.xf["crv_faces"] = centres.size() >= 2
+	var cp: PackedVector3Array
+	if centres.size() >= 2:
+		var fl := curve_line(centres, PackedInt32Array(range(centres.size())))
+		cp = fit_curve(centres, PackedInt32Array(range(centres.size())), fl) if not fl.is_empty() else fit_curve(ed.em.points, ed.xf["sel"], line)
+	else:
+		cp = fit_curve(ed.em.points, ed.xf["sel"], line)
+	ed.xf["crv_p"] = cp
+	ed.xf["crv_start"] = cp.duplicate()
+	var bind := bind_points(ed.xf["orig"], cp)
+	for k in bind:
+		ed.xf[k] = bind[k]
+	ed.xf["crv_drag"] = -1
+	ed.xf["crv_hot"] = -1
+	ed.xf["crv_snap"] = snaps()
+	ed._xf_update()
+
+
+## Flatten (Shift+Alt+F): the selected points onto a plane - the mouse sets how far.
+func begin_flatten() -> void:
+	if ed.mode != "edit" or ed.em == null:
+		ed._say("Flatten works on points: Tab into edit mode and select some.")
+		return
+	if ed.selected_points().size() < 3:
+		ed._say("Flatten needs at least three points selected.")
+		return
+	ed.begin_transform("FLT")
+	if ed.xf.get("kind", "") != "FLT":
+		return
+	var sel: PackedInt32Array = ed.xf["sel"]
+	ed.xf["flt_c"] = ed.em.centroid(sel)
+	var n: Vector3 = faces_normal(ed.em, ed.sel_t) if ed.sel_kind != 0 else Vector3.ZERO
+	ed.xf["flt_fit"] = n if n != Vector3.ZERO else fit_normal(ed.em.points, sel)
+	ed.xf["flt_faces"] = n != Vector3.ZERO
+	ed.xf["flt_f"] = -1.0   # (by the mouse until a digit's typed)
+	ed._xf_update()
+
+
+# --- the maths (static: tests call them) --------------------------------------------
+
+## The straight curve along `ids` of `pts`: from one end of their longest extent to the other
+## (the farthest point from their middle, then the farthest from it - all of them projected on
+## that line). {crv_a0, crv_dir, crv_len, crv_p: its 4 control points (thirds: straight)} - {} if
+## they're all at one place.
+static func curve_line(pts: PackedVector3Array, ids: PackedInt32Array) -> Dictionary:
+	if ids.size() < 2:
+		return {}
+	var c := Vector3.ZERO
+	for i in ids:
+		c += pts[i]
+	c /= ids.size()
+	var a := c
+	for i in ids:
+		if pts[i].distance_squared_to(c) > a.distance_squared_to(c):
+			a = pts[i]
+	var b := a
+	for i in ids:
+		if pts[i].distance_squared_to(a) > b.distance_squared_to(a):
+			b = pts[i]
+	if a.distance_to(b) < 1e-6:
+		return {}
+	var dir := (b - a).normalized()
+	var lo := INF
+	var hi := -INF
+	for i in ids:
+		var t := (pts[i] - c).dot(dir)
+		lo = minf(lo, t)
+		hi = maxf(hi, t)
+	var a0 := c + dir * lo
+	var ln := hi - lo
+	return {"crv_a0": a0, "crv_dir": dir, "crv_len": ln,
+		"crv_p": PackedVector3Array([a0, a0 + dir * (ln / 3.0), a0 + dir * (ln * 2.0 / 3.0), a0 + dir * ln])}
+
+
+static func bez(cp: PackedVector3Array, t: float) -> Vector3:
+	var u := 1.0 - t
+	return cp[0] * (u * u * u) + cp[1] * (3.0 * u * u * t) + cp[2] * (3.0 * u * t * t) + cp[3] * (t * t * t)
+
+
+static func bez_d(cp: PackedVector3Array, t: float) -> Vector3:
+	var u := 1.0 - t
+	return (cp[1] - cp[0]) * (3.0 * u * u) + (cp[2] - cp[1]) * (6.0 * u * t) + (cp[3] - cp[2]) * (3.0 * t * t)
+
+
+## The curve's length table: N + 1 cumulative lengths at t = i / N (arc_t reads it).
+static func arc_table(cp: PackedVector3Array, n := 64) -> PackedFloat32Array:
+	var out := PackedFloat32Array([0.0])
+	var prev := cp[0]
+	var acc := 0.0
+	for i in range(1, n + 1):
+		var q := bez(cp, float(i) / n)
+		acc += prev.distance_to(q)
+		out.append(acc)
+		prev = q
+	return out
+
+
+## The curve's parameter at fraction `f` (0..1) of its length.
+static func arc_t(table: PackedFloat32Array, f: float) -> float:
+	var n := table.size() - 1
+	var total := table[n]
+	if total <= 1e-12:
+		return f
+	var want := clampf(f, 0.0, 1.0) * total
+	var i := table.bsearch(want)
+	if i <= 0:
+		return 0.0
+	if i > n:
+		return 1.0
+	var a := table[i - 1]
+	var b := table[i]
+	return (float(i - 1) + ((want - a) / (b - a) if b > a else 0.0)) / n
+
+
+## A curve through the points `ids` of `pts`: its ends on the two end points (along `line`'s
+## direction), its handles solved (least squares, chord-length spacing refined by a few Newton
+## steps; held lightly towards the thirds, so two or three points still give a sound curve) for
+## it to pass as near every point as a cubic can - through them all when they lie on one.
+static func fit_curve(pts: PackedVector3Array, ids: PackedInt32Array, line: Dictionary) -> PackedVector3Array:
+	var a0: Vector3 = line["crv_a0"]
+	var dir: Vector3 = line["crv_dir"]
+	var order := Array(ids)
+	order.sort_custom(func(a, b): return (pts[a] - a0).dot(dir) < (pts[b] - a0).dot(dir))
+	var q := PackedVector3Array()
+	for i in order:
+		if q.is_empty() or pts[i].distance_to(q[-1]) > 1e-7:
+			q.append(pts[i])
+	var p0 := q[0]
+	var p3 := q[-1]
+	var third1 := p0.lerp(p3, 1.0 / 3.0)
+	var third2 := p0.lerp(p3, 2.0 / 3.0)
+	if q.size() < 3:
+		return PackedVector3Array([p0, third1, third2, p3])
+	var u := PackedFloat32Array([0.0])   # (chord-length spacing)
+	for i in range(1, q.size()):
+		u.append(u[-1] + q[i].distance_to(q[i - 1]))
+	for i in u.size():
+		u[i] /= maxf(u[-1], 1e-9)
+	var cp := PackedVector3Array([p0, third1, third2, p3])
+	var lam := 1e-4 * q.size()
+	for round in 4:
+		var c11 := lam
+		var c12 := 0.0
+		var c22 := lam
+		var x1 := third1 * lam
+		var x2 := third2 * lam
+		for i in q.size():
+			var t := u[i]
+			var v := 1.0 - t
+			var b0 := v * v * v
+			var b1 := 3.0 * v * v * t
+			var b2 := 3.0 * v * t * t
+			var b3 := t * t * t
+			var r := q[i] - p0 * b0 - p3 * b3
+			c11 += b1 * b1
+			c12 += b1 * b2
+			c22 += b2 * b2
+			x1 += r * b1
+			x2 += r * b2
+		var det := c11 * c22 - c12 * c12
+		if absf(det) < 1e-12:
+			break
+		cp[1] = (x1 * c22 - x2 * c12) / det
+		cp[2] = (x2 * c11 - x1 * c12) / det
+		for i in range(1, q.size() - 1):   # (each point's place on the curve made nearer: a Newton step)
+			u[i] = clampf(_newton(cp, q[i], u[i]), 0.0, 1.0)
+	return cp
+
+
+static func _newton(cp: PackedVector3Array, p: Vector3, t: float) -> float:
+	var d := bez(cp, t) - p
+	var d1 := bez_d(cp, t)
+	var u := 1.0 - t
+	var d2 := (cp[2] - cp[1] * 2.0 + cp[0]) * (6.0 * u) + (cp[3] - cp[2] * 2.0 + cp[1]) * (6.0 * t)
+	var den := d1.dot(d1) + d.dot(d2)
+	return t - d.dot(d1) / den if absf(den) > 1e-12 else t
+
+
+## The middles of the faces with a triangle selected in `tsel` (each face once).
+static func face_centres(em, tsel: PackedByteArray) -> PackedVector3Array:
+	var out := PackedVector3Array()
+	var seen := {}
+	for t in mini(tsel.size(), em.tri_count()):
+		if not tsel[t] or seen.has(em.tri_face[t]):
+			continue
+		seen[em.tri_face[t]] = true
+		var loop: PackedInt32Array = em.poly_loop(t)
+		var c := Vector3.ZERO
+		for p in loop:
+			c += em.points[p]
+		out.append(c / maxf(1, loop.size()))
+	return out
+
+
+## The parameter of the point on curve `cp` nearest `p` (sampled, then refined).
+static func nearest_t(cp: PackedVector3Array, p: Vector3) -> float:
+	var best := 0.0
+	var bd := INF
+	for i in 33:
+		var t := float(i) / 32.0
+		var d := bez(cp, t).distance_squared_to(p)
+		if d < bd:
+			bd = d
+			best = t
+	for i in 4:
+		best = clampf(_newton(cp, p, best), 0.0, 1.0)
+	return best
+
+
+## The fraction of curve length at parameter `t` (from arc_table's table).
+static func arc_f(table: PackedFloat32Array, t: float) -> float:
+	var n := table.size() - 1
+	var total := table[n]
+	if total <= 1e-12:
+		return t
+	var x := clampf(t, 0.0, 1.0) * n
+	var i := mini(int(x), n - 1)
+	return lerpf(table[i], table[i + 1], x - i) / total
+
+
+## The points `orig` bound to curve `cp`: each one's place along it (a fraction of its length - kept
+## as the curve changes), its offset from it there and the curve's direction there.
+## {crv_f, crv_r, crv_tan}
+static func bind_points(orig: PackedVector3Array, cp: PackedVector3Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var table := arc_table(cp)
+	var f := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var r := PackedVector3Array()
+	var tan := PackedVector3Array()
+	for o in orig:
+		var t := nearest_t(cp, o)
+		f.append(arc_f(table, t))
+		r.append(o - bez(cp, t))
+		var d := bez_d(cp, t)
+		tan.append(d.normalized() if d.length() > 1e-9 else (cp[3] - cp[0]).normalized())
+	return {"crv_f": f, "crv_r": r, "crv_tan": tan}
+
+
+## Where a selected point `o` goes when snapped: exactly on the curve, as far along it (by length)
+## as it was along the straight line.
+static func curve_snap(o: Vector3, a0: Vector3, dir: Vector3, ln: float, cp: PackedVector3Array, table: PackedFloat32Array) -> Vector3:
+	var f := clampf((o - a0).dot(dir) / maxf(ln, 1e-9), 0.0, 1.0)
+	return bez(cp, arc_t(table, f))
+
+
+## Where point `o` goes: its place along the straight line (0..1, clamped), its offset from it
+## turned as the line's direction is turned into the curve's there, added to the curve's point.
+static func curve_carry(o: Vector3, a0: Vector3, dir: Vector3, ln: float, cp: PackedVector3Array) -> Vector3:
+	var t := clampf((o - a0).dot(dir) / maxf(ln, 1e-9), 0.0, 1.0)
+	var off := o - (a0 + dir * (t * ln))
+	var tan := bez_d(cp, t)
+	if tan.length() > 1e-9:
+		off = turn(dir, tan.normalized()) * off
+	return bez(cp, t) + off
+
+
+static func _axis(a: int) -> Vector3:
+	var v := Vector3.ZERO
+	v[a] = 1.0
+	return v
+
+
+## The shortest turn taking unit `from` onto unit `to`.
+static func turn(from: Vector3, to: Vector3) -> Basis:
+	var d := from.dot(to)
+	if d > 0.999999:
+		return Basis()
+	if d < -0.999999:   # (opposite: half a turn about any line across)
+		var ax := from.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(from.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+		return Basis(ax, PI)
+	return Basis(from.cross(to).normalized(), acos(clampf(d, -1.0, 1.0)))
+
+
+## The selected faces' average normal (area-weighted; the part's space) - ZERO when none are
+## selected or they cancel out.
+static func faces_normal(em, tsel: PackedByteArray) -> Vector3:
+	var n := Vector3.ZERO
+	for t in mini(tsel.size(), em.tri_count()):
+		if tsel[t]:
+			var a: Vector3 = em.points[em.tris[t * 3]]
+			n += (em.points[em.tris[t * 3 + 1]] - a).cross(em.points[em.tris[t * 3 + 2]] - a)
+	return n.normalized() if n.length() > 1e-9 else Vector3.ZERO
+
+
+## The best-fit plane's normal through `ids` of `pts` (least squares): the direction the points
+## spread least - their covariance's smallest axis (the two largest found by power iteration,
+## the normal across them).
+static func fit_normal(pts: PackedVector3Array, ids: PackedInt32Array) -> Vector3:
+	var c := Vector3.ZERO
+	for i in ids:
+		c += pts[i]
+	c /= maxf(1, ids.size())
+	var cov := [Vector3.ZERO, Vector3.ZERO, Vector3.ZERO]   # (rows of the symmetric 3x3)
+	for i in ids:
+		var d := pts[i] - c
+		cov[0] += d * d.x
+		cov[1] += d * d.y
+		cov[2] += d * d.z
+	var mul := func(v: Vector3, m: Array) -> Vector3:
+		return Vector3((m[0] as Vector3).dot(v), (m[1] as Vector3).dot(v), (m[2] as Vector3).dot(v))
+	var e1 := _power(cov, mul, Vector3(0.6, 0.7, 0.4))
+	if e1 == Vector3.ZERO:
+		return Vector3.UP
+	var l1: float = (mul.call(e1, cov) as Vector3).dot(e1)
+	var cov2 := [cov[0] - e1 * (l1 * e1.x), cov[1] - e1 * (l1 * e1.y), cov[2] - e1 * (l1 * e1.z)]
+	var seed := e1.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(e1.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT)
+	var e2 := _power(cov2, mul, seed)
+	if e2 == Vector3.ZERO:   # (all on a line: any plane through it)
+		return seed.normalized()
+	var n := e1.cross(e2)
+	return n.normalized() if n.length() > 1e-9 else seed.normalized()
+
+
+static func _power(m: Array, mul: Callable, v0: Vector3) -> Vector3:
+	var v := v0.normalized()
+	for i in 64:
+		var w: Vector3 = mul.call(v, m)
+		if w.length() < 1e-12:
+			return Vector3.ZERO
+		v = w.normalized()
+	return v
+
+
+# --- the transform's step (from the editor's _xf_update) ------------------------------
+
+func step(m0: Vector2, m: Vector2, ps: Vector2) -> void:
+	var x: Dictionary = ed.xf
+	var ids: PackedInt32Array = x["ids"]
+	var orig: PackedVector3Array = x["orig"]
+	var w: PackedFloat32Array = x["w"]
+	var em = ed.em
+	var g: Transform3D = ed.part.global_transform
+	if x["kind"] == "CRV":
+		if not x.has("crv_p"):
+			return   # (begin_curve sets it up next)
+		var cp: PackedVector3Array = x["crv_p"]
+		if not x.has("crv_f"):
+			return
+		# Each point at its place along the curve (by length): the selected ones on it (snapped), the
+		# rest - and all of them with snapping off - keeping their offsets, turned with the curve.
+		# The curve as it started: nothing moves.
+		var changed: bool = cp != (x["crv_start"] as PackedVector3Array)
+		var snap: bool = x.get("crv_snap", snaps())
+		var table := arc_table(cp)
+		var on := {}
+		if snap and not x.get("crv_faces", false):
+			for i in x["sel"]:
+				on[i] = true
+		if (x["crv_f"] as PackedFloat32Array).size() != ids.size():   # (the points changed - proportional radius)
+			var bind := bind_points(orig, x["crv_start"])
+			for key in bind:
+				x[key] = bind[key]
+		var f: PackedFloat32Array = x["crv_f"]
+		var r: PackedVector3Array = x["crv_r"]
+		var tan0: PackedVector3Array = x["crv_tan"]
+		for k in ids.size():
+			var o := orig[k]
+			if not changed:
+				em.points[ids[k]] = o
+				continue
+			var t := arc_t(table, f[k])
+			var to := bez(cp, t)
+			if not on.has(ids[k]):
+				var d := bez_d(cp, t)
+				to += (turn(tan0[k], d.normalized()) * r[k]) if d.length() > 1e-9 else r[k]
+			em.points[ids[k]] = o.lerp(to, w[k])
+		var gp := PackedVector3Array()
+		for p in cp:
+			gp.append(g * p)
+		ed.view.curve_pts = gp
+		ed.view.curve_hot = int(x["crv_drag"]) if int(x["crv_drag"]) >= 0 else int(x["crv_hot"])
+		var ax: int = x["axis"]
+		ed.view.axis_line = {"at": gp[int(x["crv_drag"])], "dir": g.basis * _axis(ax), "col": MeshView.AXIS_COL[ax]} \
+			if ax >= 0 and int(x["crv_drag"]) >= 0 else {}
+		ed.view.hint = ("Curve deform: the faces" if x.get("crv_faces", false) else "Curve deform") + "   (drag ends / handles · X Y Z: axis · Enter: done · Esc: cancel)"
+		return
+	# Flatten
+	if not x.has("flt_c"):
+		return   # (begin_flatten sets it up next)
+	var f: float = x["flt_f"]
+	if f < 0.0:
+		f = clampf((m - ps).length() / maxf(1.0, (m0 - ps).length()) - 1.0, 0.0, 1.0)
+	var ax: int = x["axis"]
+	var n: Vector3 = x["flt_fit"]
+	if ax >= 0:
+		n = Vector3.ZERO
+		n[ax] = 1.0
+	var c: Vector3 = x["flt_c"]
+	for k in ids.size():
+		var o := orig[k]
+		em.points[ids[k]] = o - n * ((o - c).dot(n) * f * w[k])
+	ed.view.axis_line = {"at": g * c, "dir": (g.basis * n).normalized(), "col": MeshView.AXIS_COL[ax] if ax >= 0 else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9)}
+	var onto := "the %s plane" % ["YZ", "XZ", "XY"][ax] if ax >= 0 else ("the faces' plane" if x.get("flt_faces", false) else "the best-fit plane")
+	ed.view.hint = "Flatten  %d%%  onto %s   (mouse / 0-9: how flat · X Y Z: axis plane · click: done · Esc: cancel)" % [roundi(f * 100.0), onto]
+
+
+# --- the mouse (from the editor's _view_input) ---------------------------------------
+
+## The mouse moved during a transform: true when it's handled here (the curve: a handle hovered,
+## nothing to work out); a handle being dragged is moved (false: the editor works the step out).
+func hover(at: Vector2) -> bool:
+	var x: Dictionary = ed.xf
+	if x.get("kind", "") != "CRV" or not x.has("crv_p"):
+		return false
+	var i: int = x["crv_drag"]
+	if i < 0:
+		var hot := pick(at)
+		if hot != int(x["crv_hot"]):
+			x["crv_hot"] = hot
+			ed.view.curve_hot = hot
+			ed.view.queue_redraw()
+		return true
+	drag_to(i, at)
+	return false
+
+
+## A button of the mouse during a transform: true when it's taken here (the curve: a press on an
+## end or handle starts dragging it, elsewhere nothing - Enter keeps, right-click cancels).
+func mouse_button(mb: InputEventMouseButton) -> bool:
+	var x: Dictionary = ed.xf
+	if x.get("kind", "") != "CRV" or mb.button_index != MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT or not x.has("crv_p"):
+		return false
+	if mb.pressed:
+		var i := pick(mb.position)
+		x["crv_drag"] = i
+		if i >= 0:
+			x["crv_m0"] = mb.position
+			x["crv_p0"] = (x["crv_p"] as PackedVector3Array).duplicate()
+	else:
+		x["crv_drag"] = -1
+		ed._xf_update()
+	return true
+
+
+## The end point or handle (0-3) nearest `at` on screen, within HANDLE_PX - else -1.
+func pick(at: Vector2) -> int:
+	var cp: PackedVector3Array = ed.xf.get("crv_p", PackedVector3Array())
+	var g: Transform3D = ed.part.global_transform
+	var best := -1
+	var bd := HANDLE_PX
+	for i in [0, 3, 1, 2]:   # (the ends first: a handle on top of its end lets the end be taken)
+		var p := g * cp[i]
+		if ed.view.behind(p):
+			continue
+		var d: float = ((ed.view.project(p) as Vector2) - at).length()
+		if d < bd - 0.5:
+			bd = d
+			best = i
+	return best
+
+
+## Control point `i` dragged to the mouse at `at` - over the plane facing the view through where it
+## was, or along the locked axis; an end carries its handle with it.
+func drag_to(i: int, at: Vector2) -> void:
+	var x: Dictionary = ed.xf
+	var g: Transform3D = ed.part.global_transform
+	var p0: PackedVector3Array = x["crv_p0"]
+	var start := g * p0[i]
+	var m0: Vector2 = x["crv_m0"]
+	var ax: int = x["axis"]
+	var d: Vector3
+	if ax >= 0:
+		var l := (g.basis * _axis(ax)).normalized()
+		d = ed.view.on_line(at, start, l) - ed.view.on_line(m0, start, l)
+	else:
+		d = ed.view.on_view_plane(at, start) - ed.view.on_view_plane(m0, start)
+	var dl := g.basis.inverse() * d
+	var cp := p0.duplicate()
+	cp[i] = p0[i] + dl
+	if i == 0:
+		cp[1] = p0[1] + dl
+	elif i == 3:
+		cp[2] = p0[2] + dl
+	x["crv_p"] = cp
+
+
+## Sets the curve's control points (the part's space) and works the step out - for tests and typed values.
+func set_curve(cp: PackedVector3Array) -> void:
+	if ed.xf.get("kind", "") == "CRV":
+		ed.xf["crv_p"] = cp
+		ed._xf_update()
+
+
+## The curve as it started (fitted through the points: they're back where they were).
+func reset_curve() -> void:
+	var x: Dictionary = ed.xf
+	if x.get("kind", "") != "CRV":
+		return
+	set_curve((x["crv_start"] as PackedVector3Array).duplicate())
+
+
+## Flatten's plane: -1 the best fit, 0-2 the part's X / Y / Z axis plane.
+## Curve deform's snapping on or off (the open curve follows at once).
+func set_snap(on: bool) -> void:
+	set_meta("snap_on_curve", on)
+	if _crv_btns.size() > 1:
+		(_crv_btns[1] as Button).set_pressed_no_signal(on)
+	if ed.xf.get("kind", "") == "CRV":
+		ed.xf["crv_snap"] = on
+		ed._xf_update()
+
+
+func set_plane(ax: int) -> void:
+	if ed.xf.get("kind", "") == "FLT":
+		ed.xf["axis"] = ax
+		ed.xf["dir"] = Vector3.ZERO
+		ed._xf_update()
+
+
+# --- the bar in the view ----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _build_bar() -> void:
+	_bar = PanelContainer.new()
+	_bar.name = "DeformBar"
+	_bar.anchor_left = 0.5
+	_bar.anchor_right = 0.5
+	_bar.offset_top = 8
+	_bar.grow_horizontal = Control.GROW_DIRECTION_BOTH
+	_bar.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	_bar.visible = false
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
+	_bar.add_child(row)
+	var fit: Button = ed._btn("Best-fit plane", "m_flatten", "", "Flattens onto the plane that fits the selected points best (the selected faces' own plane\nwhen faces are selected).", func(): set_plane(-1))
+	_flt_btns.append(fit)
+	for a in 3:
+		_flt_btns.append(ed._btn("%s plane" % "XYZ"[a], ["m_sym_x", "m_sym_y", "m_sym_z"][a], "XYZ"[a],
+			"Flattens onto the plane across the part's own %s axis through the selection's middle\n(every point given the middle's %s)." % ["XYZ"[a], "XYZ"[a]], set_plane.bind(a)))
+	for b in _flt_btns:
+		(b as Button).toggle_mode = true
+		row.add_child(b)
+	_crv_btns.append(ed._btn("Reset the curve", "reload", "", "The curve back as it started - fitted through the points (they're back where they were).", reset_curve))
+	var sn: Button = ed._btn("Snap onto the curve", "snap", "", "On: the selected points sit exactly on the curve, spaced along it as they were along the line.\nOff: each keeps its offset from the line - an area of points bent by the curve.", func(): set_snap(not snaps()))
+	sn.toggle_mode = true
+	sn.set_pressed_no_signal(snaps())
+	_crv_btns.append(sn)
+	for b in _crv_btns:
+		row.add_child(b)
+	row.add_child(ed._btn("Keep", "accept", "Enter", "Keeps the change (one undo step).", func(): ed.confirm_transform()))
+	row.add_child(ed._btn("Cancel", "close", "Esc / right-click", "Puts the points back as they were.", func(): ed._cancel_xf()))
+	ed.view.add_child(_bar)
+
+
+func _process(_dt: float) -> void:
+	if ed == null or ed.view == null:
+		return
+	if _bar and _crv_btns.size() < 2:   # (a bar made by older code: made again, with every button)
+		_bar.queue_free()
+		_bar = null
+		_crv_btns = []
+		_flt_btns = []
+		_shown = "?"
+	var k: String = ed.xf.get("kind", "") if ed.mode == "edit" else ""
+	if not k in KINDS:
+		k = ""
+	if k != _shown:
+		_shown = k
+		if _bar == null and k != "":
+			_build_bar()
+		if _bar:
+			_bar.visible = k != ""
+			for b in _crv_btns:
+				b.visible = k == "CRV"
+			for b in _flt_btns:
+				b.visible = k == "FLT"
+	if k != "CRV" and not ed.view.curve_pts.is_empty():
+		ed.view.curve_pts = PackedVector3Array()
+		ed.view.curve_hot = -1
+		ed.view.queue_redraw()
+	if k == "FLT":
+		var ax: int = ed.xf.get("axis", -1)
+		for i in _flt_btns.size():
+			(_flt_btns[i] as Button).set_pressed_no_signal(i == ax + 1)
hunks.title: Curve deform and flatten
hunks.note: The fit, the binding, the arc-length table and the plane fit.

bubbles.text: The handles solved by least squares (chord-length spacing refined by Newton steps): the curve passes through the points, so nothing moves until it's changed.
64 samples of length along the curve: points snapped onto it spaced by length as they were along the line.
Flatten's plane: the covariance's smallest axis (the two largest by power iteration, the normal across them).

files.explanation: A part's editable copy: welded points over the vertex arrays (every attribute and bone weight kept), faces (quads and n-gons) found over the triangles, and every edit - extrude, merge, subdivide, knife, dissolve, symmetrize topology - with only what changed derived again.

@@ -1,0 +1,2920 @@ 
+extends RefCounted
+## The mesh editor's working copy of one part's mesh (its edit mode): every
+## triangle surface's vertex arrays (positions, normals, colours, UVs and, on a
+## skinned mesh, the bones and weights - kept through every edit), and over them
+## the *points*: vertices at the same place welded into one (a UV seam or a hard
+## edge splits a vertex in the arrays; you see and select one). Edits move points
+## (each moves its vertices with it) or change the topology (extrude, delete,
+## merge, subdivide, the knife), then derive() works out the triangles, edges and
+## neighbours again (the knife patches them where it cut instead).
+## Over the triangles, the *faces* (n-gons): each triangle has a face id (Surf.face),
+## the triangles of one face are edge-joined and flat; the edges inside a face (its
+## triangulation's diagonals) aren't shown. A model read from a file has its faces
+## found again: flat triangles paired into quads (squarest first), then joined into
+## n-gons along the flat face's rim (no corner made straight, none left inside).
+##   var em := EditMesh.from_mesh(part.mesh)       # (or build() on a worker, then derive())
+##   em.points[i] = ...; em.sync(ids); em.update_mesh()
+## Plain data: no nodes, so it can be built on a worker thread. (Packed arrays
+## are shared by reference: snapshots copy them; derived arrays are never changed
+## in place - made anew, or copied first - so snapshots keep them as they are.)
+
+## A vertex in a point's list: (surface << SHIFT) | vertex.
+const SHIFT := 24
+const VMASK := (1 << SHIFT) - 1
+## An edge's key in edge_of: a * KEY + b (a < b) - the same however many points are added.
+const KEY := 1 << 32
+## Triangles this close to parallel (cos 1°) are one flat face; a corner this straight (179°) isn't one.
+const COPLANAR := 0.99985
+const STRAIGHT := -0.99985
+## The faces last edited of each mesh (instance id -> [WeakRef, faces per surface]): editing it
+## again finds its faces as you left them, not guessed again from the triangles.
+static var _kept := {}
+static var _kept_lock := Mutex.new()
+## Falloffs of proportional editing (the weight at distance d of radius r).
+const FALLOFFS := ["smooth", "sphere", "root", "linear", "sharp", "constant"]
+## The 26 cells around one.
+static var _AROUND: Array = _around()
+
+static func _around() -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for x in range(-1, 2):
+		for y in range(-1, 2):
+			for z in range(-1, 2):
+				if x != 0 or y != 0 or z != 0:
+					out.append(Vector3i(x, y, z))
+	return out
+
+var surfs: Array = []            # Surf, the triangle surfaces
+var other: Array = []            # [primitive, arrays, flags, material, name] - non-triangle surfaces, kept as they are
+var points := PackedVector3Array()
+# Derived (derive()):
+var tris := PackedInt32Array()       # 3 points a triangle - surfaces in order, as Mesh.get_faces() lists them
+var tri_surf := PackedInt32Array()   # triangle -> its surface
+var tri_at := PackedInt32Array()     # triangle -> its first index in the surface's index array
+var edges := PackedInt32Array()      # 2 points an edge (a < b)
+var edge_of := {}                    # a * n + b -> edge
+var pv_start := PackedInt32Array()   # point -> its vertices: pv[pv_start[p] .. pv_start[p + 1]]
+var pv := PackedInt32Array()
+var adj_start := PackedInt32Array()  # point -> its neighbours: adj[adj_start[p] .. adj_start[p + 1]]
+var adj := PackedInt32Array()
+var tri_face := PackedInt32Array()   # triangle -> its face (0 .. face_n - 1 after derive())
+var tri_edges := PackedInt32Array()  # 3 edges a triangle (edge k: corner k -> k + 1; -1: none)
+var edge_tris := PackedInt32Array()  # 2 triangles an edge (-1: none)
+var edge_tn := PackedInt32Array()    # how many triangles use an edge
+var edge_more := {}                  # edge -> its third triangle and on (a non-manifold edge): PackedInt32Array
+var edge_inner := PackedByteArray()  # 1: an edge inside a face (a diagonal of its triangles - not shown)
+var face_n := 0                       # (the next face id: ids below it, some unused after a dissolve)
+var face_live := 0                    # how many faces
+var _wire := PackedInt32Array()
+var _wire_topo := -1
+var _eps_topo := -1
+var _eps := 1e-7
+## Points dissolved, left with no triangle (compact() drops them; edit mode does when it ends).
+var unused := false
+## Which topology the derived arrays describe (snapshots with the same one restore without derive()).
+var topo := 0
+static var _topo_ids := 0
+## The mesh shown (update_mesh() refills it).
+var mesh := ArrayMesh.new()
+
+
+## One triangle surface, its vertex attributes as typed arrays.
+class Surf extends RefCounted:
+	var name := ""
+	var material: Material
+	var flags := 0
+	var pos := PackedVector3Array()
+	var nrm := PackedVector3Array()
+	var col := PackedColorArray()
+	var uv := PackedVector2Array()
+	var uv2 := PackedVector2Array()
+	var bones := PackedInt32Array()
+	var weights := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var nb := 0                       # bones a vertex (0: not skinned)
+	var idx := PackedInt32Array()
+	var vp := PackedInt32Array()      # vertex -> point
+	var face := PackedInt32Array()    # triangle (idx / 3) -> its face (-1: to be found from the shape)
+
+	func count() -> int:
+		return pos.size()
+
+	func copy() -> Surf:
+		var s := Surf.new()
+		s.name = name
+		s.material = material
+		s.flags = flags
+		s.pos = pos.duplicate()
+		s.nrm = nrm.duplicate()
+		s.col = col.duplicate()
+		s.uv = uv.duplicate()
+		s.uv2 = uv2.duplicate()
+		s.bones = bones.duplicate()
+		s.weights = weights.duplicate()
+		s.nb = nb
+		s.idx = idx.duplicate()
+		s.vp = vp.duplicate()
+		s.face = face.duplicate()
+		return s
+
+	func bytes() -> int:
+		return pos.size() * 36 + col.size() * 16 + (uv.size() + uv2.size()) * 8 + (bones.size() + weights.size()) * 4 + idx.size() * 4 + face.size() * 4
+
+	func arrays() -> Array:
+		var a := []
+		a.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+		a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = pos
+		a[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] = nrm
+		if not col.is_empty():
+			a[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = col
+		if not uv.is_empty():
+			a[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV] = uv
+		if not uv2.is_empty():
+			a[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2] = uv2
+		if nb > 0:
+			a[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES] = bones
+			a[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS] = weights
+		a[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = idx
+		return a
+
+	## Appends a copy of vertex `v` (all its attributes) as point `point`; its index.
+	func copy_vertex(v: int, point: int) -> int:
+		pos.append(pos[v])
+		nrm.append(nrm[v])
+		if not col.is_empty():
+			col.append(col[v])
+		if not uv.is_empty():
+			uv.append(uv[v])
+		if not uv2.is_empty():
+			uv2.append(uv2[v])
+		for k in nb:
+			bones.append(bones[v * nb + k])
+			weights.append(weights[v * nb + k])
+		vp.append(point)
+		return pos.size() - 1
+
+	## Appends the vertex halfway between `a` and `b` (attributes mixed; the
+	## bone weights of both, the strongest kept) as point `point`.
+	func mix_vertex(a: int, b: int, point: int) -> int:
+		return blend_vertex(PackedInt32Array([a, b]), PackedFloat32Array([0.5, 0.5]), point)
+
+	## Appends a vertex mixed from vertices `vs`, each `ws` of it (the weights add up to 1):
+	## position, normal (smooth where theirs is), colour, UVs, and the bone weights of all
+	## of them (the strongest kept) - as point `point`.
+	func blend_vertex(vs: PackedInt32Array, ws: PackedFloat32Array, point: int) -> int:
+		var p := Vector3.ZERO
+		var n := Vector3.ZERO
+		var c := Color(0, 0, 0, 0)
+		var u := Vector2.ZERO
+		var u2 := Vector2.ZERO
+		for i in vs.size():
+			var v := vs[i]
+			var f := ws[i]
+			p += pos[v] * f
+			n += nrm[v] * f
+			if not col.is_empty():
+				c += col[v] * f
+			if not uv.is_empty():
+				u += uv[v] * f
+			if not uv2.is_empty():
+				u2 += uv2[v] * f
+		pos.append(p)
+		nrm.append(n.normalized() if n.length_squared() > 1e-20 else nrm[vs[0]])
+		if not col.is_empty():
+			col.append(c)
+		if not uv.is_empty():
+			uv.append(u)
+		if not uv2.is_empty():
+			uv2.append(u2)
+		if nb > 0:
+			var w := {}
+			for i in vs.size():
+				var v := vs[i]
+				for k in nb:
+					var wt: float = weights[v * nb + k]
+					if wt > 0.0:
+						var bn: int = bones[v * nb + k]
+						w[bn] = w.get(bn, 0.0) + wt * ws[i]
+			var ks: Array = w.keys()
+			ks.sort_custom(func(x, y): return w[x] > w[y])
+			var total := 0.0
+			for k in mini(nb, ks.size()):
+				total += w[ks[k]]
+			for k in nb:
+				if k < ks.size() and total > 0.0:
+					bones.append(ks[k])
+					weights.append(w[ks[k]] / total)
+				else:
+					bones.append(0)
+					weights.append(0.0)
+		vp.append(point)
+		return pos.size() - 1
+
+	## Positions from the points: every vertex (`only` empty) or those listed.
+	func sync(points: PackedVector3Array, only: PackedInt32Array) -> void:
+		if only.is_empty():
+			for v in pos.size():
+				pos[v] = points[vp[v]]
+		else:
+			for v in only:
+				pos[v] = points[vp[v]]
+
+	## Shading normals from the faces (area-weighted; a vertex split in the
+	## arrays - a hard edge - keeps its sides apart).
+	func recalc_normals() -> void:
+		var n := PackedVector3Array()
+		n.resize(pos.size())
+		for i in range(0, idx.size(), 3):
+			var a := idx[i]
+			var b := idx[i + 1]
+			var c := idx[i + 2]
+			var fn := (pos[a] - pos[c]).cross(pos[a] - pos[b])
+			n[a] += fn
+			n[b] += fn
+			n[c] += fn
+		for v in n.size():
+			var l := n[v].length()
+			n[v] = n[v] / l if l > 1e-12 else Vector3.UP
+		nrm = n
+
+	## Drops the vertices no triangle uses (indices remapped).
+	func compact() -> void:
+		var used := PackedInt32Array()
+		used.resize(pos.size())
+		used.fill(-1)
+		var order := PackedInt32Array()
+		for i in idx.size():
+			var v := idx[i]
+			if used[v] < 0:
+				used[v] = order.size()
+				order.append(v)
+			idx[i] = used[v]
+		if order.size() == pos.size():
+			var same := true
+			for k in order.size():
+				if order[k] != k:
+					same = false
+					break
+			if same:
+				return
+		var p2 := PackedVector3Array(); var n2 := PackedVector3Array(); var c2 := PackedColorArray()
+		var u2 := PackedVector2Array(); var uu2 := PackedVector2Array(); var b2 := PackedInt32Array()
+		var w2 := PackedFloat32Array(); var vp2 := PackedInt32Array()
+		for v in order:
+			p2.append(pos[v])
+			n2.append(nrm[v])
+			if not col.is_empty():
+				c2.append(col[v])
+			if not uv.is_empty():
+				u2.append(uv[v])
+			if not uv2.is_empty():
+				uu2.append(uv2[v])
+			for k in nb:
+				b2.append(bones[v * nb + k])
+				w2.append(weights[v * nb + k])
+			vp2.append(vp[v])
+		pos = p2; nrm = n2; col = c2; uv = u2; uv2 = uu2; bones = b2; weights = w2; vp = vp2
+
+	## Points renumbered (`map`: old -> new).
+	func remap_points(map: PackedInt32Array) -> void:
+		for v in vp.size():
+			vp[v] = map[vp[v]]
+
+	## Triangles whose corners aren't three different points dropped.
+	func drop_degenerate() -> void:
+		var ni := PackedInt32Array()
+		var nf := PackedInt32Array()
+		var has_f := face.size() == idx.size() / 3
+		for i in range(0, idx.size() - 2, 3):
+			var a := vp[idx[i]]
+			var b := vp[idx[i + 1]]
+			var c := vp[idx[i + 2]]
+			if a != b and b != c and a != c:
+				ni.append(idx[i]); ni.append(idx[i + 1]); ni.append(idx[i + 2])
+				nf.append(face[i / 3] if has_f else -1)
+		idx = ni
+		face = nf
+
+	## Drops the triangles starting at the indices in `kill`.
+	func drop_tris(kill: Dictionary) -> void:
+		var ni := PackedInt32Array()
+		var nf := PackedInt32Array()
+		var has_f := face.size() == idx.size() / 3
+		for i in range(0, idx.size() - 2, 3):
+			if not kill.has(i):
+				ni.append(idx[i]); ni.append(idx[i + 1]); ni.append(idx[i + 2])
+				nf.append(face[i / 3] if has_f else -1)
+		idx = ni
+		face = nf
+
+	## The vertices of the points flagged become point `target` at `at`.
+	func merge_points(flag: PackedByteArray, target: int, at: Vector3) -> void:
+		for v in vp.size():
+			if flag[vp[v]]:
+				vp[v] = target
+				pos[v] = at
+
+	## Mirror across `axis`: every vertex copied (`pm`: point -> its twin; itself
+	## on the seam, where the vertex is shared), the copies' faces turned round.
+	## True if any vertex was on the seam. (The copies' faces: `foff` added to the ids.)
+	## (`bones`: each bone's twin - an arm's copy weighted to the other arm; empty: the same bones.)
+	func mirror(pm: PackedInt32Array, points: PackedVector3Array, axis: int, clip: bool, foff := 0, bones_twin := PackedInt32Array()) -> bool:
+		var nv := count()
+		var vm := PackedInt32Array()
+		vm.resize(nv)
+		var seam := false
+		for v in nv:
+			var p := vp[v]
+			if pm[p] == p:
+				vm[v] = v
+				seam = true
+				if clip:
+					var q := pos[v]
+					q[axis] = 0.0
+					pos[v] = q
+			else:
+				var c := copy_vertex(v, pm[p])
+				pos[c] = points[pm[p]]
+				var nn := nrm[v]
+				nn[axis] = -nn[axis]
+				nrm[c] = nn
+				if not bones_twin.is_empty():
+					for k in nb:
+						var bn := bones[c * nb + k]
+						if bn >= 0 and bn < bones_twin.size():
+							bones[c * nb + k] = bones_twin[bn]
+				vm[v] = c
+		var ni := idx.size()
+		if face.size() != ni / 3:
+			face.resize(ni / 3)
+			face.fill(-1)
+		for i in range(0, ni, 3):
+			idx.append(vm[idx[i]])
+			idx.append(vm[idx[i + 2]])
+			idx.append(vm[idx[i + 1]])
+			face.append(face[i / 3] + foff if face[i / 3] >= 0 else -1)
+		return seam
+
+	## Extrudes the triangles starting at `starts`: their corners moved to the
+	## points' copies (`np`), walls along the region's border (`border`: the
+	## edges - keys a * n0 + b - used by one triangle of the region), each wall a
+	## face of its own (ids from `next`). Returns the next free face id.
+	func extrude(starts: PackedInt32Array, np: PackedInt32Array, border: Dictionary, n0: int, next := 0) -> int:
+		var vm := {}
+		for i0 in starts:
+			var ov := [idx[i0], idx[i0 + 1], idx[i0 + 2]]
+			for k in 3:
+				var v: int = ov[k]
+				if not vm.has(v):
+					vm[v] = copy_vertex(v, np[vp[v]])
+				idx[i0 + k] = vm[v]
+			for k in 3:
+				var va: int = ov[k]
+				var vb: int = ov[(k + 1) % 3]
+				var a := vp[va]
+				var b := vp[vb]
+				if border.get(mini(a, b) * n0 + maxi(a, b), 0) != 1:
+					continue
+				var wa := copy_vertex(va, a)
+				var wb := copy_vertex(vb, b)
+				var wa2 := copy_vertex(va, np[a])
+				var wb2 := copy_vertex(vb, np[b])
+				idx.append_array(PackedInt32Array([wa, wb, wb2, wa, wb2, wa2]))
+				face.append(next)
+				face.append(next)
+				next += 1
+		return next
+
+	## Splits every triangle with an edge in `mid` (key a * n0 + b -> the new
+	## middle point): one edge - in two, two - in three (both still in their face:
+	## it gets a corner more), all - in four (their faces found again: -1).
+	func subdivide(mid: Dictionary, n0: int, points: PackedVector3Array) -> void:
+		var vmid := {}
+		var old := idx
+		var ni := PackedInt32Array()
+		var nf := PackedInt32Array()
+		var has_f := face.size() == old.size() / 3
+		for i in range(0, old.size() - 2, 3):
+			var f: int = face[i / 3] if has_f else -1
+			var n_before := ni.size()
+			var v := [old[i], old[i + 1], old[i + 2]]
+			var m := [-1, -1, -1]   # the middle of edge k (v[k] -> v[k + 1])
+			var split := 0
+			for k in 3:
+				var va: int = v[k]
+				var vb: int = v[(k + 1) % 3]
+				var a := vp[va]
+				var b := vp[vb]
+				var key := mini(a, b) * n0 + maxi(a, b)
+				if mid.has(key):
+					var vk := Vector2i(mini(va, vb), maxi(va, vb))
+					if not vmid.has(vk):
+						var c := mix_vertex(va, vb, mid[key])
+						pos[c] = points[mid[key]]
+						vmid[vk] = c
+					m[k] = vmid[vk]
+					split += 1
+			match split:
+				0:
+					ni.append_array(PackedInt32Array(v))
+				3:
+					ni.append_array(PackedInt32Array([v[0], m[0], m[2], m[0], v[1], m[1], m[2], m[1], v[2], m[0], m[1], m[2]]))
+				1:
+					var k := 0
+					while m[k] < 0:
+						k += 1
+					var x: int = v[k]; var y: int = v[(k + 1) % 3]; var z: int = v[(k + 2) % 3]
+					ni.append_array(PackedInt32Array([x, m[k], z, m[k], y, z]))
+				2:
+					var k: int = m.find(-1)   # the edge not split, v[k] -> v[k + 1]: turned to be z -> x
+					var x: int = v[(k + 1) % 3]; var y: int = v[(k + 2) % 3]; var z: int = v[k]
+					var m1: int = m[(k + 1) % 3]; var m2: int = m[(k + 2) % 3]
+					ni.append_array(PackedInt32Array([m1, y, m2, x, m1, m2, x, m2, z]))
+			for j in (ni.size() - n_before) / 3:
+				nf.append(-1 if split == 3 else f)
+		idx = ni
+		face = nf
+
+	## The triangles starting at `starts` turned round, their vertices' normals too.
+	func flip(starts: PackedInt32Array) -> void:
+		var f := PackedByteArray()
+		f.resize(count())
+		for i in starts:
+			var b := idx[i + 1]
+			idx[i + 1] = idx[i + 2]
+			idx[i + 2] = b
+			for k in 3:
+				f[idx[i + k]] = 1
+		for v in count():
+			if f[v]:
+				nrm[v] = -nrm[v]
+
+
+## The editable copy of `m` (welded and derived) - on the calling thread.
+static func from_mesh(m: Mesh) -> RefCounted:
+	var em = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/edit_mesh.gd").new()
+	em.build(m)
+	em.derive()
+	return em
+
+
+## The faces `m`'s triangle surfaces had when it was last edited ([] - none kept).
+static func kept_faces(m: Mesh) -> Array:
+	if m == null:
+		return []
+	_kept_lock.lock()
+	var k: Array = _kept.get(m.get_instance_id(), [])
+	_kept_lock.unlock()
+	if k.is_empty() or (k[0] as WeakRef).get_ref() != m:
+		return []
+	return k[1]
+
+
+static func _keep_faces(m: Mesh, faces: Array) -> void:
+	_kept_lock.lock()
+	if _kept.size() > 64:
+		for id in _kept.keys():
+			if (_kept[id][0] as WeakRef).get_ref() == null:
+				_kept.erase(id)
+	_kept[m.get_instance_id()] = [weakref(m), faces]
+	_kept_lock.unlock()
+
+
+## Reads `m`'s surfaces and welds their vertices into points.
+func build(m: Mesh) -> void:
+	surfs = []
+	other = []
+	points = PackedVector3Array()
+	if m == null:
+		return
+	var kept := kept_faces(m)
+	var at := {}   # position -> point
+	for i in m.get_surface_count():
+		var a: Array = m.surface_get_arrays(i)
+		var prim := Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES
+		var flags := 0
+		if m is ArrayMesh:
+			prim = (m as ArrayMesh).surface_get_primitive_type(i)
+			flags = (m as ArrayMesh).surface_get_format(i) & Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USE_8_BONE_WEIGHTS
+		var mat: Material = m.surface_get_material(i)
+		var nm: String = (m as ArrayMesh).surface_get_name(i) if m is ArrayMesh else ""
+		if prim != Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES or a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] == null:
+			other.append([prim, a, flags, mat, nm])
+			continue
+		var s := Surf.new()
+		s.name = nm
+		s.material = mat
+		s.flags = flags
+		s.pos = a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+		var nv := s.pos.size()
+		s.nrm = a[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] if a[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] != null else PackedVector3Array()
+		if a[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] != null:
+			s.col = a[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR]
+		if a[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV] != null:
+			s.uv = a[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV]
+		if a[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2] != null:
+			s.uv2 = a[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV2]
+		if a[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES] != null and a[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS] != null and nv > 0:
+			var bn = a[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES]
+			s.bones = bn if bn is PackedInt32Array else PackedInt32Array(bn)
+			var wt = a[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS]
+			s.weights = wt if wt is PackedFloat32Array else PackedFloat32Array(wt)
+			s.nb = s.bones.size() / nv
+			s.flags = Mesh.ARRAY_FLAG_USE_8_BONE_WEIGHTS if s.nb == 8 else 0
+		var idx := PackedInt32Array()
+		if a[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] != null:
+			idx = a[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
+		else:
+			idx.resize(nv - nv % 3)
+			for k in idx.size():
+				idx[k] = k
+		s.idx = idx
+		var vp := PackedInt32Array()
+		vp.resize(nv)
+		var pos := s.pos
+		for v in nv:
+			var p: Vector3 = pos[v]
+			var id: int = at.get(p, -1)
+			if id < 0:
+				id = points.size()
+				at[p] = id
+				points.append(p)
+			vp[v] = id
+		s.vp = vp
+		if s.nrm.size() != nv:
+			s.recalc_normals()
+		s.drop_degenerate()   # (triangles with two corners at one point - a sphere's poles: no face, nothing drawn)
+		var ks := surfs.size()
+		if ks < kept.size() and (kept[ks] as PackedInt32Array).size() == s.idx.size() / 3:
+			s.face = (kept[ks] as PackedInt32Array).duplicate()
+		surfs.append(s)
+
+
+## Works out the triangles, edges, neighbours and faces from the surfaces (the
+## triangles of no face yet - a mesh just read, a subdivision's - grouped into faces).
+func derive() -> void:
+	var n := points.size()
+	tris = PackedInt32Array()
+	tri_surf = PackedInt32Array()
+	tri_at = PackedInt32Array()
+	tri_face = PackedInt32Array()
+	var ungrouped := false
+	var count := PackedInt32Array()
+	count.resize(n + 1)
+	for si in surfs.size():
+		var s: Surf = surfs[si]
+		var vp := s.vp
+		var idx := s.idx
+		var nt := idx.size() / 3
+		if s.face.size() != nt:
+			s.face = PackedInt32Array()
+			s.face.resize(nt)
+			s.face.fill(-1)
+		var face := s.face
+		for i in range(0, nt * 3, 3):
+			tris.append(vp[idx[i]])
+			tris.append(vp[idx[i + 1]])
+			tris.append(vp[idx[i + 2]])
+			tri_surf.append(si)
+			tri_at.append(i)
+			var f := face[i / 3]
+			tri_face.append(f)
+			if f < 0:
+				ungrouped = true
+		for v in vp:
+			count[v + 1] += 1
+	# point -> vertices (counting sort)
+	for p in n:
+		count[p + 1] += count[p]
+	pv_start = count.duplicate()
+	pv = PackedInt32Array()
+	pv.resize(count[n])
+	var fill := count.duplicate()
+	for si in surfs.size():
+		var vp: PackedInt32Array = surfs[si].vp
+		for v in vp.size():
+			var p := vp[v]
+			pv[fill[p]] = (si << SHIFT) | v
+			fill[p] += 1
+	# edges, and the triangles each one has
+	edges = PackedInt32Array()
+	edge_of = {}
+	edge_tris = PackedInt32Array()
+	edge_tn = PackedInt32Array()
+	edge_more = {}
+	tri_edges = PackedInt32Array()
+	tri_edges.resize(tris.size())
+	var deg := PackedInt32Array()
+	deg.resize(n + 1)
+	for i in tris.size():
+		var t := i / 3
+		var a := tris[i]
+		var b := tris[i + 1 if i % 3 != 2 else i - 2]
+		if a == b:
+			tri_edges[i] = -1
+			continue
+		if a > b:
+			var tmp := a; a = b; b = tmp
+		var key := a * KEY + b
+		var e: int = edge_of.get(key, -1)
+		if e < 0:
+			e = edges.size() / 2
+			edge_of[key] = e
+			edges.append(a)
+			edges.append(b)
+			edge_tris.append(t)
+			edge_tris.append(-1)
+			edge_tn.append(1)
+			deg[a + 1] += 1
+			deg[b + 1] += 1
+		else:
+			if edge_tn[e] == 1:
+				edge_tris[e * 2 + 1] = t
+			else:
+				_nb(edge_more, e, t)
+			edge_tn[e] += 1
+		tri_edges[i] = e
+	for p in n:
+		deg[p + 1] += deg[p]
+	adj_start = deg.duplicate()
+	adj = PackedInt32Array()
+	adj.resize(deg[n])
+	fill = deg
+	for e in range(0, edges.size(), 2):
+		var a := edges[e]
+		var b := edges[e + 1]
+		adj[fill[a]] = b
+		fill[a] += 1
+		adj[fill[b]] = a
+		fill[b] += 1
+	# faces
+	if ungrouped:
+		var flag := PackedByteArray()
+		flag.resize(tri_face.size())
+		for t in tri_face.size():
+			if tri_face[t] < 0:
+				flag[t] = 1
+		_group(flag)
+	_number_faces()
+	edge_inner = PackedByteArray()
+	edge_inner.resize(edge_tn.size())
+	for e in edge_tn.size():
+		if edge_tn[e] == 2 and tri_face[edge_tris[e * 2]] == tri_face[edge_tris[e * 2 + 1]]:
+			edge_inner[e] = 1
+	_topo_ids += 1
+	topo = _topo_ids
+
+
+## The faces numbered 0 .. face_n - 1 (in the triangles' order), in the surfaces too.
+func _number_faces() -> void:
+	var top := -1
+	for f in tri_face:
+		top = maxi(top, f)
+	var map := PackedInt32Array()
+	map.resize(top + 1)
+	map.fill(-1)
+	var nf := 0
+	for t in tri_face.size():
+		var f := tri_face[t]
+		if map[f] < 0:
+			map[f] = nf
+			nf += 1
+		var g := map[f]
+		tri_face[t] = g
+		(surfs[tri_surf[t]] as Surf).face[tri_at[t] / 3] = g
+	face_n = nf
+	face_live = nf
+
+
+## Triangles `flag` grouped into faces: flat (normals within 1°) edge-joined triangles
+## of one surface, not across a seam. First pairs into quads - their shared edge the
+## longest of both, every corner 20°..160°, the squarest first (a grid's diagonals) -
+## then those joined into n-gons across the flat edges between corners on the rim of
+## the flat area (a fan's centre, a grid's inner corners stay corners), never making a
+## corner straight or a point inside a face. Sets tri_face of those triangles.
+func _group(flag: PackedByteArray) -> void:
+	var nt := tri_count()
+	var nrm := PackedVector3Array()
+	nrm.resize(nt)
+	for t in nt:
+		if flag[t]:
+			var a := points[tris[t * 3]]
+			var fn := (points[tris[t * 3 + 1]] - a).cross(points[tris[t * 3 + 2]] - a)
+			var l := fn.length()
+			nrm[t] = fn / l if l > 1e-20 else Vector3.ZERO
+	var parent := PackedInt32Array()
+	parent.resize(nt)
+	for t in nt:
+		parent[t] = t
+	var cand := PackedInt32Array()
+	var rim := PackedByteArray()   # (points on an edge that isn't flat inside the area)
+	rim.resize(points.size())
+	for e in edge_tn.size():
+		var ok := edge_tn[e] == 2
+		if ok:
+			var t0 := edge_tris[e * 2]
+			var t1 := edge_tris[e * 2 + 1]
+			ok = flag[t0] == 1 and flag[t1] == 1 and tri_surf[t0] == tri_surf[t1] and nrm[t0] != Vector3.ZERO \
+				and nrm[t0].dot(nrm[t1]) > COPLANAR
+		if ok:
+			# (flat inside the area - a seam along it keeps it from joining faces, not from being inside)
+			if _seamless(edge_tris[e * 2], edge_tris[e * 2 + 1], edges[e * 2], edges[e * 2 + 1]):
+				cand.append(e)
+		else:
+			rim[edges[e * 2]] = 1
+			rim[edges[e * 2 + 1]] = 1
+	# quads, squarest first
+	var keys := PackedInt64Array()
+	for ci in cand.size():
+		var q := _quad_quality(cand[ci])
+		if q >= 0.0:
+			keys.append((int(q * 1000.0) << 32) | ci)
+	keys.sort()
+	var paired := PackedByteArray()
+	paired.resize(nt)
+	for k in keys:
+		var e := cand[k & 0xFFFFFFFF]
+		var t0 := edge_tris[e * 2]
+		var t1 := edge_tris[e * 2 + 1]
+		if paired[t0] or paired[t1]:
+			continue
+		paired[t0] = 1
+		paired[t1] = 1
+		parent[t1] = t0
+	# n-gons
+	for round in 3:
+		var merged := false
+		for e in cand:
+			var a := edges[e * 2]
+			var b := edges[e * 2 + 1]
+			if not rim[a] or not rim[b]:
+				continue
+			var r0 := _root(parent, edge_tris[e * 2])
+			var r1 := _root(parent, edge_tris[e * 2 + 1])
+			if r0 == r1:
+				continue
+			if _joinable(a, r0, r1, parent) and _joinable(b, r0, r1, parent):
+				parent[r1] = r0
+				merged = true
+		if not merged:
+			break
+	var base := 0
+	for f in tri_face:
+		base = maxi(base, f + 1)
+	for t in nt:
+		if flag[t]:
+			tri_face[t] = base + _root(parent, t)
+
+
+static func _root(parent: PackedInt32Array, t: int) -> int:
+	while parent[t] != t:
+		parent[t] = parent[parent[t]]
+		t = parent[t]
+	return t
+
+
+## Triangle `t`'s vertex at point `p` (-1: not a corner).
+func _vert_at(t: int, p: int) -> int:
+	var s: Surf = surfs[tri_surf[t]]
+	var i := tri_at[t]
+	for k in 3:
+		var v := s.idx[i + k]
+		if s.vp[v] == p:
+			return v
+	return -1
+
+
+## Triangles t0 and t1 share their vertices along edge a-b (no UV seam or hard edge there).
+func _seamless(t0: int, t1: int, a: int, b: int) -> bool:
+	return _vert_at(t0, a) == _vert_at(t1, a) and _vert_at(t0, b) == _vert_at(t1, b)
+
+
+func _third(t: int, a: int, b: int) -> int:
+	for k in 3:
+		var p := tris[t * 3 + k]
+		if p != a and p != b:
+			return p
+	return -1
+
+
+## How far from square the quad of edge `e`'s two triangles is (the sum of its corners'
+## differences from 90°, degrees); -1: not a quad (the edge isn't the longest of both,
+## a corner under 20° or over 160°, not convex).
+func _quad_quality(e: int) -> float:
+	var t0 := edge_tris[e * 2]
+	var t1 := edge_tris[e * 2 + 1]
+	var ia := edges[e * 2]
+	var ib := edges[e * 2 + 1]
+	var i0 := _third(t0, ia, ib)
+	var i1 := _third(t1, ia, ib)
+	if i0 < 0 or i1 < 0 or i0 == i1:
+		return -1.0
+	var a := points[ia]
+	var b := points[ib]
+	var c0 := points[i0]
+	var c1 := points[i1]
+	var l := a.distance_to(b) / 1.001
+	if a.distance_to(c0) >= l or b.distance_to(c0) >= l or a.distance_to(c1) >= l or b.distance_to(c1) >= l:
+		return -1.0
+	var nn := (b - a).cross(c0 - a)
+	var sa := (c1 - c0).cross(a - c0).dot(nn)
+	var sb := (c1 - c0).cross(b - c0).dot(nn)
+	if sa * sb >= 0.0:
+		return -1.0
+	var q := 0.0
+	for c in [[a, c0, c1], [b, c0, c1], [c0, a, b], [c1, a, b]]:
+		var ang := rad_to_deg((c[1] - c[0]).angle_to(c[2] - c[0]))
+		if ang < 20.0 or ang > 160.0:
+			return -1.0
+		q += absf(ang - 90.0)
+	return q
+
+
+## Groups r0 and r1 joined: point `v` still a corner on their rim - two rim edges at it,
+## not in a straight line.
+func _joinable(v: int, r0: int, r1: int, parent: PackedInt32Array) -> bool:
+	var q1 := -1
+	var q2 := -1
+	for k in range(adj_start[v], adj_start[v + 1]):
+		var q := adj[k]
+		var e := edge(v, q)
+		var tn := edge_tn[e]
+		if tn > 2:
+			return false
+		var r := _root(parent, edge_tris[e * 2])
+		var in0 := r == r0 or r == r1
+		var in1 := false
+		if tn == 2:
+			r = _root(parent, edge_tris[e * 2 + 1])
+			in1 = r == r0 or r == r1
+		if in0 != in1:
+			if q1 < 0:
+				q1 = q
+			elif q2 < 0:
+				q2 = q
+			else:
+				return false
+	if q2 < 0:
+		return false
+	return (points[q1] - points[v]).normalized().dot((points[q2] - points[v]).normalized()) > STRAIGHT
+
+
+func tri_count() -> int:
+	return tris.size() / 3
+
+
+func edge_count() -> int:
+	return edges.size() / 2
+
+
+## The edge between points a and b (-1: none).
+func edge(a: int, b: int) -> int:
+	if a > b:
+		var t := a; a = b; b = t
+	return edge_of.get(a * KEY + b, -1)
+
+
+# --- faces (n-gons) -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## How many faces (n-gons, quads, triangles).
+func poly_count() -> int:
+	return face_live
+
+
+## The triangles of triangle `t`'s face (it first).
+func poly_tris(t: int) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var out := PackedInt32Array([t])
+	var i := 0
+	while i < out.size():
+		var u := out[i]
+		i += 1
+		for k in 3:
+			var e := tri_edges[u * 3 + k]
+			if e < 0 or not edge_inner[e]:
+				continue
+			var o := edge_tris[e * 2] if edge_tris[e * 2] != u else edge_tris[e * 2 + 1]
+			if not out.has(o):
+				out.append(o)
+	return out
+
+
+## A triangle alone in its face (none of its edges inside a face).
+func _lone(t: int) -> bool:
+	for k in 3:
+		var e := tri_edges[t * 3 + k]
+		if e >= 0 and edge_inner[e]:
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+## Flags `tsel` (a flag a triangle) spread to whole faces: any of a face's flagged - all of it.
+func grow_to_polys(tsel: PackedByteArray) -> PackedByteArray:
+	var out := tsel.duplicate()
+	for t in mini(tsel.size(), tri_count()):
+		if tsel[t] and not _lone(t):
+			for u in poly_tris(t):
+				out[u] = 1
+	return out
+
+
+## Flags `tsel` kept only for whole faces (a face with any triangle not flagged: none of it).
+func close_to_polys(tsel: PackedByteArray) -> void:
+	var done := PackedByteArray()
+	done.resize(tsel.size())
+	for t in mini(tsel.size(), tri_count()):
+		if not tsel[t] or done[t] or _lone(t):
+			continue
+		var pt := poly_tris(t)
+		var all := true
+		for u in pt:
+			done[u] = 1
+			if not tsel[u]:
+				all = false
+		if not all:
+			for u in pt:
+				tsel[u] = 0
+
+
+## The corners of the face made of triangles `pt`, in order round it (the triangles' way
+## round); empty if it isn't one simple outline.
+func _loop_of(pt: PackedInt32Array) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var nxt := {}
+	for t in pt:
+		for k in 3:
+			var e := tri_edges[t * 3 + k]
+			if e >= 0 and edge_inner[e]:
+				continue
+			var a := tris[t * 3 + k]
+			if nxt.has(a):
+				return PackedInt32Array()
+			nxt[a] = tris[t * 3 + (k + 1) % 3]
+	if nxt.is_empty():
+		return PackedInt32Array()
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	var p: int = nxt.keys()[0]
+	while out.size() <= nxt.size():
+		out.append(p)
+		p = nxt.get(p, -1)
+		if p < 0:
+			return PackedInt32Array()
+		if p == out[0]:
+			break
+	return out if out.size() == nxt.size() else PackedInt32Array()
+
+
+## The corners of triangle `t`'s face, in order round it.
+func poly_loop(t: int) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	return _loop_of(poly_tris(t))
+
+
+## The edges shown (point pairs): those between faces - not the diagonals inside them
+## (`all`: every edge, the triangles).
+func wire_edges(all := false) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	if all or face_live == tri_count():
+		return edges
+	if _wire_topo != topo:
+		_wire = PackedInt32Array()
+		for e in edge_inner.size():
+			if not edge_inner[e]:
+				_wire.append(edges[e * 2])
+				_wire.append(edges[e * 2 + 1])
+		_wire_topo = topo
+	return _wire
+
+
+## The triangles with point `p` as a corner (along its edges).
+func tris_around(p: int) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	for k in range(adj_start[p], adj_start[p + 1]):
+		var e := edge(p, adj[k])
+		for t in edge_tri_list(e):
+			if not out.has(t):
+				out.append(t)
+	return out
+
+
+## The triangles on edge `e` (all of them, a non-manifold edge's too).
+func edge_tri_list(e: int) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var out := edge_tris.slice(e * 2, e * 2 + mini(edge_tn[e], 2))
+	if edge_tn[e] > 2:
+		out.append_array(edge_more[e])
+	return out
+
+
+## The vertices of `ids` (points), surface by surface: [PackedInt32Array per surface].
+func verts_of(ids: PackedInt32Array) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for s in surfs:
+		out.append(PackedInt32Array())
+	for p in ids:
+		for k in range(pv_start[p], pv_start[p + 1]):
+			var e := pv[k]
+			var lst: PackedInt32Array = out[e >> SHIFT]
+			out[e >> SHIFT] = PackedInt32Array()   # (one owner: append in place)
+			lst.append(e & VMASK)
+			out[e >> SHIFT] = lst
+	return out
+
+
+## The vertices' positions from the points: all (`per_surf` empty), or the lists verts_of() made.
+func sync(per_surf := []) -> void:
+	for si in surfs.size():
+		var s: Surf = surfs[si]
+		if per_surf.is_empty():
+			s.sync(points, PackedInt32Array())
+		elif not (per_surf[si] as PackedInt32Array).is_empty():
+			s.sync(points, per_surf[si])
+
+
+func recalc_normals(per_surf := []) -> void:
+	for si in surfs.size():
+		if per_surf.is_empty() or not (per_surf[si] as PackedInt32Array).is_empty():
+			surfs[si].recalc_normals()
+
+
+## Refills `mesh` (what's shown) from the surfaces.
+func update_mesh() -> void:
+	mesh.clear_surfaces()
+	var faces := []
+	for s in surfs:
+		if (s as Surf).idx.is_empty():
+			continue
+		faces.append((s as Surf).face.duplicate())
+		mesh.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, s.arrays(), [], {}, s.flags)
+		var k := mesh.get_surface_count() - 1
+		mesh.surface_set_name(k, s.name)
+		if s.material:
+			mesh.surface_set_material(k, s.material)
+	for o in other:
+		mesh.add_surface_from_arrays(o[0], o[1], [], {}, o[2])
+		var k := mesh.get_surface_count() - 1
+		mesh.surface_set_name(k, o[4])
+		if o[3]:
+			mesh.surface_set_material(k, o[3])
+	_keep_faces(mesh, faces)
+
+
+## A new mesh of the surfaces (the edit's result, kept).
+func to_mesh() -> ArrayMesh:
+	var keep := mesh
+	mesh = ArrayMesh.new()
+	update_mesh()
+	var out := mesh
+	mesh = keep
+	return out
+
+
+## Triangle `t`'s ray-test mesh: faces in tris order (TriangleMesh's face_index = t).
+func triangle_mesh() -> TriangleMesh:
+	var f := PackedVector3Array()
+	f.resize(tris.size())
+	for i in tris.size():
+		f[i] = points[tris[i]]
+	var tm := TriangleMesh.new()
+	tm.create_from_faces(f)
+	return tm
+
+
+# --- moving points ------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Points `ids` placed from `orig` by `xf`, each `w` of the way (1: all of it).
+func place(ids: PackedInt32Array, orig: PackedVector3Array, w: PackedFloat32Array, xf: Transform3D) -> void:
+	for k in ids.size():
+		var o := orig[k]
+		points[ids[k]] = o.lerp(xf * o, w[k]) if w[k] < 1.0 else xf * o
+
+
+## Symmetry: each (source, twin, axis) triple's twin put opposite its source, in order.
+func follow(pairs: PackedInt32Array) -> void:
+	for i in range(0, pairs.size(), 3):
+		points[pairs[i + 1]] = mirrored(points[pairs[i]], pairs[i + 2])
+
+
+## The mirror modifier's clipping: points never cross the seam of the axes in
+## `axes`; `side` (3 a point of `ids`): the side each started on (0: on the seam - stays there).
+func clip(ids: PackedInt32Array, side: PackedFloat32Array, axes: Array) -> void:
+	for k in ids.size():
+		var p := points[ids[k]]
+		for a in 3:
+			if axes[a]:
+				var sd := side[k * 3 + a]
+				if sd == 0.0 or p[a] * sd < 0.0:
+					p[a] = 0.0
+		points[ids[k]] = p
+
+
+# --- undo ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Everything an edit can change (copies: packed arrays are shared by reference).
+func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
+	return {"points": points.duplicate(), "surfs": surfs.map(func(s): return s.copy()), "topo": topo, "derived": _derived()}
+
+
+## The derived arrays as they are (never changed in place: a snapshot can keep them).
+func _derived() -> Array:
+	return [tris, tri_surf, tri_at, tri_face, tri_edges, edges, edge_of, edge_tris, edge_tn, edge_inner,
+		pv_start, pv, adj_start, adj, face_n, edge_more, face_live]
+
+
+## About how much memory a snapshot takes.
+func snapshot_bytes() -> int:
+	var b := points.size() * 12
+	for s in surfs:
+		b += s.bytes()
+	return b
+
+
+func restore(snap: Dictionary) -> void:
+	points = (snap["points"] as PackedVector3Array).duplicate()
+	surfs = (snap["surfs"] as Array).map(func(s): return s.copy())
+	if int(snap["topo"]) != topo:
+		var d: Array = snap.get("derived", [])
+		if d.size() == 17:
+			tris = d[0]; tri_surf = d[1]; tri_at = d[2]; tri_face = d[3]; tri_edges = d[4]; edges = d[5]
+			edge_of = d[6]; edge_tris = d[7]; edge_tn = d[8]; edge_inner = d[9]; pv_start = d[10]; pv = d[11]
+			adj_start = d[12]; adj = d[13]; face_n = d[14]; edge_more = d[15]; face_live = d[16]
+		else:
+			derive()
+		topo = int(snap["topo"])
+
+
+# --- selection helpers --------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The points of triangles `tsel` (a flag a triangle).
+func points_of_tris(tsel: PackedByteArray) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var flag := PackedByteArray()
+	flag.resize(points.size())
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	for t in tsel.size():
+		if tsel[t]:
+			for k in 3:
+				var p := tris[t * 3 + k]
+				if not flag[p]:
+					flag[p] = 1
+					out.append(p)
+	return out
+
+
+func points_of_edges(esel: PackedByteArray) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var flag := PackedByteArray()
+	flag.resize(points.size())
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	for e in esel.size():
+		if esel[e]:
+			for k in 2:
+				var p := edges[e * 2 + k]
+				if not flag[p]:
+					flag[p] = 1
+					out.append(p)
+	return out
+
+
+func centroid(ids: PackedInt32Array) -> Vector3:
+	var c := Vector3.ZERO
+	for p in ids:
+		c += points[p]
+	return c / maxf(1, ids.size())
+
+
+func aabb() -> AABB:
+	if points.is_empty():
+		return AABB()
+	var b := AABB(points[0], Vector3.ZERO)
+	for p in points:
+		b = b.expand(p)
+	return b
+
+
+# --- proportional editing -----------------------------------------------------
+
+static func falloff(kind: String, d: float, r: float) -> float:
+	if d >= r:
+		return 0.0
+	var x := d / r
+	var t := 1.0 - x
+	match kind:
+		"sphere": return sqrt(maxf(0.0, 1.0 - x * x))
+		"root": return sqrt(t)
+		"linear": return t
+		"sharp": return t * t
+		"constant": return 1.0
+	return t * t * (3.0 - 2.0 * t)   # smooth
+
+
+## The points a transform of `sel` moves and how much: [ids, weights] - the
+## selection (1) and, with proportional editing, everything within `radius`
+## of it (by straight distance, or `connected`: along the edges, only what's
+## joined to it), weighted by the falloff.
+func influence(sel: PackedInt32Array, radius: float, kind: String, connected: bool) -> Array:
+	var n := points.size()
+	var dist := PackedFloat32Array()
+	dist.resize(n)
+	dist.fill(INF)
+	for p in sel:
+		dist[p] = 0.0
+	if connected:
+		var queue := sel.duplicate()
+		var head := 0
+		while head < queue.size():
+			var p := queue[head]
+			head += 1
+			var dp := dist[p]
+			for k in range(adj_start[p], adj_start[p + 1]):
+				var q := adj[k]
+				var d := dp + points[p].distance_to(points[q])
+				if d < dist[q] and d < radius:
+					dist[q] = d
+					queue.append(q)
+	elif radius > 0.0 and not sel.is_empty():
+		# selected points hashed in cells of `radius`: each point looks at the 27 around it
+		# (a big selection is thinned to one point in each tenth of the radius:
+		# distances off by under 9% of it, at a fraction of the work)
+		var cells := {}
+		var seen := {}
+		var box := AABB(points[sel[0]], Vector3.ZERO)
+		for p in sel:
+			if sel.size() > 64:
+				var fine := Vector3i((points[p] / (radius * 0.1)).floor())
+				if seen.has(fine):
+					continue
+				seen[fine] = true
+			var c := Vector3i((points[p] / radius).floor())
+			if not cells.has(c):
+				cells[c] = PackedInt32Array()
+			var l: PackedInt32Array = cells[c]
+			cells[c] = PackedInt32Array()
+			l.append(p)
+			cells[c] = l
+			box = box.expand(points[p])
+		box = box.grow(radius)
+		var r2 := radius * radius
+		for q in n:
+			var pq := points[q]
+			if dist[q] == 0.0 or not box.has_point(pq):
+				continue
+			var c := Vector3i((pq / radius).floor())
+			var best := r2
+			# its own cell first, then the cells around it nearer than the best yet
+			var l = cells.get(c)
+			if l != null:
+				for p in l:
+					best = minf(best, pq.distance_squared_to(points[p]))
+			var lo := Vector3(c) * radius
+			for o in _AROUND:
+				var cc: Vector3i = c + o
+				# (the gap from it to that cell)
+				var dx := pq.x - lo.x if o.x < 0 else (lo.x + radius - pq.x if o.x > 0 else 0.0)
+				var dy := pq.y - lo.y if o.y < 0 else (lo.y + radius - pq.y if o.y > 0 else 0.0)
+				var dz := pq.z - lo.z if o.z < 0 else (lo.z + radius - pq.z if o.z > 0 else 0.0)
+				if dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz >= best:
+					continue
+				l = cells.get(cc)
+				if l == null:
+					continue
+				for p in l:
+					best = minf(best, pq.distance_squared_to(points[p]))
+			if best < r2:
+				dist[q] = sqrt(best)
+	var ids := PackedInt32Array()
+	var w := PackedFloat32Array()
+	for p in sel:
+		ids.append(p)
+		w.append(1.0)
+	if radius > 0.0:
+		for q in n:
+			var d := dist[q]
+			if d > 0.0 and d < radius:
+				var f := falloff(kind, d, radius)
+				if f > 0.0:
+					ids.append(q)
+					w.append(f)
+	return [ids, w]
+
+
