+# --- symmetry -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func mirrored(p: Vector3, axis: int) -> Vector3:
+	p[axis] = -p[axis]
+	return p
+
+
+## Each point's twin across `axis` (itself on the seam; -1: none), by position
+## (within `tol`).
+func mirror_map(axis: int, tol := 0.001) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var cells := {}
+	for i in points.size():
+		var c := Vector3i((points[i] / tol).round())
+		if not cells.has(c):
+			cells[c] = i
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	out.resize(points.size())
+	for i in points.size():
+		var m := mirrored(points[i], axis)
+		var c := Vector3i((m / tol).round())
+		var j: int = cells.get(c, -1)
+		if j < 0:
+			for dx in range(-1, 2):
+				for dy in range(-1, 2):
+					for dz in range(-1, 2):
+						var k: int = cells.get(c + Vector3i(dx, dy, dz), -1)
+						if k >= 0 and points[k].distance_to(m) <= tol * 1.8:
+							j = k
+		if absf(points[i][axis]) <= tol * 0.5:
+			j = i
+		out[i] = j
+	return out
+
+
+## Symmetrize: the `positive` side (+axis) copied onto the other (or the
+## reverse). Each point of the side made to match is paired with the nearest
+## mirrored point of the other side within `tol`; points on the seam (within
+## `seam`) are put on it. The points changed.
+func symmetrize(axis: int, positive := true, tol := -1.0, seam := 0.0005) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	if tol < 0.0:
+		tol = maxf(0.002, aabb().size.length() * 0.03)
+	var sgn := 1.0 if positive else -1.0
+	var cells := {}
+	for i in points.size():
+		if points[i][axis] * sgn > seam:
+			var c := Vector3i((points[i] / tol).floor())
+			if not cells.has(c):
+				cells[c] = PackedInt32Array()
+			var l: PackedInt32Array = cells[c]
+			cells[c] = PackedInt32Array()
+			l.append(i)
+			cells[c] = l
+	var changed := PackedInt32Array()
+	for i in points.size():
+		var v := points[i][axis] * sgn
+		if v > seam:
+			continue
+		if v >= -seam:
+			if points[i][axis] != 0.0:
+				points[i][axis] = 0.0
+				changed.append(i)
+			continue
+		var m := mirrored(points[i], axis)
+		var c := Vector3i((m / tol).floor())
+		var best := -1
+		var bd := tol * tol
+		for dx in range(-1, 2):
+			for dy in range(-1, 2):
+				for dz in range(-1, 2):
+					var l = cells.get(c + Vector3i(dx, dy, dz))
+					if l == null:
+						continue
+					for k in l:
+						var d := points[k].distance_squared_to(m)
+						if d <= bd:
+							bd = d
+							best = k
+		if best >= 0:
+			points[i] = mirrored(points[best], axis)
+			changed.append(i)
+	return changed
+
+
+
+
+# --- topology edits -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The triangles flagged in `tsel`, surface by surface: their first indices.
+func _starts(tsel: PackedByteArray) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for s in surfs:
+		out.append(PackedInt32Array())
+	for t in mini(tsel.size(), tri_count()):
+		if tsel[t]:
+			var l: PackedInt32Array = out[tri_surf[t]]
+			out[tri_surf[t]] = PackedInt32Array()
+			l.append(tri_at[t])
+			out[tri_surf[t]] = l
+	return out
+
+
+## Mirror (the modifier, applied): across each of `axes` ([x, y, z] bools) in
+## turn, the mesh copied (faces turned the right way round); points on the
+## seam (within `merge`) are shared by both halves - put on it when `clip`.
+## The vertex count becomes twice what it was, less the seam's.
+## (`recalc` false: the normals kept - the copies' mirrored, those on the seam put along it.)
+func apply_mirror(axes: Array, merge := 0.001, clip := true, recalc := true, bones_twin := PackedInt32Array()) -> void:
+	for axis in 3:
+		if not axes[axis]:
+			continue
+		var n0 := points.size()
+		var pm := PackedInt32Array()
+		pm.resize(n0)
+		for i in n0:
+			if absf(points[i][axis]) <= merge:
+				pm[i] = i
+				if clip:
+					points[i][axis] = 0.0
+			else:
+				pm[i] = points.size()
+				points.append(mirrored(points[i], axis))
+		var seam := false
+		var foff := 0
+		for s: Surf in surfs:
+			for f in s.face:
+				foff = maxi(foff, f + 1)
+		for s: Surf in surfs:
+			seam = s.mirror(pm, points, axis, clip, foff, bones_twin) or seam
+		if seam and recalc:
+			for s: Surf in surfs:
+				s.recalc_normals()
+		elif seam:
+			for s: Surf in surfs:
+				for v in s.count():
+					if s.vp[v] < n0 and pm[s.vp[v]] == s.vp[v]:
+						var nn := s.nrm[v]
+						nn[axis] = 0.0
+						if nn.length_squared() > 1e-12:
+							s.nrm[v] = nn.normalized()
+	for s: Surf in surfs:
+		s.drop_degenerate()
+	compact()
+	derive()
+
+
+## Deletes triangles (flagged), then the points nothing uses any more.
+func delete_tris(tsel: PackedByteArray) -> void:
+	var st := _starts(tsel)
+	for si in surfs.size():
+		if not (st[si] as PackedInt32Array).is_empty():
+			var kill := {}
+			for i in st[si]:
+				kill[i] = true
+			surfs[si].drop_tris(kill)
+	compact()
+	derive()
+
+
+## Material `mat` given to the triangles flagged in `tsel` (whole faces): a surface all of whose
+## triangles are flagged just gets it; flagged ones that are only some of their surface's move
+## into a new surface of their own (their vertices copied, the same points - nothing moves),
+## added after the others. The triangles that have `mat` afterwards (flags, in the new order).
+func split_to_surface(tsel: PackedByteArray, mat: Material) -> PackedByteArray:
+	var st := _starts(tsel)
+	var whole := {}
+	var added := []
+	for si in surfs.size():
+		var starts: PackedInt32Array = st[si]
+		if starts.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var s: Surf = surfs[si]
+		if starts.size() * 3 >= s.idx.size():
+			s.material = mat
+			whole[si] = true
+			continue
+		var n := Surf.new()
+		n.name = s.name + "_" + (mat.resource_name if mat and mat.resource_name != "" else "material")
+		n.material = mat
+		n.flags = s.flags
+		n.nb = s.nb
+		var has_f := s.face.size() == s.idx.size() / 3
+		var map := {}
+		var kill := {}
+		for i in starts:
+			kill[i] = true
+			for k in 3:
+				var v := s.idx[i + k]
+				if not map.has(v):
+					map[v] = n.pos.size()
+					n.pos.append(s.pos[v])
+					n.nrm.append(s.nrm[v])
+					if not s.col.is_empty():
+						n.col.append(s.col[v])
+					if not s.uv.is_empty():
+						n.uv.append(s.uv[v])
+					if not s.uv2.is_empty():
+						n.uv2.append(s.uv2[v])
+					for b in s.nb:
+						n.bones.append(s.bones[v * s.nb + b])
+						n.weights.append(s.weights[v * s.nb + b])
+					n.vp.append(s.vp[v])
+				n.idx.append(map[v])
+			n.face.append(s.face[i / 3] if has_f else -1)
+		s.drop_tris(kill)
+		added.append(n)
+	var first := surfs.size()
+	surfs.append_array(added)
+	compact()
+	derive()
+	var out := PackedByteArray()
+	out.resize(tri_count())
+	for t in tri_count():
+		var si := tri_surf[t]
+		out[t] = 1 if whole.has(si) or si >= first else 0
+	return out
+
+
+## Unused vertices and points dropped (renumbered in order).
+func compact() -> void:
+	for s: Surf in surfs:
+		s.compact()
+	var used := PackedByteArray()
+	used.resize(points.size())
+	for s: Surf in surfs:
+		for p in s.vp:
+			used[p] = 1
+	var map := PackedInt32Array()
+	map.resize(points.size())
+	var np := PackedVector3Array()
+	for p in points.size():
+		if used[p]:
+			map[p] = np.size()
+			np.append(points[p])
+		else:
+			map[p] = -1
+	if np.size() == points.size():
+		return
+	for s: Surf in surfs:
+		s.remap_points(map)
+	points = np
+
+
+## Merges points `ids` into one at their centre; its index afterwards.
+func merge(ids: PackedInt32Array) -> int:
+	if ids.size() < 2:
+		return ids[0] if ids.size() == 1 else -1
+	var target := ids[0]
+	var at := centroid(ids)
+	points[target] = at
+	var flag := PackedByteArray()
+	flag.resize(points.size())
+	for p in ids:
+		flag[p] = 1
+	for s: Surf in surfs:
+		s.merge_points(flag, target, at)
+		s.drop_degenerate()
+		s.compact()
+	var used := PackedByteArray()
+	used.resize(points.size())
+	for s: Surf in surfs:
+		for p in s.vp:
+			used[p] = 1
+	var keep := 0
+	for p in target:
+		keep += used[p]
+	compact()
+	derive()
+	return keep
+
+
+## Extrudes triangles `tsel`: the region's points doubled (the region's
+## triangles moved onto the copies) and walls along its border. Returns the
+## copies (what to move next).
+func extrude(tsel: PackedByteArray) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var n0 := points.size()
+	var np := PackedInt32Array()   # point -> its copy
+	np.resize(n0)
+	np.fill(-1)
+	var border := {}
+	for t in mini(tsel.size(), tri_count()):
+		if not tsel[t]:
+			continue
+		for k in 3:
+			var a := tris[t * 3 + k]
+			var b := tris[t * 3 + (k + 1) % 3]
+			var key := mini(a, b) * n0 + maxi(a, b)
+			border[key] = border.get(key, 0) + 1
+			if np[a] < 0:
+				np[a] = points.size()
+				points.append(points[a])
+	var st := _starts(tsel)
+	var next := face_n
+	for si in surfs.size():
+		if not (st[si] as PackedInt32Array).is_empty():
+			next = surfs[si].extrude(st[si], np, border, n0, next)
+			surfs[si].recalc_normals()
+	derive()
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	for p in n0:
+		if np[p] >= 0:
+			out.append(np[p])
+	return out
+
+
+## Subdivides triangles `tsel`: each into four at its edges' middles (the
+## triangles beside them split to match - no cracks). Returns the points of
+## the new, smaller triangles.
+func subdivide(tsel: PackedByteArray) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var n0 := points.size()
+	var mid := {}
+	var region := PackedByteArray()
+	region.resize(n0)
+	for t in mini(tsel.size(), tri_count()):
+		if not tsel[t]:
+			continue
+		for k in 3:
+			var a := tris[t * 3 + k]
+			var b := tris[t * 3 + (k + 1) % 3]
+			region[a] = 1
+			var key := mini(a, b) * n0 + maxi(a, b)
+			if not mid.has(key):
+				mid[key] = points.size()
+				points.append((points[a] + points[b]) * 0.5)
+	# each quad cut whole: its four quads (corner, two side middles, its middle), whichever
+	# way their triangles come out - the rest of the pieces' faces found from their shape
+	var quad_of := {}   # sorted corners of a piece triangle -> its quad
+	var nq := 0
+	var done := {}
+	for t in mini(tsel.size(), tri_count()):
+		if not tsel[t] or done.has(tri_face[t]):
+			continue
+		done[tri_face[t]] = true
+		var pt := poly_tris(t)
+		var whole := pt.size() == 2
+		for u in pt:
+			whole = whole and u < tsel.size() and tsel[u] == 1
+		var lp := _loop_of(pt)
+		if not whole or lp.size() != 4:
+			continue
+		var c := _mid_of(mid, n0, lp[0], lp[2])
+		if c < 0:
+			c = _mid_of(mid, n0, lp[1], lp[3])
+		if c < 0:
+			continue
+		for i in 4:
+			var q := [lp[i], _mid_of(mid, n0, lp[i], lp[(i + 1) % 4]), c, _mid_of(mid, n0, lp[i], lp[(i + 3) % 4])]
+			for j in 4:
+				var k := [q[j], q[(j + 1) % 4], q[(j + 2) % 4]]
+				k.sort()
+				quad_of[Vector3i(k[0], k[1], k[2])] = nq
+			nq += 1
+	var base := face_n
+	for s: Surf in surfs:
+		s.subdivide(mid, n0, points)
+		if not quad_of.is_empty():
+			for i in s.face.size():
+				if s.face[i] < 0:
+					var k := [s.vp[s.idx[i * 3]], s.vp[s.idx[i * 3 + 1]], s.vp[s.idx[i * 3 + 2]]]
+					k.sort()
+					var q: int = quad_of.get(Vector3i(k[0], k[1], k[2]), -1)
+					if q >= 0:
+						s.face[i] = base + q
+	derive()
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	for p in points.size():
+		if p >= n0 or region[p]:
+			out.append(p)
+	return out
+
+
+static func _mid_of(mid: Dictionary, n0: int, a: int, b: int) -> int:
+	return mid.get(mini(a, b) * n0 + maxi(a, b), -1)
+
+
+## Turns triangles `tsel` (all, if empty) the other way round, their normals too.
+func flip(tsel: PackedByteArray) -> void:
+	if tsel.is_empty():
+		tsel.resize(tri_count())
+		tsel.fill(1)
+	var st := _starts(tsel)
+	for si in surfs.size():
+		if not (st[si] as PackedInt32Array).is_empty():
+			surfs[si].flip(st[si])
+	derive()
+
+
+# --- the knife ------------------------------------------------------------------
+# A cut is drawn as *nodes* - spots the knife passes: on a point {"k": 0, "p"}, on an
+# edge {"k": 1, "e", "t": the way along it from its first point to its second}, or
+# inside a triangle {"k": 2, "tri"} - each with its "pos". Between two nodes the cut
+# follows the surface where a plane (through both, along the view) meets it:
+# knife_walk() steps from triangle to triangle, each edge it crosses a node. A chain
+# ({"nodes", "segs": the triangle each step goes through, -1 along an edge}) is then
+# made by knife_apply(): each face it crosses is made again - its outline with the new
+# points on its sides, split along the cut into two faces, each triangulated.
+
+static func node_point(p: int, pos: Vector3) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"k": 0, "p": p, "pos": pos}
+
+
+static func node_face(tri: int, pos: Vector3) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"k": 2, "tri": tri, "pos": pos}
+
+
+## The node `t` of the way along edge `e` (at an end: that point).
+func node_on_edge(e: int, t: float) -> Dictionary:
+	var a := edges[e * 2]
+	var b := edges[e * 2 + 1]
+	if t <= 1e-4:
+		return node_point(a, points[a])
+	if t >= 1.0 - 1e-4:
+		return node_point(b, points[b])
+	return {"k": 1, "e": e, "t": t, "pos": points[a].lerp(points[b], t)}
+
+
+## Where a cut at `pos` on triangle `tri` starts or bends: `kind` 0 the nearest corner of
+## its face, 1 the nearest spot on a side of the face, 2 the face itself; -1: a corner or a
+## side within `tol` of it, else the face.
+func knife_node(tri: int, pos: Vector3, kind := -1, tol := 0.0) -> Dictionary:
+	var loop := poly_loop(tri)
+	if loop.is_empty():
+		loop = tris.slice(tri * 3, tri * 3 + 3)
+	if kind != 2:
+		var bp := -1
+		var bd := INF
+		for p in loop:
+			var d := points[p].distance_to(pos)
+			if d < bd:
+				bd = d
+				bp = p
+		if kind == 0 or bd <= tol:
+			return node_point(bp, points[bp])
+		var be := -1
+		var bt := 0.0
+		bd = INF
+		for i in loop.size():
+			var a := loop[i]
+			var b := loop[(i + 1) % loop.size()]
+			var q := Geometry3D.get_closest_point_to_segment(pos, points[a], points[b])
+			var d := q.distance_to(pos)
+			if d < bd:
+				bd = d
+				be = edge(a, b)
+				var l := points[a].distance_to(points[b])
+				bt = points[a].distance_to(q) / l if l > 0.0 else 0.0
+				if be >= 0 and edges[be * 2] != a:
+					bt = 1.0 - bt
+		if be >= 0 and (kind == 1 or bd <= tol):
+			return node_on_edge(be, bt)
+	return node_face(tri, pos)
+
+
+## How near a point must be to the knife's plane to be on it (a millionth of the mesh's size).
+func knife_eps() -> float:
+	if _eps_topo != topo:
+		_eps = maxf(aabb().size.length(), 0.001) * 1e-6
+		_eps_topo = topo
+	return _eps
+
+
+static func _node_key(x: Dictionary) -> String:
+	match int(x["k"]):
+		0: return "p%d" % x["p"]
+		1: return "e%d:%d" % [x["e"], roundi(float(x["t"]) * 100000.0)]
+	return "f%d:%s" % [x["tri"], x["pos"]]
+
+
+## The triangles node `x` lies on.
+func _node_tris(x: Dictionary) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	match int(x["k"]):
+		0: return tris_around(x["p"])
+		1: return edge_tri_list(x["e"])
+	return PackedInt32Array([x["tri"]])
+
+
+func _node_on(x: Dictionary, t: int) -> bool:
+	match int(x["k"]):
+		0:
+			var p: int = x["p"]
+			return tris[t * 3] == p or tris[t * 3 + 1] == p or tris[t * 3 + 2] == p
+		1:
+			var e: int = x["e"]
+			return tri_edges[t * 3] == e or tri_edges[t * 3 + 1] == e or tri_edges[t * 3 + 2] == e
+	return int(x["tri"]) == t
+
+
+## A node not on a face's inside: a corner, or a spot on an edge between faces.
+func _border(x: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	match int(x["k"]):
+		0: return true
+		1: return not edge_inner[x["e"]]
+	return false
+
+
+## The ways on from node `x` along the plane (normal `n`, through `o`) - not back through
+## triangle `came`: [[the triangle it goes through (-1: along an edge), the next node], ...].
+func _steps(x: Dictionary, n: Vector3, o: Vector3, eps: float, came: int) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var k: int = x["k"]
+	var xp: int = x["p"] if k == 0 else -1
+	var xa := -1
+	var xb := -1
+	if k == 1:
+		xa = edges[int(x["e"]) * 2]
+		xb = edges[int(x["e"]) * 2 + 1]
+		var da := n.dot(points[xa] - o)
+		var db := n.dot(points[xb] - o)
+		if absf(da) <= eps and absf(db) <= eps:   # (the plane along this edge: on to its ends)
+			return [[-1, node_point(xa, points[xa])], [-1, node_point(xb, points[xb])]]
+	for t in _node_tris(x):
+		if t == came:
+			continue
+		var c := [tris[t * 3], tris[t * 3 + 1], tris[t * 3 + 2]]
+		var d := [n.dot(points[c[0]] - o), n.dot(points[c[1]] - o), n.dot(points[c[2]] - o)]
+		for i in 3:
+			var p: int = c[i]
+			if p == xp or p == xa or p == xb or absf(d[i]) > eps:
+				continue
+			out.append([-1 if k == 0 else t, node_point(p, points[p])])
+		for i in 3:
+			var j := (i + 1) % 3
+			if absf(d[i]) <= eps or absf(d[j]) <= eps or (d[i] > 0.0) == (d[j] > 0.0):
+				continue
+			var p: int = c[i]
+			var q: int = c[j]
+			if p == xp or q == xp:
+				continue
+			var e := edge(p, q)
+			if e < 0 or (k == 1 and e == int(x["e"])):
+				continue
+			var f: float = d[i] / (d[i] - d[j])
+			if edges[e * 2] != p:
+				f = 1.0 - f
+			out.append([t, node_on_edge(e, f)])
+	return out
+
+
+## The cut from node `a` to node `b` over the surface, along the plane through both with
+## normal `n`: {"nodes", "segs"}, or {} if it can't get there (a gap, the mesh's border).
+## `look`: the way it's seen - where it could go either way, over the faces facing you.
+func knife_walk(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary, n: Vector3, look := Vector3.ZERO) -> Dictionary:
+	if n.length_squared() < 1e-24:
+		return {}
+	n = n.normalized()
+	var o: Vector3 = a["pos"]
+	var eps := knife_eps()
+	var ab: Vector3 = b["pos"] - o
+	var l2 := ab.length_squared()
+	var nodes := [a]
+	var segs := PackedInt32Array()
+	if _node_key(a) == _node_key(b):
+		return {"nodes": nodes, "segs": segs}
+	var tb := _node_tris(b)
+	var x := a
+	var came := -2
+	var seen := {_node_key(a): true}
+	var px := 0.0
+	for step in tri_count() + 8:
+		# b in a triangle with x: straight there
+		for t in tb:
+			if _node_on(x, t):
+				nodes.append(b)
+				segs.append(-1 if x["k"] == 0 and b["k"] == 0 else t)
+				return {"nodes": nodes, "segs": segs}
+		var opts := _steps(x, n, o, eps, came)
+		var pick := -1
+		var best := -INF
+		var best_score := -INF
+		var forced: bool = int(x["k"]) == 1 and came >= 0 and opts.size() == 1   # (through an edge: one way on)
+		for i in opts.size():
+			var y: Dictionary = opts[i][1]
+			if seen.has(_node_key(y)):
+				continue
+			var py: float = (y["pos"] - o).dot(ab) / l2 if l2 > 0.0 else 0.0
+			if not forced and py <= px + 1e-9:
+				continue
+			var score := py
+			var t: int = opts[i][0]
+			if look != Vector3.ZERO and t >= 0:
+				var tn := (points[tris[t * 3 + 1]] - points[tris[t * 3]]).cross(points[tris[t * 3 + 2]] - points[tris[t * 3]])
+				if tn.dot(look) < 0.0:   # (Godot's faces wind clockwise: this cross product points in)
+					score -= 10.0   # (a face turned away: only if there's no other way)
+			if score > best_score:
+				best_score = score
+				best = py
+				pick = i
+		if pick < 0 or best > 1.5 or best < -0.5:
+			return {}
+		var y: Dictionary = opts[pick][1]
+		seen[_node_key(y)] = true
+		nodes.append(y)
+		segs.append(opts[pick][0])
+		came = opts[pick][0] if int(opts[pick][0]) >= 0 else -2
+		px = best
+		x = y
+	return {}
+
+
+## A cut right through the mesh, front and back: everywhere the plane (normal `n`, through
+## `o`) meets it within `sides` ([[point, normal], ...]: the half-spaces it stays in) -
+## chains for knife_apply() (each a run of it over the surface; a ring closes on itself).
+func knife_slice(o: Vector3, n: Vector3, sides: Array) -> Array:
+	n = n.normalized()
+	var eps := knife_eps()
+	var chains := []
+	var seen := {}
+	for e in edge_count():
+		var a := edges[e * 2]
+		var b := edges[e * 2 + 1]
+		var da := n.dot(points[a] - o)
+		var db := n.dot(points[b] - o)
+		if absf(da) <= eps or absf(db) <= eps or (da > 0.0) == (db > 0.0):
+			continue
+		var x := node_on_edge(e, da / (da - db))
+		if x["k"] != 1 or seen.has(_node_key(x)) or not _inside(x["pos"], sides, eps):
+			continue
+		seen[_node_key(x)] = true
+		var et := edge_tri_list(e)
+		var fwd := _trace(x, et[1] if et.size() > 1 else -2, n, o, eps, sides, seen)
+		var nodes := [x]
+		var segs := PackedInt32Array()
+		if not fwd["closed"] and et.size() > 1:
+			var back := _trace(x, et[0], n, o, eps, sides, seen)
+			var bn: Array = back["nodes"]
+			var bs: PackedInt32Array = back["segs"]
+			bn.reverse()
+			bs.reverse()
+			nodes = bn + nodes
+			segs = bs
+		nodes += fwd["nodes"]
+		segs.append_array(fwd["segs"])
+		if nodes.size() > 1:
+			chains.append({"nodes": nodes, "segs": segs})
+	return chains
+
+
+static func _inside(pos: Vector3, sides: Array, eps: float) -> bool:
+	for s in sides:
+		if (pos - (s[0] as Vector3)).dot(s[1]) < -eps:
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+## From node `x` on along the plane, not back through `came`, as far as it goes within `sides`.
+func _trace(x: Dictionary, came: int, n: Vector3, o: Vector3, eps: float, sides: Array, seen: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var start := _node_key(x)
+	var nodes := []
+	var segs := PackedInt32Array()
+	var closed := false
+	for step in tri_count() + 8:
+		var go := -1
+		var opts := _steps(x, n, o, eps, came)
+		for i in opts.size():
+			var y: Dictionary = opts[i][1]
+			var k := _node_key(y)
+			if k == start and nodes.size() > 1:
+				go = i
+				closed = true
+				break
+			if not seen.has(k) and _inside(y["pos"], sides, eps):
+				go = i
+				break
+		if go < 0:
+			break
+		var y: Dictionary = opts[go][1]
+		nodes.append(y)
+		segs.append(opts[go][0])
+		if closed:
+			break
+		seen[_node_key(y)] = true
+		came = opts[go][0] if int(opts[go][0]) >= 0 else -2
+		x = y
+	return {"nodes": nodes, "segs": segs, "closed": closed}
+
+
+## Makes the cut of `chains` (knife_walk / knife_slice): each face it crosses side to side
+## split along it into two faces (its ends inside a face are let go: a cut runs from side
+## to side), the new points on the edges it crosses - each with its vertices' attributes
+## mixed from the edge's ends (UVs, normals, colours, bone weights; one vertex a side of
+## a seam or hard edge, so those stay) - and the faces beside them given the new points
+## as corners (n-gons). Only the faces cut are made again; the derived arrays are patched
+## where they changed. {"ok", "why", "cut": the new edges (point pairs), "points": the new points}.
+func knife_apply(chains: Array) -> Dictionary:
+	var cs := []
+	for c in chains:
+		var nodes: Array = c["nodes"]
+		var segs: PackedInt32Array = c["segs"]
+		if nodes.size() < 2:
+			continue
+		var closed: bool = nodes.size() > 2 and _node_key(nodes[0]) == _node_key(nodes[nodes.size() - 1])
+		if not closed:
+			var i0 := 0
+			while i0 < nodes.size() and not _border(nodes[i0]):
+				i0 += 1
+			var i1 := nodes.size() - 1
+			while i1 > i0 and not _border(nodes[i1]):
+				i1 -= 1
+			if i1 <= i0:
+				continue
+			nodes = nodes.slice(i0, i1 + 1)
+			segs = segs.slice(i0, i1)
+		cs.append([nodes, segs])
+	if cs.is_empty():
+		return {"ok": false, "why": "the cut doesn't cross a face from side to side"}
+	var n0 := points.size()
+	var st := {"n0": n0, "pos": PackedVector3Array(), "pid": {}, "ins": {}, "face_pts": {}}
+	var chords := {}   # face -> [[points along the cut], ...]
+	var seed := {}     # face -> one of its triangles
+	var cut := PackedInt32Array()
+	for c in cs:
+		var nodes: Array = c[0]
+		var segs: PackedInt32Array = c[1]
+		var cur := PackedInt32Array()
+		var cur_f := -1
+		for i in segs.size():
+			var x: Dictionary = nodes[i]
+			var y: Dictionary = nodes[i + 1]
+			var t := segs[i]
+			if t < 0:
+				cur = PackedInt32Array()
+				if x["k"] == 0 and y["k"] == 0:
+					var e := edge(x["p"], y["p"])
+					if e >= 0:
+						cut.append(x["p"])
+						cut.append(y["p"])
+						if edge_inner[e]:   # (a face's diagonal: the face split along it)
+							_add_chord(chords, seed, tri_face[edge_tris[e * 2]], edge_tris[e * 2], PackedInt32Array([x["p"], y["p"]]))
+				continue
+			var f := tri_face[t]
+			if cur.is_empty() or f != cur_f:
+				cur = PackedInt32Array([_cut_point(x, st)])
+				cur_f = f
+			if _border(y):
+				cur.append(_cut_point(y, st))
+				_add_chord(chords, seed, f, t, cur)
+				for j in cur.size() - 1:
+					cut.append(cur[j])
+					cut.append(cur[j + 1])
+				cur = PackedInt32Array()
+			elif y["k"] == 2:
+				cur.append(_cut_point(y, st))
+	# the faces beside the edges that get points
+	var ins: Dictionary = st["ins"]
+	for e in ins:
+		for t in edge_tri_list(e):
+			var f := tri_face[t]
+			if not chords.has(f):
+				chords[f] = []
+				seed[f] = t
+	if chords.is_empty():
+		return {"ok": false, "why": "nothing to cut"}
+	# each face made again (worked out first: nothing changes if one can't be)
+	var new_pos: PackedVector3Array = st["pos"]
+	var plans := []
+	for f in chords:
+		var plan := _replan(f, seed[f], chords[f], st)
+		if plan.is_empty():
+			return {"ok": false, "why": "a face it crosses isn't a simple outline"}
+		plans.append(plan)
+	_apply_plans(plans, new_pos, n0)
+	var news := PackedInt32Array()
+	for i in new_pos.size():
+		news.append(n0 + i)
+	return {"ok": true, "cut": cut, "points": news}
+
+
+## Faces made again by `plans` (_replan / dissolve: each {"si", "old" triangles, "tris" new
+## (points), "piece", "f", "pmap", "spec"}), with points `new_pos` (from `n0`) added; the
+## triangles `also` (their faces changed only) patched too. A plan with fewer triangles than
+## it had lets the rest go.
+func _apply_plans(plans: Array, new_pos: PackedVector3Array, n0: int, also := PackedInt32Array()) -> void:
+	points.append_array(new_pos)
+	var nv0 := []
+	for s: Surf in surfs:
+		nv0.append(s.count())
+	var memo := {}
+	var changed := PackedInt32Array()
+	var added := []
+	var removed := PackedInt32Array()
+	for plan in plans:
+		var si: int = plan["si"]
+		var s: Surf = surfs[si]
+		var vmap: Dictionary = plan["pmap"]
+		var spec: Dictionary = plan["spec"]
+		for p in spec:
+			var sp: Array = spec[p]
+			var key: Vector4i
+			var v := -1
+			if sp[0] == "l":
+				var va: int = sp[1]
+				var vb: int = sp[2]
+				var f: float = sp[3]
+				if va > vb:
+					var tmp := va; va = vb; vb = tmp
+					f = 1.0 - f
+				key = Vector4i(si, va, vb, p)
+				v = memo.get(key, -1)
+				if v < 0:
+					v = s.blend_vertex(PackedInt32Array([va, vb]), PackedFloat32Array([1.0 - f, f]), p)
+			else:
+				key = Vector4i(si, -1, -1, p)
+				v = memo.get(key, -1)
+				if v < 0:
+					var t: int = sp[1]
+					var i := tri_at[t]
+					var vs := PackedInt32Array([s.idx[i], s.idx[i + 1], s.idx[i + 2]])
+					var w := Geometry3D.get_triangle_barycentric_coords(new_pos[p - n0], points[tris[t * 3]], points[tris[t * 3 + 1]], points[tris[t * 3 + 2]])
+					v = s.blend_vertex(vs, PackedFloat32Array([w.x, w.y, w.z]), p)
+			if not memo.has(key):
+				s.pos[v] = new_pos[p - n0]
+				memo[key] = v
+			vmap[p] = v
+		var old: PackedInt32Array = plan["old"]
+		var nt: PackedInt32Array = plan["tris"]
+		var piece: PackedInt32Array = plan["piece"]
+		var fid := {0: int(plan["f"])}
+		for k in nt.size() / 3:
+			if not fid.has(piece[k]):
+				fid[piece[k]] = face_n
+				face_n += 1
+				face_live += 1
+			var f: int = fid[piece[k]]
+			var a: int = vmap[nt[k * 3]]
+			var b: int = vmap[nt[k * 3 + 1]]
+			var c: int = vmap[nt[k * 3 + 2]]
+			if k < old.size():
+				var i := tri_at[old[k]]
+				s.idx[i] = a
+				s.idx[i + 1] = b
+				s.idx[i + 2] = c
+				s.face[i / 3] = f
+				changed.append(old[k])
+			else:
+				s.idx.append_array(PackedInt32Array([a, b, c]))
+				s.face.append(f)
+				added.append([si, s.idx.size() - 3])
+		for k in range(nt.size() / 3, old.size()):
+			removed.append(old[k])
+	for t in also:
+		if not changed.has(t):
+			changed.append(t)
+	if not _patch(changed, added, removed, n0, nv0):
+		var kill := {}
+		for t in removed:
+			if not kill.has(tri_surf[t]):
+				kill[tri_surf[t]] = {}
+			kill[tri_surf[t]][tri_at[t]] = true
+		for si in kill:
+			(surfs[si] as Surf).drop_tris(kill[si])
+		derive()
+
+
+func _add_chord(chords: Dictionary, seed: Dictionary, f: int, t: int, ch: PackedInt32Array) -> void:
+	if not chords.has(f):
+		chords[f] = []
+		seed[f] = t
+	(chords[f] as Array).append(ch)
+
+
+## The point of node `x` in the cut being made (st: its new points so far).
+func _cut_point(x: Dictionary, st: Dictionary) -> int:
+	if x["k"] == 0:
+		return x["p"]
+	var key := _node_key(x)
+	var pid: Dictionary = st["pid"]
+	if pid.has(key):
+		return pid[key]
+	var pos: PackedVector3Array = st["pos"]
+	var p: int = int(st["n0"]) + pos.size()
+	pos.append(x["pos"])
+	pid[key] = p
+	if x["k"] == 1:
+		var ins: Dictionary = st["ins"]
+		if not ins.has(x["e"]):
+			ins[x["e"]] = []
+		(ins[x["e"]] as Array).append([float(x["t"]), p])
+	else:
+		(st["face_pts"] as Dictionary)[p] = int(x["tri"])
+	return p
+
+
+## Face `f` (one of its triangles: `seed_t`) made again: its outline with the cut's new
+## points on its sides, split along `chs` (point runs from side to side), triangulated.
+## {"f", "si", "old": its triangles, "tris": the new ones (points), "piece": each one's part
+## of the split face, "pmap": point -> vertex, "spec": new point -> how its vertex is made}.
+func _replan(f: int, seed_t: int, chs: Array, st: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var n0: int = st["n0"]
+	var new_pos: PackedVector3Array = st["pos"]
+	var ins: Dictionary = st["ins"]
+	var face_pts: Dictionary = st["face_pts"]
+	var pt := poly_tris(seed_t)
+	var si := tri_surf[seed_t]
+	var s: Surf = surfs[si]
+	var pmap := {}
+	for t in pt:
+		for k in 3:
+			var v := s.idx[tri_at[t] + k]
+			pmap[s.vp[v]] = v
+	var loop := _loop_of(pt)
+	if loop.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	var ring := PackedInt32Array()
+	var spec := {}
+	for i in loop.size():
+		var a := loop[i]
+		var b := loop[(i + 1) % loop.size()]
+		ring.append(a)
+		var e := edge(a, b)
+		if ins.has(e):
+			var lst: Array = (ins[e] as Array).duplicate()
+			lst.sort_custom(func(x, y): return x[0] < y[0])
+			if edges[e * 2] != a:
+				lst.reverse()
+			for it in lst:
+				ring.append(it[1])
+				spec[it[1]] = ["l", pmap[edges[e * 2]], pmap[edges[e * 2 + 1]], it[0]]
+	var pos := func(p: int) -> Vector3: return points[p] if p < n0 else new_pos[p - n0]
+	# the face's plane, as 2D
+	var nn := Vector3.ZERO
+	for i in ring.size():
+		var a: Vector3 = pos.call(ring[i])
+		var b: Vector3 = pos.call(ring[(i + 1) % ring.size()])
+		nn += Vector3((a.y - b.y) * (a.z + b.z), (a.z - b.z) * (a.x + b.x), (a.x - b.x) * (a.y + b.y))
+	if nn.length_squared() < 1e-30:
+		return {}
+	nn = nn.normalized()
+	var u := nn.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(nn.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+	var w := nn.cross(u)
+	var flat := func(p: int) -> Vector2:
+		var q: Vector3 = pos.call(p)
+		return Vector2(q.dot(u), q.dot(w))
+	var pieces := [ring]
+	for ch: PackedInt32Array in chs:
+		for p in ch:
+			if face_pts.has(p):
+				if not pt.has(face_pts[p]):
+					return {}
+				spec[p] = ["b", face_pts[p]]
+		pieces = _split(pieces, ch, flat)
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	var piece := PackedInt32Array()
+	for pi in pieces.size():
+		var poly: PackedInt32Array = pieces[pi]
+		var p2 := PackedVector2Array()
+		for p in poly:
+			p2.append(flat.call(p))
+		var tr := ear_clip(p2)
+		for k in range(0, tr.size(), 3):
+			out.append(poly[tr[k]])
+			out.append(poly[tr[k + 1]])
+			out.append(poly[tr[k + 2]])
+			piece.append(pi)
+	return {"f": f, "si": si, "old": pt, "tris": out, "piece": piece, "pmap": pmap, "spec": spec}
+
+
+## The outlines `pieces` with the one holding chord `ch` (from one of its corners to another)
+## split in two along it.
+static func _split(pieces: Array, ch: PackedInt32Array, flat: Callable) -> Array:
+	var u := ch[0]
+	var v := ch[ch.size() - 1]
+	if u == v or ch.size() < 2:
+		return pieces
+	var mids := ch.slice(1, ch.size() - 1)
+	var probe: Vector2 = (flat.call(u) as Vector2).lerp(flat.call(ch[1]), 0.5)
+	for i in pieces.size():
+		var poly: PackedInt32Array = pieces[i]
+		var iu := poly.find(u)
+		var iv := poly.find(v)
+		if iu < 0 or iv < 0:
+			continue
+		var m := poly.size()
+		if mids.is_empty() and ((iu + 1) % m == iv or (iv + 1) % m == iu):
+			return pieces   # (along a side already)
+		var p2 := PackedVector2Array()
+		for p in poly:
+			p2.append(flat.call(p))
+		if not Geometry2D.is_point_in_polygon(probe, p2):
+			continue
+		var a := PackedInt32Array()
+		var j := iu
+		while true:
+			a.append(poly[j])
+			if j == iv:
+				break
+			j = (j + 1) % m
+		var rev := mids.duplicate()
+		rev.reverse()
+		a.append_array(rev)
+		var b := PackedInt32Array()
+		j = iv
+		while true:
+			b.append(poly[j])
+			if j == iu:
+				break
+			j = (j + 1) % m
+		b.append_array(mids)
+		var out := pieces.duplicate()
+		out[i] = a
+		out.append(b)
+		return out
+	return pieces
+
+
+## Triangles (index triples into `p`) of the simple polygon `p` (counter-clockwise), corners
+## in a straight line along a side included (never a corner of a sliver).
+static func ear_clip(p: PackedVector2Array) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	if p.size() < 3:
+		return out
+	var box := Rect2(p[0], Vector2.ZERO)
+	for q in p:
+		box = box.expand(q)
+	var tol := maxf(box.size.length_squared(), 1e-12) * 1e-10
+	var idx := PackedInt32Array()
+	for i in p.size():
+		idx.append(i)
+	while idx.size() > 3:
+		var m := idx.size()
+		var found := -1
+		var best := -1.0
+		for i in m:
+			var ia := idx[(i + m - 1) % m]
+			var ib := idx[i]
+			var ic := idx[(i + 1) % m]
+			var a := p[ia]
+			var b := p[ib]
+			var c := p[ic]
+			if (b - a).cross(c - b) <= tol:
+				continue
+			var ok := true
+			for j in m:
+				var iq := idx[j]
+				if iq == ia or iq == ib or iq == ic:
+					continue
+				var q := p[iq]
+				if q == a or q == b or q == c:
+					continue
+				if (b - a).cross(q - a) >= -tol and (c - b).cross(q - b) >= -tol and (a - c).cross(q - c) >= -tol:
+					ok = false
+					break
+			if not ok:
+				continue
+			# (the fattest ear: its smallest angle)
+			var qa := minf(minf(absf((b - a).angle_to(c - a)), absf((c - b).angle_to(a - b))), absf((a - c).angle_to(b - c)))
+			if qa > best:
+				best = qa
+				found = i
+			if m > 48:
+				break
+		if found < 0:
+			break
+		out.append(idx[(found + m - 1) % m])
+		out.append(idx[found])
+		out.append(idx[(found + 1) % m])
+		idx.remove_at(found)
+	if idx.size() == 3:
+		if (p[idx[1]] - p[idx[0]]).cross(p[idx[2]] - p[idx[1]]) > tol:
+			out.append_array(idx)
+	elif idx.size() > 3:
+		# (stuck: what's left as the engine triangulates it)
+		var rest := PackedVector2Array()
+		for i in idx:
+			rest.append(p[i])
+		for i in Geometry2D.triangulate_polygon(rest):
+			out.append(idx[i])
+	return out
+
+
+## The derived arrays patched for a cut: triangles `changed` (rewritten in place) and
+## `added` ([surface, index] - appended to their surfaces), the points from `n_old` on
+## new (their vertices: those from `nv0` - each surface's count before - on). Edges
+## dropped and added, faces' insides, neighbours - only where they changed. False:
+## can't (an edge of three triangles or more): derive() instead.
+func _patch(changed: PackedInt32Array, added: Array, removed: PackedInt32Array, n_old: int, nv0: Array) -> bool:
+	var n := points.size()
+	# the new points' vertices (first: nothing changed if it can't)
+	var per := []
+	for i in n - n_old:
+		per.append(PackedInt32Array())
+	for si in surfs.size():
+		var s: Surf = surfs[si]
+		for v in range(nv0[si], s.count()):
+			var p := s.vp[v] - n_old
+			if p < 0:
+				return false
+			var l: PackedInt32Array = per[p]
+			per[p] = PackedInt32Array()
+			l.append((si << SHIFT) | v)
+			per[p] = l
+	pv_start = pv_start.duplicate()
+	pv = pv.duplicate()
+	for l: PackedInt32Array in per:
+		pv.append_array(l)
+		pv_start.append(pv.size())
+	tris = tris.duplicate()
+	tri_surf = tri_surf.duplicate()
+	tri_at = tri_at.duplicate()
+	tri_face = tri_face.duplicate()
+	tri_edges = tri_edges.duplicate()
+	edges = edges.duplicate()
+	edge_of = edge_of.duplicate()
+	edge_tris = edge_tris.duplicate()
+	edge_tn = edge_tn.duplicate()
+	edge_inner = edge_inner.duplicate()
+	edge_more = edge_more.duplicate(true)
+	var add_nb := {}
+	var del_nb := {}
+	var dead := {}
+	var touched := {}
+	for t in changed + removed:
+		for k in 3:
+			var e := tri_edges[t * 3 + k]
+			if e < 0:
+				continue
+			_unlink(e, t)
+			touched[e] = true
+			if edge_tn[e] == 0:
+				dead[e] = true
+	var all := changed.duplicate()
+	for t in changed:
+		_set_tri(t)
+	for ad in added:
+		var t := tri_count()
+		tris.append_array(PackedInt32Array([0, 0, 0]))
+		tri_surf.append(ad[0])
+		tri_at.append(ad[1])
+		tri_face.append(0)
+		tri_edges.append_array(PackedInt32Array([-1, -1, -1]))
+		_set_tri(t)
+		all.append(t)
+	for t in all:
+		for k in 3:
+			var a := tris[t * 3 + k]
+			var b := tris[t * 3 + (k + 1) % 3]
+			if a == b:
+				tri_edges[t * 3 + k] = -1
+				continue
+			var lo := mini(a, b)
+			var hi := maxi(a, b)
+			var e: int = edge_of.get(lo * KEY + hi, -1)
+			if e < 0:
+				e = edge_tn.size()
+				edge_of[lo * KEY + hi] = e
+				edges.append(lo)
+				edges.append(hi)
+				edge_tris.append(t)
+				edge_tris.append(-1)
+				edge_tn.append(1)
+				edge_inner.append(0)
+				_nb(add_nb, lo, hi)
+				_nb(add_nb, hi, lo)
+			else:
+				if edge_tn[e] == 0:
+					edge_tris[e * 2] = t
+					dead.erase(e)
+				elif edge_tn[e] == 1:
+					edge_tris[e * 2 + 1] = t
+				else:
+					_nb(edge_more, e, t)
+				edge_tn[e] += 1
+			tri_edges[t * 3 + k] = e
+			touched[e] = true
+	# triangles let go: each surface's last one moved into its place, and the last triangle
+	# into its place in the derived arrays
+	if not removed.is_empty():
+		var smap := {}   # surface -> {index: triangle}
+		for t in removed:
+			smap[tri_surf[t]] = {}
+		for t in tri_count():
+			if smap.has(tri_surf[t]):
+				smap[tri_surf[t]][tri_at[t]] = t
+		var gone_t := Array(removed)
+		gone_t.sort()
+		gone_t.reverse()
+		for r: int in gone_t:
+			var si := tri_surf[r]
+			var sm: Dictionary = smap[si]
+			var s: Surf = surfs[si]
+			var slot := tri_at[r]
+			var last := s.idx.size() - 3
+			if slot != last:
+				var u: int = sm[last]
+				for k in 3:
+					s.idx[slot + k] = s.idx[last + k]
+				s.face[slot / 3] = s.face[last / 3]
+				tri_at[u] = slot
+				sm[slot] = u
+			sm.erase(last)
+			s.idx.resize(last)
+			s.face.resize(last / 3)
+			var lt := tri_count() - 1
+			if r != lt:
+				for k in 3:
+					tris[r * 3 + k] = tris[lt * 3 + k]
+					tri_edges[r * 3 + k] = tri_edges[lt * 3 + k]
+				tri_surf[r] = tri_surf[lt]
+				tri_at[r] = tri_at[lt]
+				tri_face[r] = tri_face[lt]
+				if smap.has(tri_surf[r]):
+					smap[tri_surf[r]][tri_at[r]] = r
+				for k in 3:
+					var e := tri_edges[r * 3 + k]
+					if e < 0:
+						continue
+					if edge_tris[e * 2] == lt:
+						edge_tris[e * 2] = r
+					elif edge_tris[e * 2 + 1] == lt:
+						edge_tris[e * 2 + 1] = r
+					elif edge_more.has(e):
+						var m: PackedInt32Array = edge_more[e]
+						var at := m.find(lt)
+						if at >= 0:
+							m[at] = r
+			tris.resize(lt * 3)
+			tri_edges.resize(lt * 3)
+			tri_surf.resize(lt)
+			tri_at.resize(lt)
+			tri_face.resize(lt)
+	for e in touched:
+		if not dead.has(e):
+			edge_inner[e] = 1 if edge_tn[e] == 2 and tri_face[edge_tris[e * 2]] == tri_face[edge_tris[e * 2 + 1]] else 0
+	# edges no triangle has any more: the last edge moved into each one's place
+	var gone: Array = dead.keys()
+	gone.sort()
+	gone.reverse()
+	for e: int in gone:
+		var a := edges[e * 2]
+		var b := edges[e * 2 + 1]
+		_nb(del_nb, a, b)
+		_nb(del_nb, b, a)
+		edge_of.erase(a * KEY + b)
+		var last := edge_tn.size() - 1
+		if e != last:
+			var la := edges[last * 2]
+			var lb := edges[last * 2 + 1]
+			edges[e * 2] = la
+			edges[e * 2 + 1] = lb
+			edge_of[la * KEY + lb] = e
+			edge_tris[e * 2] = edge_tris[last * 2]
+			edge_tris[e * 2 + 1] = edge_tris[last * 2 + 1]
+			edge_tn[e] = edge_tn[last]
+			edge_inner[e] = edge_inner[last]
+			if edge_more.has(last):
+				edge_more[e] = edge_more[last]
+				edge_more.erase(last)
+			for t in edge_tri_list(e):
+				if t >= 0:
+					for k in 3:
+						if tri_edges[t * 3 + k] == last:
+							tri_edges[t * 3 + k] = e
+		edges.resize(last * 2)
+		edge_tris.resize(last * 2)
+		edge_tn.resize(last)
+		edge_inner.resize(last)
+	# neighbours: the lists of the points whose edges changed made again, the rest copied
+	var chg := {}
+	for p in add_nb:
+		chg[p] = true
+	for p in del_nb:
+		chg[p] = true
+	var order: Array = chg.keys()
+	order.sort()
+	order.append(n)
+	var old_n := adj_start.size() - 1
+	var na := PackedInt32Array()
+	var ns := PackedInt32Array()
+	ns.resize(n + 1)
+	var run := 0
+	for c: int in order:
+		var hi := mini(c, old_n)
+		if hi > run:
+			var shift := na.size() - adj_start[run]
+			na.append_array(adj.slice(adj_start[run], adj_start[hi]))
+			for p in range(run, hi):
+				ns[p + 1] = adj_start[p + 1] + shift
+		for p in range(maxi(run, old_n), c):
+			ns[p + 1] = ns[p]
+		if c >= n:
+			break
+		var lst := PackedInt32Array()
+		if c < old_n:
+			lst = adj.slice(adj_start[c], adj_start[c + 1])
+		for q in del_nb.get(c, PackedInt32Array()):
+			var at := lst.find(q)
+			if at >= 0:
+				lst.remove_at(at)
+		lst.append_array(add_nb.get(c, PackedInt32Array()))
+		na.append_array(lst)
+		ns[c + 1] = na.size()
+		run = c + 1
+	adj = na
+	adj_start = ns
+	_topo_ids += 1
+	topo = _topo_ids
+	return true
+
+
+## Triangle `t` let go of edge `e`.
+func _unlink(e: int, t: int) -> void:
+	var more: PackedInt32Array = edge_more.get(e, PackedInt32Array())
+	var slot := -1
+	if edge_tris[e * 2] == t:
+		slot = 0
+	elif edge_tris[e * 2 + 1] == t:
+		slot = 1
+	if slot < 0:
+		var at := more.find(t)
+		if at < 0:
+			return
+		more.remove_at(at)
+	elif not more.is_empty():
+		edge_tris[e * 2 + slot] = more[more.size() - 1]
+		more.remove_at(more.size() - 1)
+	elif slot == 0:
+		edge_tris[e * 2] = edge_tris[e * 2 + 1]
+		edge_tris[e * 2 + 1] = -1
+	else:
+		edge_tris[e * 2 + 1] = -1
+	if edge_more.has(e) and more.is_empty():
+		edge_more.erase(e)
+	edge_tn[e] -= 1
+
+
+func _set_tri(t: int) -> void:
+	var s: Surf = surfs[tri_surf[t]]
+	var i := tri_at[t]
+	for k in 3:
+		tris[t * 3 + k] = s.vp[s.idx[i + k]]
+	tri_face[t] = s.face[i / 3]
+
+
+static func _nb(d: Dictionary, p: int, q: int) -> void:
+	if not d.has(p):
+		d[p] = PackedInt32Array()
+	var l: PackedInt32Array = d[p]
+	l.append(q)
+
+
+## A ray-test mesh of triangles `tr` over `pts` (TriangleMesh's face_index = the triangle) -
+## for a worker thread (copies given).
+static func make_triangle_mesh(pts: PackedVector3Array, tr: PackedInt32Array) -> TriangleMesh:
+	var f := PackedVector3Array()
+	f.resize(tr.size())
+	for i in tr.size():
+		f[i] = pts[tr[i]]
+	var tm := TriangleMesh.new()
+	tm.create_from_faces(f)
+	return tm
+
+
+
+# --- dissolve -------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Faces joined into one and points taken out, the faces round them filled again:
+# points `pts` (the faces round each made one, the point gone - one in a straight run
+# along a side just leaves it), edges `eds` (the two faces either side made one: the
+# triangles as they are) and the faces of triangles `tsel` (those side by side made one,
+# the points inside them gone). Points left in a straight run along a side, or inside a
+# face, by the joins go too. A face made again is its outline without the points gone,
+# triangulated (its corners keep their vertices: UVs, normals, weights). Only the faces
+# changed are patched. {"ok", "why", "keep": an edge (point pair) on each face made}.
+func dissolve(pts: PackedInt32Array, eds: PackedInt32Array, tsel: PackedByteArray) -> Dictionary:
+	var parent := {}   # face -> the face it's joined to (only the faces touched)
+	var seed := {}     # face -> one of its triangles
+	var cand := {}
+	var straight := {}   # (points an edge dissolved ends at: in a straight run after, they go too)
+	var rem := {}
+	var join := func(t0: int, t1: int) -> void:
+		seed[tri_face[t0]] = t0
+		seed[tri_face[t1]] = t1
+		var r0 := _froot(parent, tri_face[t0])
+		var r1 := _froot(parent, tri_face[t1])
+		if r0 != r1:
+			parent[r1] = r0
+	# faces side by side
+	var fsel := {}
+	for t in mini(tsel.size(), tri_count()):
+		if tsel[t]:
+			fsel[tri_face[t]] = true
+	for t in mini(tsel.size(), tri_count()):
+		if not tsel[t]:
+			continue
+		for k in 3:
+			var e := tri_edges[t * 3 + k]
+			if e >= 0 and edge_tn[e] == 2 and not edge_inner[e]:
+				var t0 := edge_tris[e * 2]
+				var t1 := edge_tris[e * 2 + 1]
+				if fsel.has(tri_face[t0]) and fsel.has(tri_face[t1]) and tri_surf[t0] == tri_surf[t1]:
+					join.call(t0, t1)
+					cand[edges[e * 2]] = true
+					cand[edges[e * 2 + 1]] = true
+	# edges
+	for e in eds:
+		if e < 0 or e >= edge_count() or edge_tn[e] != 2 or edge_inner[e]:
+			continue
+		var t0 := edge_tris[e * 2]
+		var t1 := edge_tris[e * 2 + 1]
+		if tri_surf[t0] != tri_surf[t1]:
+			continue
+		join.call(t0, t1)
+		cand[edges[e * 2]] = true
+		cand[edges[e * 2 + 1]] = true
+		straight[edges[e * 2]] = true
+		straight[edges[e * 2 + 1]] = true
+	# points
+	for p in pts:
+		if p < 0 or p >= points.size() or adj_start[p] == adj_start[p + 1]:
+			continue
+		var vis := _shown_at(p, parent)
+		if vis.size() == 2 and _straight(p, vis[0], vis[1]):
+			rem[p] = true   # (in a straight run: it just leaves the side)
+			continue
+		# (the faces round it made one - those of each surface: a point two layers share, each layer's)
+		var first := {}
+		for t in tris_around(p):
+			var si := tri_surf[t]
+			seed[tri_face[t]] = t
+			if not first.has(si):
+				first[si] = t
+			else:
+				join.call(first[si], t)
+		rem[p] = true
+	# points the joins left inside a face, or in a straight run along a side
+	for p in cand:
+		if rem.has(p):
+			continue
+		var vis := _shown_at(p, parent)
+		if vis.is_empty() or (straight.has(p) and vis.size() == 2 and _straight(p, vis[0], vis[1])):
+			rem[p] = true
+	# the faces to make: those joined, and those a point goes from
+	for p in rem:
+		for t in tris_around(p):
+			if not seed.has(tri_face[t]):
+				seed[tri_face[t]] = t
+	var members := {}
+	for f in seed:
+		var r := _froot(parent, f)
+		if not members.has(r):
+			members[r] = []
+		(members[r] as Array).append(f)
+	if members.is_empty():
+		return {"ok": false, "why": "nothing to dissolve there"}
+	var plans := []
+	var also := PackedInt32Array()
+	var keep := []
+	var joined := 0
+	for r in members:
+		var rt := PackedInt32Array()
+		for f in members[r]:
+			rt.append_array(poly_tris(seed[f]))
+		joined += (members[r] as Array).size() - 1
+		var loop := _loop_of_set(rt)
+		if loop.size() < 3:
+			return {"ok": false, "why": "the faces joined wouldn't make one simple outline (a hole in them?)"}
+		var gone := false
+		for t in rt:
+			for k in 3:
+				gone = gone or rem.has(tris[t * 3 + k])
+		if not gone:
+			# (only joined: the triangles stay, all in one face)
+			for t in rt:
+				(surfs[tri_surf[t]] as Surf).face[tri_at[t] / 3] = r
+				also.append(t)
+			keep.append([loop[0], loop[1]])
+			continue
+		var ring := PackedInt32Array()
+		for q in loop:
+			if not rem.has(q):
+				ring.append(q)
+		if ring.size() < 3:
+			return {"ok": false, "why": "too few corners would be left"}
+		var si := tri_surf[rt[0]]
+		var s: Surf = surfs[si]
+		var pmap := {}
+		for t in rt:
+			for k in 3:
+				var v := s.idx[tri_at[t] + k]
+				if not pmap.has(s.vp[v]):
+					pmap[s.vp[v]] = v
+		var nn := Vector3.ZERO
+		for i in ring.size():
+			var a := points[ring[i]]
+			var b := points[ring[(i + 1) % ring.size()]]
+			nn += Vector3((a.y - b.y) * (a.z + b.z), (a.z - b.z) * (a.x + b.x), (a.x - b.x) * (a.y + b.y))
+		if nn.length_squared() < 1e-30:
+			return {"ok": false, "why": "a face would have no area"}
+		nn = nn.normalized()
+		var u := nn.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(nn.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+		var w := nn.cross(u)
+		var p2 := PackedVector2Array()
+		for q in ring:
+			p2.append(Vector2(points[q].dot(u), points[q].dot(w)))
+		var tr := ear_clip(p2)
+		if tr.size() / 3 != ring.size() - 2:
+			return {"ok": false, "why": "a face joined is too bent to fill again"}
+		var out := PackedInt32Array()
+		var piece := PackedInt32Array()
+		for k in tr.size():
+			out.append(ring[tr[k]])
+		piece.resize(tr.size() / 3)
+		plans.append({"f": r, "si": si, "old": rt, "tris": out, "piece": piece, "pmap": pmap, "spec": {}})
+		keep.append([ring[0], ring[1]])
+	_apply_plans(plans, PackedVector3Array(), points.size(), also)
+	unused = unused or not rem.is_empty()
+	face_live -= joined
+	_wire_topo = -1
+	return {"ok": true, "keep": keep, "points": rem.size()}
+
+
+static func _froot(parent: Dictionary, f: int) -> int:
+	var r := f
+	while parent.has(r) and parent[r] != r:
+		r = parent[r]
+	while parent.has(f) and parent[f] != r:   # (shortened)
+		var nx: int = parent[f]
+		parent[f] = r
+		f = nx
+	return r
+
+
+## The edges at point `p` shown with faces joined as in `parent` (between two of them,
+## or on the border): their other points.
+func _shown_at(p: int, parent: Dictionary) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	for k in range(adj_start[p], adj_start[p + 1]):
+		var q := adj[k]
+		var e := edge(p, q)
+		if edge_tn[e] != 2:
+			out.append(q)
+		elif _froot(parent, tri_face[edge_tris[e * 2]]) != _froot(parent, tri_face[edge_tris[e * 2 + 1]]):
+			out.append(q)
+	return out
+
+
+func _straight(p: int, a: int, b: int) -> bool:
+	return (points[a] - points[p]).normalized().dot((points[b] - points[p]).normalized()) < STRAIGHT
+
+
+## The outline of triangles `pt` (one face or several side by side), in order round it
+## (the triangles' way round); empty if it isn't one simple outline.
+func _loop_of_set(pt: PackedInt32Array) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var inset := {}
+	for t in pt:
+		inset[t] = true
+	var nxt := {}
+	for t in pt:
+		for k in 3:
+			var e := tri_edges[t * 3 + k]
+			if e >= 0:
+				var inside := false
+				for o in edge_tri_list(e):   # (another of the set on it: inside - a layer's own, where layers share edges)
+					if o != t and inset.has(o):
+						inside = true
+				if inside:
+					continue
+			var a := tris[t * 3 + k]
+			if nxt.has(a):
+				return PackedInt32Array()
+			nxt[a] = tris[t * 3 + (k + 1) % 3]
+	if nxt.is_empty():
+		return PackedInt32Array()
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	var p: int = nxt.keys()[0]
+	while out.size() <= nxt.size():
+		out.append(p)
+		p = nxt.get(p, -1)
+		if p < 0:
+			return PackedInt32Array()
+		if p == out[0]:
+			break
+	return out if out.size() == nxt.size() else PackedInt32Array()
+
+
+
+# --- symmetrize topology -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+## The `positive` side of `axis` (the part's own plane through its origin) made the whole:
+## the faces crossing the plane cut along it (the knife's slice: new points on the edges,
+## their attributes mixed), the other side deleted, the kept side mirrored onto it (faces
+## turned the right way round, normals mirrored, UVs as they are, bone weights onto each
+## bone's twin by `bones_twin`) and welded along the seam (points within `tol` of the plane
+## put on it and shared). Each face stays a face. {"ok", "why", "new": the points of the new half}.
+func symmetrize_topology(axis: int, positive := true, tol := -1.0, bones_twin := PackedInt32Array()) -> Dictionary:
+	if tol < 0.0:
+		tol = maxf(aabb().size.length() * 0.0005, 1e-5)
+	var sgn := 1.0 if positive else -1.0
+	var n := Vector3.ZERO
+	n[axis] = 1.0
+	# points next to the plane put on it (they're the seam)
+	for i in points.size():
+		if absf(points[i][axis]) <= tol and points[i][axis] != 0.0:
+			points[i][axis] = 0.0
+	sync()
+	# the faces crossing it cut along it
+	var chains := knife_slice(Vector3.ZERO, n, [])
+	if not chains.is_empty():
+		knife_apply(chains)
+	# the other side gone (and anything flat on the plane)
+	var kill := PackedByteArray()
+	kill.resize(tri_count())
+	var keep := 0
+	for t in tri_count():
+		var c := (points[tris[t * 3]][axis] + points[tris[t * 3 + 1]][axis] + points[tris[t * 3 + 2]][axis]) / 3.0
+		if c * sgn <= tol * 0.01:
+			kill[t] = 1
+		else:
+			keep += 1
+	if keep == 0:
+		return {"ok": false, "why": "nothing on the %s%s side to keep" % ["+" if positive else "-", "XYZ"[axis]]}
+	if kill.has(1):
+		# (as delete_tris, without working the derived arrays out: the mirror does that)
+		var st := _starts(kill)
+		for si in surfs.size():
+			if not (st[si] as PackedInt32Array).is_empty():
+				var d := {}
+				for i in st[si]:
+					d[i] = true
+				(surfs[si] as Surf).drop_tris(d)
+		compact()
+	# mirrored onto it, welded along the seam
+	var axes := [false, false, false]
+	axes[axis] = true
+	apply_mirror(axes, tol * 0.5, true, false, bones_twin)
+	unused = false
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	for i in points.size():
+		if points[i][axis] * sgn < -tol * 0.5:
+			out.append(i)
+	return {"ok": true, "new": out}

bubbles.text: Triangles, edges and neighbours worked out again after an edit (the knife and dissolve patch only what they touched).
Quads first: the squarest pairs of flat triangles (convex, corners 20-160 degrees), then n-gons along the rims.
Proportional editing's six falloffs.

@@ -1,0 +1,193 @@ 
+extends VBoxContainer
+## The mesh editor's material browser (the Materials tab of its left panel): the material
+## library (material_library.gd) as a grid of balls - each drawn once in the background as a
+## turntable (mesh_thumbs.gd, kept by the material's settings), turning while the mouse is on
+## it - with its name under it; the groups (This model, Characters, Presets, Mine) as buttons,
+## a search box, and New / Duplicate / Rename / Delete. Click one: picked (its settings in the
+## MATERIAL panel); double-click: given to the selected surface (or faces); drag it onto a
+## surface in the 3D view: given to that surface.
+
+signal picked(id: String)
+signal activated(id: String)
+signal action(what: String)
+
+const MaterialLibrary := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/material_library.gd")
+
+var lib: MaterialLibrary
+var thumbs: Node
+var group := ""
+var list: ItemList
+var search: LineEdit
+var _cats: HFlowContainer
+var _cat_btns := {}
+var _keys := {}          # id -> its picture's key (as last asked)
+
+
+func setup(library: MaterialLibrary, thumb_maker: Node) -> void:
+	lib = library
+	thumbs = thumb_maker
+	thumbs.made.connect(_made)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 3)
+	var tools := HFlowContainer.new()
+	tools.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 2)
+	tools.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 2)
+	for t in [["new", "m_mat_new", "New material", "A new material of your own (in the Mine group), to edit in the MATERIAL panel - a character's\nkind when a character is open (only what the game keeps of it), else a full one."],
+			["duplicate", "m_mat_duplicate", "Duplicate material", "A copy of the picked material as one of yours (Mine) - the way to change a built-in look."],
+			["rename", "m_mat_rename", "Rename material", "A new name for the picked material (yours only - a character's materials keep their names:\nthe game finds them by name)."],
+			["delete", "m_mat_delete", "Delete material", "Removes the picked material from the library (yours; a built-in look only in a mod, asked first).\nSurfaces that have it keep it."]]:
+		var b := Button.new()
+		b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+		b.name = "Mat_" + t[0]
+		EditorIcons.dress(b, t[1], EditorIcons.tip(t[2], "", t[3]))
+		b.text = ""
+		b.icon_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
+		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(32, 30)
+		IconAnim.attach(b, t[1])
+		var what: String = t[0]
+		b.pressed.connect(func(): action.emit(what))
+		tools.add_child(b)
+	add_child(tools)
+	search = LineEdit.new()
+	search.name = "MaterialSearch"
+	search.placeholder_text = "Find a material..."
+	search.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
+	search.clear_button_enabled = true
+	search.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Find a material", "", "Narrows the materials to those whose name, group, kind or characters have these words.")
+	search.text_changed.connect(func(_t): refill())
+	add_child(search)
+	_cats = HFlowContainer.new()
+	_cats.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 4)
+	_cats.add_theme_constant_override("v_separation", 4)
+	add_child(_cats)
+	for g in [""] + MaterialLibrary.GROUPS:
+		var b := Button.new()
+		b.text = "All" if g == "" else str(MaterialLibrary.GROUP_LABEL[g])
+		b.toggle_mode = true
+		b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+		b.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
+		b.name = "Group_" + (g if g != "" else "all")
+		b.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Material group: " + b.text, "", {"": "Every material.", "model": "The open model's own materials.",
+			"character": "Every character's named materials (from its model.json) - each says who wears it.",
+			"preset": "The game's looks: bronze, gold, steel, painted armour, cloth, stone, glows...", "mine": "Your own materials (data/materials.json, or your mod's)."}[g])
+		b.button_pressed = g == group
+		b.pressed.connect(set_group.bind(g))
+		_cat_btns[g] = b
+		_cats.add_child(b)
+	list = ItemList.new()
+	list.name = "MaterialList"
+	list.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	list.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	list.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
+	list.icon_mode = ItemList.ICON_MODE_TOP
+	list.max_columns = 0
+	list.fixed_icon_size = Vector2i(56, 56)
+	list.fixed_column_width = 74
+	list.same_column_width = true
+	list.max_text_lines = 2
+	list.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
+	list.item_selected.connect(func(i): picked.emit(str(list.get_item_metadata(i))))
+	list.item_activated.connect(func(i): activated.emit(str(list.get_item_metadata(i))))
+	list.set_drag_forwarding(_drag, Callable(), Callable())
+	add_child(list)
+	TurntableHover.attach(list, func(meta) -> Array: return thumbs.frames(str(_keys.get(str(meta), ""))) if thumbs else [])
+
+
+func set_group(g: String) -> void:
+	group = g
+	for k in _cat_btns:
+		(_cat_btns[k] as Button).set_pressed_no_signal(k == g)
+	refill()
+
+
+## The grid again (the library, the group or the search changed).
+func refill() -> void:
+	if lib == null or list == null:
+		return
+	var keep := selected()
+	thumbs.clear_queue()
+	list.clear()
+	for id in lib.ids(group, search.text if search else ""):
+		var i := list.add_item(str(lib.entry(id)["name"]), EditorIcons.get_icon("m_materials"))
+		list.set_item_metadata(i, id)
+		_dress(i, id)
+		if id == keep:
+			list.select(i)
+
+
+## Item `i` (material `id`): its picture (asked for if it isn't made), tooltip and colour.
+func _dress(i: int, id: String) -> void:
+	var e := lib.entry(id)
+	list.set_item_text(i, str(e["name"]))
+	var k := lib.key_of(id)
+	_keys[id] = k
+	var tex: Texture2D = thumbs.get_thumb(k)
+	if tex == null and not thumbs._reading.has(k):   # (not on its way from disk: drawn)
+		var mat: Material = e["mat"] if e["group"] == "model" else lib.make_material(id)
+		var arrays := MaterialLibrary.sphere_arrays()
+		thumbs.ask_mesh(k, func(): return MaterialLibrary.sphere_mesh(arrays, mat))
+	if tex:
+		list.set_item_icon(i, tex)
+	var kind := "a character's material (colour, metal, roughness, glow)" if e["kind"] == "character" else "a full material"
+	var users: Array = e.get("users", [])
+	var who := ("\nWorn by: " + ", ".join(users)) if not users.is_empty() else ""
+	var slot := MaterialLibrary.slot_of(str(e["name"]))
+	var ro := "" if lib.is_editable(id) else "  ·  built in (Duplicate it to change it)"
+	list.set_item_tooltip(i, "%s\n%s  ·  %s%s%s%s\nClick: edit it (the MATERIAL panel) · double-click: give it to the selected surface or faces · drag it onto a surface in the view" % [
+		e["name"], MaterialLibrary.GROUP_LABEL[e["group"]], kind, ("  ·  recolourable (%s)" % slot) if slot != "" else "", ro, who])
+	if e["group"] == "mine":
+		list.set_item_custom_fg_color(i, Color(0.55, 1.0, 0.6))
+	elif e["group"] == "model":
+		list.set_item_custom_fg_color(i, Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.55))
+
+
+## Material `id`'s item again (its settings changed: a new picture).
+func update_item(id: String) -> void:
+	if list == null:
+		return
+	for i in list.item_count:
+		if str(list.get_item_metadata(i)) == id:
+			_dress(i, id)
+			return
+
+
+func selected() -> String:
+	if list == null:
+		return ""
+	var s := list.get_selected_items()
+	return str(list.get_item_metadata(s[0])) if not s.is_empty() else ""
+
+
+func select_id(id: String) -> void:
+	if list == null:
+		return
+	list.deselect_all()
+	for i in list.item_count:
+		if str(list.get_item_metadata(i)) == id:
+			list.select(i)
+			list.ensure_current_is_visible()
+			return
+
+
+func _made(key: String, tex: Texture2D) -> void:
+	if list == null or not key.begins_with("mat|"):
+		return
+	for i in list.item_count:
+		if str(_keys.get(str(list.get_item_metadata(i)), "")) == key:
+			list.set_item_icon(i, tex)
+
+
+## Dragging a material out of the grid (onto a surface in the 3D view): {"mesh_material": id}.
+func _drag(at: Vector2) -> Variant:
+	var i := list.get_item_at_position(at, true)
+	if i < 0:
+		return null
+	var pv := TextureRect.new()
+	pv.texture = list.get_item_icon(i)
+	pv.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(56, 56)
+	pv.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
+	pv.modulate.a = 0.85
+	set_drag_preview(pv)
+	return {"mesh_material": str(list.get_item_metadata(i))}

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,479 @@ 
+extends RefCounted
+## The mesh editor's material library (its Materials tab): every material to pick, edit and
+## give to a surface, in four groups -
+##   "model"     - the open model's own materials (the Material objects themselves);
+##   "character" - each character's named materials (art/*_3d/model.json), one entry a name,
+##                 knowing which characters use it;
+##   "preset"    - the game's looks (MeshIO.PRESETS);
+##   "mine"      - your own: data/materials.json.
+## Two kinds: "character" - only what the game keeps of a character's material (it merges a
+## character into one surface with one shader, reading colour, metal, roughness and glow from
+## model.json by the material's name); "standard" - a StandardMaterial3D's main settings and
+## its textures. Entries:
+##   {id, name, group, kind, values, textures: {slot: res path}, users: [character ids], mat (model only)}
+## values: {color: [r,g,b,a], metal, rough, emit, emission: [r,g,b], normal, alpha, uv: [u,v], cull}
+## Saved where EditTarget says: the game's data/materials.json ({"version", "materials": {id: entry}}),
+## or - in a mod - the mod's data/materials.json.merge (only the mod's changes; a built-in look the
+## mod removes: {"deleted": true} under its full id). Pictures picked for a texture are written as
+## art/materials/<name>_<slot>.png with the library.
+
+const MeshIO := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/mesh_io.gd")
+const FILE := "res://data/materials.json"
+const MERGE := "res://data/materials.json.merge"
+const TEX_DIR := "res://art/materials/"
+const GROUPS := ["model", "character", "preset", "mine"]
+const GROUP_LABEL := {"model": "This model", "character": "Characters", "preset": "Presets", "mine": "Mine"}
+## A texture slot -> its BaseMaterial3D property.
+const SLOTS := {"albedo": "albedo_texture", "rough": "roughness_texture", "emission": "emission_texture", "normal": "normal_texture"}
+const CULLS := ["back", "front", "none"]
+
+## id -> entry (ids: "model:<instance id>", "char:<name>", "preset:<name>", "mine:<id>")
+var entries := {}
+## The ids a mod adds, changes or removes (file key -> entry, or {"deleted": true}).
+var _mod := {}
+## Your materials changed since the last save().
+var dirty := false
+## Pictures picked this session, written with save(): res path -> Image.
+var pending := {}
+## Textures by res path (pictures picked this session, and those read).
+static var _tex := {}
+static var _sphere: Array = []
+
+
+## Reads the library: the characters' materials, the presets, yours (the mod's changes over the game's).
+func load_all() -> void:
+	var keep_model := {}
+	for id in entries:
+		if str(id).begins_with("model:"):
+			keep_model[id] = entries[id]
+	entries.clear()
+	_mod.clear()
+	dirty = false
+	_load_characters()
+	for i in MeshIO.PRESETS.size():
+		var p: Array = MeshIO.PRESETS[i]
+		var em: Color = p[4]
+		var c: Color = p[1]
+		entries["preset:" + str(p[0])] = {"id": "preset:" + str(p[0]), "name": str(p[0]), "group": "preset", "kind": "standard", "textures": {}, "users": [],
+			"values": _with_defaults({"color": [c.r, c.g, c.b, 1.0], "metal": p[2], "rough": p[3], "emit": p[5], "emission": [em.r, em.g, em.b]})}
+	var d = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(FILE)) if FileAccess.file_exists(FILE) else null
+	var mine: Dictionary = d.get("materials", {}) if d is Dictionary else {}
+	for k in mine:
+		_add_mine(str(k), mine[k])
+	if EditTarget.is_mod():
+		var mf := EditTarget.root() + MERGE.trim_prefix("res://")
+		var m = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(mf)) if FileAccess.file_exists(mf) else null
+		if m is Dictionary:
+			var add: Dictionary = m.get("materials", {})
+			for k in add:
+				_mod[k] = (add[k] as Dictionary).duplicate(true)
+				var full := str(k) if str(k).contains(":") else "mine:" + str(k)
+				if add[k].get("deleted", false):
+					entries.erase(full)
+				else:
+					var base: Dictionary = mine.get(k, {})
+					_add_mine(str(k), _merge(base, add[k]))
+	for id in keep_model:
+		entries[id] = keep_model[id]
+
+
+## Mods' merge: `add`'s keys over `base`'s, dictionaries merged key by key.
+static func _merge(base: Variant, add: Variant) -> Variant:
+	if base is Dictionary and add is Dictionary:
+		var out: Dictionary = base.duplicate()
+		for k in add:
+			out[k] = _merge(base[k], add[k]) if base.has(k) else add[k]
+		return out
+	return add
+
+
+func _add_mine(k: String, e: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var kind := "character" if str(e.get("kind", "standard")) == "character" else "standard"
+	entries["mine:" + k] = {"id": "mine:" + k, "name": str(e.get("name", k)), "group": "mine", "kind": kind, "users": [],
+		"values": _with_defaults(e.get("values", {})), "textures": (e.get("textures", {}) as Dictionary).duplicate()}
+
+
+## Every character's named materials (its model.json "materials" table) - the outline ink left out.
+func _load_characters() -> void:
+	var dirs := Array(DirAccess.get_directories_at("res://art/"))
+	dirs.sort()
+	for dir in dirs:
+		if not str(dir).ends_with("_3d"):
+			continue
+		var who := str(dir).trim_suffix("_3d")
+		var src := EditTarget.read_path("res://art/%s/model.json" % dir)
+		var d = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(src)) if FileAccess.file_exists(src) else null
+		if not d is Dictionary:
+			continue
+		var table: Dictionary = d.get("materials", {})
+		for nm in table:
+			var row: Dictionary = table[nm]
+			if str(row.get("kind", "")) == "ink" or str(nm).contains("Ink"):
+				continue
+			var id := "char:" + str(nm)
+			if entries.has(id):
+				(entries[id]["users"] as Array).append(who)
+				continue
+			entries[id] = {"id": id, "name": str(nm), "group": "character", "kind": "character", "textures": {}, "users": [who],
+				"values": character_values(str(nm), row)}
+
+
+## A character's material as the game sees it: its colour from the table, its metal, roughness and
+## glow from the table if it has them, else from the words in its name (Stage3D.surface_look).
+static func character_values(nm: String, row: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var look := Stage3D.surface_look(nm, str(row.get("kind", "toon")))
+	var c: Array = row.get("color", [0.8, 0.8, 0.8])
+	return _with_defaults({"color": [float(c[0]), float(c[1]), float(c[2]), 1.0], "metal": float(row.get("metal", look["metal"])),
+		"rough": float(row.get("rough", look["rough"])), "emit": float(row.get("emit", look["emit"])), "emission": [float(c[0]), float(c[1]), float(c[2])]})
+
+
+## The recolourable slot a character's material is (by its name: AUT_Armor / AUT_Red / AUT_Glow), or "".
+static func slot_of(nm: String) -> String:
+	if nm.begins_with("AUT_Armor"):
+		return "armour"
+	if nm.begins_with("AUT_Red"):
+		return "red"
+	if nm.begins_with("AUT_Glow"):
+		return "glow"
+	return ""
+
+
+static func defaults() -> Dictionary:
+	return {"color": [0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 1.0], "metal": 0.0, "rough": 0.6, "emit": 0.0, "emission": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0],
+		"normal": 1.0, "alpha": false, "uv": [1.0, 1.0], "cull": "back"}
+
+
+static func _with_defaults(v: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := defaults()
+	for k in v:
+		out[k] = v[k]
+	return out
+
+
+## The open model's own materials as the "This model" group (`character`: a character's - only
+## what the game keeps of them editable).
+func set_model(mats: Array, character: bool) -> void:
+	for id in entries.keys():
+		if str(id).begins_with("model:"):
+			entries.erase(id)
+	var n := 0
+	for m: Material in mats:
+		n += 1
+		var id := "model:%d" % m.get_instance_id()
+		entries[id] = {"id": id, "name": m.resource_name if m.resource_name != "" else "Material %d" % n, "group": "model",
+			"kind": "character" if character else "standard", "textures": {}, "users": [], "mat": m}
+
+
+## The ids of `group` ("": all) whose name, group, kind or users have every word of `words` - in group order.
+func ids(group := "", words := "") -> Array:
+	var ws := words.to_lower().split(" ", false)
+	var out := []
+	for g in GROUPS:
+		if group != "" and g != group:
+			continue
+		for id in entries:
+			var e: Dictionary = entries[id]
+			if e["group"] != g:
+				continue
+			var hay := ("%s %s %s %s" % [e["name"], GROUP_LABEL[g], e["kind"], " ".join(e.get("users", []))]).to_lower()
+			var ok := true
+			for w in ws:
+				if not hay.contains(w):
+					ok = false
+					break
+			if ok:
+				out.append(id)
+	return out
+
+
+func entry(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return entries.get(id, {})
+
+
+func has(id: String) -> bool:
+	return entries.has(id)
+
+
+## Its settings can be changed here: yours, and the open model's own (a StandardMaterial3D's kind);
+## the built-in looks are kept as they are (duplicate one to change it).
+func is_editable(id: String) -> bool:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	if e.is_empty():
+		return false
+	if e["group"] == "model":
+		return e["mat"] is BaseMaterial3D
+	return e["group"] == "mine"
+
+
+func is_builtin(id: String) -> bool:
+	return str(entry(id).get("group", "")) in ["character", "preset"]
+
+
+## The entry's settings now (a model's material: read from it).
+func values(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	if e.is_empty():
+		return defaults()
+	if e["group"] == "model":
+		return values_of(e["mat"])
+	return (e["values"] as Dictionary).duplicate(true)
+
+
+## The entry's textures: slot -> Texture2D (a model's material: its own).
+func textures(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	var out := {}
+	if e.is_empty():
+		return out
+	if e["group"] == "model":
+		var bm := e["mat"] as BaseMaterial3D
+		if bm:
+			for s in SLOTS:
+				var t = bm.get(SLOTS[s])
+				if t is Texture2D:
+					out[s] = t
+		return out
+	for s in e["textures"]:
+		var t := texture_at(str(e["textures"][s]))
+		if t:
+			out[s] = t
+	return out
+
+
+## A material's settings (values) read from it.
+static func values_of(mat: Material) -> Dictionary:
+	var bm := mat as BaseMaterial3D
+	if bm == null:
+		return defaults()
+	var c := bm.albedo_color
+	var e := bm.emission
+	return {"color": [c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a], "metal": bm.metallic, "rough": bm.roughness,
+		"emit": bm.emission_energy_multiplier if bm.emission_enabled else 0.0, "emission": [e.r, e.g, e.b],
+		"normal": bm.normal_scale, "alpha": bm.transparency != BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_DISABLED,
+		"uv": [bm.uv1_scale.x, bm.uv1_scale.y], "cull": CULLS[clampi(bm.cull_mode, 0, 2)]}
+
+
+## Puts `values` (and `tex`: slot -> res path or Texture2D; null - the textures left as they are)
+## onto `mat`. A character's kind: only colour, metal, roughness and glow (in its own colour).
+static func apply(mat: Material, kind: String, values: Dictionary, tex: Variant = null) -> void:
+	var bm := mat as BaseMaterial3D
+	if bm == null:
+		return
+	var v := _with_defaults(values)
+	var c: Array = v["color"]
+	bm.albedo_color = Color(float(c[0]), float(c[1]), float(c[2]), float(c[3]) if c.size() > 3 and kind != "character" else 1.0)
+	bm.metallic = float(v["metal"])
+	bm.roughness = float(v["rough"])
+	var e := float(v["emit"])
+	bm.emission_energy_multiplier = e
+	if kind == "character":
+		bm.emission = Color(float(c[0]), float(c[1]), float(c[2]))
+		bm.emission_enabled = e > 0.0
+		return
+	var ec: Array = v["emission"]
+	bm.emission = Color(float(ec[0]), float(ec[1]), float(ec[2]))
+	bm.normal_scale = float(v["normal"])
+	bm.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA if bool(v["alpha"]) else BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_DISABLED
+	var uv: Array = v["uv"]
+	bm.uv1_scale = Vector3(float(uv[0]), float(uv[1]), 1.0)
+	bm.cull_mode = maxi(CULLS.find(str(v["cull"])), 0) as BaseMaterial3D.CullMode
+	if tex is Dictionary:
+		for s in SLOTS:
+			var t = tex.get(s)
+			var tx: Texture2D = t if t is Texture2D else (texture_at(str(t)) if t != null and str(t) != "" else null)
+			bm.set(SLOTS[s], tx)
+	bm.normal_enabled = bm.normal_texture != null
+	bm.emission_enabled = e > 0.0 or bm.emission_texture != null
+
+
+## A new material of the entry's (named as it is - a character's table keeps it by that name).
+func make_material(id: String) -> StandardMaterial3D:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+	m.resource_name = str(e.get("name", "Material"))
+	apply(m, str(e.get("kind", "standard")), values(id), e.get("textures", {}))
+	m.set_meta("mat_lib_id", id)
+	return m
+
+
+## The key the entry's picture is kept under: its kind, settings and textures.
+func key_of(id: String) -> String:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	var tex := []
+	var t := textures(id)
+	for s in t:
+		var tx: Texture2D = t[s]
+		tex.append("%s=%s" % [s, tx.resource_path if tx.resource_path != "" else str(tx.get_instance_id())])
+	return "mat|" + JSON.stringify([e.get("kind", ""), values(id), tex], "", true).md5_text()
+
+
+## A ball a metre across (its arrays made once, here; the mesh may be made on a worker).
+static func sphere_arrays() -> Array:
+	if _sphere.is_empty():
+		var s := SphereMesh.new()
+		s.radius = 0.5
+		s.height = 1.0
+		s.radial_segments = 48
+		s.rings = 24
+		_sphere = s.get_mesh_arrays()
+	return _sphere
+
+
+static func sphere_mesh(arrays: Array, mat: Material) -> ArrayMesh:
+	var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+	m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, arrays)
+	m.surface_set_material(0, mat)
+	return m
+
+
+# --- changes -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _new_key(name: String) -> String:
+	var base := name.strip_edges().to_snake_case().validate_filename().replace(" ", "_").replace(":", "_")
+	if base == "":
+		base = "material"
+	var k := base
+	var i := 2
+	while entries.has("mine:" + k) or _mod.has(k):
+		k = "%s_%d" % [base, i]
+		i += 1
+	return k
+
+
+## A new material of yours; its id.
+func add(name: String, kind: String, vals: Dictionary, tex := {}) -> String:
+	var k := _new_key(name)
+	var id := "mine:" + k
+	entries[id] = {"id": id, "name": name.strip_edges(), "group": "mine", "kind": kind, "users": [],
+		"values": _with_defaults(vals.duplicate(true)), "textures": tex.duplicate()}
+	_changed(id)
+	return id
+
+
+## A copy of any entry as one of yours; its id.
+func duplicate_entry(id: String) -> String:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	if e.is_empty():
+		return ""
+	var tex := {}
+	if e["group"] != "model":
+		tex = (e["textures"] as Dictionary).duplicate()
+	return add(str(e["name"]) + " copy", str(e["kind"]), values(id), tex)
+
+
+func rename(id: String, name: String) -> void:
+	if entry(id).get("group", "") != "mine" or name.strip_edges() == "":
+		return
+	entries[id]["name"] = name.strip_edges()
+	_changed(id)
+
+
+func set_values(id: String, vals: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if entry(id).get("group", "") != "mine":
+		return
+	entries[id]["values"] = _with_defaults(vals.duplicate(true))
+	_changed(id)
+
+
+func set_textures(id: String, tex: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if entry(id).get("group", "") != "mine":
+		return
+	entries[id]["textures"] = tex.duplicate()
+	_changed(id)
+
+
+## Removes an entry: yours - gone; a built-in look - only in a mod (its merge file says so).
+## False if it can't be removed here.
+func remove(id: String) -> bool:
+	var e := entry(id)
+	if e.is_empty() or e["group"] == "model":
+		return false
+	if e["group"] != "mine":
+		if not EditTarget.is_mod():
+			return false
+		_mod[id] = {"deleted": true}
+		entries.erase(id)
+		dirty = true
+		return true
+	var k := id.trim_prefix("mine:")
+	entries.erase(id)
+	if EditTarget.is_mod():
+		var base = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(FILE)) if FileAccess.file_exists(FILE) else null
+		if base is Dictionary and (base.get("materials", {}) as Dictionary).has(k):
+			_mod[k] = {"deleted": true}
+		else:
+			_mod.erase(k)
+	dirty = true
+	return true
+
+
+func _changed(id: String) -> void:
+	dirty = true
+	if EditTarget.is_mod() and id.begins_with("mine:"):
+		_mod[id.trim_prefix("mine:")] = _saved(entries[id])
+
+
+static func _saved(e: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"name": e["name"], "kind": e["kind"], "values": e["values"].duplicate(true), "textures": e["textures"].duplicate()}
+
+
+## Where a picture picked for entry `id`'s texture `slot` is kept.
+func texture_path(id: String, slot: String) -> String:
+	var nm := str(entry(id).get("name", "material")).to_snake_case().validate_filename().replace(" ", "_")
+	return TEX_DIR + "%s_%s.png" % [nm, slot]
+
+
+## A picture picked for `res_path` this session (written with save()).
+func keep_picture(res_path: String, img: Image) -> Texture2D:
+	pending[res_path] = img
+	var t := ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+	_tex[res_path] = t
+	return t
+
+
+## Writes the library where EditTarget says (the game's file, or the mod's merge file) - and the
+## pictures picked. OK or an error.
+func save() -> int:
+	if not EditTarget.writable():
+		return ERR_UNAVAILABLE
+	for p in pending:
+		var to := EditTarget.write_path(p)
+		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(to.get_base_dir())
+		(pending[p] as Image).save_png(to)
+	pending.clear()
+	var data := {}
+	if EditTarget.is_mod():
+		data = {"materials": _mod}
+	else:
+		var mine := {}
+		for id in entries:
+			if entries[id]["group"] == "mine":
+				mine[str(id).trim_prefix("mine:")] = _saved(entries[id])
+		data = {"version": 1, "materials": mine}
+	var path := MERGE if EditTarget.is_mod() else FILE
+	var f := FileAccess.open(EditTarget.write_path(path), FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if f == null:
+		return FileAccess.get_open_error()
+	f.store_string(JSON.stringify(data, "\t") + "\n")
+	f.close()
+	dirty = false
+	return OK
+
+
+## The texture at `path` (a picture picked this session, the game's imported one, or the mod's file).
+static func texture_at(path: String) -> Texture2D:
+	if path == "":
+		return null
+	if _tex.has(path):
+		return _tex[path]
+	var p := EditTarget.read_path(path)
+	var t: Texture2D = null
+	if not p.begins_with("user://") and ResourceLoader.exists(p):
+		t = load(p) as Texture2D
+	if t == null and FileAccess.file_exists(p):
+		var img := Image.load_from_file(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(p))
+		if img:
+			img.generate_mipmaps()
+			t = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+	_tex[path] = t
+	return t

@@ -1,0 +1,805 @@ 
+extends Node
+## The mesh editor's materials (a node of the editor, `ed`): the material library and its
