+func set_auto_merge(on: bool) -> void:
+	auto_merge = on
+	if _auto_btn:
+		_auto_btn.set_pressed_no_signal(on)
+	ed._say("Auto merge " + ("on: points moved within %s m of another are welded to it." % _fmt(merge_dist) if on else "off."))
+
+
+static func _fmt(v: float) -> String:
+	return String.num(v, 6).rstrip("0").rstrip(".") if v < 1.0 else String.num(v, 3)
+
+
+## The selection made points `pts` and what they make up (faces in face mode and Auto).
+func _select_points(pts: PackedInt32Array) -> void:
+	ed._resize_sel()
+	var sp: PackedByteArray = ed.sel_p
+	sp.fill(0)
+	for p in pts:
+		sp[p] = 1
+	ed.sel_p = sp
+	ed.sel_e.fill(0)
+	ed.sel_t.fill(0)
+	ed.sel_pa.fill(0)
+	var keep: int = ed.sel_kind
+	ed.sel_kind = 0
+	ed._derive_sel()
+	if keep == 2:
+		ed.sel_kind = 2
+		ed._derive_sel()
+	elif keep == 3:
+		ed.sel_kind = 3
+		ed.sel_e.fill(0)
+		ed.sel_pa.fill(0)
+		ed._derive_sel()
+	ed.sel_kind = keep
+
+
+## The selection after points were renumbered (`map`: old -> new, -1 gone).
+func _remap_selection(map: PackedInt32Array, old: PackedByteArray) -> void:
+	var keep := PackedInt32Array()
+	var seen := {}
+	for p in mini(old.size(), map.size()):
+		if old[p] and map[p] >= 0 and not seen.has(map[p]):
+			seen[map[p]] = true
+			keep.append(map[p])
+	_select_points(keep)
+
+
+## The whole faces the selected points make up.
+func _faces_selected() -> PackedByteArray:
+	var em = ed.em
+	var ts := PackedByteArray()
+	ts.resize(em.tri_count())
+	var sp: PackedByteArray = ed.sel_p
+	for t in em.tri_count():
+		if sp[em.tris[t * 3]] and sp[em.tris[t * 3 + 1]] and sp[em.tris[t * 3 + 2]]:
+			ts[t] = 1
+	if ed.sel_kind == 2:
+		ts = ed.sel_t.duplicate()
+	em.close_to_polys(ts)
+	return ts
+
+
+## Duplicate (Shift+D): the selected faces copied, the copy selected and moved (G). The copy is
+## one undo step, the move another (cancelled, the copy stays where it was made).
+func duplicate_selection() -> void:
+	var em = ed.em
+	if em == null or ed.mode != "edit":
+		return
+	cancel_loopcut()
+	var ts := _faces_selected()
+	if not ts.has(1):
+		ed._say("Duplicate: select whole faces (points and edges alone copy nothing - the mesh is made of faces).")
+		return
+	var before: Dictionary = ed._snap()
+	var top := duplicate_faces(em, ts)
+	_select_points(top)
+	ed._edit_done("Duplicate", before)
+	ed._say("Duplicated %d faces (%d points) - move them, click to keep." % [_count_faces(em, ed.sel_t), top.size()])
+	ed.begin_transform("G")
+
+
+static func _count_faces(em, ts: PackedByteArray) -> int:
+	var f := {}
+	for t in mini(ts.size(), em.tri_count()):
+		if ts[t]:
+			f[em.tri_face[t]] = true
+	return f.size()
+
+
+## Merge by distance (Alt+M): the selected points (none: all) closer than `merge_dist` made one.
+## One undo step; returns how many points went.
+func merge_by_distance(dist := -1.0) -> int:
+	var em = ed.em
+	if em == null:
+		return 0
+	if dist < 0.0:
+		dist = merge_dist
+	var ids: PackedInt32Array = ed.selected_points()
+	var close := close_points(em.points, ids, ids, dist)
+	var n: int = close["removed"]
+	if n == 0:
+		ed._say("Merge by distance: no points closer than %s m%s." % [_fmt(dist), " among the selected" if not ids.is_empty() else ""])
+		return 0
+	var before: Dictionary = ed._snap()
+	var old: PackedByteArray = ed.sel_p.duplicate()
+	var map := weld(em, close)
+	_remap_selection(map, old)
+	ed._edit_done("Merge by distance", before)
+	ed._say("Merge by distance: %d point%s removed (closer than %s m)." % [n, "" if n == 1 else "s", _fmt(dist)])
+	return n
+
+
+## Auto merge, as a transform `x` ends (mesh_editor.confirm_transform, before its undo step):
+## the points it moved welded to any point within `merge_dist`. How many went.
+func after_transform(x: Dictionary) -> int:
+	if not auto_merge or ed.em == null:
+		return 0
+	var em = ed.em
+	var moved: PackedInt32Array = x.get("all", x.get("ids", PackedInt32Array()))
+	if moved.is_empty():
+		return 0
+	var fixed := PackedByteArray()
+	fixed.resize(em.points.size())
+	fixed.fill(1)
+	for p in moved:
+		fixed[p] = 0
+	var close := close_points(em.points, moved, PackedInt32Array(range(em.points.size())), merge_dist, fixed)
+	var n: int = close["removed"]
+	if n == 0:
+		return 0
+	var old: PackedByteArray = ed.sel_p.duplicate()
+	var map := weld(em, close)
+	_remap_selection(map, old)
+	ed._say("Auto merge: %d point%s welded." % [n, "" if n == 1 else "s"])
+	return n
+
+
+## The size of a screen pixel at `at` (global), in the part's own units.
+func _px_local(at: Vector3) -> float:
+	var view = ed.view
+	var px := 0.0
+	if view.cam.projection == Camera3D.PROJECTION_ORTHOGONAL:
+		px = view.cam.size / maxf(view.size.y, 1.0)
+	else:
+		px = 2.0 * view.cam.global_position.distance_to(at) * tan(deg_to_rad(view.cam.fov * 0.5)) / maxf(view.size.y, 1.0)
+	var sc: Vector3 = ed.part.global_transform.basis.get_scale()
+	return px / maxf((sc.x + sc.y + sc.z) / 3.0, 0.0001)
+
+
+# --- inset (I) ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Inset (I): the selected faces inset as a region - the ring made at once, its width then set by
+## the mouse (towards the selection's middle: wider) or typed (digits and a point; Backspace).
+## Click / Enter keeps it (one undo step with the new faces), right-click / Esc cancels it all.
+func begin_inset() -> void:
+	var em = ed.em
+	if em == null or ed.mode != "edit":
+		return
+	cancel_loopcut()
+	ed._cancel_xf()
+	var ts := _faces_selected()
+	if not ts.has(1):
+		ed._say("Inset: select faces first (3: face mode).")
+		return
+	var before: Dictionary = ed._snap()
+	var r := inset_region(em, ts)
+	if r.is_empty():
+		em.restore(before)
+		ed._say("Inset: the selected faces have no border to inset from (a closed region).")
+		return
+	_select_points(r["inner"])
+	var all := PackedInt32Array(r["ids"])
+	all.append_array(r["ring"])
+	var x := {"kind": "INS", "name": "Inset", "snap": before, "m0": ed._mouse, "axis": -1, "dir": Vector3.ZERO,
+		"pivot": ed.part.global_transform * em.centroid(r["inner"]), "ids": r["ids"], "orig": r["orig"], "dirs": r["dirs"],
+		"all": PackedInt32Array(r["ids"]), "verts": em.verts_of(_all_of(r)), "typed": "", "step": _inset_step, "on_cancel": _undo_cancel}
+	ed.xf = x
+	ed._mesh_changed()
+	ed._xf_update()
+
+
+static func _all_of(r: Dictionary) -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var out := PackedInt32Array(r["inner"])
+	out.append_array(r["ring"])
+	return out
+
+
+## The inset's width now: typed, else by the mouse.
+func inset_amount() -> float:
+	var x: Dictionary = ed.xf
+	if str(x.get("typed", "")) != "":
+		return maxf(0.0, str(x["typed"]).to_float())
+	if x.has("amount"):
+		return float(x["amount"])
+	var pivot: Vector3 = x["pivot"]
+	var ps: Vector2 = ed.view.project(pivot)
+	var m0: Vector2 = x["m0"]
+	var d0 := (m0 - ps).length()
+	var mouse: Vector2 = ed._mouse
+	var d1 := (mouse - ps).length()
+	var px := (d0 - d1) if d0 > 40.0 else (mouse - m0).length()   # (begun near the middle: as far as it's moved)
+	return maxf(0.0, px) * _px_local(pivot)
+
+
+func _inset_step() -> void:
+	var em = ed.em
+	var x: Dictionary = ed.xf
+	var a := inset_amount()
+	var ids: PackedInt32Array = x["ids"]
+	var orig: PackedVector3Array = x["orig"]
+	var dirs: PackedVector3Array = x["dirs"]
+	var pts: PackedVector3Array = em.points
+	for k in ids.size():
+		pts[ids[k]] = orig[k] + dirs[k] * a
+	em.points = pts
+	em.sync(x["verts"])
+	ed._refill = true
+	ed._sync_sel_coords()
+	var typed := str(x.get("typed", ""))
+	ed.view.hint = "Inset  %s m%s   (mouse towards the middle: wider · type a width · click / Enter: done · right-click / Esc: cancel)" % [_fmt(a), "  [" + typed + "]" if typed != "" else ""]
+	ed.view.request()
+
+
+## A transform that changed the topology cancelled: the mesh and the selection as before it.
+func _undo_cancel(x: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var snap: Dictionary = x["snap"]
+	ed.em.restore(snap)
+	ed.sel_p = (snap["sel_p"] as PackedByteArray).duplicate()
+	ed.sel_e = (snap["sel_e"] as PackedByteArray).duplicate()
+	ed.sel_t = (snap["sel_t"] as PackedByteArray).duplicate()
+	ed.sel_pa = (snap["sel_pa"] as PackedByteArray).duplicate()
+	ed._resize_sel()
+	ed._refill = false
+	ed._mesh_changed()
+
+
+## Keys while a tool of these runs (mesh_editor's key handling asks first): true if taken.
+func key(k: InputEventKey) -> bool:
+	if cutting and k.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE:
+		cancel_loopcut()
+		ed._say("Loop cut stopped.")
+		return true
+	var x: Dictionary = ed.xf
+	if x.get("kind", "") != "INS" or k.ctrl_pressed:
+		return false
+	var typed := str(x.get("typed", ""))
+	var kc := k.keycode
+	if kc >= KEY_0 and kc <= KEY_9:
+		typed += str(kc - KEY_0)
+	elif kc >= KEY_KP_0 and kc <= KEY_KP_9:
+		typed += str(kc - KEY_KP_0)
+	elif (kc == KEY_PERIOD or kc == KEY_KP_PERIOD or kc == KEY_COMMA) and not typed.contains("."):
+		typed += "."
+	elif kc == KEY_BACKSPACE:
+		typed = typed.substr(0, maxi(0, typed.length() - 1))
+	else:
+		return false
+	x["typed"] = typed
+	ed._xf_update()
+	return true
+
+
+# --- loop cut (Ctrl+R) ----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Loop cut (Ctrl+R): from now the ring across the edge under the mouse is shown; a click cuts.
+func begin_loopcut() -> void:
+	if ed.em == null or ed.mode != "edit":
+		return
+	ed._cancel_xf()
+	ed.knife_cancel()
+	cutting = true
+	_ring = {}
+	ed._say("Loop cut: point at an edge - the ring of quads across it shows; click to cut (right-click / Esc: stop).")
+	loopcut_hover(ed._mouse)
+
+
+func cancel_loopcut() -> void:
+	if not cutting:
+		return
+	cutting = false
+	_ring = {}
+	_show_ring({})
+
+
+## The shown edge nearest `at` on the face under it: [a, b] (its points) or [].
+func _edge_at(at: Vector2) -> Array:
+	var em = ed.em
+	var t: int = ed._pick_tri(at)
+	if t < 0:
+		return []
+	var loop: PackedInt32Array = em.poly_loop(t)
+	if loop.is_empty():
+		loop = em.tris.slice(t * 3, t * 3 + 3)
+	var best := []
+	var bd := INF
+	for k in loop.size():
+		var a: int = loop[k]
+		var b: int = loop[(k + 1) % loop.size()]
+		var d := Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(at, ed._screen(a), ed._screen(b)).distance_to(at)
+		if d < bd:
+			bd = d
+			best = [a, b]
+	return best
+
+
+## The rings a cut across edge a -> b makes: its own, and with symmetry on its mirror twins'.
+func _rings(a: int, b: int) -> Array:
+	var em = ed.em
+	var out := [ring(em, a, b)]
+	var taken := {}
+	for s in out[0]["sides"]:
+		taken[em.edge(s[0], s[1])] = true
+	for ax in 3:
+		if not ed.sym[ax]:
+			continue
+		var mm: PackedInt32Array = em.mirror_map(ax)
+		var ta := mm[a] if a < mm.size() else -1
+		var tb := mm[b] if b < mm.size() else -1
+		if ta < 0 or tb < 0 or em.edge(ta, tb) < 0 or taken.has(em.edge(ta, tb)):
+			continue
+		var r2 := ring(em, ta, tb)
+		if (r2["quads"] as PackedInt32Array).is_empty():
+			continue
+		for s in r2["sides"]:
+			taken[em.edge(s[0], s[1])] = true
+		out.append(r2)
+	return out
+
+
+func loopcut_hover(at: Vector2) -> void:
+	if not cutting or ed.em == null:
+		return
+	var ab := _edge_at(at)
+	if ab.is_empty():
+		_ring = {}
+		_show_ring({})
+		return
+	var key := "%d-%d" % [mini(ab[0], ab[1]), maxi(ab[0], ab[1])]
+	if _ring.get("key", "") == key:
+		return
+	var rs := _rings(ab[0], ab[1])
+	_ring = {"key": key, "a": ab[0], "b": ab[1], "rings": rs}
+	_show_ring(_ring)
+
+
+## The ring's new loop drawn (the knife's line, diamonds where it crosses the edges).
+func _show_ring(r: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var view = ed.view
+	var pts := PackedVector3Array()
+	var kinds := PackedInt32Array()
+	if not r.is_empty() and (r["rings"][0]["quads"] as PackedInt32Array).size() > 0:
+		var g: Transform3D = ed.part.global_transform
+		var rr: Dictionary = r["rings"][0]
+		for s in rr["sides"]:
+			pts.append(g * (ed.em.points[s[0]] as Vector3).lerp(ed.em.points[s[1]], 0.5))
+			kinds.append(1)
+		if rr["closed"] and not pts.is_empty():
+			pts.append(pts[0])
+			kinds.append(1)
+	view.knife_on = not pts.is_empty()
+	view.knife_pts = pts
+	view.knife_kinds = kinds
+	view.knife_next = Vector3.INF
+	view.knife_mouse = Vector2(-1, -1)
+	view.knife_through = false
+	view.queue_redraw()
+
+
+## The cut made through the ring under `at` (or the one shown), then slid by the mouse.
+## True if it cut.
+func loopcut_click(at: Vector2) -> bool:
+	loopcut_hover(at)
+	if _ring.is_empty() or (_ring["rings"][0]["quads"] as PackedInt32Array).is_empty():
+		ed._say("Loop cut: point at an edge with quads beside it.")
+		return false
+	return cut_loop(_ring["a"], _ring["b"])
+
+
+## A new edge loop across edge a -> b (and its mirror twins with symmetry on), then the slide
+## begins (xf "SLIDE"). True if it cut.
+func cut_loop(a: int, b: int, slide := true) -> bool:
+	var em = ed.em
+	var rs := _rings(a, b)
+	var chains := []
+	var sides := []
+	for r in rs:
+		if (r["quads"] as PackedInt32Array).is_empty():
+			continue
+		chains.append(ring_chain(em, r, 0.5))
+		for s in r["sides"]:
+			sides.append([em.points[s[0]], em.points[s[1]]])
+	if chains.is_empty():
+		ed._say("Loop cut: no quads across that edge.")
+		return false
+	var a0: Vector3 = em.points[a]
+	var b0: Vector3 = em.points[b]
+	var before: Dictionary = ed._snap()
+	var res: Dictionary = em.knife_apply(chains)
+	cancel_loopcut()
+	if not res["ok"]:
+		em.restore(before)
+		ed._say("Loop cut: %s - nothing cut." % res["why"])
+		return false
+	# each new point: the side it's on (by where it is - halfway along it)
+	var news: PackedInt32Array = res["points"]
+	var ids := PackedInt32Array()
+	var ends_a := PackedVector3Array()
+	var ends_b := PackedVector3Array()
+	var grid := {}
+	for p in news:
+		grid[_cell(em.points[p])] = p
+	for s in sides:
+		var mid: Vector3 = (s[0] as Vector3).lerp(s[1], 0.5)
+		var p := _near(em, grid, mid, news)
+		if p >= 0 and not ids.has(p):
+			ids.append(p)
+			ends_a.append(s[0])
+			ends_b.append(s[1])
+	ed._resize_sel()
+	ed.sel_p.fill(0)
+	ed.sel_e.fill(0)
+	ed.sel_t.fill(0)
+	ed.sel_pa.fill(0)
+	var se: PackedByteArray = ed.sel_e
+	var cut: PackedInt32Array = res["cut"]
+	for i in range(0, cut.size(), 2):
+		var e: int = em.edge(cut[i], cut[i + 1])
+		if e >= 0:
+			se[e] = 1
+	ed.sel_e = se
+	var keep: int = ed.sel_kind
+	ed.sel_kind = 1
+	ed._derive_sel()
+	ed.sel_kind = keep if keep != 2 else 1
+	var x := {"kind": "SLIDE", "name": "Loop cut", "snap": before, "m0": ed._mouse, "axis": -1, "dir": Vector3.ZERO,
+		"pivot": ed.part.global_transform * em.centroid(ids), "ids": ids, "a": ends_a, "b": ends_b, "all": ids,
+		"verts": em.verts_of(ids), "f": 0.5, "sa": a0, "sb": b0, "step": _slide_step, "on_cancel": _slide_cancel}
+	ed._mesh_changed()
+	if not slide:
+		ed._edit_done("Loop cut", before)
+		ed._update_ui()
+		return true
+	ed.xf = x
+	ed._xf_update()
+	ed._say("Loop cut: %d new points - slide it along with the mouse, click to keep (right-click / Esc: in the middle)." % ids.size())
+	return true
+
+
+static func _cell(p: Vector3) -> Vector3i:
+	return Vector3i((p * 1e5).round())
+
+
+static func _near(em, grid: Dictionary, at: Vector3, news: PackedInt32Array) -> int:
+	var c := _cell(at)
+	if grid.has(c):
+		return grid[c]
+	var best := -1
+	var bd := INF
+	for p in news:
+		var d: float = (em.points[p] as Vector3).distance_squared_to(at)
+		if d < bd:
+			bd = d
+			best = p
+	return best
+
+
+## Where along the sides the new loop is (0: the a side, 1: the b side): by the mouse along the
+## edge first pointed at, or `xf["fixed"]`.
+func slide_amount() -> float:
+	var x: Dictionary = ed.xf
+	if x.has("fixed"):
+		return float(x["fixed"])
+	var g: Transform3D = ed.part.global_transform
+	var sa: Vector2 = ed.view.project(g * (x["sa"] as Vector3))
+	var sb: Vector2 = ed.view.project(g * (x["sb"] as Vector3))
+	var d := sb - sa
+	if d.length() < 4.0:
+		return 0.5
+	var m0: Vector2 = x["m0"]
+	return clampf(0.5 + (ed._mouse - m0).dot(d) / d.length_squared(), 0.0, 1.0)
+
+
+func _slide_step() -> void:
+	var x: Dictionary = ed.xf
+	var f := slide_amount()
+	_place_slide(x, f)
+	ed._refill = true
+	ed._sync_sel_coords()
+	ed.view.hint = "Loop cut  %d%%   (mouse along the edge: slide · click / Enter: done · right-click / Esc: in the middle)" % roundi(f * 100.0)
+	ed.view.request()
+
+
+func _place_slide(x: Dictionary, f: float) -> void:
+	var em = ed.em
+	var ids: PackedInt32Array = x["ids"]
+	var a: PackedVector3Array = x["a"]
+	var b: PackedVector3Array = x["b"]
+	var pts: PackedVector3Array = em.points
+	for k in ids.size():
+		pts[ids[k]] = a[k].lerp(b[k], clampf(f, 0.0, 1.0))
+	em.points = pts
+	em.sync(x["verts"])
+
+
+## The slide cancelled: the loop kept, in the middle (one undo step).
+func _slide_cancel(x: Dictionary) -> void:
+	_place_slide(x, 0.5)
+	ed.em.recalc_normals(x["verts"])
+	ed._refill = false
+	ed._edit_done("Loop cut", x["snap"])
+	ed._update_ui()
+
+
+## The view's mouse (mesh_editor._view_input asks first): the loop cut's hover and click, Alt+click's
+## loop. True if taken.
+func view_input(e: InputEvent) -> bool:
+	if ed.em == null or ed.mode != "edit":
+		return false
+	var mm := e as InputEventMouseMotion
+	if mm:
+		if cutting and ed._drag == "":
+			loopcut_hover(mm.position)
+		return false
+	var mb := e as InputEventMouseButton
+	if mb == null:
+		return false
+	if cutting:
+		if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and not mb.alt_pressed:
+			if mb.pressed:
+				ed._mouse = mb.position
+				loopcut_click(mb.position)
+			return true
+		if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_RIGHT:
+			if mb.pressed:
+				cancel_loopcut()
+				ed._say("Loop cut stopped.")
+			return true
+		return false
+	if mb.button_index == MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT and ed.xf.is_empty() and ed.knife.is_empty():
+		if mb.pressed and mb.alt_pressed:
+			_alt_at = mb.position
+		elif not mb.pressed and _alt_at.x >= 0.0:
+			var near := mb.position.distance_to(_alt_at) <= 5.0
+			_alt_at = Vector2(-1, -1)
+			if near:
+				select_loop_at(mb.position, mb.shift_pressed)
+	return false
+
+
+# --- select loop / ring -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Alt+click at `at`: the loop through the edge nearest the mouse (edge mode, Auto: the edges;
+## vertex mode: their points) - in face mode the ring of quads across it. `add`: kept with what's
+## selected.
+func select_loop_at(at: Vector2, add := false) -> bool:
+	var em = ed.em
+	var ab := _edge_at(at)
+	if ab.is_empty():
+		return false
+	var e: int = em.edge(ab[0], ab[1])
+	if e < 0:
+		return false
+	if ed.sel_kind == 2:
+		_select_ring_faces(ab[0], ab[1], add)
+	else:
+		_select_edges(edge_loop(em, e), add)
+	return true
+
+
+## The edges `es` selected (vertex mode: their points), with their mirror twins.
+func _select_edges(es: PackedInt32Array, add: bool) -> void:
+	var em = ed.em
+	if not add:
+		ed.sel_p.fill(0)
+		ed.sel_e.fill(0)
+		ed.sel_t.fill(0)
+		ed.sel_pa.fill(0)
+	if ed.sel_kind == 0:
+		var sp: PackedByteArray = ed.sel_p
+		for e in es:
+			sp[em.edges[e * 2]] = 1
+			sp[em.edges[e * 2 + 1]] = 1
+		ed.sel_p = sp
+		for e in es:
+			ed._twins(0, em.edges[e * 2], 1)
+			ed._twins(0, em.edges[e * 2 + 1], 1)
+	else:
+		var se: PackedByteArray = ed.sel_e
+		for e in es:
+			se[e] = 1
+		ed.sel_e = se
+		for e in es:
+			ed._twins(1, e, 1)
+	ed._derive_sel()
+	ed._overlays()
+
+
+func _select_ring_faces(a: int, b: int, add: bool) -> void:
+	var em = ed.em
+	if not add:
+		ed.sel_p.fill(0)
+		ed.sel_e.fill(0)
+		ed.sel_t.fill(0)
+		ed.sel_pa.fill(0)
+	var r := ring(em, a, b)
+	for t in r["quads"]:
+		ed._set_poly(t, 1)
+	ed._derive_sel()
+	ed._overlays()
+
+
+## The selected edges (any mode) as [edges].
+func _sel_edges() -> PackedInt32Array:
+	var out := PackedInt32Array()
+	var se: PackedByteArray = ed.sel_e
+	for e in mini(se.size(), ed.em.edge_count()):
+		if se[e] and _shown(ed.em, e):
+			out.append(e)
+	return out
+
+
+## Select loop: each selected edge's loop added. How many edges are selected afterwards.
+func select_loops() -> int:
+	return _extend(edge_loop)
+
+
+## Select ring: each selected edge's ring added.
+func select_rings() -> int:
+	return _extend(edge_ring)
+
+
+func _extend(of: Callable) -> int:
+	var em = ed.em
+	if em == null:
+		return 0
+	var es := _sel_edges()
+	if es.is_empty():
+		ed._say("Select an edge first (2: edge mode), or Alt+click one.")
+		return 0
+	var all := {}
+	for e in es:
+		for e2 in of.call(em, e):
+			all[e2] = true
+	var keep: int = ed.sel_kind
+	if keep == 2:
+		ed.sel_kind = 1   # (a face's edges extended: shown as edges)
+	_select_edges(PackedInt32Array(all.keys()), true)
+	ed._update_ui()
+	return all.size()

files.explanation: Previews as 24-frame turntables, drawn once in the background a frame a tick, kept on disk; read back on a worker.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,255 @@ 
+extends Node
+## The mesh editor's previews (its models; the shape library's shapes): each thing drawn
+## as a TURNTABLE - FRAMES pictures of it turned round, in one strip - once, in the
+## background, kept on disk (user://cache/mesh_thumbs/, by its key: a file's path and
+## time, a shape's recipe) and in memory. One at a time: the thing read or made on a
+## worker, then one frame of it drawn each tick into a small lit world - never more than
+## a few milliseconds in a frame. A list shows frame 0; hovered, it turns (frames()).
+
+signal made(key: String, tex: Texture2D)
+
+const SIZE := 128
+const FRAMES := 24
+const DIR := "user://cache/mesh_thumbs/"
+const VERSION := 2
+
+var _mem := {}            # key -> Array of AtlasTexture (the turntable)
+var _queue: Array = []    # [key, Callable -> Node3D or Mesh (on a worker), disk file]
+var _busy := ""           # the key being made
+var _busy_disk := ""
+var _task := -1
+var _read: Array = []
+var _vp: SubViewport
+var _cam: Camera3D
+var _model: Node3D
+var _pivot: Node3D
+var _strip: Image
+var _frame := 0
+var _wait := 0
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(DIR)
+	_vp = SubViewport.new()
+	_vp.size = Vector2i(SIZE, SIZE)
+	_vp.own_world_3d = true
+	_vp.transparent_bg = true
+	_vp.msaa_3d = Viewport.MSAA_4X
+	_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED
+	add_child(_vp)
+	var env := Environment.new()
+	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_CLEAR_COLOR
+	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
+	env.ambient_light_color = Color(0.55, 0.58, 0.65)
+	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.9
+	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_FILMIC
+	var we := WorldEnvironment.new()
+	we.environment = env
+	_vp.add_child(we)
+	var key := DirectionalLight3D.new()
+	key.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-40, 35, 0)
+	key.light_energy = 1.6
+	_vp.add_child(key)
+	var rim := DirectionalLight3D.new()
+	rim.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-20, 200, 0)
+	rim.light_energy = 0.7
+	rim.light_color = Color(0.7, 0.8, 1.0)
+	_vp.add_child(rim)
+	_cam = Camera3D.new()
+	_cam.fov = 35.0
+	_vp.add_child(_cam)
+	_pivot = Node3D.new()
+	_vp.add_child(_pivot)
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	if _task >= 0:
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+	if _read_task >= 0:
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_read_task)
+		_read_task = -1
+
+
+## Frame 0 of `key`'s turntable if it's made (else null - ask() for it). `file`: a model's file.
+func get_thumb(key: String, file := "") -> Texture2D:
+	var f := frames(key, file)
+	return f[0] if not f.is_empty() else null
+
+
+## `key`'s turntable (FRAMES pictures), or [] - not in memory yet: one made before is read from
+## disk in the background (made() when it's in - a list of a hundred previews opens at once).
+func frames(key: String, file := "") -> Array:
+	if _mem.has(key):
+		return _mem[key]
+	if not _reading.has(key):
+		var disk := _disk(key, file)
+		if FileAccess.file_exists(disk):
+			_reading[key] = disk
+			_read_queue.append(key)
+	return []
+
+
+var _reading := {}        # key -> its disk file (being read, or waiting to be)
+var _read_queue: Array = []
+var _read_task := -1
+var _read_out: Array = []   # [[key, Image]...] (the worker's)
+var _read_done: Array = []  # read, waiting to become textures
+
+
+## The disk reads: a few at a time on a worker; their textures made here as they come in.
+func _pump_reads() -> void:
+	if _read_task >= 0:
+		if not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_read_task):
+			return
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_read_task)
+		_read_task = -1
+		_read_done.append_array(_read_out)
+		_read_out = []
+	# (two a frame made into textures: a batch at once was a 40 ms frame)
+	for i in mini(2, _read_done.size()):
+		var e: Array = _read_done.pop_front()
+		var key: String = e[0]
+		_reading.erase(key)
+		var img: Image = e[1]
+		if img and img.get_width() == SIZE * FRAMES:
+			_mem[key] = _cut(ImageTexture.create_from_image(img))
+			made.emit(key, _mem[key][0])
+	if _read_queue.is_empty() or _read_task >= 0 or _read_done.size() > 8:
+		return
+	var batch: Array = []
+	while not _read_queue.is_empty() and batch.size() < 8:
+		var k: String = _read_queue.pop_front()
+		batch.append([k, _reading[k]])
+	_read_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func():
+		var out := []
+		for b in batch:
+			out.append([b[0], Image.load_from_file(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(b[1]))])
+		_read_out = out, false, "mesh editor: previews from disk")
+
+
+func _cut(strip: Texture2D) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for i in FRAMES:
+		var a := AtlasTexture.new()
+		a.atlas = strip
+		a.region = Rect2(i * SIZE, 0, SIZE, SIZE)
+		out.append(a)
+	return out
+
+
+## A model file's turntable to be made, in turn (made() when it is).
+func ask(path: String, file: String) -> void:
+	var MeshIO: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/mesh_io.gd")
+	_enqueue(path, func(): return MeshIO.read(file), _disk(path, file))
+
+
+## Something made by `maker` (on a worker: a Node3D or a Mesh) - a shape - under `key`.
+func ask_mesh(key: String, maker: Callable) -> void:
+	_enqueue(key, maker, _disk(key, ""))
+
+
+func _enqueue(key: String, maker: Callable, disk: String) -> void:
+	if _mem.has(key) or _reading.has(key) or key == _busy or DisplayServer.get_name() == "headless":
+		return   # (in memory, on its way from disk, or being drawn)
+	for q in _queue:
+		if q[0] == key:
+			return
+	_queue.append([key, maker, disk])
+
+
+## Forget the queue (the list changed): only what's asked again is made.
+func clear_queue() -> void:
+	_queue.clear()
+
+
+func _disk(key: String, file: String) -> String:
+	var t := FileAccess.get_modified_time(file) if file != "" and FileAccess.file_exists(file) else 0
+	return DIR + ("%d|%s|%d" % [VERSION, key, t]).md5_text() + ".png"
+
+
+func _process(_dt: float) -> void:
+	_pump_reads()
+	if _busy == "":
+		if _queue.is_empty():
+			return
+		var q: Array = _queue.pop_front()
+		_busy = q[0]
+		_busy_disk = q[2]
+		var maker: Callable = q[1]
+		_read = []
+		_task = WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func(): _read = [maker.call()], false, "mesh editor: a preview")
+		return
+	if _task >= 0:
+		if not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(_task):
+			return
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(_task)
+		_task = -1
+		var n = _read[0] if not _read.is_empty() else null
+		if n is Mesh:
+			var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+			mi.mesh = n
+			n = mi
+		if not n is Node3D:
+			if n is Node:
+				n.free()
+			_busy = ""
+			return
+		_model = n
+		_pivot.rotation = Vector3.ZERO
+		_pivot.add_child(_model)
+		_aim()
+		_strip = Image.create_empty(SIZE * FRAMES, SIZE, false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+		_frame = 0
+		_shoot()
+		return
+	_wait -= 1
+	if _wait > 0:
+		return
+	var img := _vp.get_texture().get_image()
+	if img and not img.is_empty():
+		img.convert(Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+		_strip.blit_rect(img, Rect2i(0, 0, SIZE, SIZE), Vector2i(_frame * SIZE, 0))
+	_frame += 1
+	if _frame < FRAMES:
+		_shoot()
+		return
+	var key := _busy
+	_model.queue_free()
+	_model = null
+	_busy = ""
+	_strip.save_png(_busy_disk)
+	_mem[key] = _cut(ImageTexture.create_from_image(_strip))
+	_strip = null
+	made.emit(key, _mem[key][0])
+
+
+## The next frame: the thing turned on, drawn once.
+func _shoot() -> void:
+	_pivot.rotation.y = TAU * float(_frame) / FRAMES
+	_vp.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+	_wait = 2
+
+
+## The camera framing the thing (centred on the turntable's axis): from the front,
+## a little above, far enough for it to stay in view all the way round.
+func _aim() -> void:
+	var box := AABB()
+	var first := true
+	for v in _model.find_children("*", "VisualInstance3D", true, false) + ([_model] if _model is VisualInstance3D else []):
+		var vi := v as VisualInstance3D
+		var b: AABB = vi.global_transform * vi.get_aabb() if vi.is_inside_tree() else vi.get_aabb()
+		box = b if first else box.merge(b)
+		first = false
+	if first:
+		box = AABB(Vector3(-1, -1, -1), Vector3(2, 2, 2))
+	var c := box.get_center()
+	_model.position -= Vector3(c.x, 0, c.z)   # (turning about its own middle)
+	var r := maxf(Vector2(box.size.x, box.size.z).length() * 0.5, box.size.y * 0.5)
+	r = maxf(Vector3(r, box.size.y * 0.5, r).length() * 0.8, 0.05)
+	var dir := Vector3(0.0, 0.32, 1.0).normalized()
+	var dist := r / sin(deg_to_rad(_cam.fov * 0.5)) * 1.02
+	var look := Vector3(0, c.y, 0)
+	_cam.look_at_from_position(look + dir * dist, look, Vector3.UP)
+	_cam.near = maxf(dist * 0.01, 0.001)
+	_cam.far = dist * 4.0

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,788 @@ 
+extends SubViewportContainer
+## The mesh editor's 3D view: a world of its own (a studio sky, a key, fill and
+## rim light, so physically based materials look as they will in the game), a
+## floor grid with the X (red) and Z (blue) axes, an orbiting camera, and the
+## edit-mode overlays - the wireframe, the points, the selected edges and
+## faces - each one mesh (lines / points / triangles) refilled from the edit
+## mesh's arrays, never a node a vertex. Drawn on top in 2D: the box being
+## dragged, the proportional-editing circle and the transform's hint.
+## Renders only when something changed (request()): an idle editor costs no GPU.
+
+const OVERLAY_SHADER := """
+shader_type spatial;
+render_mode unshaded, cull_disabled, depth_draw_never, shadows_disabled, fog_disabled;
+uniform vec4 tint : source_color = vec4(1.0);
+uniform float bias = 0.0015;
+uniform float psize = 7.0;
+uniform bool use_vc = false;
+void vertex() {
+	// Lifted towards the camera, over the surface: in view space - in perspective along its
+	// own ray (the same spot on screen, a little nearer), in an orthographic view straight
+	// forward - `bias` a share of its distance (perspective) or metres x 100 (orthographic).
+	vec4 v = MODELVIEW_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0);
+	if (PROJECTION_MATRIX[3][3] == 0.0) {
+		v.xyz *= 1.0 - bias * 4.0;
+	} else {
+		v.z += bias * 10.0;
+	}
+	POSITION = PROJECTION_MATRIX * v;
+	//POINTS
+}
+void fragment() {
+	vec4 c = use_vc ? COLOR * tint : tint;
+	ALBEDO = c.rgb;
+	ALPHA = c.a;
+}
+"""
+const SEL := Color(1.0, 0.42, 0.0)   # (the selection: a strong, saturated orange)
+const WIRE := Color(0.06, 0.07, 0.1, 0.9)   # (dark lines over the model; their pale x-ray beneath)
+const POINT := Color(0.08, 0.08, 0.1)
+
+var sv: SubViewport
+var cam: Camera3D
+var world: Node3D             # what's edited goes in here
+var target := Vector3(0, 0.9, 0)
+var yaw := 0.6
+var pitch := -0.35
+var dist := 4.0
+var ortho := false
+## 2D overlay: the box being dragged (size 0: none), the influence circle (radius 0: none), a hint.
+var box := Rect2()
+var circle_at := Vector2.ZERO
+var circle_r := 0.0
+var hint := ""
+
+var wire_mi: MeshInstance3D
+var pts_mi: MeshInstance3D
+var sel_edges_mi: MeshInstance3D
+var sel_faces_mi: MeshInstance3D
+var _shader: Shader
+var _xray: Shader
+var _points_shader: Shader
+var wire_back_mi: MeshInstance3D
+var wire_all_mi: MeshInstance3D
+var sel_pts_mi: MeshInstance3D
+var _sel_through: Array = []
+var _key: DirectionalLight3D
+var _off := false
+## Edit mode shows every triangle's edges (true), or the faces' (n-gons: their diagonals left out).
+var show_tris := false
+## The knife's cut being drawn (mesh_editor.gd fills it): its points (global), how each
+## snapped (0 a point, 1 an edge, 2 the face), the spot under the mouse it would take
+## next (Vector3.INF: none - then `knife_mouse`), and whether it cuts right through.
+var knife_on := false
+var knife_pts := PackedVector3Array()
+var knife_kinds := PackedInt32Array()
+var knife_next := Vector3.INF
+var knife_next_kind := 2
+var knife_mouse := Vector2(-1, -1)
+var knife_through := false
+const KNIFE := Color(0.35, 1.0, 0.8)
+## Auto select: what a click would pick, drawn faintly (-1: nothing; 0 a point, 1 an edge,
+## 2 a face - its triangles' corners, three by three), global.
+var pre_kind := -1
+var pre_pts := PackedVector3Array()
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	stretch = true
+	mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_CLICK
+	sv = SubViewport.new()
+	sv.own_world_3d = true
+	sv.world_3d = World3D.new()
+	sv.msaa_3d = Viewport.MSAA_4X
+	sv.positional_shadow_atlas_size = 0
+	sv.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+	add_child(sv)
+	sv.size_changed.connect(request)
+	_build_world()
+
+
+func _build_world() -> void:
+	var env := Environment.new()
+	var sky := Sky.new()
+	var sm := ProceduralSkyMaterial.new()
+	sm.sky_top_color = Color(0.16, 0.18, 0.24)
+	sm.sky_horizon_color = Color(0.42, 0.40, 0.38)
+	sm.ground_bottom_color = Color(0.05, 0.05, 0.06)
+	sm.ground_horizon_color = Color(0.3, 0.28, 0.26)
+	sm.sun_angle_max = 30.0
+	sky.sky_material = sm
+	sky.radiance_size = Sky.RADIANCE_SIZE_128
+	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
+	env.background_color = Color(0.075, 0.08, 0.1)
+	env.sky = sky
+	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_SKY
+	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.7
+	env.reflected_light_source = Environment.REFLECTION_SOURCE_SKY
+	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_AGX
+	env.glow_enabled = true
+	env.glow_intensity = 0.5
+	env.glow_hdr_threshold = 1.2
+	var we := WorldEnvironment.new()
+	we.environment = env
+	sv.add_child(we)
+	_key = DirectionalLight3D.new()
+	_key.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-48, -35, 0)
+	_key.light_energy = 1.6
+	_key.light_color = Color(1.0, 0.95, 0.88)
+	_key.shadow_enabled = true
+	_key.directional_shadow_mode = DirectionalLight3D.SHADOW_ORTHOGONAL
+	_key.directional_shadow_max_distance = 30.0
+	sv.add_child(_key)
+	var fill := DirectionalLight3D.new()
+	fill.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-20, 140, 0)
+	fill.light_energy = 0.45
+	fill.light_color = Color(0.75, 0.85, 1.0)
+	sv.add_child(fill)
+	var rim := DirectionalLight3D.new()
+	rim.rotation_degrees = Vector3(-10, 200, 0)
+	rim.light_energy = 0.6
+	sv.add_child(rim)
+	cam = Camera3D.new()
+	cam.near = 0.01
+	cam.far = 500.0
+	cam.fov = 40.0
+	sv.add_child(cam)
+	world = Node3D.new()
+	world.name = "World"
+	sv.add_child(world)
+	_shader = Shader.new()
+	_shader.code = OVERLAY_SHADER
+	# (the points' own: a point size set draws lines and triangles as dots at their corners)
+	_points_shader = Shader.new()
+	_points_shader.code = OVERLAY_SHADER.replace("//POINTS", "POINT_SIZE = psize;")
+	sv.add_child(_grid())
+	# The hovered area's wireframe on top of the surface (lifted well clear of it), and again
+	# faintly through it (its edges behind a bulge still show).
+	wire_all_mi = _overlay(Color(WIRE, 0.6), 0.005, false, 1)   # (the whole wireframe, faint: always, in edit mode)
+	wire_mi = _overlay(WIRE, 0.006, true, 2)   # (its vertex colours: the hovered area fading out)
+	_xray = Shader.new()
+	_xray.code = OVERLAY_SHADER.replace("depth_draw_never,", "depth_draw_never, depth_test_disabled,")
+	wire_back_mi = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	wire_back_mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	wire_back_mi.mesh = wire_mi.mesh
+	var xm := material(Color(0.9, 0.95, 1.0, 0.22), 0.0, true)
+	xm.shader = _xray
+	xm.render_priority = 0
+	wire_back_mi.material_override = xm
+	wire_back_mi.visible = false
+	sv.add_child(wire_back_mi)
+	sel_edges_mi = _overlay(SEL, 0.007, false, 2)
+	sel_faces_mi = _overlay(Color(SEL, 0.55), 0.003, false, 0)
+	# (the selection seen through the model too, fainter: what's selected behind a bulge)
+	for src in [[sel_edges_mi, 0.5], [sel_faces_mi, 0.18]]:
+		var through := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		through.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+		through.mesh = (src[0] as MeshInstance3D).mesh
+		var tm := material(Color(SEL, src[1]), 0.0, false)
+		tm.shader = _xray
+		through.material_override = tm
+		through.visible = false
+		sv.add_child(through)
+		_sel_through.append(through)
+	pts_mi = _overlay(Color.WHITE, 0.008, true, 3)
+	(pts_mi.material_override as ShaderMaterial).shader = _points_shader
+	(pts_mi.material_override as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("psize", 3.5)   # (the points: small dots)
+	sel_pts_mi = _overlay(SEL, 0.009, false, 4)   # (the selected points: bigger, on top)
+	(sel_pts_mi.material_override as ShaderMaterial).shader = _points_shader
+	(sel_pts_mi.material_override as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter("psize", 7.0)
+	update_camera()
+
+
+func _overlay(tint: Color, bias: float, vc: bool, prio: int) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	mi.mesh = ArrayMesh.new()
+	var m := material(tint, bias, vc)
+	m.render_priority = prio
+	mi.material_override = m
+	mi.visible = false
+	sv.add_child(mi)
+	return mi
+
+
+func material(tint: Color, bias := 0.0, vc := false) -> ShaderMaterial:
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	m.shader = _shader
+	m.set_shader_parameter("tint", tint)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("bias", bias)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("use_vc", vc)
+	return m
+
+
+func _grid() -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var v := PackedVector3Array()
+	var c := PackedColorArray()
+	var n := 20
+	var step := 0.5
+	for i in range(-n, n + 1):
+		var x := i * step
+		var col := Color(1, 1, 1, 0.16 if i % 2 == 0 else 0.07)
+		if i == 0:
+			v.append_array([Vector3(-n * step, 0, 0), Vector3(n * step, 0, 0)])
+			c.append_array([Color(0.95, 0.3, 0.3, 0.8), Color(0.95, 0.3, 0.3, 0.8)])   # X
+			v.append_array([Vector3(0, 0, -n * step), Vector3(0, 0, n * step)])
+			c.append_array([Color(0.3, 0.5, 1.0, 0.8), Color(0.3, 0.5, 1.0, 0.8)])     # Z
+			continue
+		v.append_array([Vector3(x, 0, -n * step), Vector3(x, 0, n * step), Vector3(-n * step, 0, x), Vector3(n * step, 0, x)])
+		c.append_array([col, col, col, col])
+	# the Y axis, short
+	v.append_array([Vector3.ZERO, Vector3(0, 0.6, 0)])
+	c.append_array([Color(0.4, 0.9, 0.4, 0.8), Color(0.4, 0.9, 0.4, 0.8)])
+	var a := []
+	a.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+	a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = v
+	a[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = c
+	var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+	m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_LINES, a)
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.name = "Grid"
+	mi.mesh = m
+	mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	mi.material_override = material(Color.WHITE, 0.0, true)
+	return mi
+
+
+## Draw a frame (the scene changed).
+func request() -> void:
+	if not _off and sv:
+		sv.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+## Rendering off while Talos shows another tool (the host parks it off screen).
+func set_off(off: bool) -> void:
+	_off = off
+	sv.render_target_update_mode = SubViewport.UPDATE_DISABLED if off else SubViewport.UPDATE_ONCE
+
+
+# --- the camera -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func update_camera() -> void:
+	pitch = clampf(pitch, -1.55, 1.55)
+	dist = clampf(dist, 0.05, 300.0)
+	var b := Basis.from_euler(Vector3(pitch, yaw, 0))
+	cam.transform = Transform3D(b, target + b.z * dist)
+	cam.projection = Camera3D.PROJECTION_ORTHOGONAL if ortho else Camera3D.PROJECTION_PERSPECTIVE
+	cam.size = dist * 0.75
+	cam.near = maxf(0.005, dist * 0.005) if not ortho else 0.01
+	cam.far = maxf(100.0, dist * 50.0)
+	if ortho:
+		cam.transform.origin = target + b.z * maxf(dist, 50.0)
+	request()
+
+
+## The view turned by a mouse drag `rel`: about its target, or - `pivot` given - about that
+## point (edit mode: the selection), which stays where it is on screen while the camera
+## goes round it.
+func orbit(rel: Vector2, pivot := Vector3.INF) -> void:
+	var b0 := Basis.from_euler(Vector3(pitch, yaw, 0))
+	yaw -= rel.x * 0.008
+	pitch = clampf(pitch - rel.y * 0.008, -1.55, 1.55)
+	if pivot == Vector3.INF:
+		update_camera()
+		return
+	var b1 := Basis.from_euler(Vector3(pitch, yaw, 0))
+	var r := b1 * b0.inverse()
+	var c0 := target + b0.z * dist   # (the camera, as update_camera places it)
+	var c1 := pivot + r * (c0 - pivot)
+	target = c1 - b1.z * dist   # (the target kept on the view's axis, as far as it was)
+	update_camera()
+
+
+func pan(rel: Vector2) -> void:
+	var s := dist * 0.0016 * (40.0 / maxf(10.0, cam.fov)) * (720.0 / maxf(200.0, size.y))
+	target += (-cam.global_basis.x * rel.x + cam.global_basis.y * rel.y) * s
+	update_camera()
+
+
+## Zoomed by `f` (under 1: in) - towards `at` (a point in the world: what's under the mouse), which
+## stays where it is on screen; Vector3.INF: towards the view's centre.
+func zoom(f: float, at := Vector3.INF) -> void:
+	if at != Vector3.INF:
+		target = at + (target - at) * f   # (the camera and its target scaled about the point: it holds still on screen)
+	dist *= f
+	update_camera()
+
+
+## Front (looking along -Z), side (along -X), top; `back` the opposite.
+func set_view(which: String, back := false) -> void:
+	match which:
+		"front": yaw = PI if back else 0.0; pitch = 0.0
+		"side": yaw = -PI / 2 if back else PI / 2; pitch = 0.0
+		"top": yaw = 0.0; pitch = PI / 2 if back else -PI / 2
+	update_camera()
+
+
+## The camera framing `box` (world space).
+func frame(box3: AABB) -> void:
+	if box3.size == Vector3.ZERO and box3.position == Vector3.ZERO:
+		return
+	target = box3.get_center()
+	var r := maxf(0.05, box3.size.length() * 0.5)
+	dist = r / tan(deg_to_rad(cam.fov * 0.5)) * 1.15
+	update_camera()
+
+
+func ray(at: Vector2) -> Array:
+	return [cam.project_ray_origin(at), cam.project_ray_normal(at)]
+
+
+func project(p: Vector3) -> Vector2:
+	return cam.unproject_position(p)
+
+
+func behind(p: Vector3) -> bool:
+	return cam.is_position_behind(p)
+
+
+## Where the mouse ray meets the plane through `at` facing the camera.
+## Where the ray under `at` meets the plane through `through` with normal `n` (null: it doesn't -
+## the plane seen edge-on).
+func on_plane(at: Vector2, through: Vector3, n: Vector3) -> Variant:
+	var r := ray(at)
+	return Plane(n.normalized(), through).intersects_ray(r[0], r[1])
+
+
+func on_view_plane(at: Vector2, through: Vector3) -> Vector3:
+	var r := ray(at)
+	var pl := Plane(cam.global_basis.z, through)
+	var hit = pl.intersects_ray(r[0], r[1])
+	return hit if hit != null else through
+
+
+## The point of the line `origin + t * dir` nearest the mouse ray.
+func on_line(at: Vector2, origin: Vector3, dir: Vector3) -> Vector3:
+	var r := ray(at)
+	var p: Vector3 = r[0]
+	var d: Vector3 = r[1]
+	var w := origin - p
+	var a := dir.dot(dir)
+	var b := dir.dot(d)
+	var c := d.dot(d)
+	var dd := dir.dot(w)
+	var e := d.dot(w)
+	var den := a * c - b * b
+	if absf(den) < 1e-9:
+		return origin
+	var t := (b * e - c * dd) / den
+	return origin + dir * t
+
+
+# --- the overlays -----------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## Fills the edit-mode overlays (`em`: the edit mesh; `xf`: the part's
+## transform; `kind`: 0 vertex / 1 edge / 2 face; the selection flags). Only the
+## area under the mouse shows its wireframe and points: those within `radius` of
+## `focus` (the part's own space; Vector3.INF - none), reached from `seeds` (the
+## hovered triangle's points) along the edges, fading out towards the edge of it.
+## The selection shows whole, wherever it is.
+## `full`: the whole faint wireframe made again too (the mesh changed; not for a hover).
+func show_overlays(em, xf: Transform3D, kind: int, sel_p: PackedByteArray, sel_e: PackedByteArray, sel_t: PackedByteArray,
+		focus := Vector3.INF, radius := 0.0, seeds := PackedInt32Array(), full := true) -> void:
+	for mi in [wire_all_mi, wire_mi, wire_back_mi, pts_mi, sel_edges_mi, sel_faces_mi, sel_pts_mi] + _sel_through:
+		mi.visible = em != null
+		mi.global_transform = xf
+	if em != null and (full or wire_all_mi.mesh.get_surface_count() == 0):
+		_lines(wire_all_mi.mesh, em.points, em.wire_edges(show_tris))
+	if em == null:
+		for mi in [wire_all_mi, wire_mi, pts_mi, sel_edges_mi, sel_faces_mi, sel_pts_mi]:
+			_surface(mi.mesh, Mesh.PRIMITIVE_LINES, PackedVector3Array(), PackedInt32Array())
+		request()
+		return
+	var n: int = em.points.size()
+	# The hovered area: each point's strength (0 - outside).
+	var near := PackedFloat32Array()
+	near.resize(n)
+	var area := PackedInt32Array()
+	if focus != Vector3.INF and radius > 0.0:
+		var seen := {}
+		var stack: Array = Array(seeds)
+		while not stack.is_empty() and area.size() < 20000:
+			var p: int = stack.pop_back()
+			if seen.has(p) or p < 0 or p >= n:
+				continue
+			seen[p] = true
+			var d: float = (em.points[p] as Vector3).distance_to(focus)
+			if d > radius:
+				continue
+			var k := 1.0 - d / radius
+			near[p] = k * k * (3.0 - 2.0 * k)   # (smooth towards the rim)
+			area.append(p)
+			for j in range(em.adj_start[p], em.adj_start[p + 1]):
+				stack.append(em.adj[j])
+	var wire := PackedInt32Array()
+	var wc := PackedColorArray()
+	wc.resize(n)
+	wc.fill(Color(1, 1, 1, 0))
+	if not area.is_empty():
+		for p in area:
+			wc[p] = Color(1, 1, 1, near[p])
+		var faces: bool = not show_tris and em.poly_count() < em.tri_count()
+		for p in area:
+			for j in range(em.adj_start[p], em.adj_start[p + 1]):
+				var q: int = em.adj[j]
+				if q > p and near[q] > 0.0:
+					if faces and em.edge_inner[em.edge(p, q)]:
+						continue   # (a diagonal inside a face)
+					wire.append(p)
+					wire.append(q)
+	_surface(wire_mi.mesh, Mesh.PRIMITIVE_LINES, em.points, wire, wc)
+	# the selected edges (edge mode: those picked; else those between selected points)
+	var se := PackedInt32Array()
+	var inner: PackedByteArray = em.edge_inner if not show_tris else PackedByteArray()
+	if kind == 1 or kind == 3:
+		for e in mini(sel_e.size(), em.edge_count()):
+			if sel_e[e] and (inner.is_empty() or not inner[e]):
+				se.append(em.edges[e * 2]); se.append(em.edges[e * 2 + 1])
+	elif kind == 0:
+		for e in em.edge_count():
+			if sel_p[em.edges[e * 2]] and sel_p[em.edges[e * 2 + 1]] and (inner.is_empty() or not inner[e]):
+				se.append(em.edges[e * 2]); se.append(em.edges[e * 2 + 1])
+	_lines(sel_edges_mi.mesh, em.points, se)
+	var st := PackedInt32Array()
+	for t in sel_t.size():
+		if sel_t[t]:
+			st.append(em.tris[t * 3]); st.append(em.tris[t * 3 + 1]); st.append(em.tris[t * 3 + 2])
+	_surface(sel_faces_mi.mesh, Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, em.points, st)
+	# The points: the hovered area's (vertex mode) and every selected one.
+	var pi := PackedInt32Array()
+	var c := PackedColorArray()
+	c.resize(n)
+	c.fill(Color(POINT, 0.0))
+	if kind == 0 or kind == 3:
+		for p in area:
+			pi.append(p)
+			c[p] = Color(POINT, near[p])
+	for p in sel_p.size():
+		if sel_p[p]:
+			if near[p] <= 0.0 or (kind != 0 and kind != 3):
+				pi.append(p)
+			c[p] = SEL
+	pts_mi.visible = not pi.is_empty()
+	_surface(pts_mi.mesh, Mesh.PRIMITIVE_POINTS, em.points if not pi.is_empty() else PackedVector3Array(), pi, c)
+	var sp := PackedInt32Array()
+	for p in sel_p.size():
+		if sel_p[p]:
+			sp.append(p)
+	sel_pts_mi.visible = not sp.is_empty()
+	_surface(sel_pts_mi.mesh, Mesh.PRIMITIVE_POINTS, em.points if not sp.is_empty() else PackedVector3Array(), sp)
+	request()
+
+
+## Only the positions changed (a transform being dragged): the overlays follow
+## (same indices, same colours).
+func move_overlays(em) -> void:
+	for m in _arrays:
+		var e: Array = _arrays[m]
+		var a: Array = e[1]
+		a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = em.points
+		(m as ArrayMesh).clear_surfaces()
+		(m as ArrayMesh).add_surface_from_arrays(e[0], a)
+	request()
+
+
+## Each overlay mesh's arrays (kept: refilling them doesn't read the GPU's copy back).
+var _arrays := {}
+
+func _lines(m: ArrayMesh, pts: PackedVector3Array, idx: PackedInt32Array) -> void:
+	_surface(m, Mesh.PRIMITIVE_LINES, pts, idx)
+
+
+func _surface(m: ArrayMesh, prim: int, pts: PackedVector3Array, idx: PackedInt32Array, col := PackedColorArray()) -> void:
+	m.clear_surfaces()
+	_arrays.erase(m)
+	if (idx.is_empty() and prim != Mesh.PRIMITIVE_POINTS) or pts.is_empty():
+		return
+	var a := []
+	a.resize(Mesh.ARRAY_MAX)
+	a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] = pts
+	if not idx.is_empty():
+		a[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX] = idx
+	if not col.is_empty():
+		a[Mesh.ARRAY_COLOR] = col
+	m.add_surface_from_arrays(prim, a)
+	_arrays[m] = [prim, a]
+
+
+# --- 2D, on top -------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+# --- the gizmo: move, turn and scale the selection with the mouse ------------------------
+
+## Where the gizmo stands (global; Vector3.INF - none) and the handle under the mouse.
+var gizmo_at := Vector3.INF
+var gizmo_hot := ""
+## The gizmo's axes (global, its columns X / Y / Z): the world's, the part's own (object mode),
+## or the selection's own (edit mode: along its surface, across it, its normal).
+var gizmo_basis := Basis()
+const GIZMO_PX := 90.0
+const AXES := [Vector3.RIGHT, Vector3.UP, Vector3.BACK]
+const AXIS_COL := [Color(0.95, 0.35, 0.35), Color(0.45, 0.9, 0.45), Color(0.4, 0.6, 1.0)]
+
+
+## The gizmo's handles on screen: [{id, kind ("G" move / "R" turn / "S" scale), axis
+## (Vector3.ZERO: free), pts (a polyline on screen), col, w}] - in the order they're picked.
+func gizmo_handles() -> Array:
+	if gizmo_at == Vector3.INF or cam == null or behind(gizmo_at):
+		return []
+	var c := project(gizmo_at)
+	var d := cam.global_position.distance_to(gizmo_at)
+	var wpp := (cam.size if cam.projection == Camera3D.PROJECTION_ORTHOGONAL else 2.0 * d * tan(deg_to_rad(cam.fov * 0.5))) / maxf(size.y, 1.0)
+	var L := GIZMO_PX * wpp
+	var out: Array = []
+	for a in 3:
+		var ax: Vector3 = gizmo_basis[a].normalized()
+		var s0 := project(gizmo_at + ax * L * 0.62)
+		var q := 5.0
+		out.append({"id": "s" + "xyz"[a], "kind": "S", "axis": ax, "col": AXIS_COL[a], "w": 0.0,
+			"pts": PackedVector2Array([s0 + Vector2(-q, -q), s0 + Vector2(q, -q), s0 + Vector2(q, q), s0 + Vector2(-q, q), s0 + Vector2(-q, -q)]), "box": true})
+	for a in 3:
+		var ax: Vector3 = gizmo_basis[a].normalized()
+		out.append({"id": "m" + "xyz"[a], "kind": "G", "axis": ax, "col": AXIS_COL[a], "w": 3.0,
+			"pts": PackedVector2Array([c, project(gizmo_at + ax * L)]), "arrow": true})
+	for a in 3:
+		var ax: Vector3 = gizmo_basis[a].normalized()
+		var u: Vector3 = gizmo_basis[(a + 1) % 3].normalized()
+		var v: Vector3 = gizmo_basis[(a + 2) % 3].normalized()
+		var ring := PackedVector2Array()
+		for i in 49:
+			var t := TAU * i / 48.0
+			ring.append(project(gizmo_at + (u * cos(t) + v * sin(t)) * L * 0.85))
+		out.append({"id": "r" + "xyz"[a], "kind": "R", "axis": ax, "col": AXIS_COL[a], "w": 2.0, "pts": ring})
+	var outer := PackedVector2Array()
+	for i in 49:
+		outer.append(c + Vector2(cos(TAU * i / 48.0), sin(TAU * i / 48.0)) * GIZMO_PX * 1.12)
+	out.append({"id": "s", "kind": "S", "axis": Vector3.ZERO, "col": Color(1, 1, 1, 0.7), "w": 1.5, "pts": outer})
+	var dot := PackedVector2Array()
+	for i in 17:
+		dot.append(c + Vector2(cos(TAU * i / 16.0), sin(TAU * i / 16.0)) * 7.0)
+	out.append({"id": "m", "kind": "G", "axis": Vector3.ZERO, "col": Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9), "w": 2.0, "pts": dot, "fill": true})
+	return out
+
+
+## The handle under screen point `at` (within a few pixels), or {}.
+func gizmo_pick(at: Vector2) -> Dictionary:
+	var best := {}
+	var bd := 9.0
+	for h in gizmo_handles():
+		var pts: PackedVector2Array = h["pts"]
+		var d := INF
+		if h.get("box", false) or h.get("fill", false):
+			var r := Rect2(pts[0], Vector2.ZERO)
+			for q in pts:
+				r = r.expand(q)
+			d = 0.0 if r.grow(3.0).has_point(at) else INF
+		else:
+			for i in pts.size() - 1:
+				d = minf(d, at.distance_to(Geometry2D.get_closest_point_to_segment(at, pts[i], pts[i + 1])))
+		if d < bd:
+			bd = d
+			best = h
+	return best
+
+
+func _draw_gizmo() -> void:
+	for h in gizmo_handles():
+		var pts: PackedVector2Array = h["pts"]
+		var col: Color = h["col"]
+		if h["id"] == gizmo_hot:
+			col = Color(1.0, 0.9, 0.35)
+		if h.get("box", false):
+			draw_colored_polygon(pts.slice(0, 4), col)
+			draw_polyline(pts, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 1.0, true)
+		elif h.get("fill", false):
+			draw_colored_polygon(pts, Color(col, 0.35))
+			draw_polyline(pts, col, h["w"], true)
+		else:
+			draw_polyline(pts, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.45), float(h["w"]) + 2.0, true)
+			draw_polyline(pts, col, h["w"], true)
+			if h.get("arrow", false):
+				var a: Vector2 = pts[0]
+				var b: Vector2 = pts[1]
+				var dv := (b - a).normalized()
+				var n := Vector2(-dv.y, dv.x)
+				draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([b + dv * 10.0, b + n * 5.0, b - n * 5.0]), col)
+
+
+## The knife's cut: the points placed so far joined up, a line on from the last to where the
+## mouse would put the next, each point marked by how it snapped (a square on a point, a
+## diamond on an edge, a dot on a face).
+func _draw_knife() -> void:
+	if not knife_on or cam == null:
+		return
+	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+	for p in knife_pts:
+		if not behind(p):
+			pts.append(project(p))
+	var nxt := Vector2(-1, -1)
+	if knife_next != Vector3.INF and not behind(knife_next):
+		nxt = project(knife_next)
+	elif knife_mouse.x >= 0.0:
+		nxt = knife_mouse
+	if pts.size() > 1:
+		draw_polyline(pts, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 4.0, true)
+		draw_polyline(pts, KNIFE, 2.0, true)
+	if not pts.is_empty() and nxt.x >= 0.0:
+		var a := pts[pts.size() - 1]
+		var l := a.distance_to(nxt)
+		var d := (nxt - a) / maxf(l, 1.0)
+		var s := 0.0
+		while s < l:   # (dashed: not cut yet)
+			var e := minf(s + 8.0, l)
+			draw_line(a + d * s, a + d * e, Color(KNIFE, 0.85), 1.5, true)
+			s += 13.0
+	var marks := Array(pts)
+	var kinds := Array(knife_kinds)
+	if nxt.x >= 0.0:
+		marks.append(nxt)
+		kinds.append(knife_next_kind if knife_next != Vector3.INF else 2)
+	for i in marks.size():
+		var c: Vector2 = marks[i]
+		var k: int = kinds[i] if i < kinds.size() else 2
+		var col := KNIFE if i < pts.size() else Color(1, 1, 1, 0.9)
+		if knife_through:
+			draw_line(c + Vector2(-6, 0), c + Vector2(6, 0), col, 2.0)
+			draw_line(c + Vector2(0, -6), c + Vector2(0, 6), col, 2.0)
+		elif k == 0:
+			draw_rect(Rect2(c - Vector2(4.5, 4.5), Vector2(9, 9)), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
+			draw_rect(Rect2(c - Vector2(3.5, 3.5), Vector2(7, 7)), col)
+		elif k == 1:
+			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(0, -6), c + Vector2(6, 0), c + Vector2(0, 6), c + Vector2(-6, 0)]), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
+			draw_colored_polygon(PackedVector2Array([c + Vector2(0, -4.5), c + Vector2(4.5, 0), c + Vector2(0, 4.5), c + Vector2(-4.5, 0)]), col)
+		else:
+			draw_circle(c, 4.5, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
+			draw_circle(c, 3.2, col)
+
+
+func _draw_pre() -> void:
+	if pre_kind < 0 or cam == null:
+		return
+	var q := PackedVector2Array()
+	for p in pre_pts:
+		if behind(p):
+			return
+		q.append(project(p))
+	var col := Color(SEL, 0.4)
+	match pre_kind:
+		0:
+			draw_circle(q[0], 6.0, col)
+		1:
+			draw_line(q[0], q[1], col, 5.0, true)
+		2:
+			for i in range(0, q.size() - 2, 3):
+				draw_primitive(PackedVector2Array([q[i], q[i + 1], q[i + 2]]), PackedColorArray([Color(SEL, 0.25), Color(SEL, 0.25), Color(SEL, 0.25)]), PackedVector2Array())
+
+
+## The model's stats, drawn in the view's top-left corner (MeshEditor.show_stats).
+var stats := ""
+
+
+func _draw_stats() -> void:
+	if stats == "":
+		return
+	var f := get_theme_default_font()
+	var fs := maxi(Settings.MIN_FONT, 13)
+	var y := 84.0
+	for line in stats.split("\n"):
+		draw_string_outline(f, Vector2(14, y), line, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, 4, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.7))
+		draw_string(f, Vector2(14, y), line, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.8, 0.9))
+		y += fs + 4
+
+
+## The axis a transform is locked to, drawn through what it moves: {at (global), dir, col} - {} none.
+var axis_line := {}
+
+
+func _draw_axis_line() -> void:
+	if axis_line.is_empty() or cam == null:
+		return
+	var at: Vector3 = axis_line["at"]
+	var d: Vector3 = (axis_line["dir"] as Vector3).normalized()
+	var col: Color = axis_line["col"]
+	var reach := maxf(cam.global_position.distance_to(at), 1.0) * 4.0
+	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+	var n := 64
+	for i in n + 1:   # (sampled: the part of the line behind the camera left out)
+		var w := at + d * lerpf(-reach, reach, float(i) / n)
+		if behind(w):
+			if pts.size() >= 2:
+				draw_polyline(pts, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 4.0, true)
+				draw_polyline(pts, col, 2.0, true)
+			pts = PackedVector2Array()
+			continue
+		pts.append(project(w))
+	if pts.size() >= 2:
+		draw_polyline(pts, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 4.0, true)
+		draw_polyline(pts, col, 2.0, true)
+	if not behind(at):
+		draw_circle(project(at), 4.0, col)
+
+
+## Curve deform's curve (mesh_editor.gd / deform_tools.gd fill it): its 4 control points (global:
+## an end, its handle, the other handle, the other end) - empty: none; the one hovered or dragged.
+var curve_pts := PackedVector3Array()
+var curve_hot := -1
+const CURVE := Color(0.4, 0.9, 1.0)
+
+
+func _draw_curve() -> void:
+	if curve_pts.size() != 4 or cam == null:
+		return
+	var cp := curve_pts
+	var pts := PackedVector2Array()
+	for i in 49:
+		var t := i / 48.0
+		var u := 1.0 - t
+		var w := cp[0] * (u * u * u) + cp[1] * (3.0 * u * u * t) + cp[2] * (3.0 * u * t * t) + cp[3] * (t * t * t)
+		if behind(w):
+			continue
+		pts.append(project(w))
+	if pts.size() >= 2:
+		draw_polyline(pts, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.55), 4.5, true)
+		draw_polyline(pts, CURVE, 2.0, true)
+	for h in [[0, 1], [3, 2]]:   # (each end's handle: a dashed line out to it, a round knob)
+		if behind(cp[h[0]]) or behind(cp[h[1]]):
+			continue
+		var a := project(cp[h[0]])
+		var b := project(cp[h[1]])
+		draw_dashed_line(a, b, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.75), 1.5, 5.0)
+		var hot: bool = curve_hot == h[1]
+		draw_circle(b, 7.0 if hot else 5.5, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
+		draw_circle(b, 5.5 if hot else 4.0, SEL if hot else Color(1, 1, 1))
+	for e in [0, 3]:   # (the ends: squares)
+		if behind(cp[e]):
+			continue
+		var c := project(cp[e])
+		var r := 7.0 if curve_hot == e else 5.5
+		draw_rect(Rect2(c - Vector2(r + 1.5, r + 1.5), Vector2(r + 1.5, r + 1.5) * 2.0), Color(0, 0, 0, 0.6))
+		draw_rect(Rect2(c - Vector2(r, r), Vector2(r, r) * 2.0), SEL if curve_hot == e else CURVE)
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	_draw_stats()
+	_draw_axis_line()
+	_draw_curve()
+	_draw_pre()
+	_draw_gizmo()
+	_draw_knife()
+	if box.size != Vector2.ZERO:
+		var r := box.abs()
+		draw_rect(r, Color(SEL, 0.12))
+		draw_rect(r, SEL, false, 1.0)
+	if circle_r > 0.0:
+		draw_arc(circle_at, circle_r, 0, TAU, 72, Color(1, 1, 1, 0.75), 1.5, true)
+		draw_arc(circle_at, circle_r + 1.5, 0, TAU, 72, Color(0, 0, 0, 0.5), 1.0, true)
+	if hint != "":
+		var f := get_theme_default_font()
+		var fs := maxi(Settings.MIN_FONT, 15)
+		draw_string(f, Vector2(14, size.y - 16), hint, HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, fs, Color(1.0, 0.92, 0.8))
+	# the axes, in the corner
+	var o := Vector2(46, 46)
+	var b := cam.global_basis.inverse() if cam else Basis()
+	for ax in [[Vector3.RIGHT, Color(0.95, 0.35, 0.35), "X"], [Vector3.UP, Color(0.45, 0.9, 0.45), "Y"], [Vector3.BACK, Color(0.4, 0.6, 1.0), "Z"]]:
+		var d: Vector3 = b * (ax[0] as Vector3)
+		var e := o + Vector2(d.x, -d.y) * 30.0
+		draw_line(o, e, ax[1], 2.0, true)
+		draw_string(get_theme_default_font(), e + Vector2(-4, 5), ax[2], HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_LEFT, -1, Settings.MIN_FONT, ax[1])

@@ -1,0 +1,415 @@ 
+extends Node
+## The mesh editor's reference images (a node of the editor, `ed`): pictures from anywhere on
+## disk (png / jpg / webp) shown in the 3D view to model from - each lined up with a view (front,
+## side, top - upright in it, centred on the origin) or on a free plane in the scene, behind the
+## model or over it (see-through), with its opacity, size, offset and visibility. The REFERENCE
+## IMAGES panel (build_right) adds, picks, changes and removes them; they're kept per model (by its
+## path) in user://mesh_ref_images.json and come back when the model's opened again.
+## Cheap to draw: each one quad (a shared 1 x 1 mesh, scaled) with an unshaded material - behind
+## (a view's): pushed to the far plane in its vertex shader, not writing depth (the model, the grid
+## and the overlays all draw over it); over: no depth test, drawn before the edit overlays; a view's
+## image fades out as the camera turns away from that view. Pictures are read on a worker.
+
+const FILE := "user://mesh_ref_images.json"
+const VIEWS := ["front", "side", "top", "free"]
+const VIEW_NAMES := ["Front", "Side", "Top", "Free plane"]
+const SHADER := """
+shader_type spatial;
+render_mode unshaded, cull_disabled, depth_draw_never, shadows_disabled, fog_disabled/*NODEPTH*/;
+uniform sampler2D tex : source_color, filter_linear_mipmap, repeat_disable;
+uniform float opacity = 1.0;
+uniform bool far = false;
+uniform bool fade = true;
+void vertex() {
+	// (POSITION written in any branch: Godot leaves it to us in all - so always set)
+	POSITION = PROJECTION_MATRIX * (MODELVIEW_MATRIX * vec4(VERTEX, 1.0));
+	if (far) {   // (at the far plane: behind everything drawn)
+		POSITION.z = POSITION.w * 0.000001;
+	}
+}
+void fragment() {
+	vec4 c = texture(tex, UV);
+	float a = c.a * opacity;
+	if (fade) {   // (a view's picture: only while that view is looked along)
+		a *= smoothstep(0.45, 0.8, abs(dot(normalize(NORMAL), VIEW)));
+	}
+	ALBEDO = c.rgb;
+	ALPHA = a;
+}
+"""
+
+static var _shaders := {}   # depth tested (false) / not (true) -> Shader
+static var _quad: QuadMesh
+
+var ed: Control
+## The open model's images: {file, view, layer ("back" / "front"), opacity, height (m), x, y, z,
+## turn, tilt (degrees - a free plane's), shown} - and while open "_mi" (its quad), "_tex", "_aspect".
+var images: Array = []
+var _key := ""
+var _root: Node3D
+var _tasks: Array = []      # [task id, [Image], entry]
+var _save_due := false
+var _sel := -1
+# the panel
+var _list: ItemList
+var _fields := {}
+var _detail: Control
+var _eye: Button
+var _remove: Button
+
+
+func setup(editor: Control) -> void:
+	ed = editor
+	name = "RefImages"
+	set_process(false)
+
+
+func _exit_tree() -> void:
+	for t in _tasks:
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(t[0])
+	_tasks.clear()
+	if _save_due:
+		_save_now()
+
+
+# --- the model's images -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func _key_of(path: String) -> String:
+	return path if path != "" else "(new model)"
+
+
+## A model was opened (or made new): its images back.
+func model_opened(path: String) -> void:
+	if _save_due:
+		_save_now()
+	for e in images:
+		_drop(e)
+	images = []
+	_key = _key_of(path)
+	_sel = -1
+	var all := _read_all()
+	for d in all.get(_key, []):
+		if d is Dictionary and str(d.get("file", "")) != "":
+			var e := _defaults(str(d["file"]))
+			for k in e:
+				if d.has(k):
+					e[k] = d[k]
+			images.append(e)
+			_load(e)
+	_fill_list()
+
+
+static func _defaults(file: String) -> Dictionary:
+	return {"file": file, "view": "front", "layer": "back", "opacity": 0.8, "height": 2.0, "x": 0.0, "y": 1.0, "z": 0.0,
+		"turn": 0.0, "tilt": 0.0, "shown": true}
+
+
+## Adds the picture at `file` (any path on disk) - lined up with the front view, behind the model.
+## Its index.
+func add_file(file: String) -> int:
+	var e := _defaults(file)
+	images.append(e)
+	_load(e)
+	_sel = images.size() - 1
+	_fill_list()
+	_save_soon()
+	return _sel
+
+
+func remove(i: int) -> void:
+	if i < 0 or i >= images.size():
+		return
+	_drop(images[i])
+	images.remove_at(i)
+	_sel = mini(_sel, images.size() - 1)
+	_fill_list()
+	_save_soon()
+	_request()
+
+
+## Image `i`'s `key` set to `value` (one of the saved keys), shown at once.
+func set_value(i: int, key: String, value) -> void:
+	if i < 0 or i >= images.size():
+		return
+	var e: Dictionary = images[i]
+	e[key] = value
+	_place(e)
+	_save_soon()
+	if key in ["shown", "view", "layer"]:
+		_fill_list()
+
+
+## The quad showing image `i` (null: its picture's not read yet, or couldn't be).
+func quad_of(i: int) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	return images[i].get("_mi") if i >= 0 and i < images.size() else null
+
+
+## Pictures still being read.
+func busy() -> bool:
+	return not _tasks.is_empty()
+
+
+func _load(e: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var holder := [null]
+	var f: String = e["file"]
+	var id := WorkerThreadPool.add_task(func():
+		var img: Image = null
+		if FileAccess.file_exists(f):
+			img = Image.load_from_file(f)
+		if img and not img.is_empty():
+			if img.is_compressed():
+				img.decompress()
+			img.generate_mipmaps()
+			holder[0] = img, false, "Reference image")
+	_tasks.append([id, holder, e])
+	set_process(true)
+
+
+func _process(_dt: float) -> void:
+	var left := []
+	for t in _tasks:
+		if not WorkerThreadPool.is_task_completed(t[0]):
+			left.append(t)
+			continue
+		WorkerThreadPool.wait_for_task_completion(t[0])
+		var e: Dictionary = t[2]
+		if not images.has(e):
+			continue   # (removed, or another model opened)
+		var img: Image = t[1][0]
+		if img == null:
+			ed._say("Couldn't read the reference image %s." % str(e["file"]))
+			continue
+		e["_tex"] = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+		e["_aspect"] = float(img.get_width()) / maxf(1.0, img.get_height())
+		_place(e)
+	_tasks = left
+	if _tasks.is_empty():
+		set_process(false)
+
+
+static func _shader(no_depth: bool) -> Shader:
+	if not _shaders.has(no_depth):
+		var s := Shader.new()
+		s.code = SHADER.replace("/*NODEPTH*/", ", depth_test_disabled" if no_depth else "")
+		_shaders[no_depth] = s
+	return _shaders[no_depth]
+
+
+## Image `e`'s quad made (once) and put where its values say.
+func _place(e: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if not e.has("_tex") or ed.view == null:
+		return
+	if _root == null or not is_instance_valid(_root):
+		_root = Node3D.new()
+		_root.name = "ReferenceImages"
+		ed.view.sv.add_child(_root)
+	if _quad == null:
+		_quad = QuadMesh.new()
+	var mi: MeshInstance3D = e.get("_mi")
+	if mi == null:
+		mi = MeshInstance3D.new()
+		mi.mesh = _quad
+		mi.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+		mi.material_override = ShaderMaterial.new()
+		_root.add_child(mi)
+		e["_mi"] = mi
+	var view: String = e["view"]
+	var front: bool = e["layer"] == "front"
+	var m: ShaderMaterial = mi.material_override
+	m.shader = _shader(front)
+	m.render_priority = -1 if front else -100   # (over: before the edit overlays; behind: first of all)
+	m.set_shader_parameter("tex", e["_tex"])
+	m.set_shader_parameter("opacity", clampf(float(e["opacity"]), 0.0, 1.0))
+	m.set_shader_parameter("far", not front and view != "free")
+	m.set_shader_parameter("fade", view != "free")
+	var b := Basis()
+	match view:
+		"side": b = Basis.from_euler(Vector3(0, PI / 2, 0))   # (as the side view looks: from +X)
+		"top": b = Basis.from_euler(Vector3(-PI / 2, 0, 0))
+		"free": b = Basis.from_euler(Vector3(deg_to_rad(float(e["tilt"])), deg_to_rad(float(e["turn"])), 0))
+	var at := Vector3(float(e["x"]), float(e["y"]), float(e["z"])) if view == "free" else b * Vector3(float(e["x"]), float(e["y"]), 0.0)
+	var h := maxf(0.001, float(e["height"]))
+	mi.transform = Transform3D(b * Basis.from_scale(Vector3(h * float(e.get("_aspect", 1.0)), h, 1.0)), at)
+	mi.visible = bool(e["shown"])
+	_request()
+
+
+func _drop(e: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var mi: MeshInstance3D = e.get("_mi")
+	if mi and is_instance_valid(mi):
+		mi.queue_free()
+	e.erase("_mi")
+	e.erase("_tex")
+
+
+func _request() -> void:
+	if ed and ed.view:
+		ed.view.request()
+
+
+# --- kept per model ---------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func _read_all() -> Dictionary:
+	if not FileAccess.file_exists(FILE):
+		return {}
+	var d = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(FILE))
+	return d if d is Dictionary else {}
+
+
+func _save_soon() -> void:
+	if _save_due:
+		return
+	_save_due = true
+	if is_inside_tree():
+		get_tree().create_timer(0.4).timeout.connect(func(): if _save_due: _save_now())
+	else:
+		_save_now()
+
+
+func _save_now() -> void:
+	_save_due = false
+	var all := _read_all()
+	var out := []
+	for e in images:
+		var d := {}
+		for k in e:
+			if not str(k).begins_with("_"):
+				d[k] = e[k]
+		out.append(d)
+	if out.is_empty():
+		all.erase(_key)
+	else:
+		all[_key] = out
+	var f := FileAccess.open(FILE, FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if f:
+		f.store_string(JSON.stringify(all, "\t"))
+
+
+# --- the panel ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func build_right(box: VBoxContainer) -> void:
+	box.add_child(UI.section("REFERENCE IMAGES"))
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
+	row.add_child(ed._btn("Add reference image", "m_ref_image", "", "A picture from anywhere on this computer (png, jpg, webp) shown in the view to model from -\nlined up with the front view at first, behind the model. Kept with this model.", open_dialog))
+	_remove = ed._btn("Remove reference image", "delete", "", "Takes the picked reference image away (the picture file isn't touched).", func(): remove(_sel))
+	row.add_child(_remove)
+	_eye = ed._btn("Show / hide reference image", "eye", "", "Shows or hides the picked reference image (kept either way).", func():
+		if _sel >= 0:
+			set_value(_sel, "shown", not bool(images[_sel]["shown"])))
+	row.add_child(_eye)
+	box.add_child(row)
+	_list = ItemList.new()
+	_list.custom_minimum_size.y = 56
+	_list.auto_height = true
+	_list.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
+	_list.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Reference images", "", "This model's reference images: pick one to change it below.")
+	_list.item_selected.connect(func(i): _sel = i; _fill_fields())
+	box.add_child(_list)
+	var grid := GridContainer.new()
+	grid.columns = 2
+	grid.add_theme_constant_override("h_separation", 6)
+	_detail = grid
+	box.add_child(grid)
+	var vo := OptionButton.new()
+	for n in VIEW_NAMES:
+		vo.add_item(n)
+	vo.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	vo.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
+	vo.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Lined up with", "", "The view the picture is upright in (front, side, top - it shows while you look along that\nview, centred on the origin), or a free plane placed and turned anywhere in the scene.")
+	vo.item_selected.connect(func(i): set_value(_sel, "view", VIEWS[i]); _fill_fields())
+	_row(grid, "View", vo, "view")
+	var lo := OptionButton.new()
+	lo.add_item("Behind the model")
+	lo.add_item("Over the model")
+	lo.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	lo.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 14)
+	lo.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Layer", "", "Behind: the model drawn over the picture. Over: the picture drawn over the model,\nsee-through by its opacity (the points and wireframe still on top).")
+	lo.item_selected.connect(func(i): set_value(_sel, "layer", "front" if i == 1 else "back"))
+	_row(grid, "Layer", lo, "layer")
+	var op := HSlider.new()
+	op.min_value = 0.0
+	op.max_value = 1.0
+	op.step = 0.01
+	op.custom_minimum_size.x = 100
+	op.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	op.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	op.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Opacity", "", "How solid the picture is: 0 - not seen, 1 - solid.")
+	op.value_changed.connect(func(v): set_value(_sel, "opacity", v))
+	_row(grid, "Opacity", op, "opacity")
+	for f in [["height", "Size", 0.01, 1000.0, 0.01, "The picture's height in metres (its width follows its shape)."],
+			["x", "Offset X", -1000.0, 1000.0, 0.01, "Moves the picture across (metres): a view's along its own right; a free plane's along X."],
+			["y", "Offset Y", -1000.0, 1000.0, 0.01, "Moves the picture up or down (metres): a view's along its own up; a free plane's along Y."],
+			["z", "Offset Z", -1000.0, 1000.0, 0.01, "A free plane's place along Z (metres)."],
+			["turn", "Turn", -360.0, 360.0, 1.0, "A free plane turned round the up axis (degrees)."],
+			["tilt", "Tilt", -360.0, 360.0, 1.0, "A free plane tipped forward or back (degrees)."]]:
+		var s := SpinBox.new()
+		s.min_value = f[2]
+		s.max_value = f[3]
+		s.step = f[4]
+		s.allow_greater = true
+		s.allow_lesser = f[0] != "height"
+		s.custom_minimum_size.x = 80
+		s.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		s.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip(f[1], "", f[5])
+		var key: String = f[0]
+		s.value_changed.connect(func(v): set_value(_sel, key, v))
+		_row(grid, f[1], s, key)
+	_fill_list()
+
+
+func _row(grid: GridContainer, text: String, c: Control, key: String) -> void:
+	var l := UI.label(text, 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	l.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP
+	l.tooltip_text = c.tooltip_text
+	grid.add_child(l)
+	grid.add_child(c)
+	_fields[key] = [l, c]
+
+
+func open_dialog() -> void:
+	var fd := FileDialog.new()
+	fd.file_mode = FileDialog.FILE_MODE_OPEN_FILE
+	fd.access = FileDialog.ACCESS_FILESYSTEM
+	fd.filters = PackedStringArray(["*.png, *.jpg, *.jpeg, *.webp ; Images"])
+	fd.title = "Add a reference image"
+	fd.use_native_dialog = true
+	ed.add_child(fd)
+	fd.file_selected.connect(func(f: String):
+		fd.queue_free()
+		add_file(f)
+		ed._say("Reference image %s added - lined up with the front view (the panel changes it)." % f.get_file()))
+	fd.canceled.connect(fd.queue_free)
+	fd.popup_centered_ratio(0.6)
+
+
+func _fill_list() -> void:
+	if _list == null:
+		return
+	_list.clear()
+	for e in images:
+		var i := _list.add_item("%s%s · %s" % ["" if e["shown"] else "(hidden) ", str(e["file"]).get_file(), VIEW_NAMES[maxi(0, VIEWS.find(e["view"]))]])
