@@ -1,0 +1,55 @@ 
+class_name TurntableHover
+extends Node
+## A list's pictures turning: the item under the mouse cycles through its turntable
+## (its frames - MeshThumbs.frames()) at FPS, by the clock; put back to its first
+## frame when the mouse leaves it. One item at a time: an icon swapped a few times a
+## second, nothing while the mouse is elsewhere.
+##   TurntableHover.attach(item_list, func(meta) -> Array: return thumbs.frames(meta))
+
+const FPS := 18.0
+
+var list: ItemList
+var frames_of: Callable
+var _item := -1
+var _shown := -1
+var _t := 0.0
+
+
+static func attach(l: ItemList, frames: Callable) -> TurntableHover:
+	var h := TurntableHover.new()
+	h.list = l
+	h.frames_of = frames
+	h.name = "TurntableHover"
+	l.add_child(h)
+	l.mouse_exited.connect(h._leave)
+	return h
+
+
+func _process(dt: float) -> void:
+	if list == null or not list.is_visible_in_tree():
+		return
+	var at := list.get_local_mouse_position()
+	var i := list.get_item_at_position(at, true) if Rect2(Vector2.ZERO, list.size).has_point(at) else -1
+	if i != _item:
+		_leave()
+		_item = i
+		_t = 0.0
+	if _item < 0 or _item >= list.item_count:
+		return
+	var f: Array = frames_of.call(list.get_item_metadata(_item))
+	if f.is_empty():
+		return
+	_t += dt
+	var k := int(_t * FPS) % f.size()
+	if k != _shown:
+		_shown = k
+		list.set_item_icon(_item, f[k])
+
+

files.explanation: An icon coming alive on hover: spin, turntable, push, bob, breathe, swing or pulse - drawn as a transform of the same texture, eased back on leaving, asleep otherwise.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,155 @@ 
+class_name IconAnim
+extends Control
+## An icon button's icon coming alive while the mouse is on it: the same picture drawn
+## moving - the turn icon spinning, cubes and shapes turning round like a turntable,
+## arrows pushing out, an extrude or a flip bobbing, rings breathing, the rest
+## pulsing with a glint. Drawn over the button in the icon's place (the button's own
+## icon hidden meanwhile, its size kept), by the clock; eased back to rest when the
+## mouse leaves, then the button's icon is back and this sleeps. Nothing repainted:
+## one texture, a transform.
+##   IconAnim.attach(button, "m_rotate")   (EditorIcons.dress does it for every icon button)
+
+## How each icon moves (by name; prefixes for families): spin, turn, push, bob, breathe,
+## swing, pulse (the default).
+const KINDS := {
+	"m_rotate": "spin", "reload": "spin", "restart": "spin", "m_torus": "spin", "m_falloff": "breathe",
+	"m_move": "push", "m_scale": "push", "fit_all": "push", "m_frame": "push", "m_frame_all": "push",
+	"m_extrude": "bob", "m_flip": "bob", "m_normals": "bob", "up": "bob", "down": "bob", "land": "bob",
+	"m_prop": "breathe", "m_merge": "breathe", "m_connected": "swing", "undo": "swing", "redo": "swing",
+	"back": "swing", "forward": "swing", "next": "swing", "exit": "swing",
+	"m_mirror_x": "turn", "m_mirror_y": "turn", "m_mirror_z": "turn", "m_symmetrize": "turn", "m_symmetrize_back": "turn",
+	"m_box": "turn", "m_cylinder": "turn", "m_cone": "turn", "m_sphere": "turn", "m_plane": "turn",
+	"m_object": "turn", "m_edit": "turn", "m_vertex": "turn", "m_edge": "turn", "m_face": "turn",
+	"m_front": "turn", "m_side": "turn", "m_top": "turn", "mesh": "turn", "mod": "turn", "ui_cargo": "turn",
+	"anim": "swing", "play": "push", "effects": "breathe", "ui_galaxy": "spin", "ui_system": "spin", "patch": "swing",
+	"m_union": "breathe", "m_difference": "pulse", "m_intersect": "breathe", "m_slice": "swing", "m_shapes": "turn",
+	"m_shape_save": "bob", "m_shape_add": "bob", "m_knife": "swing", "m_ngons": "turn", "m_auto_select": "push", "m_dissolve": "breathe", "m_symmetrize_topo": "turn", "m_bind_auto": "swing", "m_bind_bone": "swing",
+	"m_materials": "turn", "m_mat_new": "bob", "m_mat_duplicate": "push", "m_mat_rename": "swing", "m_mat_delete": "swing", "m_mat_assign": "bob",
+	"m_move_smart": "bob", "m_move_persp": "push", "m_gizmo": "spin", "m_panel_left": "push", "m_panel_right": "push", "m_maximize": "push", "m_restore": "push", "m_tpose": "swing", "m_weapons": "swing", "save": "bob", "delete": "swing", "duplicate": "push", "add": "spin", "help": "swing", "docs": "swing",
+}
+const SPEED := 1.6     # cycles a second (spin: turns a second / 2)
+const EASE := 7.0      # how quickly it settles back
+
+var button: Button
+var tex: Texture2D
+var kind := "pulse"
+var _t := 0.0
+var _amt := 0.0         # 0 at rest .. 1 alive
+var _on := false
+
+static var _blank := {}  # size -> a clear texture (the button's icon while this draws it)
+
+
+static func attach(b: Button, icon_name: String) -> void:
+	if b == null or b.has_meta("icon_anim"):
+		return
+	var a := IconAnim.new()
+	a.button = b
+	a.kind = KINDS.get(icon_name, "spin" if icon_name.begins_with("m_sym") else "pulse")
+	a.name = "IconAnim"
+	a.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
+	a.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	b.set_meta("icon_anim", a)
+	b.add_child(a)
+	b.mouse_entered.connect(a._start)
+	b.mouse_exited.connect(a._stop)
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	set_process(false)
+
+
+func _start() -> void:
+	if button.disabled or button.icon == null:
+		return
+	if not _on and _amt <= 0.0:
+		tex = button.icon
+		button.icon = _clear(tex.get_size())
+		_t = 0.0
+	_on = true
+	set_process(true)
+
+
+func _stop() -> void:
+	_on = false
+
+
+static func _clear(sz: Vector2) -> Texture2D:
+	var k := Vector2i(sz)
+	if not _blank.has(k):
+		var img := Image.create_empty(maxi(k.x, 1), maxi(k.y, 1), false, Image.FORMAT_RGBA8)
+		_blank[k] = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+	return _blank[k]
+
+
+func _process(dt: float) -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(button) or tex == null:
+		set_process(false)
+		return
+	if button.icon != null and not button.icon in _blank.values():
+		tex = button.icon   # (the button's code changed its icon meanwhile - Play to Stop: that one moves now)
+		button.icon = _clear(tex.get_size())
+	_t += dt
+	_amt = move_toward(_amt, 1.0 if _on else 0.0, dt * EASE)
+	if not _on and _amt <= 0.0:
+		button.icon = tex   # (at rest: the button's own icon back)
+		tex = null
+		set_process(false)
+	queue_redraw()
+
+
+## Where the button draws its icon: centred when it has no text, else at its left.
+func _icon_rect() -> Rect2:
+	var sz := tex.get_size()
+	if button.expand_icon:
+		var h := size.y * 0.6
+		sz = Vector2(h, h)
+	var sb := button.get_theme_stylebox("normal")
+	var left := sb.get_margin(SIDE_LEFT) if sb else 4.0
+	var x := (size.x - sz.x) * 0.5 if button.text == "" or button.icon_alignment == HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER else left
+	if button.icon_alignment == HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_RIGHT and button.text != "":
+		x = size.x - (sb.get_margin(SIDE_RIGHT) if sb else 4.0) - sz.x
+	var y := (size.y - sz.y) * 0.5
+	if button.vertical_icon_alignment == VERTICAL_ALIGNMENT_TOP and button.text != "":
+		y = (sb.get_margin(SIDE_TOP) if sb else 4.0)
+	return Rect2(Vector2(x, y), sz)
+
+
+func _draw() -> void:
+	if tex == null:
+		return
+	var r := _icon_rect()
+	var c := r.get_center()
+	var a := _amt
+	var ph := _t * SPEED * TAU
+	var rot := 0.0
+	var sc := Vector2.ONE
+	var off := Vector2.ZERO
+	var glow := 0.0
+	match kind:
+		"spin":
+			rot = _t * PI * 2.0 * a
+		"turn":   # (a turntable: the picture's width swinging through its turn, never quite edge-on)
+			var k := cos(_t * PI * 1.6)
+			sc = Vector2(lerpf(1.0, signf(k) * maxf(absf(k), 0.15), a), 1.0)
+			glow = 0.25 * a * (1.0 - absf(k))
+		"push":
+			sc = Vector2.ONE * (1.0 + 0.16 * a * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(ph)))
+		"bob":
+			off = Vector2(0, -2.5 * a * sin(ph))
+		"breathe":
+			sc = Vector2.ONE * (1.0 + 0.12 * a * sin(ph))
+			glow = 0.3 * a * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(ph))
+		"swing":
+			rot = 0.28 * a * sin(ph)
+		_:
+			sc = Vector2.ONE * (1.0 + 0.1 * a * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(ph)))
+			glow = 0.35 * a * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(ph * 0.5))
+	var m := button.get_theme_color("icon_hover_color") if button.has_theme_color("icon_hover_color") else Color.WHITE
+	if button.disabled:
+		m = Color(1, 1, 1, 0.4)
+	draw_set_transform(c + off, rot, sc)
+	draw_texture_rect(tex, Rect2(-r.size * 0.5, r.size), false, m)
+	if glow > 0.0:
+		draw_texture_rect(tex, Rect2(-r.size * 0.5, r.size), false, Color(1.0, 0.85, 0.55, glow))
+	draw_set_transform(Vector2.ZERO)

+class_name Fx
+extends Node3D
+## Particle effects as data: data/effects.json (a mod overlays it - or a .merge of
+## it - like any data file). Each effect is named and is a list of emitters
+## (CPUParticles3D: simulated on the CPU, drawn as one MultiMesh each - the same on
+## the desktop and in a browser, no particle shader to compile), plus a flash of
+## light if it has one. An Fx node is one effect playing:
+##   Fx.spawn("explosion", cosmos.world, at, 1.6)          a one-shot: gone (back in the pool) when done
+##   var f := Fx.attach("mining_sparks", node); f.emitting = on     a looping one, on a thing
+##
+## Every live Fx rebuilds its emitters when its effect's definition changes
+## (Fx.reload_all() - the file read again - or set_def() from the editors: Talos's
+## Effects, the Live Editor's Particles tab), so edits show at once in the game.
+##
+## The effects' look: few materials, shared - fx_add.gdshader (glow, fire, spark,
+## ring: added light), fx_smoke.gdshader (smoke, dust: lit, blended) and
+## fx_debris.gdshader (lit solid pieces glowing with heat); CosmosWarm draws them
+## once at the title. A particle's colour is its emitter's colour ramp times its
+## emissive strength times the Fx's tint (set_tint: a landing's dust the ground's
+## colour, a bolt's sparks its gun's).
+##
+## An emitter (PARAMS: every key, its default, range and meaning):
+##   {name, material, mesh, amount, lifetime, one_shot, explosiveness, delay, shape,
+##    size, direction, spread, velocity [min, max], gravity [x, y, z], damping [min, max],
+##    scale [min, max], scale_curve [[t, k]...], colors [[t, "#rrggbbaa"]...], emissive...}
+## An effect: {about, emitters: [...], light: {color, energy, range, life}, duration}.
+
+const FILE := "res://data/effects.json"
+## One-shots kept for reuse, per effect (finished ones wait hidden in their parent).
+const POOL_MAX := 24
+const MATERIALS := ["glow", "fire", "spark", "ring", "smoke", "debris"]
+const MESHES := ["quad", "streak", "shard"]
+const SHAPES := ["point", "sphere", "sphere_surface", "box", "ring"]
+const ADD := preload("res://shaders/world/fx_add.gdshader")
+const SMOKE := preload("res://shaders/world/fx_smoke.gdshader")
+const DEBRIS := preload("res://shaders/world/fx_debris.gdshader")
+
+## Every emitter key: [key, kind, default, min, max, label, help]
+## (kinds: text, enum (min: the options), bool, int, float, range, vec3, colors, curve).
+const PARAMS := [
+	["name", "text", "emitter", null, null, "Name", "What this emitter is (for you: shown in the editors)."],
+	["on", "bool", true, null, null, "On", "Off: the emitter isn't drawn (to look at the others alone)."],
+	["material", "enum", "glow", MATERIALS, null, "Material", "glow: a soft light, added - fire: ragged flame burning away - spark: a streak along its flight\nring: a thin ring (a shockwave) - smoke: lit, blended billows (dust too) - debris: solid lit pieces, glowing with heat."],
+	["mesh", "enum", "quad", MESHES, null, "Mesh", "What each particle is: a quad (glow, fire, smoke, ring), a streak (sparks) or a shard (debris)."],
+	["billboard", "bool", true, null, null, "Billboard", "The quads face the camera. Off: they lie as the emitter turns them (a ring flat round the blast)."],
+	["amount", "int", 16, 1, 512, "Amount", "How many particles (a one-shot: all of them; looping: alive at once)."],
+	["lifetime", "float", 1.0, 0.02, 20.0, "Lifetime", "Seconds each particle lives."],
+	["lifetime_random", "float", 0.0, 0.0, 1.0, "Lifetime random", "How much shorter some live (0: all the same, 1: anything down to none)."],
+	["one_shot", "bool", true, null, null, "One-shot", "All its particles once (a burst). Off: it keeps emitting (a trail, a jet's dust)."],
+	["explosiveness", "float", 1.0, 0.0, 1.0, "Explosiveness", "1: all at once. 0: spread evenly over the lifetime."],
+	["delay", "float", 0.0, 0.0, 5.0, "Delay", "Seconds after the effect starts before this emitter does."],
+	["shape", "enum", "point", SHAPES, null, "Shape", "Where particles start: a point, in a sphere, on a sphere's surface, in a box, on a ring (round the emitter's up)."],
+	["size", "float", 0.0, 0.0, 50.0, "Shape size", "The shape's radius (the box: half its side), in metres."],
+	["direction", "vec3", [0.0, 1.0, 0.0], -1.0, 1.0, "Direction", "Which way they fly (the emitter's own axes: up is its Y)."],
+	["spread", "float", 180.0, 0.0, 180.0, "Spread", "Degrees round the direction (180: every way)."],
+	["velocity", "range", [2.0, 6.0], 0.0, 500.0, "Velocity", "Starting speed, m/s (each particle: between the two)."],
+	["gravity", "vec3", [0.0, 0.0, 0.0], -50.0, 50.0, "Gravity", "Acceleration, m/s2 (space: none; a planet: -9.8 down; smoke rising: up)."],
+	["damping", "range", [0.0, 0.0], 0.0, 100.0, "Damping", "Slowing, m/s each second (air drag: sparks and smoke stop)."],
+	["radial", "range", [0.0, 0.0], -100.0, 100.0, "Radial accel", "Pushed out from the centre (or pulled in, below 0), m/s2: dust rolling out from a landing."],
+	["scale", "range", [1.0, 1.0], 0.0, 100.0, "Scale", "Each particle's size in metres (between the two)."],
+	["scale_curve", "curve", [], 0.0, 4.0, "Scale over life", "The size through its life (x: age, y: times the scale). None: the same size all its life."],
+	["angle", "range", [0.0, 360.0], -360.0, 360.0, "Angle", "Its starting turn, degrees (billboards: round the view; debris: its tumble)."],
+	["spin", "range", [0.0, 0.0], -1440.0, 1440.0, "Spin", "Turning, degrees a second."],
+	["colors", "colors", [[0.0, "#ffffffff"], [1.0, "#ffffff00"]], null, null, "Colour over life", "Its colour and opacity through its life (left: born, right: gone)."],
+	["emissive", "float", 1.0, 0.0, 20.0, "Emissive", "How bright (the colours times this: over 1 glows past white)."],
+	["tinted", "bool", true, null, null, "Takes the tint", "Coloured by the effect's tint where the game sets one (a bolt's colour, the ground's).\nOff: always its own colours (a bolt's dust stays dust-coloured)."],
+	["align", "bool", false, null, null, "Align to flight", "Its Y along its velocity (sparks always are)."],
+	["local", "bool", true, null, null, "Local space", "The particles move with the emitter (a blast with its ship). Off: they stay where they were let go (a trail)."],
+]
+const EFFECT_PARAMS := [
+	["about", "text", "", null, null, "About", "What the effect is and where the game uses it."],
+	["duration", "float", 1.0, 0.05, 30.0, "Duration", "A spawned effect's looping emitters stop after this many seconds."],
+]
+const LIGHT_PARAMS := [
+	["color", "color", "#ffb060ff", null, null, "Light colour", "The flash of light's colour."],
+	["energy", "float", 0.0, 0.0, 40.0, "Light energy", "How bright the flash (0: no light)."],
+	["range", "float", 20.0, 0.5, 400.0, "Light range", "How far it reaches, m (times the effect's scale)."],
+	["life", "float", 0.5, 0.02, 10.0, "Light life", "Seconds it takes to fade."],
+]
+
+static var defs := {}                 # name -> the effect's definition
+static var order: Array = []          # names, as in the file
+static var dirty := false             # changed since saved
+static var _loaded := false
+static var _mats := {}
+static var _meshes := {}
+static var _pool := {}                # name -> Array of idle Fx
+
+var effect := ""
+var attached := false
+## A one-shot kept when done (not pooled, not freed: the editors' previews play it again).
+var keep := false
+var scale_k := 1.0
+var tint := Color.WHITE
+var playing := false
+var emitting := true: set = set_emitting
+var _t := 0.0
+var _life := 1.0
+var _light: OmniLight3D
+var _emitters: Array = []             # CPUParticles3D, one per emitter of the definition
+var _started: Array = []              # (delayed emitters: started yet)
+
+
+# --- The data ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+static func load_all() -> void:
+	_loaded = true
+	defs = {}
+	order = []
+	var et: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/edit_target.gd")
+	var d = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(et.read_path(FILE)))
+	if d is Dictionary:
+		for k in d:
+			if str(k).begins_with("_") or not d[k] is Dictionary:
+				continue
+			defs[str(k)] = d[k]
+			order.append(str(k))
+	dirty = false
+
+
+## The file read again (the game's, a mod's) and every live effect rebuilt.
+static func reload_all() -> void:
+	load_all()
+	_refresh("")
+
+
+static func names() -> Array:
+	if not _loaded:
+		load_all()
+	return order.duplicate()
+
+
+static func has(name: String) -> bool:
+	if not _loaded:
+		load_all()
+	return defs.has(name)
+
+
+## Effect `name`'s definition ({} - none).
+static func def(name: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if not _loaded:
+		load_all()
+	return defs.get(name, {})
+
+
+## Changes an effect's definition: every live effect of it rebuilt at once.
+static func set_def(name: String, d: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if not _loaded:
+		load_all()
+	defs[name] = d
+	if not order.has(name):
+		order.append(name)
+	dirty = true
+	_refresh(name)
+
+
+static func remove(name: String) -> void:
+	defs.erase(name)
+	order.erase(name)
+	dirty = true
+	_refresh(name)
+
+
+static func rename(from: String, to: String) -> bool:
+	if not defs.has(from) or defs.has(to) or to.strip_edges() == "":
+		return false
+	defs[to] = defs[from]
+	defs.erase(from)
+	order[order.find(from)] = to
+	for n in _live():
+		if n.effect == from:
+			n.effect = to
+	_pool.erase(from)
+	dirty = true
+	return true
+
+
+## Every definition as it is now: {name: def} in order (to undo to, or to save).
+static func snapshot() -> Dictionary:
+	if not _loaded:
+		load_all()
+	var out := {}
+	for k in order:
+		out[k] = defs[k].duplicate(true)
+	return out
+
+
+## Puts back a snapshot (undo): the effects that differ rebuilt.
+static func restore(s: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var was := defs
+	defs = {}
+	order = []
+	for k in s:
+		defs[k] = (s[k] as Dictionary).duplicate(true)
+		order.append(k)
+	dirty = true
+	for k in was:
+		if not defs.has(k) or JSON.stringify(defs[k]) != JSON.stringify(was[k]):
+			_refresh(k)
+	for k in defs:
+		if not was.has(k):
+			_refresh(k)
+
+
+## Writes data/effects.json through EditTarget (the game's file, or the mod being made).
+static func save() -> bool:
+	var et: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/edit_target.gd")
+	if not et.writable():
+		return false
+	var f := FileAccess.open(et.write_path(FILE), FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if f == null:
+		return false
+	f.store_string(JSON.stringify(snapshot(), "\t", false) + "\n")
+	f.close()
+	dirty = false
+	return true
+
+
+## A new emitter: every key at its default.
+static func new_emitter() -> Dictionary:
+	var e := {}
+	for p in PARAMS:
+		e[p[0]] = p[2].duplicate(true) if p[2] is Array else p[2]
+	return e
+
+
+## Emitter `e`'s value of `key` (its default when it hasn't one).
+static func val(e: Dictionary, key: String) -> Variant:
+	if e.has(key):
+		return e[key]
+	for p in PARAMS:
+		if p[0] == key:
+			return p[2]
+	return null
+
+
+static func param(key: String) -> Array:
+	for p in PARAMS:
+		if p[0] == key:
+			return p
+	return []
+
+
+static func _rng2(v: Variant, d := Vector2.ZERO) -> Vector2:
+	if v is Array and v.size() >= 2:
+		return Vector2(float(v[0]), float(v[1]))
+	if v is float or v is int:
+		return Vector2(float(v), float(v))
+	return d
+
+
+static func _vec3(v: Variant, d := Vector3.ZERO) -> Vector3:
+	if v is Array and v.size() >= 3:
+		return Vector3(float(v[0]), float(v[1]), float(v[2]))
+	return d
+
+
+static func color_of(v: Variant, d := Color.WHITE) -> Color:
+	if v is String:
+		return Color.from_string(v, d)
+	if v is Array and v.size() >= 3:
+		return Color(float(v[0]), float(v[1]), float(v[2]), float(v[3]) if v.size() > 3 else 1.0)
+	return d
+
+
+static func gradient(stops: Variant) -> Gradient:
+	var g := Gradient.new()
+	var offs := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var cols := PackedColorArray()
+	if stops is Array:
+		var s: Array = stops.duplicate()
+		s.sort_custom(func(a, b): return float(a[0]) < float(b[0]))
+		for st in s:
+			if st is Array and st.size() >= 2:
+				offs.append(clampf(float(st[0]), 0.0, 1.0))
+				cols.append(color_of(st[1]))
+	if offs.is_empty():
+		offs = PackedFloat32Array([0.0, 1.0])
+		cols = PackedColorArray([Color.WHITE, Color(1, 1, 1, 0)])
+	g.offsets = offs
+	g.colors = cols
+	return g
+
+
+static func curve(pts: Variant) -> Curve:
+	if not pts is Array or (pts as Array).size() < 2:
+		return null
+	var c := Curve.new()
+	var hi := 1.0
+	for p in pts:
+		hi = maxf(hi, float(p[1]))
+	c.max_value = hi
+	for p in pts:
+		c.add_point(Vector2(clampf(float(p[0]), 0.0, 1.0), float(p[1])), 0.0, 0.0, Curve.TANGENT_LINEAR, Curve.TANGENT_LINEAR)
+	return c
+
+
+# --- Playing -----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+## A one-shot effect at `global_pos` in `parent` (`scale` x its size, turned by `basis`:
+## its Y the effect's up). Freed (pooled) when it's done. null: no such effect.
+static func spawn(name: String, parent: Node, global_pos: Vector3, scale := 1.0, basis := Basis()) -> Fx:
+	if parent == null or not is_instance_valid(parent) or not has(name):
+		return null
+	var fx := _take(name, parent)
+	if fx == null:
+		fx = Fx.new()
+		fx.effect = name
+		parent.add_child(fx)
+	fx.scale_k = scale
+	var b := Basis(basis.orthonormalized().get_rotation_quaternion()) if basis != Basis() else Basis()
+	if fx.is_inside_tree():
+		fx.global_transform = Transform3D(b.scaled(Vector3.ONE * scale), global_pos)
+	else:
+		fx.transform = Transform3D(b.scaled(Vector3.ONE * scale), global_pos)
+	fx.play()
+	return fx
+
+
+## A looping effect on `parent` (at its origin; move it, or set `emitting`).
+static func attach(name: String, parent: Node) -> Fx:
+	if parent == null or not is_instance_valid(parent):
+		return null
+	var fx := Fx.new()
+	fx.effect = name
+	fx.attached = true
+	fx.name = "Fx_" + name
+	parent.add_child(fx)
+	fx.play()
+	return fx
+
+
+## A basis whose Y is `up` (an effect's direction: a ground's normal, a hit's way back).
+static func basis_up(up: Vector3) -> Basis:
+	var y := up.normalized()
+	if y.length_squared() < 0.5:
+		return Basis()
+	var x := y.cross(Vector3.FORWARD if absf(y.z) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+	return Basis(x, y, x.cross(y))
+
+
+static func _take(name: String, parent: Node) -> Fx:
+	var list: Array = _pool.get(name, [])
+	while not list.is_empty():
+		var fx = list.pop_back()
+		if is_instance_valid(fx) and not fx.playing and fx.effect == name:
+			if fx.get_parent() != parent:
+				if fx.get_parent():
+					fx.get_parent().remove_child(fx)
+				parent.add_child(fx)
+			return fx
+	return null
+
+
+## Every Fx node there is (in the tree).
+static func _live() -> Array:
+	var tree := Engine.get_main_loop() as SceneTree
+	return tree.get_nodes_in_group("fx") if tree else []
+
+
+static func _refresh(name: String) -> void:
+	for n in _live():
+		if name == "" or n.effect == name:
+			n.rebuild()
+
+
+## The Fx nodes under `n` (itself included).
+static func under(n: Node) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	if n == null:
+		return out
+	if n is Fx:
+		out.append(n)
+	for c in n.find_children("*", "Node3D", true, false):
+		if c is Fx and (c as Fx).visible:
+			out.append(c)
+	return out
+
+
+func _ready() -> void:
+	add_to_group("fx")
+	if _emitters.is_empty():
+		rebuild()
+
+
+func play() -> void:
+	_t = 0.0
+	playing = true
+	visible = true
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT
+	if _emitters.is_empty():
+		rebuild()
+	set_tint(Color.WHITE)
+	_start_all()
+
+
+func _start_all() -> void:
+	var ems: Array = def(effect).get("emitters", [])
+	for i in _emitters.size():
+		var p: CPUParticles3D = _emitters[i]
+		var e: Dictionary = ems[i] if i < ems.size() else {}
+		var go: bool = bool(val(e, "on")) and (emitting or not attached)
+		_started[i] = float(val(e, "delay")) <= 0.0
+		if go and _started[i]:
+			p.restart()
+		else:
+			p.emitting = false
+	if _light:
+		_light.visible = true
+
+
+## On / off (a looping effect: its emitters; its one-shot emitters fire again on).
+func set_emitting(on: bool) -> void:
+	if emitting == on:
+		return
+	emitting = on
+	if not is_inside_tree():
+		return
+	var ems: Array = def(effect).get("emitters", [])
+	for i in _emitters.size():
+		var p: CPUParticles3D = _emitters[i]
+		var e: Dictionary = ems[i] if i < ems.size() else {}
+		if on and bool(val(e, "on")):
+			if p.one_shot:
+				p.restart()
+			else:
+				p.emitting = true
+		elif not on:
+			p.emitting = false
+	if on:
+		_t = 0.0
+
+
+## Its particles' colour times `c` (and the light's).
+func set_tint(c: Color) -> void:
+	tint = c
+	var ems: Array = def(effect).get("emitters", [])
+	for i in _emitters.size():
+		var e: Dictionary = ems[i] if i < ems.size() else {}
+		var k := float(val(e, "emissive"))
+		var t := c if bool(val(e, "tinted")) else Color.WHITE
+		(_emitters[i] as CPUParticles3D).color = Color(t.r * k, t.g * k, t.b * k, t.a)
+
+
+## Its emitters made again from the definition (in place: the nodes kept when they can be).
+func rebuild() -> void:
+	var d := def(effect)
+	var ems: Array = d.get("emitters", [])
+	while _emitters.size() > ems.size():
+		var p: CPUParticles3D = _emitters.pop_back()
+		remove_child(p)
+		p.queue_free()
+	_started.resize(ems.size())
+	_started.fill(false)
+	_life = 0.05
+	var dur := float(d.get("duration", 1.0))
+	for i in ems.size():
+		if i >= _emitters.size():
+			var p := CPUParticles3D.new()
+			p.name = "E%d" % i
+			p.emitting = false
+			add_child(p)
+			_emitters.append(p)
+		var e: Dictionary = ems[i] if ems[i] is Dictionary else {}
+		configure(_emitters[i], e)
+		var life := float(val(e, "lifetime"))
+		var span := life * (2.0 - clampf(float(val(e, "explosiveness")), 0.0, 1.0)) if bool(val(e, "one_shot")) else dur + life
+		_life = maxf(_life, float(val(e, "delay")) + span + 0.05)
+	var l: Dictionary = d.get("light", {}) if d.get("light") is Dictionary else {}
+	if float(l.get("energy", 0.0)) > 0.0:
+		if _light == null:
+			_light = OmniLight3D.new()
+			_light.shadow_enabled = false
+			_light.name = "Light"
+			add_child(_light)
+		_light.light_color = color_of(l.get("color", "#ffb060"))
+		_life = maxf(_life, float(l.get("life", 0.5)))
+	elif _light:
+		_light.queue_free()
+		_light = null
+	set_tint(tint)
+	if playing:
+		_start_all()
+
+
+## Emitter `e`'s values onto particles `p`.
+static func configure(p: CPUParticles3D, e: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var mat := str(val(e, "material"))
+	p.visible = bool(val(e, "on"))
+	p.amount = clampi(int(val(e, "amount")), 1, 4096)
+	p.lifetime = maxf(0.02, float(val(e, "lifetime")))
+	p.lifetime_randomness = clampf(float(val(e, "lifetime_random")), 0.0, 1.0)
+	p.one_shot = bool(val(e, "one_shot"))
+	p.explosiveness = clampf(float(val(e, "explosiveness")), 0.0, 1.0)
+	p.local_coords = bool(val(e, "local"))
+	p.draw_order = CPUParticles3D.DRAW_ORDER_INDEX
+	var size := maxf(0.0, float(val(e, "size")))
+	match str(val(e, "shape")):
+		"sphere":
+			p.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE
+			p.emission_sphere_radius = maxf(size, 0.001)
+		"sphere_surface":
+			p.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_SPHERE_SURFACE
+			p.emission_sphere_radius = maxf(size, 0.001)
+		"box":
+			p.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_BOX
+			p.emission_box_extents = Vector3.ONE * size
+		"ring":
+			p.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_RING
+			p.emission_ring_axis = Vector3.UP
+			p.emission_ring_radius = maxf(size, 0.001)
+			p.emission_ring_inner_radius = size * 0.6
+			p.emission_ring_height = 0.0
+		_:
+			p.emission_shape = CPUParticles3D.EMISSION_SHAPE_POINT
+	var dir := _vec3(val(e, "direction"), Vector3.UP)
+	p.direction = dir if dir.length_squared() > 0.0001 else Vector3.UP
+	p.spread = clampf(float(val(e, "spread")), 0.0, 180.0)
+	p.flatness = 0.0
+	p.gravity = _vec3(val(e, "gravity"))
+	var v := _rng2(val(e, "velocity"))
+	p.initial_velocity_min = v.x
+	p.initial_velocity_max = maxf(v.x, v.y)
+	var dm := _rng2(val(e, "damping"))
+	p.damping_min = dm.x
+	p.damping_max = maxf(dm.x, dm.y)
+	var ra := _rng2(val(e, "radial"))
+	p.radial_accel_min = ra.x
+	p.radial_accel_max = maxf(ra.x, ra.y)
+	var sc := _rng2(val(e, "scale"), Vector2.ONE)
+	p.scale_amount_min = sc.x
+	p.scale_amount_max = maxf(sc.x, sc.y)
+	p.scale_amount_curve = curve(val(e, "scale_curve"))
+	var an := _rng2(val(e, "angle"))
+	p.angle_min = an.x
+	p.angle_max = maxf(an.x, an.y)
+	var sp := _rng2(val(e, "spin"))
+	p.angular_velocity_min = sp.x
+	p.angular_velocity_max = maxf(sp.x, sp.y)
+	p.color_ramp = gradient(val(e, "colors"))
+	p.particle_flag_align_y = bool(val(e, "align")) or mat == "spark"
+	p.mesh = mesh(str(val(e, "mesh")))
+	p.material_override = material(mat, bool(val(e, "billboard")))
+	p.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if not playing:
+		return
+	_t += delta
+	var ems: Array = def(effect).get("emitters", [])
+	for i in _emitters.size():
+		if not _started[i] and i < ems.size() and _t >= float(val(ems[i], "delay")):
+			_started[i] = true
+			if bool(val(ems[i], "on")) and (emitting or not attached):
+				(_emitters[i] as CPUParticles3D).restart()
+	if not attached:
+		var dur := float(def(effect).get("duration", 1.0))
+		if _t >= dur:
+			for p in _emitters:
+				if not (p as CPUParticles3D).one_shot:
+					(p as CPUParticles3D).emitting = false
+	if _light:
+		var l: Dictionary = def(effect).get("light", {})
+		var k := clampf(1.0 - _t / maxf(float(l.get("life", 0.5)), 0.01), 0.0, 1.0)
+		_light.light_energy = float(l.get("energy", 0.0)) * k * k
+		_light.omni_range = float(l.get("range", 20.0)) * scale_k
+		_light.visible = k > 0.0
+	if not attached and _t >= _life:
+		_finish()
+
+
+## A one-shot done: hidden and pooled for the next (or freed past the pool's size).
+func _finish() -> void:
+	playing = false
+	for p in _emitters:
+		(p as CPUParticles3D).emitting = false
+	visible = false
+	if keep:
+		return
+	var list: Array = _pool.get(effect, [])
+	if list.size() >= POOL_MAX:
+		queue_free()
+		return
+	list.append(self)
+	_pool[effect] = list
+	process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED
+
+
+# --- Materials and meshes (shared) ------------------------------------------------
+
+static func material(kind: String, billboard := true) -> Material:
+	var key := kind + ("" if billboard else "/flat")
+	if _mats.has(key):
+		return _mats[key]
+	var m := ShaderMaterial.new()
+	match kind:
+		"smoke":
+			m.shader = SMOKE
+		"debris":
+			m.shader = DEBRIS
+		_:
+			m.shader = ADD
+			m.set_shader_parameter("kind", maxi(0, ["glow", "fire", "spark", "ring"].find(kind)))
+			m.render_priority = 1   # (light over smoke: added after the blended ones)
+	if kind != "debris":
+		m.set_shader_parameter("billboard", billboard)
+	_mats[key] = m
+	return m
+
+
+static func mesh(kind: String) -> Mesh:
+	if _meshes.has(kind):
+		return _meshes[kind]
+	var m: Mesh
+	match kind:
+		"streak":
+			var q := QuadMesh.new()
+			q.size = Vector2(0.12, 1.0)
+			m = q
+		"shard":
+			m = _shard()
+		_:
+			var q := QuadMesh.new()
+			q.size = Vector2.ONE
+			m = q
+	_meshes[kind] = m
+	return m
+
+
+## A jagged shard of plate (debris): a flattened, uneven octahedron, flat-shaded.
+static func _shard() -> Mesh:
+	var pts := [Vector3(0.5, 0.05, 0.1), Vector3(-0.45, -0.04, -0.12), Vector3(0.1, 0.12, 0.5), Vector3(-0.08, -0.1, -0.42),
+		Vector3(0.05, 0.22, -0.05), Vector3(-0.04, -0.2, 0.06)]
+	var faces := [[4, 0, 2], [4, 2, 1], [4, 1, 3], [4, 3, 0], [5, 2, 0], [5, 1, 2], [5, 3, 1], [5, 0, 3]]
+	var st := SurfaceTool.new()
+	st.begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES)
+	for f in faces:
+		var a: Vector3 = pts[f[0]]
+		var b: Vector3 = pts[f[1]]
+		var c: Vector3 = pts[f[2]]
+		var n := (b - a).cross(c - a).normalized()
+		for v in [a, c, b]:
+			st.set_normal(-n)
+			st.add_vertex(v)
+	return st.commit()
+
+
+## The materials drawn once (CosmosWarm, at the title: their shaders compiled, their
+## pipelines made) - one emitter of each kind the effects use, in `parent` (`shader`:
+## only that shader's - "add", "smoke" or "debris": one compile a frame).
+static func warm_into(parent: Node, shader := "") -> void:
+	var seen := {}
+	for name in names():
+		for e in def(name).get("emitters", []):
+			if not e is Dictionary:
+				continue
+			var m := str(val(e, "material"))
+			if shader != "" and shader != (m if m in ["smoke", "debris"] else "add"):
+				continue
+			var key := "%s|%s|%s" % [val(e, "material"), val(e, "billboard"), val(e, "mesh")]
+			if seen.has(key):
+				continue
+			seen[key] = true
+			var p := CPUParticles3D.new()
+			var w := (e as Dictionary).duplicate()
+			w["amount"] = 2
+			w["one_shot"] = false
+			w["lifetime"] = 1.0
+			w["on"] = true
+			configure(p, w)
+			p.position = Vector3(randf_range(-1, 1), randf_range(-1, 1), 0)
+			p.emitting = true
+			p.preprocess = 0.5
+			parent.add_child(p)

@@ -1,0 +1,41 @@ 
+class_name SmoothTurn
+extends RefCounted
+## A body turning to face a new way the way a body does: its turn speeding up,
+## held at a top rate, easing off as it comes round - never snapped round. A
+## reversal (the new way straight behind) goes round one side, the side it was
+## already turning (else the right) - not flickering between the two. One for
+## each walker, citizen, creature (its turn speed kept between frames).
+
+var rate := 9.0     # how hard it turns toward the new way (1/s: the remaining angle times this)
+var top := 7.5      # rad/s at most (a half turn in about half a second)
+var accel := 16.0   # how quickly its turn speed follows (1/s)
+var w := 0.0        # its turn speed now (rad/s, about `up`)
+
+
+func _init(p_rate := 9.0, p_top := 7.5, p_accel := 16.0) -> void:
+	rate = p_rate
+	top = p_top
+	accel = p_accel
+
+
+## `facing` turned toward `to` about `up` over `delta` (both level: across `up`).
+func step(facing: Vector3, to: Vector3, up: Vector3, delta: float) -> Vector3:
+	var f := (facing - up * facing.dot(up))
+	var t := (to - up * to.dot(up))
+	if f.length() < 0.001 or t.length() < 0.001:
+		w = 0.0
+		return facing
+	f = f.normalized()
+	t = t.normalized()
+	var a := f.signed_angle_to(t, up)
+	if absf(a) > PI - 0.15 and absf(w) > 0.01:
+		a = absf(a) * signf(w)   # (straight behind: on round the way it's turning)
+	elif absf(a) > PI - 0.15:
+		a = -absf(a)   # (from standing: round to the right)
+	var want := clampf(a * rate, -top, top)
+	w = lerpf(w, want, 1.0 - exp(-delta * accel))
+	var stepped := w * delta
+	if absf(a) < 0.002 or (signf(stepped) == signf(a) and absf(stepped) >= absf(a)):
+		w = 0.0
+		return t   # (come round: there)
+	return f.rotated(up, stepped).normalized()
hunks.title: SmoothTurn
hunks.note: A turn speed kept between frames.

bubbles.text: Wanted speed: the remaining angle times the rate, never over the top speed - eases off as it comes round.
Straight behind: on round the way it's already turning - no flicker between the two sides.
The speed follows the wanted one: the turn builds up instead of starting at full speed.

+## scripts/world/live/tabs/<id>_tab.gd) show what can be edited on it: Object (where
+## it is, its turn and size, its values), Model (its meshes - in the mesh editor),
+## Materials (every colour, number and texture of its looks), Animation (its clips
+## - in the animation editor), Particles (its effects), Collision (its solids).
+## The game goes on underneath (Pause, and the speed, at the top).

+## apply_edit(anchor, data)) reaches the editor through: selected, anchor, key,

+	box.add_child(HSeparator.new())
+	# The selection: its name, its kind (what an edit applies to), its parts.
+	_title = UI.label("Nothing picked", 18, NeonTheme.HEAD)
+	_title.clip_text = true
+	box.add_child(_title)
+	_kind = UI.label("", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	_kind.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	box.add_child(_kind)
+	var h3 := HBoxContainer.new()
+	h3.add_child(_btn("Up", "up", "", "Picks what this is part of.", func():
+		if selected and selected.get_parent() and selected.get_parent() != cosmos:
+			select(selected.get_parent())))
+	_parts = OptionButton.new()
+	_parts.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	_parts.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_parts.clip_text = true
+	_parts.tooltip_text = "Its parts: pick one."
+	_parts.item_selected.connect(func(i):
+		var n = instance_from_id(int(_parts.get_item_metadata(i))) if _parts.get_item_metadata(i) else null
+		if n is Node:
+			select(n))
+	h3.add_child(_parts)
+	box.add_child(h3)
+	_tab_bar = HBoxContainer.new()
+	_tab_bar.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 2)
+	box.add_child(_tab_bar)
+	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
+	scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
+	box.add_child(scroll)
+	_tab_holder = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_tab_holder.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	scroll.add_child(_tab_holder)
+	_status = UI.label("", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	_status.autowrap_mode = TextServer.AUTOWRAP_WORD_SMART
+	box.add_child(_status)
+
+
+func _fill_targets() -> void:
+	_target.clear()
+	_target.add_item("into the game" if EditTarget.game_writable() else "(game: read-only)")
+	_target.set_item_metadata(0, "")
+	for m in Mods.installed():
+		_target.add_item("into mod: " + str(m["name"]))
+		_target.set_item_metadata(_target.item_count - 1, m["id"])
+		if m["id"] == EditTarget.mod_id:
+			_target.select(_target.item_count - 1)
+
+
+func _btn(text: String, icon: String, keys: String, help: String, cb: Callable) -> Button:
+	var b := UI.button(text, cb, 14)
+	b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	EditorIcons.dress(b, icon, EditorIcons.tip(text if text != "" else keys, keys, help))
+	b.text = text
+	return b
+
+
+func set_paused(on: bool) -> void:
+	get_tree().paused = on
+	_pause.set_pressed_no_signal(on)
+	_pause.text = "Paused" if on else "Pause"
+
+
+func say(t: String) -> void:
+	if _status:
+		_status.text = t
+
+
+## A tab changed something (section `sec` of the selection's kind): kept, to save,
+## and - a moment later - put on every other thing of that kind in the world too.
+func edited(_sec := "") -> void:
+	if key != "":
+		LiveEdits.touched(key)
+		_spread_t = 0.3
+	_dirty_mark.text = "  ● unsaved"
+
+
+var _spread_t := -1.0
+
+
+## The selection's kind's edits put on every thing of that kind in the world now.
+func apply_everywhere() -> int:
+	if key == "":
+		return 0
+	var n := 0
+	var stack: Array = [cosmos]
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var x: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		if x == self:
+			continue
+		var k := ""
+		if x.has_meta("edit_key"):
+			k = str(x.get_meta("edit_key"))
+		elif x.scene_file_path != "":
+			k = x.scene_file_path
+		elif x.get_script() and (x.get_script() as Script).resource_path == key:
+			k = key
+		if k == key and x != anchor:
+			LiveEdits.apply(x, key)
+			n += 1
+		for c in x.get_children():
+			stack.append(c)
+	return n
+
+
+## A Talos tool (`id`: "mesh", "anim", "fx") in a window over the running game: the
+## tool, embedded, under a bar of `buttons` ([[label, icon, help, Callable(tool)]]).
+func open_tool(id: String, title: String, buttons: Array = []) -> Node:
+	var w := Window.new()
+	w.title = title
+	w.size = Vector2i(1500, 860)
+	w.process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS
+	w.wrap_controls = false
+	w.transient = true
+	add_child(w)
+	var bg := Panel.new()
+	bg.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	w.add_child(bg)
+	var box := VBoxContainer.new()
+	box.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	w.add_child(box)
+	var bar := HBoxContainer.new()
+	box.add_child(bar)
+	var t: Node = load(TalosNav.SCENES[id]).instantiate()
+	t.set("embedded", true)
+	for b in buttons:
+		var cb: Callable = b[3]
+		bar.add_child(_btn(b[0], b[1], "", b[2], func(): cb.call(t)))
+	var gap := Control.new()
+	gap.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	bar.add_child(gap)
+	var close_it := func():
+		if t.get("dirty") == true and t.has_method("guard"):
+			t.guard(w.queue_free)
+		else:
+			w.queue_free()
+	bar.add_child(_btn("Close", "close", "", "Closes the window (asks about unsaved work).", close_it))
+	w.close_requested.connect(close_it)
+	if t is Control:
+		t.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	box.add_child(t)
+	w.popup_centered()
+	return t
+
+
+func save() -> void:
+	if _tab and _tab.has_method("save"):
+		_tab.save()
+	if LiveEdits.save():
+		_dirty_mark.text = ""
+		say("Saved into %s - put back each time such a thing is made." % EditTarget.label())
+	else:
+		say("Can't save into %s: pick a mod (top right)." % EditTarget.label())
+
+
+# --- Picking -------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func camera() -> Camera3D:
+	return get_viewport().get_camera_3d()
+
+
+## The ray under screen point `p` (global): [origin, direction].
+func pick_ray(p: Vector2) -> Array:
+	var cam := camera()
+	if cam == null:
+		return [Vector3.ZERO, Vector3.FORWARD]
+	return [cam.project_ray_origin(p), cam.project_ray_normal(p)]
+
+
+func _input(event: InputEvent) -> void:
+	var k := event as InputEventKey
+	if k and k.pressed and not k.echo:
+		if Keybinds.pressed(event, "live_edit") or (k.keycode == KEY_ESCAPE and not _has_dialog()):
+			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+			close()
+			return
+		if k.ctrl_pressed and k.keycode == KEY_S:
+			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+			save()
+			return
+		if k.keycode == KEY_F1:
+			get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+			EditorDocs.open(_panel, "live", EditorDocs.FILE)
+			return
+	var mb := event as InputEventMouseButton
+	if mb == null or not mb.pressed or mb.button_index != MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT:
+		return
+	if _panel.get_global_rect().has_point(mb.position) or _has_dialog() or _over_gui(mb.position):
+		return
+	get_viewport().set_input_as_handled()
+	var r := pick_ray(mb.position)
+	if _tab and _tab.has_method("pick_in_world") and _tab.pick_in_world(r[0], r[1]):
+		return
+	var hit := pick(r[0], r[1])
+	if hit:
+		select(hit)
+	else:
+		say("Nothing there.")
+
+
+func _has_dialog() -> bool:
+	return get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner() is LineEdit or get_viewport().gui_get_focus_owner() is TextEdit
+
+
+## A control (a dialog, its dimmed backdrop, the HUD's buttons) under `p` takes the
+## click - not a full-screen holder letting clicks through.
+func _over_gui(p: Vector2) -> bool:
+	var c := get_viewport().gui_get_hovered_control()
+	if c == null or not c.is_visible_in_tree() or c.mouse_filter == Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE:
+		return false
+	var full := c.get_global_rect().size.is_equal_approx(get_viewport().get_visible_rect().size)
+	return not full or c is ColorRect
+
+
+## What a ray first meets in the game's world: the nearest drawn thing (its mesh's
+## triangles; a scatter of many - flora, rocks - as a whole) - or null.
+func pick(o: Vector3, d: Vector3) -> Node:
+	var best: Node = null
+	var bd := INF
+	var stack: Array = [cosmos]
+	var cam := camera()
+	while not stack.is_empty():
+		var n: Node = stack.pop_back()
+		if n == self or n == cam:
+			continue
+		if n is Node3D and not (n as Node3D).visible:
+			continue
+		if n is CanvasItem or n is CanvasLayer or n is Viewport:
+			continue
+		for c in n.get_children():
+			stack.append(c)
+		if not n is GeometryInstance3D:
+			continue
+		var gi := n as GeometryInstance3D
+		var aabb := gi.global_transform * gi.get_aabb()
+		if aabb.size.length() > 400.0 and aabb.has_point(o):
+			continue   # (a sky, an atmosphere, the sea round you)
+		var at = aabb.intersects_ray(o, d)
+		if at == null and not aabb.has_point(o):
+			continue
+		var dist := (o - (at as Vector3)).length() if at != null else 0.0
+		if dist > bd:
+			continue
+		if gi is MeshInstance3D and (gi as MeshInstance3D).mesh:
+			var tm := _triangles((gi as MeshInstance3D).mesh)
+			if tm:
+				var inv := gi.global_transform.affine_inverse()
+				var res := tm.intersect_ray(inv * o, (inv.basis * d).normalized())
+				if res.is_empty():
+					continue
+				dist = (gi.global_transform * Vector3(res["position"]) - o).length()
+		if dist < bd:
+			bd = dist
+			best = gi
+	return best
+
+
+func _triangles(m: Mesh) -> TriangleMesh:
+	if _tri.has(m):
+		return _tri[m]
+	var n := 0
+	for s in m.get_surface_count():
+		var a := m.surface_get_arrays(s) if m is ArrayMesh else []
+		n += (a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] as PackedVector3Array).size() if a.size() > 0 and a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] != null else 0
+	var tm: TriangleMesh = m.generate_triangle_mesh() if n < 400000 else null
+	_tri[m] = tm
+	return tm
+
+
+# --- The selection --------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func select(n: Node) -> void:
+	_unbind()
+	if selected and is_instance_valid(selected):
+		SelectOutline.show(selected, false)
+	selected = n
+	SelectOutline.show(n, true)   # (outlined - and its box drawn)
+	var a := LiveEdits.anchor_of(n)
+	anchor = a[0]
+	key = a[1]
+	_title.text = _name_of(n)
+	_kind.text = ("Edits apply to %s." % kind_name(key)) if key != "" else "Not part of anything kept: edits last till it's gone."
+	_fill_parts()
+	_shown.clear()
+	UI.clear(_tab_bar)
+	for id in TABS:
+		var s = _scripts.get(id)
+		if s and s.handles(n):
+			_shown.append(id)
+			var b := _btn(str(s.TITLE), str(s.ICON), "", "The %s of what's picked." % str(s.TITLE).to_lower(), show_tab.bind(id))
+			b.name = "Tab_" + id
+			b.toggle_mode = true
+			_tab_bar.add_child(b)
+	if _shown.is_empty():
+		say("Nothing here to edit.")
+		return
+	show_tab(_tab_id if _tab_id in _shown else _shown[0])
+
+
+func show_tab(id: String) -> void:
+	_unbind()
+	_tab_id = id
+	for b in _tab_bar.get_children():
+		(b as Button).set_pressed_no_signal(b.name == "Tab_" + id)
+	_tab = _scripts[id].new()
+	_tab.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_tab_holder.add_child(_tab)
+	_tab.bind(self)
+
+
+## The tab showing now (its id "" - none).
+func tab() -> Control:
+	return _tab
+
+
+func _unbind() -> void:
+	if _tab and is_instance_valid(_tab):
+		_tab.unbind()
+		_tab.queue_free()
+	_tab = null
+
+
+func _fill_parts() -> void:
+	_parts.clear()
+	_parts.add_item("(its parts)")
+	_parts.set_item_metadata(0, null)
+	if selected == null:
+		return
+	var k := 0
+	for c in selected.get_children():
+		if c is Node3D and k < 60:
+			_parts.add_item(_name_of(c))
+			_parts.set_item_metadata(_parts.item_count - 1, c.get_instance_id())
+			k += 1
+
+
+static func _name_of(n: Node) -> String:
+	var s := str(n.name)
+	if s.contains("@"):
+		s = n.get_class()
+	if n.has_meta("model_id"):
+		s += "  (%s)" % n.get_meta("model_id")
+	return s
+
+
+## What a key stands for, in words: "every Cosmos Creature", "every town: athens port".
+static func kind_name(k: String) -> String:
+	if k.begins_with("res://"):
+		return "every " + k.get_file().get_basename().capitalize()
+	if k.contains("/"):
+		var parts := k.split("/")
+		return "every %s: %s" % [parts[0], " ".join(parts.slice(1))]
+	return "every " + k
+
+
+func _process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if selected and not is_instance_valid(selected):
+		_unbind()
+		selected = null
+		_title.text = "Gone"
+		UI.clear(_tab_bar)
+	if _tab and _tab.has_method("live_process"):
+		_tab.live_process(delta)
+	if _spread_t > 0.0:
+		_spread_t -= delta / maxf(Engine.time_scale, 0.01)
+		if _spread_t <= 0.0:
+			apply_everywhere()
+	_draw_box()
+
+
+func _draw_box() -> void:
+	_box_mesh.clear_surfaces()
+	if selected == null or not selected is Node3D or not (selected as Node3D).is_inside_tree():
+		return
+	var aabb := _aabb_of(selected)
+	if aabb.size == Vector3.ZERO:
+		return
+	_box_mesh.surface_begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_LINES)
+	_box_mesh.surface_set_color(Color(ACCENT, 0.9))
+	var p := aabb.position
+	var s := aabb.size
+	var c := [p, p + Vector3(s.x, 0, 0), p + Vector3(s.x, 0, s.z), p + Vector3(0, 0, s.z)]
+	for i in 4:
+		var a: Vector3 = c[i]
+		var b: Vector3 = c[(i + 1) % 4]
+		for y in [0.0, s.y]:
+			_box_mesh.surface_add_vertex(a + Vector3(0, y, 0))
+			_box_mesh.surface_add_vertex(b + Vector3(0, y, 0))
+		_box_mesh.surface_add_vertex(a)
+		_box_mesh.surface_add_vertex(a + Vector3(0, s.y, 0))
+	_box_mesh.surface_end()
+
+
+## `n`'s box (global): its own drawn box, or its drawn parts' together.
+func _aabb_of(n: Node) -> AABB:
+	if n is VisualInstance3D:
+		return (n as VisualInstance3D).global_transform * (n as VisualInstance3D).get_aabb()
+	var out := AABB()
+	var first := true
+	var k := 0
+	for c in n.find_children("*", "VisualInstance3D", true, false):
+		var b: AABB = (c as VisualInstance3D).global_transform * (c as VisualInstance3D).get_aabb()
+		out = b if first else out.merge(b)
+		first = false
+		k += 1
+		if k > 200:
+			break
+	if first and n is Node3D:
+		return AABB((n as Node3D).global_position - Vector3.ONE * 0.5, Vector3.ONE)
+	return out

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,277 @@ 
+class_name LiveEdits
+extends RefCounted
+## What the Live Editor changed, kept: the game's world is mostly made in code (a
+## town, a station, a creature, an effect...), so there's often no file to save an
+## edit into. Each edit is kept against the KIND of thing it was made on - its key
+## (key_of: "every Athenian station", "every wolf", "the player") - and the part of
+## it changed (a node path under it), and put back each time such a thing is made.
+##
+## data/live_edits.json (in a mod: its copy, or a .merge of it - Mods):
+##   {key: {section: {...}}}  - a section per Live Editor tab ("node", "material",
+##   "solids", "fx"...), its data the tab's own (JSON: Variants as var_to_str).
+## Each section is a Live Editor tab's: scripts/world/live/tabs/<section>_tab.gd, whose
+## `static func apply_edit(anchor: Node, data: Dictionary)` puts it back (loaded only
+## when some edit has that section; register() for one that isn't a tab).
+##
+## Keys: a node with meta "edit_key" is an anchor (builders set it: CosmosTown
+## "town/<empire>/<kind>", CosmosStation "station/<empire>"...); else the nearest
+## ancestor (or itself) with a script is, keyed by its script's file (or a scene's).
+## The anchor's applied when it enters the tree, and again a little later (its parts
+## are often built on workers and come in after it).
+
+const FILE := "res://data/live_edits.json"
+## Seconds after an anchor enters to put its edits back again (parts built later).
+const RETRIES := [0.6, 2.5, 8.0]
+
+static var data := {}             # key -> {section -> data}
+static var _loaded := false
+static var _appliers := {}         # section -> Callable(anchor: Node, data)
+static var _hooked: SceneTree
+static var _scripts := {}          # script path -> true (anchors that may have edits)
+## Edits made since the last save.
+static var dirty := false
+## Called before a save (a tab writing what it made: the Model tab's meshes, the Materials tab's pictures).
+static var before_save: Array = []
+
+
+static func load_all() -> void:
+	_loaded = true
+	data = {}
+	var t := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(FILE)
+	if t != "":
+		var d = JSON.parse_string(t)
+		if d is Dictionary:
+			data = d
+	_index()
+
+
+static func _index() -> void:
+	_scripts.clear()
+	for k in data:
+		if str(k).begins_with("res://"):
+			_scripts[str(k)] = true
+
+
+## Starts putting the edits back on the things made from now on (Cosmos, as the world's made).
+static func hook(tree: SceneTree) -> void:
+	if not _loaded:
+		load_all()
+	if _hooked == tree:
+		return
+	_hooked = tree
+	tree.node_added.connect(_on_node_added)
+
+
+static func register(section: String, applier: Callable) -> void:
+	_appliers[section] = applier
+
+
+## The kind of thing `n` is part of: [anchor node, its key] ([null, ""] - none).
+static func anchor_of(n: Node) -> Array:
+	var a := n
+	while a:
+		if a.has_meta("edit_key"):
+			return [a, str(a.get_meta("edit_key"))]
+		a = a.get_parent()
+	a = n
+	while a and a != a.get_tree().root:
+		if a.scene_file_path != "":
+			return [a, a.scene_file_path]
+		var s: Script = a.get_script()
+		if s and s.resource_path != "" and not s.resource_path.contains("::"):
+			return [a, s.resource_path]
+		a = a.get_parent()
+	return [null, ""]
+
+
+## `n`'s path under its anchor ("." - the anchor itself): its names, with the
+## engine's made-up ones (@MeshInstance3D@123) as the class and its place among
+## its siblings of that class.
+static func rel_path(anchor: Node, n: Node) -> String:
+	if n == anchor:
+		return "."
+	var parts := PackedStringArray()
+	var a := n
+	while a and a != anchor:
+		parts.insert(0, _name_of(a))
+		a = a.get_parent()
+	return "/".join(parts)
+
+
+static func _name_of(n: Node) -> String:
+	if not made_up(n):
+		return str(n.name)
+	var k := 0
+	var p := n.get_parent()
+	if p:
+		for c in p.get_children():
+			if c == n:
+				break
+			if c.get_class() == n.get_class() and made_up(c):
+				k += 1
+	return "%s#%d" % [n.get_class(), k]
+
+
+## `n`'s name is the engine's, not its maker's: "@MeshInstance3D@12", its copy's
+## "_MeshInstance3D_12", or the class's own ("MeshInstance3D", "MeshInstance3D2").
+static func made_up(n: Node) -> bool:
+	var s := str(n.name)
+	var cls := n.get_class()
+	if s.contains("@"):
+		return true
+	if s.begins_with("_" + cls + "_") and s.trim_prefix("_" + cls + "_").is_valid_int():
+		return true
+	return s == cls or (s.begins_with(cls) and s.trim_prefix(cls).is_valid_int())
+
+
+## The node at `rel` under `anchor` (null - not there, or not yet).
+static func find(anchor: Node, rel: String) -> Node:
+	if rel == "." or rel == "":
+		return anchor
+	var n := anchor
+	for part in rel.split("/"):
+		var next: Node = null
+		if part.contains("#"):
+			var cls := part.get_slice("#", 0)
+			var k := int(part.get_slice("#", 1))
+			for c in n.get_children():
+				if c.get_class() == cls and made_up(c):
+					if k == 0:
+						next = c
+						break
+					k -= 1
+		else:
+			next = n.get_node_or_null(NodePath(part))
+		if next == null:
+			return null
+		n = next
+	return n
+
+
+## A tab's section for `key` (made empty if new).
+static func section(key: String, sec: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if not _loaded:
+		load_all()
+	if not data.has(key):
+		data[key] = {}
+	if not data[key].has(sec):
+		data[key][sec] = {}
+	return data[key][sec]
+
+
+## Records that a section changed (saved later) and indexes the key.
+static func touched(key: String) -> void:
+	dirty = true
+	if key.begins_with("res://"):
+		_scripts[key] = true
+
+
+## Drops a key's section ("" - all of it).
+static func forget(key: String, sec := "") -> void:
+	if not data.has(key):
+		return
+	if sec == "":
+		data.erase(key)
+	else:
+		data[key].erase(sec)
+		if data[key].is_empty():
+			data.erase(key)
+	dirty = true
+	_index()
+
+
+## Writes the edits (the game's file, or the mod's - EditTarget): true when written.
+static func save() -> bool:
+	var et: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/edit_target.gd")
+	if not et.writable():
+		return false
+	for cb in before_save:
+		(cb as Callable).call()
+	var f := FileAccess.open(et.write_path(FILE), FileAccess.WRITE)
+	if f == null:
+		return false
+	f.store_string(JSON.stringify(data, "\t", true))
+	f.close()
+	dirty = false
+	return true
+
+
+## Puts the edits for `anchor`'s key back on it, every section.
+static func apply(anchor: Node, key := "") -> void:
+	if key == "":
+		key = str(anchor_of(anchor)[1])
+	if not data.has(key) or not is_instance_valid(anchor) or not anchor.is_inside_tree():
+		return
+	for sec in data[key]:
+		var f: Callable = _applier(str(sec))
+		if f.is_valid():
+			f.call(anchor, data[key][sec])
+
+
+## Section `sec`'s way back: registered, or its tab's static apply_edit.
+static func _applier(sec: String) -> Callable:
+	if _appliers.has(sec):
+		return _appliers[sec]
+	var path := "res://scripts/world/live/tabs/%s_tab.gd" % sec
+	var f := Callable()
+	if ResourceLoader.exists(path):
+		var s = load(path)
+		if s is GDScript and has_static(s, "apply_edit"):
+			f = Callable(s, "apply_edit")
+	_appliers[sec] = f
+	return f
+
+
+## Script `s` (compiled) has a function `fn` of its own.
+static func has_static(s: GDScript, fn: String) -> bool:
+	if s == null or not s.can_instantiate():
+		return false
+	for m in s.get_script_method_list():
+		if m["name"] == fn:
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+static func _on_node_added(n: Node) -> void:
+	if data.is_empty():
+		return
+	var key := ""
+	if n.has_meta("edit_key"):
+		key = str(n.get_meta("edit_key"))
+	elif n.scene_file_path != "" and data.has(n.scene_file_path):
+		key = n.scene_file_path
+	else:
+		var s: Script = n.get_script()
+		if s == null or not _scripts.has(s.resource_path):
+			return
+		key = s.resource_path
+	if not data.has(key):
+		return
+	_later(n, key, 0.0)
+	for t in RETRIES:
+		_later(n, key, t)
+
+
+static func _later(n: Node, key: String, t: float) -> void:
+	var w: WeakRef = weakref(n)
+	var go := func():
+		var o = w.get_ref()
+		if o:
+			apply(o, key)
+	if t <= 0.0:
+		go.call_deferred()
+	else:
+		n.get_tree().create_timer(t, false).timeout.connect(go)
+
+
+## Variants in JSON (vectors, colours, transforms...) and back.
+static func enc(v: Variant) -> Variant:
+	if v is bool or v is int or v is float or v is String:
+		return v
+	return {"v": var_to_str(v)}
+
+
+static func dec(v: Variant) -> Variant:
+	if v is Dictionary and v.has("v"):
+		return str_to_var(str(v["v"]))
+	return v
hunks.title: LiveEdits
hunks.note: Keys, sections, applying.

bubbles.text: Parts built later (on workers) get the edit when they appear.
Which thing a node belongs to and its key: town/..., station/..., or its script's file.
Every node added is checked once against the keys that have edits: one lookup.

files.explanation: One way to read and write what's solid in any kind of place (town, structure, dungeon, station, hangar, ship interior); edits kept as differences from what's built.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,456 @@ 
+class_name SolidsEdit
+extends RefCounted
+## One way to read and edit what's solid, whatever kind of place holds it (the
+## Live Editor's Collision tab, its tests). The game's collision is its own
+## geometry, no physics bodies, kept by each kind of place in its own form:
+##   CosmosSolids (a town, a structure of yours) - AABBs and Prisms in a grid;
+##   CosmosDungeon - AABBs in a grid;
+##   CosmosStation - oriented boxes and cylinders (_solids: [ring?, centre, bound, inverse, half, cylinder?, basis]);
+##   CosmosHangar - the camera's boxes (_boxes) and the feet's footprints (_blocks);
+##   CosmosNpcInterior - the furniture's footprints (blocks).
+## Here each is a list of shapes in the node's own space:
+##   {kind: "box" | "obox" | "cyl" | "prism", xf: Transform3D (its middle, its turn),
+##    half: Vector3, on: bool (solid - off: kept, shown, not in the way),
+##    use: "" | "cam" | "walk" | "both" (the hangar's: what it stops), ro: bool (a
+##    sloped or many-sided prism: deleted or turned off, not moved), src (the prism), id (its index in the base)}.
+## Nothing here runs while nobody edits: the systems keep their own arrays and
+## lookups; set_boxes rebuilds them once, at the edit.
+##
+## Persisted (LiveEdits, section "collision"): the edit as a difference from what
+## the place builds (`base`) - {path, del: [shape], mod: [[from, to]], add: [shape]}
+## (shapes encoded: enc_shape) - put back by matching the shapes it changed, so it
+## holds while the place is built the same (its key: the builders' "edit_key").
+
+const SECTION := "collision"
+const EPS := 0.03                # m: two shapes the same (matching an edit to what's built)
+const WALK_H := 1.2              # m: how high a footprint (the hangar's, an interior's) is drawn
+
+
+## The kind of collision `n` itself keeps ("" - none).
+static func kind_of(n: Object) -> String:
+	if n is CosmosSolids:
+		return "solids"
+	if n is CosmosDungeon:
+		return "dungeon"
+	if n is CosmosStation:
+		return "station"
+	if n is CosmosHangar:
+		return "hangar"
+	if n is CosmosNpcInterior:
+		return "interior"
+	return ""
+
+
+## The node holding the solids `n` is part of: itself or its nearest such ancestor (null - none).
+static func owner_of(n: Node) -> Node:
+	var a := n
+	while a:
+		if kind_of(a) != "":
+			return a
+		a = a.get_parent()
+	return null
+
+
+## How its boxes may turn: "none" (axis-aligned), "yaw" (about up), "full".
+static func rotation_of(n: Node) -> String:
+	match kind_of(n):
+		"solids":
+			return "yaw"
+		"station":
+			return "full"
+	return "none"
+
+
+## Its solids are in (built) - nothing to edit before.
+static func has_solids(n: Node) -> bool:
+	var src = _primary(n)
+	return src is Array and not (src as Array).is_empty()
+
+
+## Its solids are still the ones last read or set here (not built again since).
+static func current(n: Node) -> bool:
+	return n.has_meta("solids_base") and _same_src(n, _primary(n))
+
+
+## Its shapes as they are now (edited or as built) - copies, free to change.
+static func boxes(n: Node) -> Array:
+	base(n)
+	return _copy(n.get_meta("solids_now") if n.has_meta("solids_now") else n.get_meta("solids_base", []))
+
+
+## Its shapes as it built them (read once a build: the edits' reference).
+static func base(n: Node) -> Array:
+	var src = _primary(n)
+	if n.has_meta("solids_base") and _same_src(n, src):
+		return n.get_meta("solids_base")
+	var b := _read(n)
+	for i in b.size():
+		b[i]["id"] = i
+	n.set_meta("solids_base", b)
+	n.remove_meta("solids_now")
+	_mark_src(n, src)
+	return b
+
+
+## Replaces its solids with `shapes` (those on) and rebuilds its lookups, at once.
+static func set_boxes(n: Node, shapes: Array) -> void:
+	base(n)   # (what it built, read before it's replaced)
+	var list := _copy(shapes)
+	match kind_of(n):
+		"solids":
+			_set_solids(n, list)
+		"dungeon":
+			_set_dungeon(n, list)
+		"station":
+			_set_station(n, list)
+		"hangar":
+			_set_hangar(n, list)
+		"interior":
+			_set_interior(n, list)
+		_:
+			return
+	n.set_meta("solids_now", list)
+	_mark_src(n, _primary(n))
+
+
+## Back to what it built.
+static func revert(n: Node) -> void:
+	if n.has_meta("solids_base"):
+		set_boxes(n, n.get_meta("solids_base"))
+		n.remove_meta("solids_now")
+
+
+# --- Edits kept: the difference from what's built ------------------------------------
+
+## Its edit as a record ({} - nothing changed): what was deleted, changed, added.
+static func record(n: Node) -> Dictionary:
+	var b := base(n)
+	var now: Array = n.get_meta("solids_now", b)
+	var seen := {}
+	var dels: Array = []
+	var mods: Array = []
+	var adds: Array = []
+	for s: Dictionary in now:
+		var i := int(s.get("id", -1))
+		if i >= 0 and i < b.size() and not seen.has(i):
+			seen[i] = true
+			if not same(b[i], s):
+				mods.append([enc_shape(b[i]), enc_shape(s)])
+		else:
+			adds.append(enc_shape(s))
+	for i in b.size():
+		if not seen.has(i):
+			dels.append(enc_shape(b[i]))
+	if dels.is_empty() and mods.is_empty() and adds.is_empty():
+		return {}
+	return {"del": dels, "mod": mods, "add": adds}
+
+
+## Puts a record back on `n` (as built - each change found by the shape it
+## changed; one not found is let be): true when it changed something. Again and
+## again is the same (always from what it built).
+static func apply_record(n: Node, rec: Dictionary) -> bool:
+	if kind_of(n) == "" or not has_solids(n):
+		return false
+	var b := base(n)
+	var out: Array = _copy(b)
+	var used := {}
+	var changed := false
+	for e in rec.get("del", []):
+		var j := _match(b, dec_shape(e), used)
+		if j >= 0:
+			used[j] = true
+			out[j] = null
+			changed = true
+	for e in rec.get("mod", []):
+		var j := _match(b, dec_shape(e[0]), used)
+		if j < 0:
+			continue
+		used[j] = true
+		var to := dec_shape(e[1])
+		if bool(b[j].get("ro", false)):   # (a prism: only its being solid changes)
+			to = (b[j] as Dictionary).duplicate()
+			to["on"] = bool(dec_shape(e[1]).get("on", true))
+		to["id"] = j
+		out[j] = to
+		changed = true
+	for e in rec.get("add", []):
+		var s := dec_shape(e)
+		s["id"] = -1
+		out.append(s)
+		changed = true
+	if not changed:
+		return false
+	set_boxes(n, out.filter(func(s): return s != null))
+	return true
+
+
+## A place's solids just came in (its builder calls this, a dictionary lookup):
+## its kind's kept edit put back on them now, not at the next of LiveEdits' tries.
+static func installed(n: Node) -> void:
+	if not n.has_meta("edit_key"):
+		return
+	if not LiveEdits._loaded:
+		LiveEdits.load_all()
+	var d = LiveEdits.data.get(str(n.get_meta("edit_key")), {})
+	if d is Dictionary and (d as Dictionary).get(SECTION) is Dictionary and not (d[SECTION] as Dictionary).is_empty():
+		apply_record(n, d[SECTION])
+
+
+static func _match(b: Array, s: Dictionary, used: Dictionary) -> int:
+	for j in b.size():
+		if not used.has(j) and same(b[j], s, true):
+			return j
+	return -1
+
+
+## Two shapes the same (within EPS). `shape_only`: whether they're solid aside.
+static func same(a: Dictionary, b: Dictionary, shape_only := false) -> bool:
+	if str(a.get("kind")) != str(b.get("kind")) or str(a.get("use", "")) != str(b.get("use", "")):
+		return false
+	if not shape_only and bool(a.get("on", true)) != bool(b.get("on", true)):
+		return false
+	var xa: Transform3D = a["xf"]
+	var xb: Transform3D = b["xf"]
+	if xa.origin.distance_to(xb.origin) > EPS or (a["half"] as Vector3).distance_to(b["half"]) > EPS:
+		return false
+	for k in 3:
+		if xa.basis[k].distance_to(xb.basis[k]) > 0.01:
+			return false
+	return true
+
+
+## A shape for JSON (LiveEdits.enc for its numbers).
+static func enc_shape(s: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var xf: Transform3D = s["xf"]
+	var d := {"k": str(s["kind"]), "c": LiveEdits.enc(xf.origin), "h": LiveEdits.enc(s["half"]), "on": bool(s.get("on", true))}
+	if not xf.basis.is_equal_approx(Basis.IDENTITY):
+		d["b"] = LiveEdits.enc(xf.basis)
+	if str(s.get("use", "")) != "":
+		d["u"] = str(s["use"])
+	return d
+
+
+static func dec_shape(d: Dictionary) -> Dictionary:
+	var b: Basis = LiveEdits.dec(d["b"]) if d.has("b") else Basis.IDENTITY
+	var c: Vector3 = LiveEdits.dec(d.get("c"))
+	var h: Vector3 = LiveEdits.dec(d.get("h"))
+	return {"kind": str(d.get("k", "box")), "xf": Transform3D(b, c), "half": h, "on": bool(d.get("on", true)),
+		"use": str(d.get("u", "")), "ro": str(d.get("k", "")) == "prism"}
+
+
+## A plain box (an editor's new one): centre, half size, its turn.
+static func make(c: Vector3, half: Vector3, b := Basis.IDENTITY, use := "") -> Dictionary:
+	return {"kind": "box", "xf": Transform3D(b, c), "half": half.abs(), "on": true, "use": use, "ro": false, "id": -1}
+
+
+## A shape's bounds (its own space -> the node's): an AABB.
+static func bounds(s: Dictionary) -> AABB:
+	var h: Vector3 = s["half"]
+	return (s["xf"] as Transform3D) * AABB(-h, h * 2.0)
+
+
+## Where the ray (node space) first meets the shape (INF: not within `limit`).
+static func ray(s: Dictionary, o: Vector3, d: Vector3, limit: float) -> float:
+	var inv := (s["xf"] as Transform3D).affine_inverse()
+	var h: Vector3 = s["half"]
+	var t := CosmosSolids._ray_box(inv * o, inv.basis * d, AABB(-h, h * 2.0), limit)
+	return t
+
+
+## How far `p` (node space) is from the shape (0 inside).
+static func distance(s: Dictionary, p: Vector3) -> float:
+	var xf: Transform3D = s["xf"]
+	var l := xf.affine_inverse() * p
+	var h: Vector3 = s["half"]
+	return (xf.basis * (l - l.clamp(-h, h))).length()
+
+
+# --- Each system: its array, read and written ------------------------------------------
+
+## The array a system's solids are installed as (to tell a new build from ours).
+static func _primary(n: Node) -> Variant:
+	match kind_of(n):
+		"solids", "dungeon", "station":
+			return n.get("_solids")
+		"hangar":
+			return n.get("_boxes")
+		"interior":
+			return n.get("blocks")
+	return null
+
+
+static func _same_src(n: Node, src: Variant) -> bool:
+	return n.has_meta("solids_src") and is_same(n.get_meta("solids_src"), src) and src is Array \
+		and int(n.get_meta("solids_n", -1)) == (src as Array).size()
+
+
+static func _mark_src(n: Node, src: Variant) -> void:
+	n.set_meta("solids_src", src)
+	n.set_meta("solids_n", (src as Array).size() if src is Array else -1)
+
+
+static func _copy(list: Array) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	for s in list:
+		out.append((s as Dictionary).duplicate() if s is Dictionary else s)
+	return out
+
+
+static func _read(n: Node) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	match kind_of(n):
+		"solids", "dungeon":
+			for s in n.get("_solids"):
+				out.append(_from_block(s))
+		"station":
+			for s: Array in n.get("_solids"):
+				out.append({"kind": "cyl" if s[5] else "obox", "xf": Transform3D(s[6], s[1]), "half": s[4], "on": true,
+					"use": "", "ro": bool(s[0]), "ring": bool(s[0])})
+		"hangar":
+			var feet := {}   # (a footprint the same as a camera box's: one box, both)
+			for i in (n.get("_blocks") as Array).size():
+				var bl: Array = n.get("_blocks")[i]
+				var k := _foot_key(bl[0], bl[1], bl[2], bl[3])
+				if not feet.has(k):
+					feet[k] = []
+				feet[k].append(i)
+			var taken := {}
+			for bx: Array in n.get("_boxes"):
+				var c: Vector3 = bx[0]
+				var h: Vector3 = bx[1]
+				var k := _foot_key(c.x - h.x, c.z - h.z, c.x + h.x, c.z + h.z)
+				var use := "cam"
+				for i in feet.get(k, []):
+					if not taken.has(i):
+						taken[i] = true
+						use = "both"
+						break
+				out.append(make(c, h, Basis.IDENTITY, use))
+			for i in (n.get("_blocks") as Array).size():
+				if not taken.has(i):
+					var bl: Array = n.get("_blocks")[i]
+					out.append(_foot(bl, 0.0, "walk"))
+		"interior":
+			for bl: Array in n.get("blocks"):
+				out.append(_foot(bl, float(n.get("sill")), "walk"))
+	for s in out:
+		s["on"] = true
+	return out
+
+
+static func _foot_key(x0: float, z0: float, x1: float, z1: float) -> String:
+	return "%d,%d,%d,%d" % [roundi(x0 * 20.0), roundi(z0 * 20.0), roundi(x1 * 20.0), roundi(z1 * 20.0)]
+
+
+static func _foot(bl: Array, y0: float, use: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var c := Vector3((float(bl[0]) + float(bl[2])) * 0.5, y0 + WALK_H * 0.5, (float(bl[1]) + float(bl[3])) * 0.5)
+	return make(c, Vector3((float(bl[2]) - float(bl[0])) * 0.5, WALK_H * 0.5, (float(bl[3]) - float(bl[1])) * 0.5), Basis.IDENTITY, use)
+
+
+## A CosmosSolids block as a shape: an AABB; a Prism that's a flat-topped
+## rectangle, a box turned about up; any other prism, read-only.
+static func _from_block(s: Variant) -> Dictionary:
+	if s is AABB:
+		var b: AABB = s
+		return make(b.get_center(), b.size * 0.5)
+	var pr: CosmosSolids.Prism = s
+	var p := pr.poly
+	if pr.planes.is_empty() and p.size() == 4:
+		var e0 := p[1] - p[0]
+		var e1 := p[2] - p[1]
+		var e2 := p[3] - p[2]
+		if absf(e0.dot(e1)) < 1e-3 * e0.length() * e1.length() and (e0 + e2).length() < 1e-3:
+			var c := (p[0] + p[1] + p[2] + p[3]) * 0.25
+			var yaw := atan2(-e0.y, e0.x)
+			var sh := make(Vector3(c.x, (pr.y0 + pr.y1) * 0.5, c.y), Vector3(e0.length() * 0.5, (pr.y1 - pr.y0) * 0.5, e1.length() * 0.5),
+				Basis(Vector3.UP, yaw))
+			return sh
+	var a := pr.aabb()
+	return {"kind": "prism", "xf": Transform3D(Basis.IDENTITY, a.get_center()), "half": a.size * 0.5, "on": true,
+		"use": "", "ro": true, "src": pr}
+
+
+## A shape as a CosmosSolids block (null - off).
+static func _to_block(s: Dictionary, yaw_ok := true) -> Variant:
+	if not bool(s.get("on", true)):
+		return null
+	if str(s["kind"]) == "prism":
+		return s.get("src")
+	var xf: Transform3D = s["xf"]
+	var h: Vector3 = s["half"]
+	var bx := xf.basis.orthonormalized()
+	if bx.is_equal_approx(Basis.IDENTITY) or not yaw_ok:
+		return xf * AABB(-h, h * 2.0)
+	var yaw := atan2(-bx.x.z, bx.x.x)
+	var r := Basis(Vector3.UP, yaw)
+	var c := xf.origin
+	var poly := PackedVector2Array()
+	for q in [Vector2(-h.x, -h.z), Vector2(h.x, -h.z), Vector2(h.x, h.z), Vector2(-h.x, h.z)]:
+		var w := r * Vector3(q.x, 0.0, q.y)
+		poly.append(Vector2(c.x + w.x, c.z + w.z))
+	return CosmosSolids.Prism.new(poly, c.y - h.y, c.y + h.y)
+
+
+static func _set_solids(n: Node, list: Array) -> void:
+	var solids: Array = []
+	for s in list:
+		var b = _to_block(s)
+		if b != null:
+			solids.append(b)
+	n.set("_solids", solids)
+	n.set("_grid", CosmosSolids.grid_of(solids))
+
+
+static func _set_dungeon(n: Node, list: Array) -> void:
+	var solids: Array = []
+	for s in list:
+		var b = _to_block(s, false)
+		if b != null:
+			solids.append(b)
+	n.set("_solids", solids)
+	n.set("_grid", CosmosSolids.grid_of(solids))   # (its cells: CosmosTown.CELL, the same 8 m)
+
+
+static func _set_station(n: Node, list: Array) -> void:
+	var solids: Array = []
+	var bound := 0.0
+	for s: Dictionary in list:
+		if not bool(s.get("on", true)):
+			continue
+		var xf: Transform3D = s["xf"]
+		var h: Vector3 = s["half"]
+		var cyl := str(s["kind"]) == "cyl"
+		if cyl:
+			h.z = h.x
+		solids.append([bool(s.get("ring", false)), xf.origin, h.length(), xf.affine_inverse(), h, cyl, xf.basis])
+		bound = maxf(bound, xf.origin.length() + h.length())
+	n.set("_solids", solids)
+	n.set("_bound", maxf(bound, 1.0))
+
+
+static func _set_hangar(n: Node, list: Array) -> void:
+	var cam: Array = []
+	var feet: Array = []
+	for s: Dictionary in list:
+		if not bool(s.get("on", true)):
+			continue
+		var bb := bounds(s)
+		var use := str(s.get("use", ""))
+		if use != "walk":
+			cam.append([bb.get_center(), bb.size * 0.5])
+		if use != "cam":
+			feet.append([bb.position.x, bb.position.z, bb.end.x, bb.end.z])
+	n.set("_boxes", cam)
+	n.set("_blocks", feet)
+	n.set("_cells", {})
+	n.set("_cells_n", -1)   # (its cells of blocks made again at the next look)
+
+
+static func _set_interior(n: Node, list: Array) -> void:
+	var feet: Array = []
+	for s: Dictionary in list:
+		if bool(s.get("on", true)):
+			var bb := bounds(s)
+			feet.append([bb.position.x, bb.position.z, bb.end.x, bb.end.z])
+	n.set("blocks", feet)

+extends VBoxContainer
+## The Live Editor's Animation tab: the clips of what's picked (its AnimationPlayer)
+## - which one's playing and where, any of them played on it now, its speed - and
+## the animation editor in a window over the running game, open on its character and
+## clip: saved there, a clip changes on every character of that model at once (their
+## clips are shared). Kept (LiveEdits, section "anim"): {rel path: {"speed": x}}.
+
+const TITLE := "Animation"
+const ICON := "anim"
+
+var ed: Node
+var _ap: AnimationPlayer
+var _now: Label
+var _list: ItemList
+var _t := 0.0
+
+
+static func handles(n: Node) -> bool:
+	return _player_of(n) != null
+
+
+## The AnimationPlayer of `n`'s character: under it, or under the thing it's part of.
+static func _player_of(n: Node) -> AnimationPlayer:
+	var a := n
+	for i in 6:
+		if a == null:
+			break
+		var found := a.find_children("*", "AnimationPlayer", true, false)
+		if not found.is_empty():
+			return found[0]
+		if a.has_meta("edit_key") or a.has_meta("model_id"):
+			break
+		a = a.get_parent()
+	return null
+
+
+static func model_id(ap: AnimationPlayer) -> String:
+	var a: Node = ap
+	while a:
+		if a.has_meta("model_id"):
+			return str(a.get_meta("model_id"))
+		a = a.get_parent()
+	return ""
+
+
+func bind(e: Node) -> void:
+	ed = e
+	_ap = _player_of(ed.selected)
+	var id := model_id(_ap)
+	add_child(LiveFields.head("CLIPS" + ("  ·  " + id if id != "" else "")))
+	_now = UI.label("", 14)
+	add_child(_now)
+	_list = ItemList.new()
+	_list.custom_minimum_size.y = 260
+	_list.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	for c in _ap.get_animation_list():
+		var a := _ap.get_animation(c)
+		_list.add_item("%s   %.2f s%s" % [c, a.length, "  loop" if a.loop_mode != Animation.LOOP_NONE else ""])
+		_list.set_item_metadata(_list.item_count - 1, c)
+	_list.item_activated.connect(func(i): _ap.play(str(_list.get_item_metadata(i))))
+	_list.tooltip_text = "Double-click a clip to play it on this one now."
+	add_child(_list)
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	var play := UI.button("Play", func():
+		var s := _list.get_selected_items()
+		if not s.is_empty():
+			_ap.play(str(_list.get_item_metadata(s[0]))), 14)
+	EditorIcons.dress(play, "play", EditorIcons.tip("Play", "", "Plays the selected clip on this one now (its own behaviour takes over again when it picks its next clip)."))
+	play.text = "Play"
+	h.add_child(play)
+	if id != "" and ResourceLoader.exists(TalosNav.SCENES["anim"]):
+		var edit := UI.button("Animation editor", _edit, 14)
+		EditorIcons.dress(edit, "anim", EditorIcons.tip("Animation editor", "", "Opens the animation editor over the running game, on this character and its clip. Saved there, the clip changes on every %s at once." % id))
+		edit.text = "Animation editor"
+		h.add_child(edit)
+	add_child(h)
+	var rel := LiveEdits.rel_path(ed.anchor, _ap) if ed.anchor else "."
+	add_child(LiveFields.row("Speed", _ap.speed_scale, func(v):
+		_ap.speed_scale = v
+		if ed.key != "":
+			var sec := LiveEdits.section(ed.key, "anim")
+			sec[rel] = {"speed": v}
+			ed.edited("anim"), "0,3,0.01", "How fast its clips play: 1 as made, 0 frozen, 2 twice as fast. Kept for every one of its kind."))
+
+
+func unbind() -> void:
+	ed = null
+
+
+func _edit() -> void:
+	var t: Node = ed.open_tool("anim", "Animation: " + model_id(_ap))
+	t.open_character(model_id(_ap))
+	if _ap.current_animation != "":
+		t.select_clip(_ap.current_animation)
+
+
+func live_process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t -= delta
+	if _t > 0.0 or not is_instance_valid(_ap):
+		return
+	_t = 0.1
+	_now.text = ("Playing: %s  %.2f / %.2f s" % [_ap.current_animation, _ap.current_animation_position, _ap.current_animation_length]) if _ap.is_playing() else "Not playing"
+
+
+static func apply_edit(anchor: Node, data: Dictionary) -> void:
+	for rel in data:
+		var ap := LiveEdits.find(anchor, str(rel)) as AnimationPlayer
+		if ap and data[rel].has("speed"):
+			ap.speed_scale = float(data[rel]["speed"])
