@@ -1,0 +1,497 @@ 
+extends VBoxContainer
+## The Live Editor's Collision tab: what's solid in the place picked - a town's
+## buildings, a structure of yours, a station's parts, a port's walls and things,
+## a ship's furniture, a dungeon's walls - its boxes drawn in the world as lines
+## (near the camera), picked with a click there or from the list, moved, sized,
+## turned, added, copied, deleted, made solid or not. The walker and the camera
+## meet the edited boxes at once (SolidsEdit sets them into the place's own lookups).
+## Kept (LiveEdits, section "collision"): the edit as a difference from what the
+## place builds (SolidsEdit.record) - put back each time it's built (its builder:
+## SolidsEdit.installed), so it holds for that place (its key: town by its seed,
+## station by its id...).
+
+const TITLE := "Collision"
+const ICON := "wall"
+const REACH := 60.0          # m: the boxes drawn and listed round the camera
+const LISTED := 200          # (the list's longest)
+const C_SOLID := Color(0.35, 0.9, 1.0, 0.8)
+const C_FEET := Color(0.45, 1.0, 0.5, 0.8)
+const C_CAM := Color(0.75, 0.55, 1.0, 0.8)
+const C_OFF := Color(0.6, 0.6, 0.6, 0.45)
+const C_SEL := Color(1.0, 0.72, 0.2, 1.0)
+const KINDS := {"box": "box", "obox": "box", "cyl": "cylinder", "prism": "sloped block"}
+const USES := [["both", "Camera and feet"], ["cam", "Camera only"], ["walk", "Feet only"]]
+
+var ed: Node
+var _owner: Node             # what holds the solids (SolidsEdit.owner_of the picked)
+var _anchor: Node
+var _key := ""
+var _rel := "."
+var _rot := "none"
+var _shapes: Array = []      # SolidsEdit shapes, as edited
+var _sel := -1
+var _listed: Array = []      # the list's rows -> shape index
+var _info: Label
+var _list: ItemList
+var _fields: VBoxContainer
+var _xray: CheckBox
+var _overlay: MeshInstance3D
+var _im: ImmediateMesh
+var _drawn_at := Vector3.INF
+var _redraw := true
+var _t := 0.0
+
+static var _mat_depth: StandardMaterial3D
+static var _mat_xray: StandardMaterial3D
+
+
+static func handles(n: Node) -> bool:
+	return SolidsEdit.owner_of(n) != null
+
+
+## A kept edit put back on `anchor` (LiveEdits - as such a place is made): on its
+## solids' holder at `path` under it.
+static func apply_edit(anchor: Node, data: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var o: Node = LiveEdits.find(anchor, str(data.get("path", ".")))
+	if o == null or SolidsEdit.kind_of(o) == "":
+		o = SolidsEdit.owner_of(anchor)
+	if o:
+		SolidsEdit.apply_record(o, data)
+
+
+func bind(e: Node) -> void:
+	ed = e
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	_owner = SolidsEdit.owner_of(ed.selected)
+	var a := LiveEdits.anchor_of(_owner)
+	_anchor = a[0]
+	_key = a[1]
+	_rel = LiveEdits.rel_path(_anchor, _owner) if _anchor else "."
+	_rot = SolidsEdit.rotation_of(_owner)
+	add_child(LiveFields.head("SOLIDS"))
+	_info = UI.note("", 13, 420.0)
+	add_child(_info)
+	_xray = CheckBox.new()
+	_xray.text = "Show through walls"
+	_xray.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	_xray.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
+	_xray.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Show through walls", "", "Draws the solid boxes over everything, not hidden behind walls and floors.")
+	_xray.toggled.connect(func(_v): _redraw = true)
+	add_child(_xray)
+	_list = ItemList.new()
+	_list.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 220)
+	_list.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
+	_list.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	_list.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Solids nearby", "", "The solid boxes nearest the camera: number, kind, distance. Click one to select it\n(or click a box in the world); its fields show below.")
+	_list.item_selected.connect(func(i): _select(int(_listed[i]) if i < _listed.size() else -1, false))
+	add_child(_list)
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	row.add_child(_btn("Add", "add", "A new box: round what's picked if it's small, else in front of the camera.", _add))
+	row.add_child(_btn("Copy", "duplicate", "A copy of the selected box, a metre over.", _duplicate))
+	row.add_child(_btn("Delete", "delete", "The selected box gone.", _delete))
+	add_child(row)
+	var row2 := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row2.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	row2.add_child(_btn("Revert", "undo", "This place's solids as it builds them: its kept collision edits forgotten.", _revert))
+	row2.add_child(_btn("Save", "save", "Keeps the edits (into the game, or the mod picked at the top).", _save))
+	add_child(row2)
+	add_child(LiveFields.head("SELECTED BOX"))
+	_fields = VBoxContainer.new()
+	_fields.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
+	add_child(_fields)
+	_im = ImmediateMesh.new()
+	_overlay = MeshInstance3D.new()
+	_overlay.name = "SolidsOverlay"
+	_overlay.mesh = _im
+	_overlay.top_level = true
+	_overlay.cast_shadow = GeometryInstance3D.SHADOW_CASTING_SETTING_OFF
+	add_child(_overlay)   # (a 3D node under the tab: drawn in the game's world, gone with the tab)
+	_load()
+	_fill_fields()
+
+
+func unbind() -> void:
+	if _overlay and is_instance_valid(_overlay):
+		_overlay.queue_free()
+	_overlay = null
+	ed = null
+
+
+func _btn(text: String, icon: String, help: String, cb: Callable) -> Button:
+	var b := UI.button(text, cb, 14)
+	b.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	b.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	EditorIcons.dress(b, icon, EditorIcons.tip(text, "", help))
+	b.text = text
+	return b
+
+
+# --- Its shapes ----------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _load() -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(_owner):
+		return
+	if not SolidsEdit.has_solids(_owner):
+		_shapes = []
+		_info.text = "%s: its solids aren't built yet (they come in as you near it)." % _owner.name
+		return
+	var keep := _sel
+	_shapes = SolidsEdit.boxes(_owner)
+	_sel = keep if keep < _shapes.size() else -1
+	var off := _shapes.filter(func(s): return not bool(s.get("on", true))).size()
+	_info.text = "%s - %d solid shapes%s. Click one in the world, or below (those within %d m)." % [
+		_owner.name, _shapes.size() - off, (", %d off" % off) if off > 0 else "", int(REACH)]
+	if _key == "":
+		_info.text += " Not kept: this isn't a kind of thing the game makes again."
+	_redraw = true
+	_drawn_at = Vector3.INF
+
+
+## The shapes changed: into the place at once, kept, redrawn.
+func _apply() -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(_owner):
+		return
+	SolidsEdit.set_boxes(_owner, _shapes)
+	if _key != "":
+		var rec := SolidsEdit.record(_owner)
+		if rec.is_empty():
+			LiveEdits.forget(_key, SolidsEdit.SECTION)
+		else:
+			rec["path"] = _rel
+			var sec := LiveEdits.section(_key, SolidsEdit.SECTION)
+			sec.clear()
+			sec.merge(rec)
+			LiveEdits.touched(_key)
+	if ed:
+		ed.edited(SolidsEdit.SECTION)
+	_redraw = true
+	_drawn_at = Vector3.INF
+
+
+func _select(i: int, from_world := true) -> void:
+	_sel = i
+	_fill_fields()
+	_redraw = true
+	if from_world:
+		_drawn_at = Vector3.INF   # (the list again, the picked row in it)
+
+
+func _new_use() -> String:
+	match SolidsEdit.kind_of(_owner):
+		"hangar":
+			return "both"
+		"interior":
+			return "walk"
+	return ""
+
+
+func _add() -> void:
+	if not SolidsEdit.has_solids(_owner):
+		return
+	var inv := (_owner as Node3D).global_transform.affine_inverse()
+	var s := {}
+	var sel = ed.selected if ed else null
+	if sel is Node3D and sel != _owner and ed.has_method("_aabb_of"):
+		var g: AABB = ed.call("_aabb_of", sel)
+		var l := inv * g
+		if l.size != Vector3.ZERO and maxf(l.size.x, maxf(l.size.y, l.size.z)) < 40.0:
+			s = SolidsEdit.make(l.get_center(), l.size * 0.5, Basis.IDENTITY, _new_use())
+	if s.is_empty():
+		var cam: Camera3D = ed.camera() if ed else null
+		var at := Vector3.ZERO
+		if cam:
+			var fwd := inv.basis * -cam.global_basis.z
+			fwd.y = 0.0
+			at = inv * cam.global_position + (fwd.normalized() if fwd.length() > 0.01 else Vector3.ZERO) * 4.0
+		s = SolidsEdit.make(at, Vector3(0.5, 1.0, 0.5), Basis.IDENTITY, _new_use())
+	_shapes.append(s)
+	_apply()
+	_select(_shapes.size() - 1)
+	_say("A box added: size it and move it below.")
+
+
+func _duplicate() -> void:
+	if _sel < 0 or _sel >= _shapes.size():
+		_say("Pick a box first.")
+		return
+	var src: Dictionary = _shapes[_sel]
+	var s: Dictionary
+	if bool(src.get("ro", false)):   # (a sloped block: copied as a box round it)
+		var b := SolidsEdit.bounds(src)
+		s = SolidsEdit.make(b.get_center(), b.size * 0.5, Basis.IDENTITY, str(src.get("use", "")))
+	else:
+		s = src.duplicate()
+		s.erase("src")
+		s["id"] = -1
+		s["ring"] = false
+	var xf: Transform3D = s["xf"]
+	xf.origin += xf.basis.x.normalized() * 1.0
+	s["xf"] = xf
+	_shapes.append(s)
+	_apply()
+	_select(_shapes.size() - 1)
+
+
+func _delete() -> void:
+	if _sel < 0 or _sel >= _shapes.size():
+		_say("Pick a box first.")
+		return
+	_shapes.remove_at(_sel)
+	_sel = -1
+	_apply()
+	_fill_fields()
+
+
+func _revert() -> void:
+	if not is_instance_valid(_owner):
+		return
+	SolidsEdit.revert(_owner)
+	if _key != "":
+		LiveEdits.forget(_key, SolidsEdit.SECTION)
+	_sel = -1
+	_load()
+	_fill_fields()
+	_say("As it's built: its collision edits forgotten.")
+
+
+func _save() -> void:
+	if ed and ed.has_method("save"):
+		ed.save()
+	elif LiveEdits.save():
+		_say("Saved.")
+	else:
+		_say("Can't save here: pick a mod.")
+
+
+func _say(t: String) -> void:
+	if ed:
+		ed.say(t)
+
+
+# --- The selected box's fields -------------------------------------------------------
+
+func _fill_fields() -> void:
+	if _fields == null:
+		return
+	UI.clear(_fields)
+	if _sel < 0 or _sel >= _shapes.size():
+		_fields.add_child(UI.note("None: click a box in the world, or one in the list.", 13, 420.0))
+		return
+	var s: Dictionary = _shapes[_sel]
+	var xf: Transform3D = s["xf"]
+	var ro := bool(s.get("ro", false))
+	_fields.add_child(UI.label("#%d  %s" % [_sel, _describe(s)], 14))
+	_fields.add_child(LiveFields.row("Solid", bool(s.get("on", true)), func(v): _change(_sel, "on", v), "", "Off: the box stops nothing (kept, drawn grey) - a gap without deleting it."))
+	if ro:
+		_fields.add_child(UI.note("A sloped or many-sided block: it can be turned off, copied (as a box) or deleted, not moved.", 13, 420.0))
+		return
+	_fields.add_child(LiveFields.row("Centre (m)", xf.origin, func(v): _change(_sel, "centre", v), "", "The box's middle (metres), in the place's own frame."))
+	var size: Vector3 = (s["half"] as Vector3) * 2.0
+	_fields.add_child(LiveFields.row("Size (m)" if str(s["kind"]) != "cyl" else "Size (m: across, high)", size, func(v): _change(_sel, "size", v), "", "The box's size (metres): width, height, depth."))
+	match _rot:
+		"yaw":
+			var bx := xf.basis.orthonormalized()
+			_fields.add_child(LiveFields.row("Turn (degrees)", snappedf(rad_to_deg(atan2(-bx.x.z, bx.x.x)), 0.01), func(v): _change(_sel, "yaw", float(v)), "", "The box's turn about the upright (degrees)."))
+		"full":
+			var eu := xf.basis.orthonormalized().get_euler()
+			_fields.add_child(LiveFields.row("Turn (degrees)", Vector3(rad_to_deg(eu.x), rad_to_deg(eu.y), rad_to_deg(eu.z)).snapped(Vector3.ONE * 0.01),
+				func(v): _change(_sel, "euler", v), "", "The box's turn (degrees) about x, y and z."))
+	if SolidsEdit.kind_of(_owner) == "hangar":
+		var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+		var l := UI.label("Stops", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+		l.custom_minimum_size.x = 150
+		h.add_child(l)
+		var ob := OptionButton.new()
+		ob.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 13)
+		ob.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+		ob.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		for i in USES.size():
+			ob.add_item(USES[i][1])
+			if USES[i][0] == str(s.get("use", "both")):
+				ob.select(i)
+		ob.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Stops", "", "What the box stops: the camera (it never passes through), feet (you walking), or both.")
+		l.tooltip_text = ob.tooltip_text
+		ob.item_selected.connect(func(i): _change(_sel, "use", USES[i][0]))
+		h.add_child(ob)
+		_fields.add_child(h)
+	if SolidsEdit.kind_of(_owner) in ["hangar", "interior"]:
+		_fields.add_child(UI.note("Feet: only its footprint counts (its height is drawn, not used).", 13, 420.0))
+
+
+func _change(i: int, what: String, v: Variant) -> void:
+	if i < 0 or i >= _shapes.size():
+		return
+	var s: Dictionary = _shapes[i]
+	var xf: Transform3D = s["xf"]
+	match what:
+		"on":
+			s["on"] = bool(v)
+		"use":
+			s["use"] = str(v)
+		"centre":
+			xf.origin = v
+		"size":
+			var sz: Vector3 = (v as Vector3).abs()
+			s["half"] = Vector3(maxf(sz.x, 0.02), maxf(sz.y, 0.02), maxf(sz.z, 0.02)) * 0.5
+		"yaw":
+			xf.basis = Basis(Vector3.UP, deg_to_rad(float(v)))
+		"euler":
+			var e: Vector3 = v
+			xf.basis = Basis.from_euler(Vector3(deg_to_rad(e.x), deg_to_rad(e.y), deg_to_rad(e.z)))
+	s["xf"] = xf
+	_apply()
+	_list_row(i)
+
+
+func _describe(s: Dictionary) -> String:
+	var sz: Vector3 = (s["half"] as Vector3) * 2.0
+	var turned := not (s["xf"] as Transform3D).basis.is_equal_approx(Basis.IDENTITY)
+	var t := "%s%s  %.1f x %.1f x %.1f m" % ["turned " if turned and str(s["kind"]) != "prism" else "", KINDS.get(str(s["kind"]), "box"), sz.x, sz.y, sz.z]
+	var use := str(s.get("use", ""))
+	if use == "cam":
+		t += "  (camera)"
+	elif use == "walk":
+		t += "  (feet)"
+	if not bool(s.get("on", true)):
+		t += "  - off"
+	return t
+
+
+# --- The world: picking, the lines ---------------------------------------------------
+
+## A click in the world (global ray): the nearest box it meets selected - true
+## when there was one (else the editor picks as usual).
+func pick_in_world(origin: Vector3, dir: Vector3) -> bool:
+	if not is_instance_valid(_owner) or _shapes.is_empty():
+		return false
+	var inv := (_owner as Node3D).global_transform.affine_inverse()
+	var o := inv * origin
+	var d := (inv.basis * dir).normalized()
+	var best := INF
+	var bi := -1
+	for i in _shapes.size():
+		var t := SolidsEdit.ray(_shapes[i], o, d, minf(best, 2000.0))
+		if t < best:
+			best = t
+			bi = i
+	if bi < 0:
+		return false
+	_select(bi)
+	_say("Box #%d: %s" % [bi, _describe(_shapes[bi])])
+	return true
+
+
+func live_process(delta: float) -> void:
+	if ed == null:
+		return
+	if not is_instance_valid(_owner):
+		if _overlay:
+			_im.clear_surfaces()
+		return
+	_overlay.global_transform = (_owner as Node3D).global_transform
+	_t -= delta
+	if _t <= 0.0:
+		_t = 0.25
+		if SolidsEdit.has_solids(_owner) and (_shapes.is_empty() or not SolidsEdit.current(_owner)):
+			_load()   # (built since, or built again: its solids anew)
+			_fill_fields()
+		var cl := _cam_local()
+		if cl.distance_to(_drawn_at) > 3.0:
+			_drawn_at = cl
+			_redraw = true
+			_fill_list(cl)
+	if _redraw:
+		_redraw = false
+		_draw_lines(_cam_local())
+
+
+func _cam_local() -> Vector3:
+	var cam: Camera3D = ed.camera() if ed else null
+	if cam == null or not is_instance_valid(_owner):
+		return Vector3.ZERO
+	return (_owner as Node3D).to_local(cam.global_position)
+
+
+func _fill_list(cl: Vector3) -> void:
+	var near: Array = []
+	for i in _shapes.size():
+		var d := SolidsEdit.distance(_shapes[i], cl)
+		if d < REACH or i == _sel:
+			near.append([d, i])
+	near.sort_custom(func(a, b): return a[0] < b[0])
+	_list.clear()
+	_listed.clear()
+	for e in near.slice(0, LISTED):
+		var i: int = e[1]
+		_list.add_item("#%d  %s   %.0f m" % [i, _describe(_shapes[i]), float(e[0])])
+		_listed.append(i)
+		if i == _sel:
+			_list.select(_list.item_count - 1)
+	if _sel >= 0 and _listed.has(_sel):
+		_list.ensure_current_is_visible()
+
+
+func _list_row(i: int) -> void:
+	var r := _listed.find(i)
+	if r >= 0:
+		var cl := _cam_local()
+		_list.set_item_text(r, "#%d  %s   %.0f m" % [i, _describe(_shapes[i]), SolidsEdit.distance(_shapes[i], cl)])
+
+
+func _draw_lines(cl: Vector3) -> void:
+	_im.clear_surfaces()
+	if _shapes.is_empty():
+		return
+	_overlay.material_override = _material(_xray.button_pressed)
+	var any := false
+	for i in _shapes.size():
+		var s: Dictionary = _shapes[i]
+		if i != _sel and SolidsEdit.distance(s, cl) > REACH:
+			continue
+		if not any:
+			_im.surface_begin(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_LINES)
+			any = true
+		var col := C_SOLID
+		if i == _sel:
+			col = C_SEL
+		elif not bool(s.get("on", true)):
+			col = C_OFF
+		elif str(s.get("use", "")) == "walk":
+			col = C_FEET
+		elif str(s.get("use", "")) == "cam":
+			col = C_CAM
+		_box_lines(s, col, i == _sel)
+	if any:
+		_im.surface_end()
+
+
+func _box_lines(s: Dictionary, col: Color, sel: bool) -> void:
+	var xf: Transform3D = s["xf"]
+	var h: Vector3 = s["half"]
+	var c: Array = []
+	for k in 8:
+		c.append(xf * Vector3(h.x if k & 1 else -h.x, h.y if k & 2 else -h.y, h.z if k & 4 else -h.z))
+	_im.surface_set_color(col)
+	for e in [[0, 1], [2, 3], [4, 5], [6, 7], [0, 2], [1, 3], [4, 6], [5, 7], [0, 4], [1, 5], [2, 6], [3, 7]]:
+		_im.surface_add_vertex(c[e[0]])
+		_im.surface_add_vertex(c[e[1]])
+	if sel:   # (the picked one: its faces crossed too)
+		for e in [[0, 3], [4, 7], [0, 6], [1, 7], [0, 5], [2, 7]]:
+			_im.surface_add_vertex(c[e[0]])
+			_im.surface_add_vertex(c[e[1]])
+
+
+static func _material(xray: bool) -> StandardMaterial3D:
+	if (_mat_xray if xray else _mat_depth) == null:
+		var m := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+		m.shading_mode = BaseMaterial3D.SHADING_MODE_UNSHADED
+		m.vertex_color_use_as_albedo = true
+		m.transparency = BaseMaterial3D.TRANSPARENCY_ALPHA
+		m.no_depth_test = xray
+		m.render_priority = 10
+		if xray:
+			_mat_xray = m
+		else:
+			_mat_depth = m
+	return _mat_xray if xray else _mat_depth

+extends VBoxContainer
+## The Live Editor's Particles tab: the particle effects (Fx - data/effects.json) on
+## what's picked - the ones playing under it, its kind's (its anchor's), or any
+## effect of the game - their parameters edited live (FxParams): an edit changes
+## the effect's definition, so every effect of that name in the game (every
+## explosion, every landing's dust) changes at once. Add an effect to the picked
+## thing (attached at its origin): kept by LiveEdits (section "fx": {added: [{path,
+## effect, pos}]}) and put back each time that kind of thing is made (apply_edit).
+## Save writes data/effects.json (and the kept additions) through EditTarget.
+##
+## Shown for any 3D thing picked (an effect can be added to it); it lists what's
+## playing under it first.
+
+const TITLE := "Particles"
+const ICON := "effects"
+const SECTION := "fx"
+
+var _ed: Node
+var _here: OptionButton
+var _all: OptionButton
+var _add: OptionButton
+var _params: FxParams
+var _note: Label
+var _found: Array = []          # the Fx nodes under the selection
+var _t := 0.0
+
+
+## The picked node (or its anchor, or a parent) has effects under it - or it's a 3D
+## thing an effect can be added to.
+static func handles(n: Node) -> bool:
+	if n == null:
+		return false
+	if not Fx.under(n).is_empty():
+		return true
+	var a := n.get_parent()
+	while a:
+		if a is Fx:
+			return true
+		a = a.get_parent()
+	var anc: Node = LiveEdits.anchor_of(n)[0]
+	if anc and not Fx.under(anc).is_empty():
+		return true
+	return n is Node3D
+
+
+func bind(ed: Node) -> void:
+	_ed = ed
+	add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	add_child(UI.section("EFFECTS HERE"))
+	_here = OptionButton.new()
+	_here.name = "Here"
+	_here.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	_here.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Effects here", "", "The effects playing on what's picked (or on its kind). Pick one to edit its effect.")
+	_here.item_selected.connect(func(i): _edit(str(_here.get_item_metadata(i))))
+	add_child(_here)
+	var row := HBoxContainer.new()
+	row.add_child(UI.label("Any effect", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	_all = OptionButton.new()
+	_all.name = "All"
+	_all.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	_all.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_all.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Any effect", "", "Edit any of the game's effects (its every instance changes).")
+	_all.item_selected.connect(func(i): _edit(_all.get_item_text(i)))
+	row.add_child(_all)
+	row.add_child(_btn("Replay", "play", "Plays the effects on what's picked again (one-shots).", replay))
+	add_child(row)
+	var arow := HBoxContainer.new()
+	arow.add_child(UI.label("Add", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	_add = OptionButton.new()
+	_add.name = "AddWhich"
+	_add.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	_add.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_add.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip("Effect to add", "", "Which effect Add here puts on what's picked.")
+	arow.add_child(_add)
+	arow.add_child(_btn("Add here", "add", "Attaches the effect to what's picked (at its origin) - kept for every thing of its kind once saved.", func(): add_here(_add.get_item_text(_add.selected))))
+	arow.add_child(_btn("Remove added", "delete", "Takes away the effects you added to this kind of thing.", remove_added))
+	add_child(arow)
+	var srow := HBoxContainer.new()
+	srow.add_child(_btn("Save", "save", "Writes the effects (data/effects.json) and what you added - into the game, or the mod picked.", func(): save()))
+	_note = UI.label("", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	_note.clip_text = true
+	_note.size_flags_horizontal = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	srow.add_child(_note)
+	add_child(srow)
+	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
+	scroll.size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	scroll.custom_minimum_size.y = 300
+	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
+	add_child(scroll)
+	_params = FxParams.new()
+	_params.compact = true
+	_params.name = "Params"
+	_params.changed.connect(func():
+		if _ed and _ed.has_method("edited"):
+			_ed.edited(SECTION)
+		_show_dirty())
+	scroll.add_child(_params)
+	size_flags_vertical = SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	_fill()
+
+
+func unbind() -> void:
+	_ed = null
+
+
+func live_process(delta: float) -> void:
+	_t += delta
+	if _t < 0.5:
+		return
+	_t = 0.0
+	if _ed and Fx.under(_root()).size() != _found.size():
+		_fill_here()
+
+
+func _btn(name: String, icon: String, help: String, cb: Callable) -> Button:
+	var b := UI.button("", cb, 14)
+	b.focus_mode = FOCUS_NONE
+	return EditorIcons.dress(b, icon, EditorIcons.tip(name, "", help))
+
+
+## Where to look for effects: the selection, or (none under it) its anchor.
+func _root() -> Node:
+	var sel: Node = _ed.selected if _ed else null
+	if sel == null or not is_instance_valid(sel):
+		return null
+	if not Fx.under(sel).is_empty():
+		return sel
+	var a: Node = _ed.anchor if _ed.anchor and is_instance_valid(_ed.anchor) else null
+	return a if a else sel
+
+
+func _fill() -> void:
+	_all.clear()
+	_add.clear()
+	for n in Fx.names():
+		_all.add_item(n)
+		_add.add_item(n)
+	_fill_here()
+	var first := str(_here.get_item_metadata(0)) if _here.item_count > 0 and _here.get_item_metadata(0) != null else (str(Fx.names()[0]) if not Fx.names().is_empty() else "")
+	_edit(first)
+	_show_dirty()
+
+
+func _fill_here() -> void:
+	_here.clear()
+	_found = Fx.under(_root()) if _ed else []
+	for f in _found:
+		_here.add_item("%s  (%s)" % [f.effect, "looping" if f.attached else "one-shot"])
+		_here.set_item_metadata(_here.item_count - 1, f.effect)
+	if _found.is_empty():
+		_here.add_item("(none playing here)")
+		_here.set_item_metadata(0, null)
+		_here.disabled = true
+	else:
+		_here.disabled = false
+
+
+func _edit(name: String) -> void:
+	if name == "" or not Fx.has(name):
+		_params.show_effect("")
+		return
+	var i := Fx.names().find(name)
+	if i >= 0:
+		_all.select(i)
+		_add.select(i)
+	_params.show_effect(name)
+
+
+## Plays the one-shots on what's picked again.
+func replay() -> void:
+	for f in Fx.under(_root()):
+		f.play()
+
+
+## Effect `name` attached to what's picked, kept for its kind (LiveEdits "fx").
+func add_here(name: String) -> Node3D:
+	var sel: Node = _ed.selected if _ed else null
+	if sel == null or not is_instance_valid(sel) or not Fx.has(name):
+		return null
+	var key: String = _ed.key
+	var anchor: Node = _ed.anchor
+	if key == "" or anchor == null:
+		var fx := Fx.attach(name, sel)
+		_say("Added - not kept (this isn't part of anything kept).")
+		_fill_here()
+		return fx
+	var sec := LiveEdits.section(key, SECTION)
+	var list: Array = sec.get("added", [])
+	list.append({"path": LiveEdits.rel_path(anchor, sel), "effect": name, "pos": LiveEdits.enc(Vector3.ZERO)})
+	sec["added"] = list
+	if _ed.has_method("edited"):
+		_ed.edited(SECTION)
+	apply_edit(anchor, sec)
+	_fill_here()
+	_edit(name)
+	_say("Added %s to %s." % [name, LiveEditor.kind_name(key)])
+	return Fx.under(sel).back() if not Fx.under(sel).is_empty() else null
+
+
+## Takes away the effects added to this kind of thing (kept ones: from the record too).
+func remove_added() -> void:
+	if _ed == null or _ed.anchor == null:
+		return
+	for f in Fx.under(_ed.anchor):
+		if str(f.name).begins_with("LiveFx_"):
+			f.visible = false
+			f.queue_free()
+	if _ed.key != "":
+		var sec := LiveEdits.section(_ed.key, SECTION)
+		sec.erase("added")
+		if sec.is_empty():
+			LiveEdits.forget(_ed.key, SECTION)
+		if _ed.has_method("edited"):
+			_ed.edited(SECTION)
+	_say("Removed the added effects.")
+	_fill_here()
+
+
+func save() -> bool:
+	var ok := true
+	if Fx.dirty:
+		ok = Fx.save()
+	if LiveEdits.dirty:
+		ok = LiveEdits.save() and ok
+	var et: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/edit_target.gd")
+	_say(("Saved into %s." if ok else "Can't save into %s: pick a mod.") % et.label())
+	return ok
+
+
+func _say(t: String) -> void:
+	if _note:
+		_note.text = t
+	if _ed and _ed.has_method("say"):
+		_ed.say(t)
+
+
+func _show_dirty() -> void:
+	if _note and Fx.dirty:
+		_note.text = "effects changed - unsaved"
+
+
+## Puts back the effects added to this kind of thing (LiveEdits, each time one's made).
+static func apply_edit(anchor: Node, data: Dictionary) -> void:
+	var list: Array = data.get("added", [])
+	for i in list.size():
+		var e = list[i]
+		if not e is Dictionary or not Fx.has(str(e.get("effect", ""))):
+			continue
+		var at: Node = LiveEdits.find(anchor, str(e.get("path", ".")))
+		var nm := "LiveFx_%d" % i
+		if at == null or at.has_node(NodePath(nm)):
+			continue
+		var fx := Fx.attach(str(e["effect"]), at)
+		fx.name = nm
+		var p = LiveEdits.dec(e.get("pos"))
+		if p is Vector3:
+			fx.position = p

+class_name LiveFields
+extends RefCounted
+## The Live Editor tabs' fields: a value of any simple type as a labelled widget
+## (a tick, a number, a slider in a range, text, a vector, a colour), calling back
+## with the new value as it's edited.
+
+
+## A row: `label` and a widget for `value`; `on_change(v)` as it's edited. `hint`:
+## "min,max[,step]" for a slider. Null - an unknown type (shown, not editable).
+## `about`: what the value is (the tooltip's text; the value's kind and range are
+## added to it - made from the value alone when it's "").
+static func row(label: String, value: Variant, on_change: Callable, hint := "", about := "") -> Control:
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	h.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 6)
+	var l := UI.label(label, 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	l.custom_minimum_size.x = 130
+	l.clip_text = true
+	l.text_overrun_behavior = TextServer.OVERRUN_TRIM_ELLIPSIS
+	var t := tip_for(label, value, hint, about)
+	l.tooltip_text = t
+	h.add_child(l)
+	var w := widget(value, on_change, hint)
+	w.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	h.add_child(w)
+	give_tip(w, t)
+	h.set_meta("widget", w)
+	return h
+
+
+## A field's tooltip: its name, what it is (`about`), then the kind of value and
+## its range ("min,max[,step]" `hint`) and how to change it.
+static func tip_for(label: String, value: Variant, hint := "", about := "") -> String:
+	var how := ""
+	match typeof(value):
+		TYPE_BOOL:
+			how = "On or off: tick it to turn it on."
+		TYPE_INT, TYPE_FLOAT:
+			var whole := typeof(value) == TYPE_INT
+			var r := hint.split(",")
+			if r.size() >= 2 and r[0].is_valid_float() and r[1].is_valid_float():
+				how = "%s from %s to %s%s: drag the slider." % ["A whole number" if whole else "A number", _num(float(r[0]), whole), _num(float(r[1]), whole),
+					(", in steps of " + r[2]) if r.size() > 2 and r[2].is_valid_float() and not whole else ""]
+			else:
+				how = "%s: type it (Enter), or use the arrows / the mouse wheel over it." % ("A whole number" if whole else "A number")
+		TYPE_STRING, TYPE_STRING_NAME:
+			how = "Text: type it, then Enter (or click away)."
+		TYPE_VECTOR2, TYPE_VECTOR2I:
+			how = "Two numbers, x and y: one box each."
+		TYPE_VECTOR3, TYPE_VECTOR3I:
+			how = "Three numbers, x, y and z (z: forward / back): one box each."
+		TYPE_VECTOR4:
+			how = "Four numbers, x, y, z and w: one box each."
+		TYPE_COLOR:
+			how = "A colour: click to pick it (with its opacity, alpha)."
+		_:
+			how = "Shown, not editable here."
+	return EditorIcons.tip(label, "", (about + "\n" if about != "" else "") + how)
+
+
+## Puts tooltip `t` on `w` and on every control in it you can use.
+static func give_tip(w: Control, t: String) -> void:
+	if w.tooltip_text == "":
+		w.tooltip_text = t
+	for c in w.find_children("*", "Control", true, false):
+		if (c is BaseButton or c is Range or c is LineEdit) and (c as Control).tooltip_text == "":
+			(c as Control).tooltip_text = t
+
+
+static func widget(value: Variant, on_change: Callable, hint := "") -> Control:
+	match typeof(value):
+		TYPE_BOOL:
+			var c := CheckBox.new()
+			c.button_pressed = value
+			c.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+			c.toggled.connect(func(v): on_change.call(v))
+			return c
+		TYPE_INT, TYPE_FLOAT:
+			var r := hint.split(",")
+			if r.size() >= 2 and r[0].is_valid_float() and r[1].is_valid_float():
+				return _slider(float(value), float(r[0]), float(r[1]), float(r[2]) if r.size() > 2 and r[2].is_valid_float() else (1.0 if typeof(value) == TYPE_INT else 0.001), typeof(value) == TYPE_INT, on_change)
+			var s := _spin(float(value), typeof(value) == TYPE_INT)
+			s.value_changed.connect(func(v): on_change.call(int(v) if typeof(value) == TYPE_INT else v))
+			return s
+		TYPE_STRING, TYPE_STRING_NAME:
+			var e := LineEdit.new()
+			e.text = str(value)
+			e.text_submitted.connect(func(t): on_change.call(t))
+			e.focus_exited.connect(func(): on_change.call(e.text))
+			return e
+		TYPE_VECTOR2, TYPE_VECTOR3, TYPE_VECTOR4, TYPE_VECTOR2I, TYPE_VECTOR3I:
+			return _vector(value, on_change)
+		TYPE_COLOR:
+			var cp := ColorPickerButton.new()
+			cp.color = value
+			cp.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(80, 28)
+			cp.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+			cp.color_changed.connect(func(c): on_change.call(c))
+			return cp
+	var lab := UI.label(_brief(value), 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	lab.clip_text = true
+	return lab
+
+
+static func _spin(v: float, whole: bool) -> SpinBox:
+	var s := SpinBox.new()
+	s.allow_greater = true
+	s.allow_lesser = true
+	s.min_value = -1e6
+	s.max_value = 1e6
+	s.step = 1.0 if whole else 0.001
+	s.value = v
+	s.custom_minimum_size.x = 64
+	s.update_on_text_changed = false
+	s.get_line_edit().expand_to_text_length = false
+	return s
+
+
+static func _slider(v: float, lo: float, hi: float, step: float, whole: bool, on_change: Callable) -> Control:
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	var sl := HSlider.new()
+	sl.min_value = lo
+	sl.max_value = hi
+	sl.step = step
+	sl.value = v
+	sl.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	sl.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_CENTER
+	sl.focus_mode = Control.FOCUS_NONE
+	h.add_child(sl)
+	var n := UI.label(_num(v, whole), 13)
+	n.custom_minimum_size.x = 48
+	h.add_child(n)
+	sl.value_changed.connect(func(x):
+		n.text = _num(x, whole)
+		on_change.call(int(x) if whole else x))
+	return h
+
+
+static func _num(v: float, whole: bool) -> String:
+	return str(int(v)) if whole else ("%.3f" % v).rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
+
+
+static func _vector(value: Variant, on_change: Callable) -> Control:
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	var n := 2 if (value is Vector2 or value is Vector2i) else (3 if (value is Vector3 or value is Vector3i) else 4)
+	var whole := value is Vector2i or value is Vector3i
+	var cur := [value]
+	for i in n:
+		var s := _spin(float(value[i]), whole)
+		s.custom_minimum_size.x = 0
+		s.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+		s.value_changed.connect(func(x):
+			var v = cur[0]
+			v[i] = int(x) if whole else x
+			cur[0] = v
+			on_change.call(v))
+		h.add_child(s)
+	return h
+
+
+static func _brief(v: Variant) -> String:
+	if v is Object:
+		return (v as Object).get_class() if v else "(none)"
+	var s := str(v)
+	return s if s.length() < 60 else s.left(57) + "..."
+
+
+## A heading inside a tab.
+static func head(text: String) -> Label:
+	return UI.section(text)

@@ -1,0 +1,305 @@ 
+extends VBoxContainer
+## The Live Editor's Materials tab: the looks of what's picked - each surface's
+## material: a shader's every parameter (numbers - sliders where the shader gives a
+## range -, colours, vectors, ticks, textures), a standard material's colour, metal,
+## roughness, glow and textures; and the thing's own per-instance values. Textures
+## are replaced with a picture of yours. Edits change the material itself, so
+## everything sharing it changes ("Its own copy" first to change only this kind).
+## Kept (LiveEdits, section "material"): {rel path: {"<surface>": {"own": bool,
+## param: value | {"tex": res path}}, "inst": {param: value}}}.
+
+const TITLE := "Materials"
+const ICON := "paint"
+const DIR := "res://art/live/tex/"
+## A standard material's parameters shown.
+## [property, slider range, what it is (the row's tooltip)]
+const STANDARD := [["albedo_color", "", "The surface's base colour (tinting its colour texture, if any)."],
+	["metallic", "0,1,0.01", "How metal it is: 0 paint, plastic, stone; 1 bare metal (reflects its surroundings in its own colour)."],
+	["roughness", "0,1,0.01", "How rough the surface is: 0 a mirror-sharp shine, 1 matt."],
+	["emission_enabled", "", "Glow: the surface gives off light of its own (Emission)."],
+	["emission", "", "The glow's colour (with Emission enabled)."],
+	["emission_energy_multiplier", "0,16,0.01", "How bright the glow is (with Emission enabled)."],
+	["albedo_texture", "", ""], ["normal_texture", "", ""], ["roughness_texture", "", ""], ["metallic_texture", "", ""],
+	["emission_texture", "", ""],
+	["uv1_scale", "", "How many times the textures repeat across the surface (x, y, z)."]]
+## A texture slot's tooltip.
+const TEXTURES := {"albedo_texture": "The colour picture on the surface.", "normal_texture": "The bumps' picture (a normal map): fine relief without geometry.",
+	"roughness_texture": "Roughness over the surface (a greyscale picture: white matt).", "metallic_texture": "Metal over the surface (a greyscale picture: white metal).",
+	"emission_texture": "Where and how it glows (a picture: black no glow)."}
+
+static var pending := {}        # res path -> Image (pictures chosen this session, written with the edits)
+static var _tex := {}           # res path -> Texture2D
+static var _hooked := false
+
+var ed: Node
+var _gi: GeometryInstance3D
+var _rel := "."
+var _dialog: FileDialog
+
+
+static func handles(n: Node) -> bool:
+	return _first_geometry(n) != null
+
+
+static func _first_geometry(n: Node) -> GeometryInstance3D:
+	if n is GeometryInstance3D:
+		return n
+	var all := n.find_children("*", "GeometryInstance3D", true, false)
+	return all[0] if not all.is_empty() else null
+
+
+func bind(e: Node) -> void:
+	ed = e
+	if not _hooked:
+		_hooked = true
+		LiveEdits.before_save.append(flush)
+	_gi = _first_geometry(ed.selected)
+	_rel = LiveEdits.rel_path(ed.anchor, _gi) if ed.anchor else "."
+	if _gi != ed.selected:
+		add_child(UI.label("Its part: " + LiveEditor._name_of(_gi), 14, UI.TEXT_DIM))
+	var n := surfaces(_gi)
+	for s in n:
+		var mat := material_of(_gi, s)
+		add_child(LiveFields.head("SURFACE %d  ·  %s" % [s, _mat_name(mat)]))
+		if mat == null:
+			continue
+		var own := UI.button("Its own copy", func(): _make_own(s), 13)
+		own.tooltip_text = "Gives this kind of thing its own copy of the material, so edits change only it (not everything sharing it)."
+		add_child(own)
+		_params(mat, s)
+	var inst := _instance_params(_gi)
+	if not inst.is_empty():
+		add_child(LiveFields.head("THIS THING'S OWN VALUES"))
+		for p in inst:
+			var name: String = p.trim_prefix("instance_shader_parameters/")
+			add_child(LiveFields.row(name.capitalize(), _gi.get(p), func(v):
+				_gi.set(p, v)
+				_keep("inst", name, LiveEdits.enc(v)), "", "This thing's own value of its shader's \"%s\" (instance uniform): only this one changes." % name))
+
+
+func unbind() -> void:
+	ed = null
+
+
+static func surfaces(gi: GeometryInstance3D) -> int:
+	if gi is MeshInstance3D and (gi as MeshInstance3D).mesh:
+		return (gi as MeshInstance3D).mesh.get_surface_count()
+	return 1
+
+
+## The material drawing surface `s` of `gi` (its override, the surface's, or the mesh's).
+static func material_of(gi: GeometryInstance3D, s: int) -> Material:
+	if gi.material_override:
+		return gi.material_override
+	if gi is MeshInstance3D:
+		var mi := gi as MeshInstance3D
+		if mi.get_surface_override_material(s):
+			return mi.get_surface_override_material(s)
+		if mi.mesh and s < mi.mesh.get_surface_count():
+			return mi.mesh.surface_get_material(s)
+	return null
+
+
+static func _mat_name(m: Material) -> String:
+	if m == null:
+		return "(none)"
+	if m is ShaderMaterial and (m as ShaderMaterial).shader:
+		return (m as ShaderMaterial).shader.resource_path.get_file() if (m as ShaderMaterial).shader.resource_path != "" else "a shader"
+	return m.get_class()
+
+
+func _params(mat: Material, s: int) -> void:
+	if mat is ShaderMaterial:
+		var sm := mat as ShaderMaterial
+		if sm.shader == null:
+			return
+		for u in sm.shader.get_shader_uniform_list():
+			var name: String = u["name"]
+			var v = sm.get_shader_parameter(name)
+			var t := int(u["type"])
+			if v == null:
+				v = _zero(t, str(u.get("hint_string", "")))
+			if t == TYPE_OBJECT or v is Texture2D:
+				add_child(_texture_row(name, v, s, func(tex): sm.set_shader_parameter(name, tex)))
+				continue
+			if t == TYPE_VECTOR4 and str(u.get("hint_string", "")).contains("source_color") or (t == TYPE_COLOR):
+				v = Color(v.x, v.y, v.z, v.w) if v is Vector4 else v
+			var hint := str(u["hint_string"]) if int(u["hint"]) == PROPERTY_HINT_RANGE else ""
+			add_child(LiveFields.row(name.capitalize(), v, func(nv):
+				sm.set_shader_parameter(name, nv)
+				_keep(str(s), name, LiveEdits.enc(nv)), hint, _uniform_about(sm.shader, name, t)))
+	elif mat is BaseMaterial3D:
+		for p in STANDARD:
+			var v = mat.get(p[0])
+			if p[0].ends_with("_texture"):
+				add_child(_texture_row(p[0], v, s, func(tex): mat.set(p[0], tex)))
+				continue
+			add_child(LiveFields.row(str(p[0]).capitalize(), v, func(nv):
+				mat.set(p[0], nv)
+				_keep(str(s), p[0], LiveEdits.enc(nv)), p[1], str(p[2]) + "\nChanges everything sharing this material."))
+
+
+## A shader parameter's tooltip text: which uniform of which shader, its type.
+static func _uniform_about(sh: Shader, name: String, t: int) -> String:
+	var file := sh.resource_path.get_file() if sh and sh.resource_path != "" else "the shader"
+	return "The shader parameter \"%s\" (%s) of %s.\nChanges everything sharing this material." % [name, type_string(t), file]
+
+
+static func _zero(t: int, _hint: String) -> Variant:
+	match t:
+		TYPE_FLOAT: return 0.0
+		TYPE_INT: return 0
+		TYPE_BOOL: return false
+		TYPE_VECTOR2: return Vector2.ZERO
+		TYPE_VECTOR3: return Vector3.ZERO
+		TYPE_VECTOR4: return Vector4.ZERO
+		TYPE_COLOR: return Color.WHITE
+	return null
+
+
+func _texture_row(name: String, v: Variant, s: int, set_tex: Callable) -> Control:
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	var l := UI.label(name.capitalize(), 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	l.custom_minimum_size.x = 130
+	l.clip_text = true
+	l.tooltip_text = EditorIcons.tip(name.capitalize(), "", str(TEXTURES.get(name, "A texture (picture) of the shader parameter \"%s\"." % name)))
+	h.add_child(l)
+	var tr := TextureRect.new()
+	tr.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(48, 48)
+	tr.expand_mode = TextureRect.EXPAND_IGNORE_SIZE
+	tr.stretch_mode = TextureRect.STRETCH_KEEP_ASPECT_CENTERED
+	tr.texture = v if v is Texture2D else null
+	h.add_child(tr)
+	var info := UI.label(("%dx%d" % [(v as Texture2D).get_width(), (v as Texture2D).get_height()]) if v is Texture2D else "(none)", 13, UI.TEXT_DIM)
+	info.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
+	h.add_child(info)
+	if not OS.has_feature("web") and not v is Texture3D:
+		var b := UI.button("Replace", func():
+			_pick_picture(func(path: String):
+				var img := Image.load_from_file(path)
+				if img == null:
+					ed.say("Couldn't read " + path.get_file())
+					return
+				img.generate_mipmaps()
+				var tex := ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+				var res_path := DIR + path.get_file().get_basename().validate_filename() + ".png"
+				pending[res_path] = img
+				_tex[res_path] = tex
+				set_tex.call(tex)
+				tr.texture = tex
+				info.text = "%dx%d" % [img.get_width(), img.get_height()]
+				_keep(str(s), name, {"tex": res_path})), 13)
+		b.tooltip_text = "Replaces the texture with a picture of yours (PNG, JPG, WebP)."
+		h.add_child(b)
+	return h
+
+
+func _pick_picture(cb: Callable) -> void:
+	if _dialog:
+		_dialog.queue_free()
+	_dialog = FileDialog.new()
+	_dialog.file_mode = FileDialog.FILE_MODE_OPEN_FILE
+	_dialog.access = FileDialog.ACCESS_FILESYSTEM
+	_dialog.filters = PackedStringArray(["*.png, *.jpg, *.jpeg, *.webp ; Pictures"])
+	_dialog.use_native_dialog = true
+	add_child(_dialog)
+	_dialog.file_selected.connect(cb)
+	_dialog.popup_centered(Vector2i(900, 600))
+
+
+static func _instance_params(gi: GeometryInstance3D) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	for p in gi.get_property_list():
+		if str(p["name"]).begins_with("instance_shader_parameters/"):
+			out.append(str(p["name"]))
+	return out
+
+
+## The surface's material made this kind's own (a copy on its part).
+func _make_own(s: int) -> void:
+	_own(_gi, s)
+	_keep(str(s), "own", true)
+	ed.say("This kind has its own copy of surface %d's material now." % s)
+	var e = ed
+	e.show_tab("material")
+
+
+static func _own(gi: GeometryInstance3D, s: int) -> Material:
+	var m := material_of(gi, s)
+	if m == null or gi.has_meta("live_own_%d" % s):
+		return m
+	var c := m.duplicate()
+	if gi.material_override:
+		gi.material_override = c
+	elif gi is MeshInstance3D:
+		(gi as MeshInstance3D).set_surface_override_material(s, c)
+	gi.set_meta("live_own_%d" % s, true)
+	return c
+
+
+func _keep(surface: String, param: String, v: Variant) -> void:
+	if ed == null or ed.key == "":
+		return
+	var sec := LiveEdits.section(ed.key, "material")
+	if not sec.has(_rel):
+		sec[_rel] = {}
+	if not sec[_rel].has(surface):
+		sec[_rel][surface] = {}
+	sec[_rel][surface][param] = v
+	ed.edited("material")
+
+
+## The pictures chosen this session written as PNGs (with the Live Editor's Save).
+static func flush() -> void:
+	var et: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/edit_target.gd")
+	for path in pending:
+		var to: String = et.write_path(path)
+		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(to.get_base_dir())
+		(pending[path] as Image).save_png(to)
+	pending.clear()
+
+
+static func texture_at(path: String) -> Texture2D:
+	if _tex.has(path):
+		return _tex[path]
+	var et: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/edit_target.gd")
+	var p: String = et.read_path(path)
+	var t: Texture2D = null
+	if ResourceLoader.exists(p) and not p.begins_with("user://"):
+		t = load(p)   # (a mod's, through Mods' loader; the game's own, imported)
+	if t == null:
+		var img := Image.load_from_file(ProjectSettings.globalize_path(p))
+		if img:
+			img.generate_mipmaps()
+			t = ImageTexture.create_from_image(img)
+	_tex[path] = t
+	return t
+
+
+static func apply_edit(anchor: Node, data: Dictionary) -> void:
+	for rel in data:
+		var gi := LiveEdits.find(anchor, str(rel)) as GeometryInstance3D
+		if gi == null:
+			continue
+		for surface in data[rel]:
+			var vals: Dictionary = data[rel][surface]
+			if surface == "inst":
+				for p in vals:
+					gi.set("instance_shader_parameters/" + str(p), LiveEdits.dec(vals[p]))
+				continue
+			var s := int(surface)
+			var mat := _own(gi, s) if bool(vals.get("own", false)) else material_of(gi, s)
+			if mat == null:
+				continue
+			for p in vals:
+				if p == "own":
+					continue
+				var v = vals[p]
+				if v is Dictionary and v.has("tex"):
+					v = texture_at(str(v["tex"]))
+				else:
+					v = LiveEdits.dec(v)
+				if mat is ShaderMaterial:
+					(mat as ShaderMaterial).set_shader_parameter(str(p), v)
+				else:
+					mat.set(str(p), v)

files.explanation: The Model tab: a mesh opened in the mesh editor in a window over the game and put back in the world, or replaced from a file; saved as a resource.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,193 @@ 
+extends VBoxContainer
+## The Live Editor's Model tab: the meshes of what's picked - each opened in the
+## mesh editor (a window over the running game: a copy of it, its edits put back
+## with "Put in the world"), or replaced with a model file of yours. The new mesh
+## goes on every thing of that kind at once; kept (LiveEdits, section "model":
+## {rel path: res path of the mesh}), the mesh saved as a resource
+## (res://art/live/<kind>/<part>.res - in the game, or the mod) when the edits are.
+
+const TITLE := "Model"
+const ICON := "mesh"
+const DIR := "res://art/live/"
+
+## Meshes made this session, not yet written: res path -> Mesh.
+static var pending := {}
+static var _cache := {}         # res path -> Mesh (loaded once, shared)
+static var _hooked := false
+
+var ed: Node
+var _list: VBoxContainer
+var _dialog: FileDialog
+
+
+static func handles(n: Node) -> bool:
+	return n is MeshInstance3D or not n.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false).is_empty()
+
+
+func bind(e: Node) -> void:
+	ed = e
+	_hook_save()
+	add_child(LiveFields.head("ITS MESHES"))
+	_list = VBoxContainer.new()
+	add_child(_list)
+	var meshes: Array = [ed.selected] if ed.selected is MeshInstance3D else ed.selected.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false).slice(0, 24)
+	for mi in meshes:
+		_list.add_child(_row(mi))
+
+
+func unbind() -> void:
+	ed = null
+
+
+func _row(mi: MeshInstance3D) -> Control:
+	var v := VBoxContainer.new()
+	var m := mi.mesh
+	var nv := 0
+	if m is ArrayMesh:
+		for s in m.get_surface_count():
+			nv += (m as ArrayMesh).surface_get_array_len(s)
+	v.add_child(UI.label("%s  ·  %d vertices, %d surface%s" % [LiveEditor._name_of(mi), nv, m.get_surface_count() if m else 0,
+		"" if m and m.get_surface_count() == 1 else "s"], 14))
+	var h := HBoxContainer.new()
+	var edit := UI.button("Mesh editor", func(): edit_in_window(mi), 14)
+	EditorIcons.dress(edit, "mesh", EditorIcons.tip("Mesh editor", "", "Opens a copy of this mesh in the mesh editor, over the running game; \"Put in the world\" there puts it on every one of its kind."))
+	edit.text = "Mesh editor"
+	h.add_child(edit)
+	if not OS.has_feature("web"):
+		var rep := UI.button("Replace", func(): _replace(mi), 14)
+		EditorIcons.dress(rep, "open", EditorIcons.tip("Replace", "", "Replaces the mesh with a model file of yours (.glb, .gltf, .obj)."))
+		rep.text = "Replace"
+		h.add_child(rep)
+	var back := UI.button("As made", func(): _revert(mi), 14)
+	EditorIcons.dress(back, "undo", EditorIcons.tip("As made", "", "Puts back the mesh it was made with (and forgets the kept one)."))
+	back.text = "As made"
+	h.add_child(back)
+	v.add_child(h)
+	return v
+
+
+## The mesh as an ArrayMesh (a primitive's arrays; an ArrayMesh copied).
+static func editable(m: Mesh) -> ArrayMesh:
+	if m is ArrayMesh:
+		return (m as ArrayMesh).duplicate(true)
+	var out := ArrayMesh.new()
+	if m is PrimitiveMesh:
+		out.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, (m as PrimitiveMesh).get_mesh_arrays())
+		out.surface_set_material(0, (m as PrimitiveMesh).material)
+	return out
+
+
+func edit_in_window(mi: MeshInstance3D) -> void:
+	var root := Node3D.new()
+	root.name = "Model"
+	var part := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	part.name = str(mi.name) if not str(mi.name).contains("@") else "Part"
+	part.mesh = editable(mi.mesh)
+	root.add_child(part)
+	var target: WeakRef = weakref(mi)
+	var t: Node = ed.open_tool("mesh", "Mesh: " + LiveEditor._name_of(mi), [
+		["Put in the world", "apply", "Puts the edited mesh on this - and every one of its kind - now (kept once you save the Live Editor's edits).",
+			func(tool: Node):
+				if tool.get("mode") == "edit":
+					tool.toggle_edit()   # (the edit session finished into the part)
+				var ps: Array = tool.parts()
+				var o = target.get_ref()
+				if ps.is_empty() or o == null:
+					return
+				put(o, tool.mirrored_mesh(ps[0]))
+				tool.set("dirty", false)],
+	])
+	t._set_model(root, "")
+	ed.say("Editing a copy of its mesh: \"Put in the world\" when it's right.")
+
+
+## Mesh `m` on `mi` and on every one of its kind; kept.
+func put(mi: MeshInstance3D, m: Mesh) -> void:
+	if not mi.has_meta("live_made_mesh"):
+		mi.set_meta("live_made_mesh", mi.mesh)
+	mi.mesh = m
+	if ed == null or ed.key == "" or ed.anchor == null:
+		return
+	var rel := LiveEdits.rel_path(ed.anchor, mi)
+	var path := DIR + _safe(ed.key) + "/" + _safe(rel) + ".res"
+	pending[path] = m
+	_cache[path] = m
+	LiveEdits.section(ed.key, "model")[rel] = path
+	ed.edited("model")
+	ed.say("The new mesh is on every %s." % LiveEditor.kind_name(ed.key).trim_prefix("every "))
+
+
+func _revert(mi: MeshInstance3D) -> void:
+	if mi.has_meta("live_made_mesh"):
+		mi.mesh = mi.get_meta("live_made_mesh")
+	if ed and ed.key != "" and ed.anchor:
+		var sec := LiveEdits.section(ed.key, "model")
+		sec.erase(LiveEdits.rel_path(ed.anchor, mi))
+		ed.edited("model")
+	ed.say("As made (others of its kind: the next time they're made).")
+
+
+func _replace(mi: MeshInstance3D) -> void:
+	if _dialog:
+		_dialog.queue_free()
+	_dialog = FileDialog.new()
+	_dialog.file_mode = FileDialog.FILE_MODE_OPEN_FILE
+	_dialog.access = FileDialog.ACCESS_FILESYSTEM
+	_dialog.filters = PackedStringArray(["*.glb, *.gltf, *.obj ; Models"])
+	_dialog.use_native_dialog = true
+	add_child(_dialog)
+	_dialog.file_selected.connect(func(path: String):
+		var MeshIO: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/mesh_io.gd")
+		var root: Node3D = MeshIO.read(path)
+		if root == null:
+			ed.say("Couldn't read " + path.get_file())
+			return
+		var parts := root.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false)
+		if parts.is_empty():
+			ed.say(path.get_file() + " has no mesh.")
+		else:
+			put(mi, (parts[0] as MeshInstance3D).mesh)
+		root.free())
+	_dialog.popup_centered(Vector2i(900, 600))
+
+
+static func _safe(s: String) -> String:
+	return s.trim_prefix("res://").replace("/", "_").replace(".", "_").replace("#", "_").validate_filename()
+
+
+## The meshes made this session written (with the Live Editor's Save).
+static func flush() -> void:
+	var et: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/edit_target.gd")
+	for path in pending:
+		var to: String = et.write_path(path)
+		DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(to.get_base_dir())
+		ResourceSaver.save(pending[path], to)
+	pending.clear()
+
+
+static func _hook_save() -> void:
+	if not _hooked:
+		_hooked = true
+		LiveEdits.before_save.append(flush)
+
+
+static func mesh_at(path: String) -> Mesh:
+	if _cache.has(path):
+		return _cache[path]
+	var et: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/edit_target.gd")
+	var p: String = et.read_path(path)
+	var m = ResourceLoader.load(p) if ResourceLoader.exists(p) or FileAccess.file_exists(p) else null
+	_cache[path] = m

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,149 @@ 
+extends RefCounted
+## A model's override: the mesh editor saves an edited model (and a character's material table,
+## model.json) beside the game's own, in res://art/overrides/ (laid out like res://), and never
+## writes over the original. An override has VARIANTS - versions of it, numbered 1, 2, 3... - each a
+## folder of its own files:
+##   res://art/overrides/art/pirate_3d/pirate.glb.variants/3/pirate.glb   (+ model.json)
+## The LATEST (the highest number) is the active one: the game uses it. A file a variant lacks (a
+## model.json never edited) is read from the original. No variants: the original is used. (A Blender
+## rebuild of a character writes the original: the variants stay.) Read from their own files as the
+## game runs (glTF read at run time), so a save shows at once, imported or not.
+##   const ModelOverride := preload("res://scripts/world/models/model_override.gd")
+
+const DIR := "res://art/overrides/"
+
+## Where overrides live: DIR (tests point it at a folder of their own - never the game's).
+static var dir := DIR
+
+static var _scenes := {}   # variant file -> PackedScene (read once)
+
+
+## The folder of `model_path`'s variants.
+static func root_of(model_path: String) -> String:
+	return dir + model_path.trim_prefix("res://") + ".variants/"
+
+
+## `model_path`'s variants' numbers, oldest first ([] - none: the original is used).
+static func variants(model_path: String) -> Array:
+	var out := []
+	var root := root_of(model_path)
+	if not DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(root):
+		return out
+	for d in DirAccess.get_directories_at(root):
+		if d.is_valid_int() and int(d) > 0:
+			out.append(int(d))
+	out.sort()
+	return out
+
+
+## The active variant: the latest (0 - none, the original).
+static func active(model_path: String) -> int:
+	var v := variants(model_path)
+	return v[-1] if not v.is_empty() else 0
+
+
+## `model_path` has an override (a variant).
+static func has(model_path: String) -> bool:
+	return active(model_path) > 0
+
+
+## Variant `n`'s file `name` (the model's own file if no name). n = 0: the original's.
+static func file_of(model_path: String, n: int, name := "") -> String:
+	var f := name if name != "" else model_path.get_file()
+	if n <= 0:
+		return model_path.get_base_dir().path_join(f)
+	return root_of(model_path) + str(n) + "/" + f
+
+
+## The file to read for `model_path`'s file `name` (the model's own if none) in variant `n` (-1: the
+## active one): the variant's if it has it, else the original's.
+static func read(model_path: String, name := "", n := -1) -> String:
+	if n < 0:
+		n = active(model_path)
+	var f := file_of(model_path, n, name)
+	return f if n > 0 and FileAccess.file_exists(f) else file_of(model_path, 0, name)
+
+
+## A new variant (the latest - so the active one): a copy of variant `from`'s files (0 - empty: its
+## files read from the original till it's saved). Its number.
+static func add(model_path: String, from := 0) -> int:
+	var v := variants(model_path)
+	var n: int = (v[-1] if not v.is_empty() else 0) + 1
+	var dir := root_of(model_path) + str(n) + "/"
+	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(dir)
+	if from > 0:
+		var src := root_of(model_path) + str(from) + "/"
+		for f in DirAccess.get_files_at(src):
+			DirAccess.copy_absolute(src + f, dir + f)
+	forget(model_path)
+	return n
+
+
+## Variant `n` deleted (the one before it becomes active if it was the latest).
+static func erase(model_path: String, n: int) -> void:
+	var dir := root_of(model_path) + str(n) + "/"
+	if n <= 0 or not DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(dir):
+		return
+	for f in DirAccess.get_files_at(dir):
+		DirAccess.remove_absolute(dir + f)
+	DirAccess.remove_absolute(dir)
+	_prune(root_of(model_path))
+	forget(model_path)
+
+
+## Empty folders left by erasing removed, up to art/overrides/ itself.
+static func _prune(folder: String) -> void:
+	var top := dir.trim_suffix("/")
+	var d := folder.trim_suffix("/")
+	while d.length() >= top.length() and DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(d) \
+			and DirAccess.get_files_at(d).is_empty() and DirAccess.get_directories_at(d).is_empty():
+		DirAccess.remove_absolute(d)
+		if d == top:
+			break
+		d = d.get_base_dir()
+
+
+## When variant `n` was last saved (Unix time; 0 - never).
+static func saved_at(model_path: String, n: int) -> int:
+	var f := file_of(model_path, n)
+	return FileAccess.get_modified_time(f) if n > 0 and FileAccess.file_exists(f) else 0
+
+
+## `model_path` as a scene: its active variant (read as glTF at run time), else the game's own.
+static func scene(model_path: String) -> PackedScene:
+	var p := read(model_path)
+	if p == model_path:
+		return load(model_path)
+	if _scenes.has(p):
+		return _scenes[p]
+	var ps: PackedScene = null
+	if p.get_extension().to_lower() in ["glb", "gltf"]:
+		var doc := GLTFDocument.new()
+		var st := GLTFState.new()
+		if doc.append_from_file(p, st) == OK:
+			var root := doc.generate_scene(st)
+			if root:
+				_own(root, root)
+				ps = PackedScene.new()
+				ps.pack(root)
+				root.free()
+	if ps == null and ResourceLoader.exists(p):
+		ps = load(p)   # (an exported game: the imported override)
+	if ps == null:
+		ps = load(model_path)
+	_scenes[p] = ps
+	return ps
+
+
+## `model_path`'s variants forgotten (saved again, added, erased): read anew next time.
+static func forget(model_path: String) -> void:
+	var root := root_of(model_path)
+	for k in _scenes.keys():
+		if str(k).begins_with(root):
+			_scenes.erase(k)
+
+
+static func _own(n: Node, root: Node) -> void:
+	for c in n.get_children():
+		c.owner = root
+		_own(c, root)
hunks.title: ModelOverride
hunks.note: Variants, active, add, erase, read.

@@ -50,9 +50,239 @@ static func has_model
 
 
 ## A model's facts (model.json): fps, clips {n, loop, gun, marks, air (m a frame), points (m)}, materials.
+## A model's looping clips set to loop (model.json's "loop"), each a whole cycle long
+## (n / fps: its last frame blending back into its first - the imported clips end ON
+## their last frame, and the loop jumped from it to the first: up to 20 degrees a step
+## in the run); and `extra` clips looping too.
+static func loop_clips(anim: AnimationPlayer, id: String, extra: Array = []) -> void:
+	if anim == null:
+		return
+	smooth_clips(anim, id)
+	var d := info(id)
+	var clips: Dictionary = d.get("clips", {})
+	var own := custom_clips(id)            # (clips from files keep their own loop and length)
+	for name in clips:
+		if anim.has_animation(name) and not own.has(name) and bool(clips[name].get("loop", false)):
+			var a := anim.get_animation(name)
+			a.loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_LINEAR
+			a.length = float(clips[name]["n"]) / float(d["fps"])
+	for c in extra:
+		if anim.has_animation(c) and not own.has(c):
+			anim.get_animation(c).loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_LINEAR
+
+
+## Glitches taken out of a model's clips (once a model - its clips are shared): a
+## bone that flips away for one to four frames and straight back (the pose solver
+## picking the other solution for an elbow, a shoulder piece - up to 180 degrees in a
+## frame and back) has those frames blended across from the frames either side. Real
+## fast moves - a punch, a kick, going on the way they went - are left as they are.
+## Returns the frames mended.
+static var _smoothed := {}
+
+
+static func smooth_clips(anim: AnimationPlayer, id: String) -> int:
+	if anim == null:
+		return 0
+	var fixed := 0
+	if not _smoothed.has(id):
+		_smoothed[id] = true
+		var clips: Dictionary = info(id).get("clips", {})
+		var own := custom_clips(id)
+		for name in anim.get_animation_list():
+			var a := anim.get_animation(name)
+			if own.has(name):
+				continue   # (a clip from a file: as its maker keyed it)
+			fixed += smooth_animation(a)
+			fixed += ease_steps(a, deg_to_rad(60.0 if bool(clips.get(name, {}).get("loop", false)) else 100.0))
+	use_clips(anim, id)
+	return fixed
+
+
+## Clips from files (the animation editor's - Talos > Animation): every
+## art/<id>_3d/clips/<name>.tres - the game's, a mod's (mounted over res://), and
+## the mod Talos is saving into (EditTarget) - replaces the model's clip of that
+## name or adds one, in the model's library (shared by every instance of it: the
+## walker, NPCs, the hangar's crews, the ArmsLayer reading draw / holster / aim by
+## name). The folder is listed once per id and the clips loaded then (none: an
+## empty dictionary, one lookup a model after that). The model's own clips are
+## kept aside (_orig), put back when a file's gone (forget_clips).
+static var _clip_files := {}               # id -> {name: path}
+static var _custom := {}                   # id -> {name: Animation}
+static var _orig := {}                     # id -> {name: the model's own Animation, replaced}
+static var _libs := {}                     # id -> the AnimationLibrary the clips went into
+
+
+static func clips_dir(id: String) -> String:
+	return model_dir(id) + "clips/"
+
+
+## The clip files for `id`: {name: path} (listed once; forget_clips lists again).
+static func clip_files(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if not _clip_files.has(id):
+		var out := {}
+		_list_clips(clips_dir(id), out)
+		# (the mod being made in the Mod Editor: not mounted till the game restarts.
+		# EditTarget loaded, not named: scripts run with -s compile this before the autoloads exist)
+		var target: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/edit_target.gd") if ResourceLoader.exists("res://scripts/editor/edit_target.gd") else null
+		if target != null and target.is_mod():
+			_list_clips(target.root() + clips_dir(id).trim_prefix("res://"), out)
+		_clip_files[id] = out
+	return _clip_files[id]
+
+
+static func _list_clips(dir: String, out: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if not DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute(dir):
+		return
+	for f in DirAccess.get_files_at(dir):
+		f = f.trim_suffix(".remap")   # (an exported game's converted resources)
+		if f.ends_with(".tres") or f.ends_with(".res"):
+			out[f.get_basename()] = dir + f
+
+
+## The clips from files for `id`, loaded: {name: Animation}.
+static func custom_clips(id: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if not _custom.has(id):
+		var out := {}
+		var files := clip_files(id)
+		for name in files:
+			var a = ResourceLoader.load(files[name], "Animation", ResourceLoader.CACHE_MODE_IGNORE)
+			if a is Animation:
+				out[name] = a
+		_custom[id] = out
+	return _custom[id]
+
+
+## The clips from files put into `anim`'s library (in place of the model's own).
+static func use_clips(anim: AnimationPlayer, id: String) -> void:
+	if anim == null:
+		return
+	var own := custom_clips(id)
+	if own.is_empty():
+		return
+	var lib := anim.get_animation_library(&"")
+	if lib == null:
+		return
+	_libs[id] = lib
+	if not _orig.has(id):
+		_orig[id] = {}
+	for name in own:
+		var a: Animation = own[name]
+		if lib.has_animation(name):
+			var cur := lib.get_animation(name)
+			if cur == a:
+				continue
+			if not _orig[id].has(name):
+				_orig[id][name] = cur
+			lib.remove_animation(name)
+		lib.add_animation(name, a)
+
+
+## The model's own clip `name` (not a file's), or null.
+static func base_clip(anim: AnimationPlayer, id: String, name: String) -> Animation:
+	if _orig.get(id, {}).has(name):
+		return _orig[id][name]
+	if anim != null and anim.has_animation(name) and not custom_clips(id).has(name):
+		return anim.get_animation(name)

+

+## model's own clips put back meanwhile, the files' added again by use_clips.
+static func forget_clips(id: String) -> void:
+	var lib: AnimationLibrary = _libs.get(id)
+	if lib != null:
+		for name in _custom.get(id, {}):
+			if lib.has_animation(name):
+				lib.remove_animation(name)
+		for name in _orig.get(id, {}):
+			lib.add_animation(name, _orig[id][name])
+	_orig.erase(id)
+	_libs.erase(id)
+	_clip_files.erase(id)
+	_custom.erase(id)
+
+
+static func smooth_animation(a: Animation) -> int:
+	var fixed := 0
+	const JUMP := deg_to_rad(40.0)
+	for t in a.get_track_count():
+		if a.track_get_type(t) != Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D:
+			continue
+		var n := a.track_get_key_count(t)
+		var k := 1
+		while k < n - 1:
+			var q0: Quaternion = a.track_get_key_value(t, k - 1)
+			var q1: Quaternion = a.track_get_key_value(t, k)
+			if q0.angle_to(q1) < JUMP:
+				k += 1
+				continue
+			# (a jump away: does it come straight back within 4 frames, to near where it left?)
+			var back := -1
+			for e in range(k + 1, mini(k + 5, n)):
+				var qe: Quaternion = a.track_get_key_value(t, e)
+				var qp: Quaternion = a.track_get_key_value(t, e - 1)
+				if qp.angle_to(qe) >= JUMP and q0.angle_to(qe) < q0.angle_to(q1) * 0.5:
+					back = e
+					break
+			if back < 0:
+				k += 1
+				continue
+			var qb: Quaternion = a.track_get_key_value(t, back)
+			for j in range(k, back):
+				a.track_set_key_value(t, j, q0.slerp(qb, float(j - k + 1) / float(back - k + 1)))
+				fixed += 1
+			k = back + 1
+	return fixed
+
+
+## A step far bigger than the motion round it (`over` and 2.5 times the frames' usual
+## step there - a pose jumping to the next in one frame: a shoulder piece flipping as
+## the dive starts, the leap's arms) spread over the frames either side: those frames
+## eased (each drawn toward its neighbours' middle, a few times), the window's ends
+## kept. Returns the steps eased.
+static func ease_steps(a: Animation, over: float) -> int:
+	var eased := 0
+	for t in a.get_track_count():

@@ -1,0 +1,207 @@ 
+class_name ArmsLayer
+extends SkeletonModifier3D
+## The automaton's upper body played over whatever its legs are doing (a child of
+## its Skeleton3D, after the AnimationPlayer's pose): taking the rifle off its
+## back (draw) and slinging it back (holster), raising it to aim, a shot's recoil
+## - the spine, chest, head, arms and the rifle from those clips, the legs and
+## hips from the walk / run / stand below. And the aim: the chest (and the rifle
+## with it, round the chest) pitched up or down to where the shot goes.
+##
+## `weight` 0: the clips below as they are; 1: this layer's pose. A new clip
+## cross-fades from the last (`blend` s). CosmosWalker drives it.
+
+const BONES := ["spine", "chest", "head", "pauldron.L", "pauldron.R", "upper.L", "fore.L", "hand.L", "fingers.L",
+	"upper.R", "fore.R", "hand.R", "fingers.R", "gun"]
+## The rifle's muzzle from its grip, in its bone's axes (its Y the barrel, Z its top): automaton.py rifle().
+const MUZZLE := Vector3(0.0, 0.78, 0.075)
+
+var weight := 0.0
+var pitch := 0.0          # rad: the aim up (+) or down
+var aim_k := 0.0          # how much of the pitch (0..1)
+
+var _ap: AnimationPlayer
+var _cur := ""
+var _t := 0.0
+var _prev := ""
+var _pt := 0.0
+var _mix := 1.0
+var _mix_rate := 8.0
+var _tracks := {}         # clip -> {bone index: [rotation track, position track]}
+var _bones := {}          # name -> index
+
+
+func setup(ap: AnimationPlayer) -> void:
+	_ap = ap
+
+
+func clip() -> String:
+	return _cur
+
+
+func time() -> float:
+	return _t
+
+
+## Plays `name` from `from` (a cross-fade of `blend` s from what it was playing).
+func play(name: String, from := 0.0, blend := 0.12) -> void:
+	if _ap == null or not _ap.has_animation(name):
+		return
+	_prev = _cur
+	_pt = _t
+	_cur = name
+	_t = from
+	_mix = 1.0 if _prev == "" or blend <= 0.0 else 0.0
+	_mix_rate = 1.0 / maxf(blend, 0.001)
+
+
+func step(dt: float, speed := 1.0) -> void:
+	if _cur == "":
+		return
+	_t = minf(_t + dt * speed, length())
+	_mix = minf(1.0, _mix + dt * _mix_rate)
+
+
+func length() -> float:
+	return _ap.get_animation(_cur).length if _ap and _cur != "" and _ap.has_animation(_cur) else 0.0
+
+
+## Its cross-fade into the clip finished.
+func blended() -> bool:
+	return _mix >= 1.0
+
+
+func done() -> bool:
+	return _cur == "" or _t >= length() - 0.001
+
+
+## The muzzle (global): the rifle's bone as posed now, MUZZLE along it.
+func muzzle() -> Vector3:
+	var sk := get_skeleton()
+	if sk == null:
+		return Vector3.ZERO
+	if has_gun_pose:
+		return sk.global_transform * (gun_pose * MUZZLE)
+	var g := sk.find_bone("gun")
+	if g < 0:
+		return sk.global_position
+	return sk.global_transform * (sk.get_bone_global_pose(g) * MUZZLE)
+
+
+## The barrel's way (global), as the rifle's posed now.
+func barrel() -> Vector3:
+	var sk := get_skeleton()
+	return (sk.global_basis * gun_pose.basis.y).normalized() if sk and has_gun_pose else Vector3.ZERO
+
+
+var gun_pose := Transform3D()   # (the rifle's bone, skeleton space, as last posed - with this layer)
+var has_gun_pose := false
+
+
+func _tracks_of(name: String, sk: Skeleton3D) -> Dictionary:
+	if _tracks.has(name):
+		return _tracks[name]
+	var out := {}
+	var a := _ap.get_animation(name)
+	for t in a.get_track_count():
+		var bone := str(a.track_get_path(t)).get_slice(":", 1)
+		if not (bone in BONES or bone == "pelvis"):
+			continue
+		var b := sk.find_bone(bone)
+		if b < 0:
+			continue
+		if not out.has(b):
+			out[b] = [-1, -1]
+		if a.track_get_type(t) == Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D:
+			out[b][0] = t
+		elif a.track_get_type(t) == Animation.TYPE_POSITION_3D:
+			out[b][1] = t
+	_tracks[name] = out
+	return out
+
+
+## A bone's pose in the layer's clip (cross-faded from the last): [rotation or null, position or null].
+func _sample(b: int, cur: Dictionary, a: Animation, prev: Dictionary, pa: Animation) -> Array:
+	var q = null
+	var p = null
+	if cur.has(b):
+		var tr: Array = cur[b]
+		if tr[0] >= 0:
+			q = a.rotation_track_interpolate(tr[0], _t)
+			if pa and prev.has(b) and prev[b][0] >= 0:
+				q = (pa.rotation_track_interpolate(prev[b][0], _pt) as Quaternion).slerp(q, _mix)
+		if tr[1] >= 0:
+			p = a.position_track_interpolate(tr[1], _t)
+			if pa and prev.has(b) and prev[b][1] >= 0:
+				p = (pa.position_track_interpolate(prev[b][1], _pt) as Vector3).lerp(p, _mix)
+	return [q, p]
+
+
+func _process_modification_with_delta(_delta: float) -> void:
+	_pose_now()
+
+
+func _process_modification() -> void:
+	_pose_now()
+
+
+func _pose_now() -> void:
+	var sk := get_skeleton()
+	if sk == null or _ap == null:
+		return
+	if weight > 0.001 and _cur != "":
+		var cur := _tracks_of(_cur, sk)
+		var a := _ap.get_animation(_cur)
+		var prev := _tracks_of(_prev, sk) if _mix < 1.0 and _prev != "" and _ap.has_animation(_prev) else {}
+		var pa: Animation = _ap.get_animation(_prev) if not prev.is_empty() else null
+		var pelvis := sk.find_bone("pelvis")
+		var spine := sk.find_bone("spine")
+		# (the legs' pelvis - its walk's bob and sway - against the clip's: the upper body put where the
+		# clip has it, carried by the pelvis's move; the rifle - a root bone - carried the same)
+		var actual := sk.get_bone_pose(pelvis)
+		var ps := _sample(pelvis, cur, a, prev, pa)
+		var clip_pelvis := Transform3D(Basis(ps[0] if ps[0] != null else actual.basis.get_rotation_quaternion()), ps[1] if ps[1] != null else actual.origin)
+		var shift := actual.origin - clip_pelvis.origin
+		for name in BONES:
+			var b := sk.find_bone(name)
+			if b < 0 or not cur.has(b):
+				continue
+			var s := _sample(b, cur, a, prev, pa)
+			if b == spine:
+				var local := Transform3D(Basis(s[0] if s[0] != null else sk.get_bone_pose_rotation(b)), s[1] if s[1] != null else sk.get_bone_pose_position(b))
+				var want := Transform3D(clip_pelvis.basis, clip_pelvis.origin + shift) * local
+				var l2 := actual.affine_inverse() * want
+				sk.set_bone_pose_rotation(b, sk.get_bone_pose_rotation(b).slerp(l2.basis.get_rotation_quaternion(), weight))
+				sk.set_bone_pose_position(b, sk.get_bone_pose_position(b).lerp(l2.origin, weight))
+				continue
+			if s[0] != null:
+				sk.set_bone_pose_rotation(b, sk.get_bone_pose_rotation(b).slerp(s[0], weight))
+			if s[1] != null:
+				var pos: Vector3 = s[1] + (shift if name == "gun" else Vector3.ZERO)
+				sk.set_bone_pose_position(b, sk.get_bone_pose_position(b).lerp(pos, weight))
+	if aim_k > 0.001 and absf(pitch) > 0.001:
+		_pitch_chest(sk, pitch * aim_k)
+	var gb := sk.find_bone("gun")
+	if gb >= 0:
+		gun_pose = sk.get_bone_global_pose(gb)   # (as posed - the skeleton's own pose drops the modifiers' after the frame)
+		has_gun_pose = true
+
+
+## The chest turned up / down round its own middle (the arms with it), and the rifle -
+## its own root bone - turned the same, round the same point.
+func _pitch_chest(sk: Skeleton3D, p: float) -> void:
+	var chest := sk.find_bone("chest")
+	var spine := sk.find_bone("spine")
+	var gun := sk.find_bone("gun")
+	if chest < 0 or spine < 0:
+		return
+	var parent := sk.get_bone_global_pose(spine)
+	var g := parent * sk.get_bone_pose(chest)
+	var r := Basis(Vector3(1, 0, 0), -p)   # (the model faces +z: about +x, -p tips the front up)
+	var g2 := Transform3D(r * g.basis, g.origin)
+	var local := parent.affine_inverse() * g2
+	sk.set_bone_pose_rotation(chest, local.basis.get_rotation_quaternion())
+	if gun >= 0:
+		var gg := sk.get_bone_pose(gun)   # (a root bone: its pose is its place in the skeleton)
+		var o := g.origin + r * (gg.origin - g.origin)
+		sk.set_bone_pose_rotation(gun, (r * gg.basis).get_rotation_quaternion())
+		sk.set_bone_pose_position(gun, o)

files.explanation: Tests: the animation editor (4): posing, keys, clips, saving.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,203 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## Talos's animation editor (Talos > Animation, F7): it builds, shows a
+## character's clips, keys bones, makes clips, undoes - and what it saves (a
+## clip as art/<id>_3d/clips/<clip>.tres, here into a mod) is what the game's
+## models play: Stage3D.use_clips puts it in the model's library in place of
+## the model's own clip.
+
+const SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/anim_editor.tscn"
+
+var _mod := ""
+
+
+func teardown() -> void:
+	EditTarget.mod_id = ""
+	Stage3D.forget_clips("player")
+	if _mod != "":
+		Mods.remove(_mod)
+		_mod = ""
+
+
+func _editor() -> Control:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	return ed
+
+
+func test_builds_and_loads_player() -> void:
+	var ed: Control = await _editor()
+	check(ed.find_child("TalosNav", true, false) != null, "the rail's there (not embedded)")
+	check_eq(ed.char_id, "player", "opens on the automaton")
+	check(ed.characters().size() >= 5, "every character with a model is offered (%d)" % ed.characters().size())
+	check(ed._sk != null and ed._sk.get_bone_count() > 10, "its skeleton's there")
+	var d: Dictionary = ed._doc()
+	check(d["order"].has("walk") and d["order"].has("draw"), "its clips are listed")
+	ed.select_clip("walk")
+	check_eq(ed.frames(), 30, "walk: 30 frames, a loop")
+	check(ed.rows().size() == ed._sk.get_bone_count() and not (ed.rows()[ed._sk.find_bone("pelvis")] as PackedInt32Array).is_empty(), "the dope sheet has the pelvis's keys")
+	ed.set_frame(10)
+	check_eq(ed.frame, 10, "scrubbed to frame 10")
+	ed.step(1)
+	check_eq(ed.frame, 11, "a frame on")
+	check(ed.dirty == false, "nothing changed yet")
+	ed.free()
+	# Embedded (the Mod Editor's): no rail.
+	var em: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	em.set("embedded", true)
+	tree.root.add_child(em)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	check(em.find_child("TalosNav", true, false) == null, "embedded: no rail")
+	em.free()
+
+
+func test_key_new_clip_undo() -> void:
+	var ed: Control = await _editor()
+	ed.select_clip("walk")
+	var orig: Animation = ed.anim()
+	var b: int = ed._sk.find_bone("head")
+	ed.select_bone("head")
+	ed.set_frame(7)
+	var q := Quaternion(Vector3.UP, 0.6) * Quaternion(Vector3.RIGHT, 0.3)
+	ed.pose_bone(b, q)
+	check(ed._sk.get_bone_pose_rotation(b).is_equal_approx(q), "the pose shows before it's keyed")
+	ed.key_bone()
+	var got = ed.key_value("head", 7)
+	check(got is Quaternion and (got as Quaternion).is_equal_approx(q), "keyed head at frame 7 and read back (%s)" % str(got))
+	check(ed.dirty, "an edit makes it dirty")
+	check(ed.anim() != orig, "the edit is on a copy - the model's own clip untouched")
+	var t: int = orig.find_track(NodePath(ed._prefix + ":head"), Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D)
+	check(t >= 0 and not (orig.rotation_track_interpolate(t, 7.0 / 30.0) as Quaternion).is_equal_approx(q), "the game's walk unchanged")
+	# Played back as Godot interpolates: between keys, slerped.
+	ed.set_frame(7)
+	check(ed._sk.get_bone_pose_rotation(b).is_equal_approx(q), "the keyed pose plays at its frame")
+	# Undo takes it back, redo again.
+	ed.undo()
+	check(ed.anim() == orig and not ed.dirty, "undo: the clip as it was, nothing unsaved")
+	ed.redo()
+	check((ed.key_value("head", 7) as Quaternion).is_equal_approx(q) and ed.dirty, "redo: keyed again")
+	# Keys moved, copied, pasted, deleted.
+	ed.sel_keys = {Vector2i(b, 7): true}
+	ed.move_keys(3)
+	check((ed.key_value("head", 10) as Quaternion).is_equal_approx(q), "a key dragged 3 frames on")
+	ed.copy()
+	ed.set_frame(20)
+	ed.paste()
+	check((ed.key_value("head", 20) as Quaternion).is_equal_approx(q), "copied and pasted at frame 20")
+	ed.sel_keys = {Vector2i(b, 20): true}
+	ed.delete_keys()
+	check(ed.key_value("head", 20) == null, "deleted")
+	# New clips: empty, then a copy; rename; length; loop; delete.
+	ed.new_clip(false)
+	check_eq(ed.clip, "clip", "a new empty clip")
+	check(ed.anim().get_track_count() == 0 and ed.frames() == 30, "empty, 30 frames")
+	ed.key_all()
+	check(ed.anim().get_track_count() >= ed._sk.get_bone_count(), "Key all keys every bone")
+	ed.rename_clip("wave")
+	check(ed._doc()["clips"].has("wave") and not ed._doc()["clips"].has("clip"), "renamed")
+	ed.set_length(45)
+	check_eq(ed.frames(), 45, "45 frames long")
+	ed.set_loop(true)
+	check(ed.anim().loop_mode == Animation.LOOP_LINEAR and ed.frames() == 45, "loops, still 45 frames")
+	ed.select_clip("walk")
+	ed.new_clip(true)
+	check_eq(ed.clip, "walk_copy", "a copy of walk")
+	check(ed.key_value("head", 10) != null, "with walk's keys")
+	ed.delete_clip()
+	check(not ed._doc()["clips"].has("walk_copy"), "your own clip deleted")
+	ed.undo()
+	check(ed._doc()["clips"].has("walk_copy"), "and undone")
+	ed.rename_clip("x")
+	ed.select_clip("walk")
+	ed.rename_clip("stroll")
+	check(ed._doc()["clips"].has("walk"), "the model's clips keep their names")
+	ed.discard()
+	check(not ed.dirty and not ed._doc()["clips"].has("wave"), "discard: back to as saved")
+	ed.free()
