files.explanation: Tests: smooth turns, whole-cycle loops, no flips, cross-fades.

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,65 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## The characters move smoothly: a body turns round (never snapped - a reversal a
+## half-second turn, one way round), clips cross-fade, looping clips are a whole
+## cycle long (no jump at the seam), and the clips' glitches - a bone flipping
+## away for a frame or two, a pose jumping in one frame - are mended as they load.
+
+
+## Turned from facing +z to facing -z (straight behind): how long, its largest step a frame.
+func _reversal(turn: SmoothTurn, dt: float) -> Array:
+	var f := Vector3(0, 0, 1)
+	var t := 0.0
+	var biggest := 0.0
+	var sides := {}
+	while t < 3.0:
+		var g := turn.step(f, Vector3(0, 0, -1), Vector3.UP, dt)
+		biggest = maxf(biggest, f.angle_to(g))
+		if f.angle_to(g) > 0.0001:
+			sides[signf(f.cross(g).y)] = true
+		f = g
+		t += dt
+		if f.angle_to(Vector3(0, 0, -1)) < 0.01:
+			break
+	return [t, biggest, sides.size()]
+
+
+func test_turning_round_is_smooth() -> void:
+	for dt in [1.0 / 60.0, 1.0 / 600.0]:
+		var r := _reversal(SmoothTurn.new(8.0, 7.5, 14.0), dt)
+		check(r[0] > 0.3 and r[0] < 1.0, "a reversal turns round in about half a second (%.2f s at %d FPS)" % [r[0], roundi(1.0 / dt)])
+		check(r[1] <= 7.5 * dt + 0.001, "never more than its top turn speed a frame - no snap (%.1f deg)" % rad_to_deg(r[1]))
+		check_eq(r[2], 1, "round one way, not flickering between the two")
+	# A small change of way: done quickly, and eased in (its first frame a small part of it).
+	var turn := SmoothTurn.new(8.0, 7.5, 14.0)
+	var f := turn.step(Vector3(0, 0, 1), Vector3(1, 0, 1).normalized(), Vector3.UP, 1.0 / 60.0)
+	check(rad_to_deg(Vector3(0, 0, 1).angle_to(f)) < 5.0, "a turn starts gently (%.1f deg the first frame)" % rad_to_deg(Vector3(0, 0, 1).angle_to(f)))
+
+
+func test_clips_loop_whole_and_have_no_glitches() -> void:
+	for id in ["player", "minoan", "kilon", "pirate"]:
+		if not Stage3D.has_model(id):
+			continue
+		var m: Node3D = Stage3D._scene(id).instantiate()
+		var ap: AnimationPlayer = m.find_child("AnimationPlayer", true, false)
+		Stage3D.loop_clips(ap, id)
+		var d := Stage3D.info(id)
+		var flips := 0
+		for name in ap.get_animation_list():
+			var a := ap.get_animation(name)
+			var c: Dictionary = d["clips"].get(name, {})
+			if bool(c.get("loop", false)):
+				check(a.loop_mode == Animation.LOOP_LINEAR and absf(a.length - float(c["n"]) / float(d["fps"])) < 0.001, "%s %s: loops, a whole cycle long" % [id, name])
+			for t in a.get_track_count():
+				if a.track_get_type(t) != Animation.TYPE_ROTATION_3D:
+					continue
+				for k in range(1, a.track_get_key_count(t)):
+					if (a.track_get_key_value(t, k - 1) as Quaternion).angle_to(a.track_get_key_value(t, k)) > deg_to_rad(120.0):
+						flips += 1
+		check_eq(flips, 0, "%s: no bone flipping over 120 degrees in a frame" % id)
+		m.free()
+
+
+func test_clips_cross_fade() -> void:
+	var W: GDScript = load("res://scripts/world/player/cosmos_walker.gd")
+	check(float(W.BLENDS.get("walk", 0.3)) >= 0.25 and float(W.BLENDS.get("idle", 0.3)) >= 0.25, "walking and standing cross-fade a quarter second or more")
+	check(float(W.BLENDS["jump"]) < 0.2, "a jump's spring quicker")

+extends TestCase
+## Parts bound to a character's skeleton: a part added beside a skinned body is skinned to
+## it by itself (each vertex to its nearest bones), or rigidly to one bone; it stays where
+## it's drawn; saved, the game merges it into the body (its look, its animation); added in
+## the T-pose, it's saved back in the character's own pose.
+
+const SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/mesh_editor.tscn"
+const TPose := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/tpose.gd")
+const MeshIO := preload("res://scripts/editor/mesh/mesh_io.gd")
+
+
+func _pirate() -> Control:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	check(ed.open_now("res://art/pirate_3d/pirate.glb"), "the pirate opens")
+	return ed
+
+
+func _done(ed: Control) -> void:
+	ed.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+
+
+func _bind_index(ed: Control, bone: String) -> int:
+	var bs: Array = ed.MeshBind.binds(ed._rig())
+	for k in bs.size():
+		if bs[k][1] == bone:
+			return k
+	return -1
+

+## Where part `p`'s vertices are drawn (the skeleton's space): skinned by its bind matrices,
+## or (T-posed) as they are.
+func _drawn(ed: Control, p: MeshInstance3D) -> PackedVector3Array:
+	var rig: Dictionary = ed._rig()
+	var a := p.mesh.surface_get_arrays(0)
+	if p.has_meta("tpose"):
+		return a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+	var baked: Array = TPose.bake(p.mesh, rig["mats"])
+	return baked[0][1][Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]

+	check(box.get_node_or_null(box.skeleton) == body.get_node(body.skeleton), "to the body's skeleton")
+	ed.undo()

+	ed.redo()
+	# moved onto the left hand, bound again where it is
+	var rig: Dictionary = ed._rig()
+	var skel: Skeleton3D = rig["skel"]
+	var hand := skel.find_bone("hand.L")

+	ed.unbind_part(box)
+	box.global_transform = Transform3D(Basis.from_scale(Vector3.ONE * 0.06), at)
+	var want: PackedVector3Array = box.mesh.surface_get_arrays(0)[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+	var g0 := box.global_transform
+	check(ed.bind_part(box), "bound again")
+	var drawn := _drawn(ed, box)
+	var worst := 0.0
+	var sk_inv := skel.global_transform.affine_inverse()
+	for i in want.size():
+		worst = maxf(worst, drawn[i].distance_to(sk_inv * (g0 * want[i])))
+	check(worst < 1e-3, "drawn where it was (%.5f m off)" % worst)
+	var a := box.mesh.surface_get_arrays(0)
+	var bones: PackedInt32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES]
+	var weights: PackedFloat32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS]
+	var arm := 0.0

+	for i in bones.size():

+	var m: ArrayMesh = body.mesh
+	check(m.get_surface_count() == 1 and m.surface_get_array_len(0) > 0, "merged")

+	var merged_n := m.surface_get_array_len(0)

+	# the head turned: the box's vertices move with it

+
+func _done(ed: Control) -> void:

+	var bs: Array = ed.MeshBind.binds(ed._rig())

+## How far part `p` (drawn) is from its bone: [its centre's distance to the bone's segment
+## (head to child's head), its farthest vertex from it].
+func _off_bone(ed: Control, p: MeshInstance3D, bone: String, child: String) -> Array:
+	var rig: Dictionary = ed._rig()
+	var skel: Skeleton3D = rig["skel"]
+	var a: Vector3 = (rig["g"][skel.find_bone(bone)] as Transform3D).origin
+	var b: Vector3 = (rig["g"][skel.find_bone(child)] as Transform3D).origin
+	var vs := _drawn(ed, p)
+	var c := Vector3.ZERO
+	var far := 0.0
+	for v in vs:
+		c += v
+		far = maxf(far, v.distance_to(Geometry3D.get_closest_point_to_segment(v, a, b)))
+	c /= vs.size()
+	return [c.distance_to(Geometry3D.get_closest_point_to_segment(c, a, b)), far]

+func _all_on(p: MeshInstance3D, bind: int) -> bool:

+	var bones: PackedInt32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES]
+	var weights: PackedFloat32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS]
+	for i in range(0, bones.size(), 4):
+		if bones[i] != bind or not is_equal_approx(weights[i], 1.0):
+			return false
+	return bones.size() > 0

+		check(p.has_meta("bound_part") and p.skin == body.skin and p.get_node_or_null(p.skeleton) == rig["skel"], "%s is bound to the body's skeleton" % p.name)

+		check(str(p.name).begins_with(str(p.get_meta("bone_part")).validate_node_name()), "named after its bone (%s)" % p.name)

+## Made in the T-pose: along the T-posed bones, saved back in the character's own pose - where

+extends TestCase
+## The mesh editor's curve deform (V), flatten (Shift+Alt+F) - transforms of edit mode, one undo
+## step each, proportional editing applying - and its reference images (kept per model).

+const SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/mesh_editor.tscn"

+
+func _editor() -> Control:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	return ed
+
+
+func _done(ed: Control) -> void:
+	ed.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+
+
+## A subdivided plane in edit mode, everything selected.
+func _grid(ed: Control, cuts := 2) -> void:
+	var p: MeshInstance3D = ed.add_primitive("plane")
+	ed.select_part(p)
+	ed.toggle_edit()
+	for i in 200:
+		if ed.mode == "edit":
+			break
+		await tree.process_frame
+	for i in cuts:
+		ed.select_all(true)

+	ed._derive_sel()

+static func _same(a: PackedVector3Array, b: PackedVector3Array, eps := 1e-5) -> bool:
+	if a.size() != b.size():

+	for i in a.size():
+		if a[i].distance_to(b[i]) > eps:

+
+
+## The curve's handle dragged with the mouse in the view (a press on it, a move, a release).
+func test_curve_dragged_in_the_view() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()

+	ed.frame_all()
+	await tree.process_frame

@@ -1,0 +1,1090 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## Talos's mesh editor (Meshes, F6): the screen, parts from primitives, edit
+## mode with proportional editing, the mirror modifier, symmetrize, undo, and
+## saving a glb into a mod (read back with its parts, skeleton and animations).
+
+const SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/mesh_editor.tscn"
+
+
+func _editor() -> Control:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	return ed
+
+
+func _done(ed: Control) -> void:
+	ed.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+
+
+func test_builds_headless() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()
+	check(ed.view != null and ed.view.sv.world_3d != null, "the 3D view has a world of its own")
+	check(ed.find_children("TalosNav", "", true, false).size() == 1, "the Talos rail is there")
+	check(ed.model != null and ed.parts().is_empty(), "it starts with an empty model")
+	check(not ed.dirty, "nothing to save yet")
+	# a model opens in the background
+	ed.open("res://art/pirate_3d/pirate.glb")
+	check(ed.loading, "opening: read on a worker")
+	for i in 600:
+		if not ed.loading:
+			break
+		await tree.process_frame
+	check(not ed.loading and not ed.parts().is_empty(), "the pirate opened (%d parts)" % ed.parts().size())
+	check_eq(ed.path, "res://art/pirate_3d/pirate.glb", "its path")
+	# and a big part's edit mode is prepared in the background too
+	ed.select_part(ed.parts()[0])
+	ed.enter_edit()
+	for i in 600:
+		if ed.mode == "edit":
+			break
+		await tree.process_frame
+	check_eq(ed.mode, "edit", "edit mode on the pirate's body")
+	ed.toggle_edit()
+	# the model list (scanned on a worker)
+	for i in 600:
+		if ed._scan_task < 0:
+			break
+		await tree.process_frame
+	check(ed._all_files.has("res://art/minoan_3d/minoan.glb"), "the characters are listed")
+	await _done(ed)
+	# embedded (the Mod Editor): no rail
+	var e2: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	e2.embedded = true
+	tree.root.add_child(e2)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	check(e2.find_children("TalosNav", "", true, false).is_empty(), "embedded: no Talos rail")
+	await _done(e2)
+
+
+func test_add_primitive() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()
+	for k in ["box", "cylinder", "cone", "sphere", "plane", "torus"]:
+		var mi: MeshInstance3D = ed.add_primitive(k)
+		check(mi != null and mi.mesh.get_surface_count() == 1, "a %s is added" % k)
+	check_eq(ed.parts().size(), 6, "six parts")
+	check(ed.dirty, "adding makes it unsaved")
+	check_eq(str(ed.part.name), "Torus", "the new part is selected")
+	ed.duplicate_part()
+	check_eq(ed.parts().size(), 7, "duplicated")
+	ed.undo()
+	check_eq(ed.parts().size(), 6, "duplicate undone")
+	ed.delete_part()
+	check_eq(ed.parts().size(), 5, "deleted")
+	ed.undo()
+	check_eq(ed.parts().size(), 6, "delete undone")
+	ed.rename_part("Ring")
+	check_eq(str(ed.part.name), "Ring", "renamed")
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+## A plane subdivided into a grid (edit mode), its points moved by hand.
+func _grid_part(ed: Control) -> MeshInstance3D:
+	var mi: MeshInstance3D = ed.add_primitive("plane")
+	var pm := PlaneMesh.new()
+	pm.size = Vector2(2, 2)
+	pm.subdivide_width = 9
+	pm.subdivide_depth = 9
+	var a := pm.get_mesh_arrays()
+	a[Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT] = null
+	var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+	m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, a)
+	mi.mesh = m
+	return mi
+
+
+func _nearest(em, at: Vector3) -> int:
+	var best := -1
+	var bd := INF
+	for i in em.points.size():
+		var d: float = em.points[i].distance_to(at)
+		if d < bd:
+			bd = d
+			best = i
+	return best
+
+
+func test_proportional_move() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()
+	_grid_part(ed)
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	check_eq(ed.mode, "edit", "edit mode")
+	var em = ed.em
+	check_eq(em.points.size(), 121, "11 x 11 points")
+	var c := _nearest(em, Vector3.ZERO)
+	var near := _nearest(em, Vector3(0.2, 0, 0))
+	var far := _nearest(em, Vector3(0.8, 0, 0))
+	var out := _nearest(em, Vector3(1.0, 0, 1.0))
+	ed.prop_on = true
+	ed.prop_radius = 1.0
+	ed.prop_falloff = "smooth"
+	ed.select_points(PackedInt32Array([c]))
+	ed.move_selection(Vector3(0, 1, 0))
+	var y_c: float = ed.em.points[c].y
+	var y_near: float = ed.em.points[near].y
+	var y_far: float = ed.em.points[far].y
+	check(absf(y_c - 1.0) < 1e-4, "the selected point moved all the way (%.3f)" % y_c)
+	check(y_near > 0.0 and y_near < y_c, "a neighbour moved less (%.3f)" % y_near)
+	check(y_far >= 0.0 and y_far < y_near, "a further one less still (%.3f)" % y_far)
+	check(absf(ed.em.points[out].y) < 1e-6, "outside the radius nothing moved")
+	# the shown mesh follows the points
+	var pos: PackedVector3Array = ed.part.mesh.surface_get_arrays(0)[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+	var top := -INF
+	for p in pos:
+		top = maxf(top, p.y)
+	check(absf(top - 1.0) < 1e-4, "the mesh shown moved too")
+	# every falloff fades from 1 to 0
+	for f in ["smooth", "sphere", "root", "linear", "sharp", "constant"]:
+		check(ed.em.falloff(f, 0.0, 1.0) == 1.0 and ed.em.falloff(f, 1.0, 1.0) == 0.0, "falloff %s: 1 at the centre, 0 at the radius" % f)
+	# connected only: a separate piece isn't pulled
+	ed.undo()
+	check(absf(ed.em.points[c].y) < 1e-6, "undo puts it back")
+	ed.redo()
+	check(absf(ed.em.points[c].y - 1.0) < 1e-4, "redo moves it again")
+	ed.undo()
+	ed.prop_connected = true
+	ed.select_points(PackedInt32Array([c]))
+	ed.move_selection(Vector3(0, 0.5, 0))
+	check(ed.em.points[near].y > 0.0 and ed.em.points[near].y < 0.5, "connected: joined neighbours follow")
+	# leaving edit mode: one undo step of the model
+	var before_edit: Mesh = ed._part_mesh_before
+	ed.toggle_edit()
+	check_eq(ed.mode, "object", "back to object mode")
+	ed.undo()
+	check(ed.part.mesh == before_edit, "the whole edit undone in one step")
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+func test_mirror_modifier() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()
+	var mi := _grid_part(ed)
+	# the grid moved to x >= 0, its left edge on the seam
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	ed.select_all(true)
+	ed.move_selection(Vector3(1, 0, 0))
+	var n: int = ed.em.points.size()
+	var seam := 0
+	for p in ed.em.points:
+		if absf(p.x) < 1e-4:
+			seam += 1
+	check_eq(seam, 11, "11 points on the seam")
+	ed.toggle_edit()
+	ed.set_mirror(mi, {"axes": [true, false, false], "clip": true, "merge": 0.001})
+	check(mi.has_meta("mesh_mirror"), "the modifier is kept on the part")
+	check_eq((ed._ghosts.get(mi, []) as Array).size(), 1, "shown live: one mirrored copy")
+	# a move in edit mode with clipping: seam points stay on the seam
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	var s0 := _nearest(ed.em, Vector3(0, 0, 0))
+	ed.prop_on = false
+	ed.select_points(PackedInt32Array([s0]))
+	ed.move_selection(Vector3(-0.3, 0.2, 0))
+	check(absf(ed.em.points[s0].x) < 1e-6 and absf(ed.em.points[s0].y - 0.2) < 1e-4, "clipped: a seam point stays on the seam")
+	ed.undo()
+	ed.toggle_edit()
+	var applied: Mesh = ed.mirrored_mesh(mi)
+	var vcount: int = applied.surface_get_array_len(0)
+	var vbase: int = mi.mesh.surface_get_array_len(0)
+	check_eq(vcount, vbase * 2 - 11, "applied: the vertex count doubled minus the seam")
+	ed.apply_mirror()
+	check(not mi.has_meta("mesh_mirror"), "applied: the modifier is gone")
+	check_eq(mi.mesh.surface_get_array_len(0), vbase * 2 - 11, "the part's mesh is mirrored")
+	var b: AABB = mi.mesh.get_aabb()
+	check(absf(b.position.x + 2.0) < 1e-3 and absf(b.end.x - 2.0) < 1e-3, "it spans both sides (%s)" % b)
+	ed.undo()
+	check(mi.has_meta("mesh_mirror") and mi.mesh.surface_get_array_len(0) == vbase, "apply undone")
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+func test_symmetrize() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()
+	ed.add_primitive("box")
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	var em = ed.em
+	var p := _nearest(em, Vector3(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
+	var twin := _nearest(em, Vector3(0.5, 0.5, 0.5))
+	ed.prop_on = false
+	ed.select_points(PackedInt32Array([p]))
+	ed.move_selection(Vector3(-0.02, 0.01, 0))
+	check(ed.em.points[p].distance_to(Vector3(-0.52, 0.51, 0.5)) < 1e-4, "a -X corner moved")
+	ed.symmetrize(0, true)
+	check(ed.em.points[p].distance_to(Vector3(-0.5, 0.5, 0.5)) < 1e-4, "symmetrize +X to -X: it matches its twin again (%s)" % ed.em.points[p])
+	ed.undo()
+	ed.symmetrize(0, false)
+	check(ed.em.points[twin].distance_to(Vector3(0.52, 0.51, 0.5)) < 1e-4, "symmetrize -X to +X: the twin follows it (%s)" % ed.em.points[twin])
+	# symmetry editing: a move mirrors to the twin
+	ed.undo()
+	ed.undo()
+	ed.sym = [true, false, false]
+	ed.select_points(PackedInt32Array([twin]))
+	ed.move_selection(Vector3(0.1, 0, 0))
+	check(ed.em.points[twin].distance_to(Vector3(0.6, 0.5, 0.5)) < 1e-4, "symmetry: the point moved")
+	check(ed.em.points[p].distance_to(Vector3(-0.6, 0.5, 0.5)) < 1e-4, "symmetry: its twin moved the mirrored way (%s)" % ed.em.points[p])
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+func test_edit_ops() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()
+	ed.add_primitive("box")
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	var em = ed.em
+	check_eq(em.points.size(), 8, "a box: 8 points")
+	check_eq(em.tri_count(), 12, "12 triangles")
+	check_eq(em.edge_count(), 18, "18 edges")
+	# extrude the top face
+	ed.set_kind(2)
+	for t in em.tri_count():
+		var ok := true
+		for k in 3:
+			if em.points[em.tris[t * 3 + k]].y < 0.49:
+				ok = false
+		ed.sel_t[t] = 1 if ok else 0
+	ed._derive_sel()
+	var top: PackedInt32Array = ed.extrude(false)
+	check_eq(top.size(), 4, "extrude: four new points")
+	check_eq(ed.em.points.size(), 12, "12 points")
+	check_eq(ed.em.tri_count(), 12 + 8, "four walls (8 triangles)")
+	ed.move_selection(Vector3(0, 0.5, 0))
+	check(absf(ed.em.aabb().end.y - 1.0) < 1e-4, "pulled up")
+	# subdivide the top
+	var tris_before: int = ed.em.tri_count()
+	ed.subdivide()
+	check(ed.em.tri_count() > tris_before, "subdivided (%d -> %d)" % [tris_before, ed.em.tri_count()])

+	ed.merge_selected()

+	var t0: int = ed.em.tri_count()
+	ed.select_points(PackedInt32Array([0]))
+	ed.delete_selected()
+	check(ed.em.tri_count() < t0, "delete removes faces")
+	ed.flip_normals()
+	ed.recalc_normals()
+	# undo back to the box
+	for i in 8:
+		ed.undo()
+	check_eq(ed.em.points.size(), 8, "undo all: the box again")
+	check_eq(ed.em.tri_count(), 12, "12 triangles again")
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+func test_save_reload_mod() -> void:
+	var id: String = Mods.create("t")
+	EditTarget.mod_id = id
+	var ed := await _editor()
+	var mi: MeshInstance3D = ed.add_primitive("box")
+	mi.position = Vector3(1, 2, 3)
+	ed.set_surface_material(mi, 0, load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/mesh_io.gd").preset(1))

+## A character T-posed for editing (arms out, its weapon beside it), turned back exactly
+## when saved; its weapons hidden and shown.
+func test_tpose_and_weapons() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()
+	check(ed.open_now("res://art/pirate_3d/pirate.glb"), "the pirate opens")
+	var body: MeshInstance3D = ed.parts()[0]
+	var before: PackedVector3Array = body.mesh.surface_get_arrays(0)[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+	ed.toggle_tpose()
+	for i in 600:
+		if ed._tpose_task < 0 and ed.is_tposed():
+			break
+		await tree.process_frame
+	check(ed.is_tposed(), "T-posed")
+	var box: AABB = body.mesh.get_aabb()
+	check(box.size.x > 1.2, "its arms out to the sides (%.2f m wide)" % box.size.x)
+	check(body.skeleton == NodePath(""), "drawn as laid out (not skinned again)")
+	# back exactly
+	var back: ArrayMesh = ed.TPose.mesh_from(ed.TPose.bake(body.mesh, body.get_meta("tpose_mats"), true))
+	var after: PackedVector3Array = back.surface_get_arrays(0)[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX]
+	var worst := 0.0
+	for i in before.size():
+		worst = maxf(worst, before[i].distance_to(after[i]))
+	check(worst < 0.0005, "turned back to its own pose exactly (%.6f m)" % worst)
+	ed.undo()
+	check(not ed.is_tposed() and body.skeleton != NodePath(""), "undo: its own pose again")
+	var n0: int = body.mesh.get_surface_count()
+	var ws: PackedInt32Array = ed.TPose.weapon_surfaces(body)
+	check(not ws.is_empty(), "the pirate has weapons (%d parts)" % ws.size())
+	check(not ed.TPose.is_weapon_material("AUT_VisorGunmetal"), "a gunmetal visor isn't a weapon")
+	var tris := func(m: Mesh) -> int:
+		var n := 0
+		for i in m.get_surface_count():
+			n += m.surface_get_array_index_len(i) / 3
+		return n
+	var t0: int = tris.call(body.mesh)
+	ed.set_weapons(false)
+	check(tris.call(body.mesh) < t0 and body.mesh.get_surface_count() <= n0, "its weapons out of the body (not drawn, not edited)")
+	# nothing left on the gun's bone - the whole rifle, whatever its materials
+	var wb: Dictionary = ed.TPose.weapon_binds(body)
+	check(not wb.is_empty(), "the rifle's bone found")
+	var left := 0
+	for i in body.mesh.get_surface_count():
+		var a: Array = body.mesh.surface_get_arrays(i)
+		if a[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES] == null:
+			continue
+		var bones: PackedInt32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_BONES]
+		var w: PackedFloat32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_WEIGHTS]
+		var nv: int = (a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] as PackedVector3Array).size()
+		var per: int = bones.size() / nv
+		var idx: PackedInt32Array = a[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
+		for t in idx.size() / 3:
+			var all_gun := true
+			for c in 3:
+				var v: int = idx[t * 3 + c]
+				var bb := -1
+				var bw := 0.0
+				for k in per:
+					if w[v * per + k] > bw:
+						bw = w[v * per + k]
+						bb = bones[v * per + k]
+				all_gun = all_gun and wb.has(bb)
+			if all_gun:
+				left += 1
+	check_eq(left, 0, "no triangle of the rifle left showing")
+	check(body.has_meta("weapons_part") and not (body.get_meta("weapons_part") as Node3D).visible, "kept aside, hidden")
+	check(not body.get_meta("weapons_part") in ed.parts(), "not one of the parts to pick")
+	# saved T-posed with its weapons hidden: the file is the model as it was
+	ed.toggle_tpose()
+	for i in 600:
+		if ed._tpose_task < 0 and ed.is_tposed():
+			break
+		await tree.process_frame
+	var id := Mods.create("t_tpose")
+	EditTarget.mod_id = id
+	check_eq(ed.write_to("res://art/test_tpose/pirate_t.glb"), OK, "saved")
+	EditTarget.mod_id = id
+	var saved_n: Node3D = ed.MeshIO.read(EditTarget.read_path("res://art/test_tpose/pirate_t.glb"))
+	var bm: Mesh = (saved_n.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false)[0] as MeshInstance3D).mesh
+	check_eq(bm.get_surface_count(), n0, "the file has its weapons")
+	var bb: AABB = bm.get_aabb()
+	check(bb.size.x < 1.0, "and its own pose, not the T (%.2f m wide)" % bb.size.x)
+	saved_n.free()
+	EditTarget.mod_id = ""
+	Mods.remove(id)
+	check(ed.is_tposed() and body.has_meta("weapons_part"), "after saving: still T-posed, weapons still hidden")
+	ed.set_weapons(true)
+	check_eq(body.mesh.get_surface_count(), n0, "shown again: back in the body, in its own surfaces")
+	check_eq(tris.call(body.mesh), t0, "every triangle back")
+	await _done(ed)

+## Spherize: the selected points onto a sphere round their middle - all the way (0), half (5); undone.
+func test_spherize() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()
+	var p: MeshInstance3D = ed.add_primitive("box")
+	ed.select_part(p)

+	for i in 200:
+		if ed.mode == "edit":
+			break
+		await tree.process_frame

+	ed.select_all(true)
+	ed._derive_sel()
+	var sel: PackedInt32Array = ed.selected_points()
+	var before: PackedVector3Array = ed.em.points.duplicate()
+	var c: Vector3 = ed.em.centroid(sel)
+	var spread := func() -> float:
+		var lo := INF
+		var hi := 0.0
+		for i in sel:
+			var d: float = (ed.em.points[i] as Vector3).distance_to(c)
+			lo = minf(lo, d)

+## Saving makes an override (a variant of it): the original kept, the game takes the latest variant;
+## variants added, duplicated and erased; Revert brings the original back.
+func test_save_is_an_override_with_variants() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor()

+	for n in MO.variants(orig):
+		MO.erase(orig, n)
+	check(ed.open_now(orig), "the pirate opens")
+	check_eq(ed.variant, 0, "the original open")
+	ed.add_primitive("box")
+	ed.set("dirty", true)
+	check_eq(ed.write_to(orig), OK, "saved")
+	check_eq(FileAccess.get_md5(orig), before, "the original file untouched")
+	check_eq(MO.variants(orig), [1], "saved as variant 1")
+	check(FileAccess.file_exists(MO.file_of(orig, 1)), "its file in art/overrides/")
+	check(ed.has_override(), "the editor knows it has one")
+	var count := func() -> int:
+		Stage3D._scenes.erase("pirate")
+		var inst: Node = Stage3D._scene("pirate").instantiate()
+		var c: int = inst.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false).size()
+		inst.free()
+		return c
+	check(count.call() >= 2, "the game takes the variant (with the added part)")
+	# duplicate: a copy, the latest - active
+	ed.add_primitive("box")
+	ed.duplicate_variant()
+	check_eq(MO.variants(orig), [1, 2], "duplicated: variant 2")
+	check_eq(ed.variant, 2, "the copy open")
+	check_eq(MO.active(orig), 2, "the latest is active")
+	check(count.call() >= 3, "the game takes variant 2")
+	# add: a new one from the original
+	ed.add_variant()
+	check_eq(ed.variant, 3, "added: variant 3 open")
+	check_eq(count.call(), 1, "an unsaved new variant: the original's mesh")
+	# erase: the one before becomes active
+	ed.erase_variant(false)
+	check_eq(MO.variants(orig), [1, 2], "erased variant 3")
+	check_eq(ed.variant, 2, "the active one open again")
+	check(count.call() >= 3, "the game back on variant 2")
+	ed.open_now(orig, 1)
+	check_eq(ed.variant, 1, "an older variant opens")
+	ed.revert_to_original(false)
+	check(MO.variants(orig).is_empty() and not ed.has_override(), "reverted: every variant gone")
+	check_eq(count.call(), 1, "the game: the original again")
+	check(not DirAccess.dir_exists_absolute("user://test_overrides"), "nothing left behind")
+	MO.dir = MO.DIR
+	Stage3D._scenes.erase("pirate")
+	await _done(ed)

@@ -1,0 +1,489 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## The mesh editor's faces (n-gons over the triangles) and its knife (K): a box reads as
+## six quads; a cut splits the faces it crosses into two each (new points on the edges
+## it crosses, their UVs and normals mixed from the edge's ends), follows the surface
+## over an edge onto the next face, mirrors with symmetry, cuts right through (Shift+K),
+## and is one undo step.
+
+const SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/mesh_editor.tscn"
+
+
+func _box_editor() -> Control:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	ed.add_primitive("box")
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	return ed
+
+
+func _done(ed: Control) -> void:
+	ed.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+
+
+## The faces whose every corner has coordinate `axis` = `v` (a side of the box).
+func _faces_on(em, axis: int, v: float) -> Array:
+	var out := {}
+	for t in em.tri_count():
+		var ok := true
+		for k in 3:
+			if absf(em.points[em.tris[t * 3 + k]][axis] - v) > 1e-4:
+				ok = false
+		if ok:
+			out[em.tri_face[t]] = t
+	return out.values()
+
+
+func _point_at(em, at: Vector3) -> int:
+	for p in em.points.size():
+		if em.points[p].distance_to(at) < 1e-4:
+			return p
+	return -1
+
+
+func test_a_box_is_six_quads() -> void:
+	var ed := await _box_editor()
+	var em = ed.em
+	check_eq(em.tri_count(), 12, "12 triangles underneath")
+	check_eq(em.poly_count(), 6, "six faces")
+	check_eq(em.edge_count(), 18, "18 edges, the diagonals counted")
+	check_eq(em.wire_edges().size() / 2, 12, "12 edges shown - not the diagonals")
+	for t in em.tri_count():
+		check_eq(em.poly_loop(t).size(), 4, "each face a quad")
+	# face mode: a click on one triangle selects its whole quad
+	ed.view.frame(AABB(Vector3(-1, -1, -1), Vector3(2, 2, 2)))
+	ed.set_kind(2)
+	var top: Vector2 = ed.view.project(ed.part.global_transform * Vector3(0.1, 0.5, 0.2))
+	ed.click_select(top, false)
+	var n := 0
+	for b in ed.sel_t:
+		n += b
+	check_eq(n, 2, "face mode: a click selects the whole quad (both its triangles)")
+	# extruded, the quad is still one face on top, with a quad for each wall
+	ed.extrude(false)
+	check_eq(ed.em.poly_count(), 10, "extruded: its four walls are quads (6 + 4 faces)")
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+func test_a_cut_across_a_face() -> void:
+	var ed := await _box_editor()
+	var em = ed.em
+	var before: Dictionary = em.snapshot()
+	var n0: int = em.points.size()
+	ed.begin_knife()
+	check(not ed.knife.is_empty(), "K: the knife is on")
+	check(ed.knife_add_local(Vector3(0.25, 0.5, -0.5), Vector3.DOWN), "a point on the top's back edge")

+## "" if the edit mesh's faces are sound: every face one outline, and the derived arrays as
+## they are equal to those worked out again (else what's wrong).
+func _sound(em) -> String:
+	for t in em.tri_count():
+		if em.poly_loop(t).size() < 3:
+			return "triangle %d's face has no outline" % t
+	var key := func() -> Array:
+		var es := {}
+		for e in em.edge_count():
+			es["%d-%d:%d" % [em.edges[e * 2], em.edges[e * 2 + 1], em.edge_inner[e]]] = true
+		var ts := {}
+		for t in em.tri_count():
+			var k := [em.tris[t * 3], em.tris[t * 3 + 1], em.tris[t * 3 + 2]]
+			k.sort()
+			ts[str(k)] = true
+		var adj := {}
+		for p in em.points.size():
+			var l := Array(em.adj.slice(em.adj_start[p], em.adj_start[p + 1]))
+			l.sort()
+			if not l.is_empty():
+				adj[p] = l
+		return [es, ts, adj, em.poly_count()]
+	var a: Array = key.call()
+	em.derive()
+	var b: Array = key.call()
+	for i in 4:
+		if a[i] != b[i]:
+			return ["edges", "triangles", "neighbours", "face count (%s vs %s)" % [a[3], b[3]]][i] + " differ from those derived again"
+	return ""

+## Each edit on a sphere leaves its faces sound (the derived arrays as derive() makes them).
+func test_edits_keep_faces_sound() -> void:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	ed.add_primitive("sphere")
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	var em = ed.em
+	var q := -1
+	for t in em.tri_count():
+		if em.poly_loop(t).size() == 4 and em.points[em.tris[t * 3]].x > 0.2:
+			q = t
+			break
+	var steps := {
+		"extrude": func():
+			ed.set_kind(2); ed.sel_t.fill(0)
+			for u in ed.em.poly_tris(q): ed.sel_t[u] = 1
+			ed._derive_sel(); ed.extrude(false),
+		"delete": func():
+			ed.set_kind(2); ed.sel_t.fill(0)
+			for u in ed.em.poly_tris(q): ed.sel_t[u] = 1
+			ed._derive_sel(); ed.delete_selected(),
+		"merge": func():
+			ed.set_kind(0); ed.select_points(PackedInt32Array([ed.em.tris[q * 3], ed.em.tris[q * 3 + 1]])); ed.merge_selected(),
+		"knife": func():
+			var lp: PackedInt32Array = ed.em.poly_loop(q)
+			var a: Vector3 = (ed.em.points[lp[0]] + ed.em.points[lp[1]]) * 0.5
+			var b: Vector3 = (ed.em.points[lp[2]] + ed.em.points[lp[3]]) * 0.5
+			var n: Vector3 = -((a + b) * 0.5).normalized()
+			ed.begin_knife(); ed.knife_add_local(a, n); ed.knife_add_local(b, n); ed.knife_confirm(),
+		"dissolve": func():
+			ed.set_kind(0); ed.select_points(PackedInt32Array([ed.em.tris[q * 3]])); ed.dissolve_selected(),
+	}
+	for name in steps:
+		var t0: int = ed.em.tri_count()
+		(steps[name] as Callable).call()
+		check(ed.em.tri_count() != t0, "%s: the mesh changed" % name)

+## The mesh editor's edit-mode tools in mesh/mesh_ops.gd: Duplicate (Shift+D), Merge by distance
+## (Alt+M) and Auto merge, Inset (I), Loop cut (Ctrl+R) and Select loop / ring (Alt+click) - each
+## one undo step, on a box (six quads) and a 10 x 10 grid of quads.
+
+const SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/mesh_editor.tscn"
+
+
+func _box_editor() -> Control:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	ed.add_primitive("box")
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	return ed
+
+
+## A 2 m plane in a 10 x 10 grid of quads, in edit mode.
+func _grid_editor() -> Control:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	var mi: MeshInstance3D = ed.add_primitive("plane")
+	var pm := PlaneMesh.new()
+	pm.size = Vector2(2, 2)
+	pm.subdivide_width = 9
+	pm.subdivide_depth = 9
+	var a := pm.get_mesh_arrays()
+	a[Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT] = null
+	var m := ArrayMesh.new()
+	m.add_surface_from_arrays(Mesh.PRIMITIVE_TRIANGLES, a)
+	mi.mesh = m
+	ed.select_part(mi)
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	return ed
+
+
+func _done(ed: Control) -> void:
+	ed.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+
+
+func _point_at(em, at: Vector3) -> int:
+	for p in em.points.size():
+		if em.points[p].distance_to(at) < 1e-4:
+			return p
+	return -1
+
+
+## The faces whose every corner has coordinate `axis` = `v`.
+func _faces_on(em, axis: int, v: float) -> Array:
+	var out := {}
+	for t in em.tri_count():
+		var ok := true
+		for k in 3:
+			if absf(em.points[em.tris[t * 3 + k]][axis] - v) > 1e-4:
+				ok = false
+		if ok:
+			out[em.tri_face[t]] = t
+	return out.values()
+
+
+func _count(flags: PackedByteArray) -> int:
+	var n := 0
+	for b in flags:
+		n += b
+	return n
+
+
+func test_duplicate() -> void:
+	var ed := await _box_editor()
+	var n0: int = ed.em.points.size()

+	# points alone (no whole face): nothing copied
+	ed.set_kind(0)
+	ed.select_points(PackedInt32Array([0]))
+	ed.mesh_ops.duplicate_selection()
+	check_eq(ed.em.points.size(), n0, "one point selected: nothing to copy")
+	check(ed.xf.is_empty(), "and no move")
+	# the top face
+	ed.set_kind(2)
+	ed.select_all(false)
+	ed._set_poly(_faces_on(ed.em, 1, 0.5)[0], 1)
+	ed._derive_sel()
+	ed.mesh_ops.duplicate_selection()
+	check_eq(ed.em.points.size(), n0 + 4, "the top face copied: four new points")
+	check_eq(ed.em.poly_count(), 7, "and one new face")
+	check_eq(ed.xf.get("kind", ""), "G", "the copy is being moved")
+	var sel: PackedInt32Array = ed.selected_points()
+	check_eq(sel.size(), 4, "the copy is selected")

+	check_eq(_faces_on(ed.em, 1, 0.8).size(), 1, "the copy's face up there")
+	ed.undo()

+extends TestCase
+## The mesh editor's shape library (120 parametric shapes, editable, new ones saved into
+## a mod), its browser, and the boolean operations between parts (union, difference,
+## intersection, slice - undoable).
+
+const SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/mesh_editor.tscn"
+
+
+func _editor() -> Control:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	return ed
+
+
+func _done(ed: Control) -> void:
+	ed.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+
+
+func _vol(m: Mesh) -> float:
+	return load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/shapes.gd").volume(m)
+
+
+## Every shape of the library is made: not empty, with normals, UVs and tangents - and the
+## solid ones closed, their skin facing out.
+func test_all_shapes_generate() -> void:
+	var Shapes: GDScript = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/shapes.gd")
+	var lib = load("res://scripts/editor/mesh/shape_library.gd").new()
+	lib.load_all()
+	var built := 0
+	var cats := {}
+	var slowest := ""
+	var slow_ms := 0.0
+	var t_all := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	for id in lib.shapes:
+		var e: Dictionary = lib.shapes[id]
+		if not e.get("builtin", false):
+			continue
+		built += 1
+		cats[e["cat"]] = int(cats.get(e["cat"], 0)) + 1
+		var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+		var m: Mesh = lib.mesh_of(e)
+		var ms := (Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0
+		if ms > slow_ms:
+			slow_ms = ms
+			slowest = id
+		if m == null or m.get_surface_count() == 0:
+			check(false, "%s is made" % id)
+			continue
+		var a := m.surface_get_arrays(0)
+		var nv: int = (a[Mesh.ARRAY_VERTEX] as PackedVector3Array).size()
+		var ok: bool = nv > 0 and a[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] != null and (a[Mesh.ARRAY_NORMAL] as PackedVector3Array).size() == nv \
+			and a[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV] != null and (a[Mesh.ARRAY_TEX_UV] as PackedVector2Array).size() == nv and a[Mesh.ARRAY_TANGENT] != null
+		check(ok, "%s: vertices, normals, UVs, tangents (%d vertices)" % [id, nv])
+		if Shapes.GENS[e["gen"]]["solid"]:
+			var open: int = Shapes.open_edges(m)
+			check(open == 0, "%s is closed (%d open edges)" % [id, open])
+			check(Shapes.volume(m) > 0.0, "%s faces out (volume %.4f)" % [id, Shapes.volume(m)])
+	check_eq(built, 120, "120 shapes built in")
+	check(cats.size() >= 6, "in %d categories (%s)" % [cats.size(), cats])
+	print("  120 shapes made in %.0f ms (one thread); the slowest %s: %.1f ms" % [(Time.get_ticks_usec() - t_all) / 1000.0, slowest, slow_ms])
+

+	print("  boolean difference of 2,028 + 2,024 triangles: %.0f ms on a worker (%d frames)" % [ms, frames])

+extends TestCase
+## Symmetrize topology (Ctrl+Shift+M): one side rebuilt as the mirror of the other - cut at
+## the plane, the other side deleted, the kept side mirrored and welded at the seam; a
+## character's copy weighted to the twin bones; one undo step.
+
+const SCENE := "res://scenes/editor/mesh_editor.tscn"
+
+
+func _editor(kind: String) -> Control:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	ed.add_primitive(kind)
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	return ed
+
+
+func _done(ed: Control) -> void:
+	ed.queue_free()
+	await tree.process_frame
+
+
+## Points with no mirror twin across `axis`, and edges not between exactly two triangles.
+func _lone_and_open(em, axis: int) -> Array:
+	var m: PackedInt32Array = em.mirror_map(axis, 1e-4)
+	var lone := 0
+	for i in em.points.size():
+		if m[i] < 0 and em.adj_start[i + 1] > em.adj_start[i]:
+			lone += 1
+	var open := 0
+	for e in em.edge_count():
+		if em.edge_tn[e] != 2:
+			open += 1
+	return [lone, open]
+
+
+func test_a_box_across_the_plane() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor("box")
+	ed.select_all(true)
+	ed.move_selection(Vector3(0.2, 0, 0))
+	var before: Dictionary = ed.em.snapshot()
+	ed.symmetrize_topology(0, true)
+	var em = ed.em
+	var b: AABB = em.aabb()
+	check(absf(b.position.x + 0.7) < 1e-4 and absf(b.end.x - 0.7) < 1e-4, "both sides as the + side was (%s)" % b)
+	var lo: Array = _lone_and_open(em, 0)
+	check_eq(lo[0], 0, "every point has its mirror twin")
+	check_eq(lo[1], 0, "closed: every edge between two triangles")
+	check_eq(em.points.size(), 12, "12 points: 8 corners, 4 on the seam")
+	check_eq(em.poly_count(), 10, "10 faces: the +X side, and four faces cut in two")
+	var sel := 0
+	for p in em.points.size():
+		if ed.sel_p[p]:
+			sel += 1
+			check(em.points[p].x < 0.0, "a new point selected (on -X)")
+	check_eq(sel, 4, "the new half's points selected")
+	ed.undo()
+	check_eq(ed.em.points, before["points"], "undo: the points exactly")
+	check_eq(ed.em.tris, before["derived"][0], "undo: the triangles exactly")
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+func test_cuts_on_one_side_mirrored() -> void:
+	var ed := await _editor("sphere")
+	var em = ed.em
+	# a knife cut on +X only
+	var q := -1
+	for t in em.tri_count():
+		var lp: PackedInt32Array = em.poly_loop(t)
+		if lp.size() == 4 and em.points[lp[0]].x > 0.25 and absf(em.points[lp[0]].y) < 0.3:
+			q = t
+			break
+	var lp: PackedInt32Array = em.poly_loop(q)
+	var a: Vector3 = (em.points[lp[0]] + em.points[lp[1]]) * 0.5
+	var b: Vector3 = (em.points[lp[2]] + em.points[lp[3]]) * 0.5
+	var n: Vector3 = -((a + b) * 0.5).normalized()
+	ed.begin_knife()
+	ed.knife_add_local(a, n)
+	ed.knife_add_local(b, n)
+	check(ed.knife_confirm(), "cut on +X")
+	var cuts := []
+	for p in range(ed.em.points.size() - 2, ed.em.points.size()):
+		cuts.append(ed.em.points[p])
+	check(_lone_and_open(ed.em, 0)[0] > 0, "before: the cut's points have no twins")
+	ed.symmetrize_topology(0, true, true)   # (the side changed found by itself)
+	em = ed.em
+	for c: Vector3 in cuts:
+		var want := Vector3(-c.x, c.y, c.z)
+		var found := false
+		for p in em.points.size():
+			if em.points[p].distance_to(want) < 1e-4:
+				found = true
+		check(found, "the cut's point %s mirrored on -X" % c)
+	var lo: Array = _lone_and_open(em, 0)
+	check_eq(lo[0], 0, "every point has its twin")
+	check_eq(lo[1], 0, "still closed")
+	await _done(ed)
+
+
+## A character: the copied side's vertices weighted to the twin bones (upper.L -> upper.R).
+func test_a_character_follows_its_twin_bones() -> void:
+	var ed: Control = load(SCENE).instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(ed)
+	await tree.process_frame
+	check(ed.open_now("res://art/pirate_3d/pirate.glb"), "the pirate opens")
+	ed.select_part(ed.parts()[0])
+	ed.enter_edit(true)
+	var tw: PackedInt32Array = ed._bones_twin()
+	check(not tw.is_empty(), "its bones paired")
+	check_eq(ed.twin_bone_name("upper.L"), "upper.R", "upper.L's twin")
+	check_eq(ed.twin_bone_name("Hand_Left"), "Hand_Right", "Left -> Right")
+	check_eq(ed.twin_bone_name("spine"), "spine", "a bone in the middle: itself")
+	var sk: Skin = ed.part.skin
+	var skel := ed.part.get_node(ed.part.skeleton) as Skeleton3D
+	var bind_of := func(bone: String) -> int:
+		for i in sk.get_bind_count():
+			if skel.get_bone_name(sk.get_bind_bone(i)) == bone or str(sk.get_bind_name(i)) == bone:
+				return i
+		return -1
+	var bl: int = bind_of.call("upper.L")
+	var br: int = bind_of.call("upper.R")
+	check(bl >= 0 and br >= 0 and tw[bl] == br and tw[br] == bl, "upper.L and upper.R twins (%d, %d)" % [bl, br])
+	# a vertex mostly on upper.L: its side kept
+	var em = ed.em
+	var best_v := -1
+	var best_s := -1
+	var best_w := 0.5
+	for si in em.surfs.size():
+		var s = em.surfs[si]
+		for v in s.count():
+			for k in s.nb:
+				if s.bones[v * s.nb + k] == bl and s.weights[v * s.nb + k] > best_w:
+					best_w = s.weights[v * s.nb + k]
+					best_v = v
+					best_s = si
+	check(best_v >= 0, "a vertex mostly on upper.L")
+	var at: Vector3 = em.surfs[best_s].pos[best_v]
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_usec()
+	ed.symmetrize_topology(0, at.x > 0.0)
+	print("    symmetrize topology on the pirate: %.0f ms" % ((Time.get_ticks_usec() - t0) / 1000.0))
+	em = ed.em
+	var want := Vector3(-at.x, at.y, at.z)
+	var twin_ok := false
+	var s2 = em.surfs[best_s]
+	for v in s2.count():
+		if s2.pos[v].distance_to(want) < 1e-4:
+			var top := -1
+			var tw2 := 0.0
+			for k in s2.nb:
+				if s2.weights[v * s2.nb + k] > tw2:
+					tw2 = s2.weights[v * s2.nb + k]
+					top = s2.bones[v * s2.nb + k]
+			if top == br:
+				twin_ok = true
+	check(twin_ok, "its mirror image mostly on upper.R")
+	ed.undo()
+	await _done(ed)

@@ -1,0 +1,247 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## Editing what's solid while the game runs (SolidsEdit, the Live Editor's
+## Collision tab): a town's blocks and a station's turned boxes read, moved,
+## added, deleted - the walker's push and the camera's line meet them at once -
+## and the edit kept (LiveEdits) and put back on the same place built again.
+
+const TAB := "res://scripts/world/live/tabs/collision_tab.gd"
+
+var _saved := {}
+var _dirty := false
+
+
+func setup() -> void:
+	LiveEdits.load_all()
+	_saved = LiveEdits.data.duplicate(true)
+	_dirty = LiveEdits.dirty
+
+
+func teardown() -> void:
+	LiveEdits.data = _saved
+	LiveEdits._index()
+	LiveEdits.dirty = _dirty
+
+
+func _town(seed := 7) -> CosmosTown:
+	var t := CosmosTown.new()
+	t.setup(null, {"kind": "village", "seed": seed, "empire": "minoa", "name": "Test%d" % seed, "r": 130.0})
+	tree.root.add_child(t)
+	t.want(true)
+	return t
+
+
+func _wait_town(t: CosmosTown) -> void:
+	var t0 := Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	while not t.poll() and Time.get_ticks_msec() - t0 < 15000:
+		await tree.process_frame
+
+
+## The shape holding (town-local) point `p` (-1: none).
+func _at(shapes: Array, p: Vector3) -> int:
+	for i in shapes.size():
+		if SolidsEdit.distance(shapes[i], p) == 0.0:
+			return i
+	return -1
+
+
+func _blocked(t: CosmosSolids, feet: Vector3) -> bool:
+	return t.push(feet, 0.4) != Vector3.ZERO
+
+
+func test_town_solids_edited_live_and_kept() -> void:
+	var t := _town()
+	await _wait_town(t)
+	check(t.built, "the town built")
+	check(SolidsEdit.owner_of(t.get_child(0)) == t, "a part of it picked: the town holds its solids")
+	check(load(TAB).handles(t.get_child(0)), "the Collision tab takes it")
+	var key := str(LiveEdits.anchor_of(t.get_child(0))[1])
+	check_eq(key, "town/minoa/village/7", "its edits kept for this town (its seed)")
+	var shapes := SolidsEdit.boxes(t)
+	check(shapes.size() > 50, "its blocks read (%d)" % shapes.size())
+	var port: Vector3 = CosmosTown.layout("village")["port"]
+	var post_a := port + Vector3(-32, 0, 32)   # (two of the landing field's corner posts)
+	var post_b := port + Vector3(32, 0, 32)
+	var feet := Vector3(0, 0.1, 0)
+	var ia := _at(shapes, post_a + Vector3(0, 1, 0))
+	var ib := _at(shapes, post_b + Vector3(0, 1, 0))
+	check(ia >= 0 and ib >= 0, "the posts are among them")
+	check(_blocked(t, post_a + feet) and _blocked(t, post_b + feet), "both posts in the way")
+	# Move one 6 m along x, delete the other, add a box in the field's middle.
+	var moved := post_a + Vector3(6, 0, 0)
+	var xf: Transform3D = shapes[ia]["xf"]
+	xf.origin += Vector3(6, 0, 0)
+	shapes[ia]["xf"] = xf
+	shapes.remove_at(ib)
+	shapes.append(SolidsEdit.make(port + Vector3(0, 1, 0), Vector3(1, 1, 1)))
+	SolidsEdit.set_boxes(t, shapes)
+	check(not _blocked(t, post_a + feet), "the moved post's old place: clear")
+	check(_blocked(t, moved + feet), "its new place: in the way")
+	check(not _blocked(t, post_b + feet), "the deleted post: gone")
+	check(_blocked(t, port + feet), "the added box: in the way")
+	var g := t.to_global(moved + Vector3(0, 1, -4))
+	check(t.cam_hit(g, Vector3(0, 0, 1), 8.0) < 4.0, "the camera's line meets the moved post")
+	check(t.cam_hit(t.to_global(post_a + Vector3(0, 1, -4)), Vector3(0, 0, 1), 8.0) == INF, "not its old place")
+	# A turned box (a prism in the town's grid).
+	var s := SolidsEdit.boxes(t)
+	s.append(SolidsEdit.make(port + Vector3(10, 1, 10), Vector3(3, 1, 0.3), Basis(Vector3.UP, PI * 0.25)))
+	SolidsEdit.set_boxes(t, s)
+	var along := port + Vector3(10, 0.1, 10) + Basis(Vector3.UP, PI * 0.25) * Vector3(2.5, 0, 0)
+	check(_blocked(t, along), "a box turned 45 degrees: in the way along its length")
+	check(not _blocked(t, port + Vector3(12.5, 0.1, 10)), "not where it would be unturned")
+	var back := SolidsEdit.boxes(t)
+	check(absf((back[back.size() - 1]["xf"] as Transform3D).basis.get_euler().y - PI * 0.25) < 0.01, "read back with its turn")
+	# Kept: the edit as a difference, put back on the same town built again.
+	var rec := SolidsEdit.record(t)
+	check_eq([rec["del"].size(), rec["mod"].size(), rec["add"].size()], [1, 1, 2], "the record: one deleted, one moved, two added")
+	rec["path"] = "."
+	LiveEdits.data[key] = {"collision": JSON.parse_string(JSON.stringify(rec))}   # (as saved and loaded)
+	var t2 := _town()
+	await _wait_town(t2)
+	check(not _blocked(t2, post_a + feet) and _blocked(t2, moved + feet), "built again: the post where it was moved")
+	check(not _blocked(t2, post_b + feet), "the deleted one still gone")
+	check(_blocked(t2, port + feet) and _blocked(t2, along), "the added ones there")
+	var n := (t2._solids as Array).size()
+	load(TAB).apply_edit(t2, LiveEdits.data[key]["collision"])
+	LiveEdits.apply(t2, key)
+	check_eq((t2._solids as Array).size(), n, "put back again (LiveEdits' tries): the same, not twice")
+	# Another town (another seed): its own layout - not this one's edit.
+	var t3 := _town(8)
+	await _wait_town(t3)
+	check(_blocked(t3, post_a + feet) and _blocked(t3, post_b + feet), "another town keeps its posts")
+	# Back to as built.
+	SolidsEdit.revert(t2)
+	check(_blocked(t2, post_a + feet) and _blocked(t2, post_b + feet) and not _blocked(t2, port + feet), "reverted: as built")
+	for x in [t, t2, t3]:
+		x.free()
+
+
+func test_station_boxes() -> void:
+	var st := CosmosStation.new()
+	var rec := {"id": "test:solids", "name": "Test solids", "empire": "athens", "economy": "trade", "health": 100.0}
+	st.setup(rec)
+	tree.root.add_child(st)
+	check_eq(str(st.get_meta("edit_key")), "station/athens/test:solids", "its edits kept for this station (its id)")
+	var shapes := SolidsEdit.boxes(st)
+	check(shapes.size() > 60, "its parts read (%d)" % shapes.size())
+	check(shapes.any(func(s): return s["kind"] == "obox") and shapes.any(func(s): return s["kind"] == "cyl"), "boxes and cylinders")
+	check_eq(SolidsEdit.rotation_of(st), "full", "turned any way")
+	# A box turned 45 degrees about z, far over the station.
+	var up := Vector3(0, 3000, 0)
+	var b := Basis(Vector3(0, 0, 1), PI * 0.25)
+	shapes.append(SolidsEdit.make(up, Vector3(10, 2, 10), b))
+	# One of its parts moved up there too.
+	var xf: Transform3D = shapes[0]["xf"]
+	xf.origin = Vector3(0, 4000, 0)
+	shapes[0]["xf"] = xf
+	SolidsEdit.set_boxes(st, shapes)
+	var inside := up + b * Vector3(9, 0, 0)   # (inside it turned; over it unturned)
+	check(st.push_out(st.to_global(inside), 0.5) != Vector3.ZERO, "the turned box: in the way along its turn")
+	check(st.push_out(st.to_global(up + Vector3(0, 6, 0)), 0.5) == Vector3.ZERO, "not where it would be unturned")
+	check(st.cam_hit(st.to_global(up + Vector3(0, 0, -50)), st.global_basis * Vector3(0, 0, 1), 100.0) < 50.0, "the camera's line meets it")
+	check(st.push_out(st.to_global(Vector3(0, 4000, 0)), 0.5) != Vector3.ZERO, "the moved part: in the way up there")
+	# Kept and put back on the same station built again.
+	var r := SolidsEdit.record(st)
+	r["path"] = "."
+	LiveEdits.data["station/athens/test:solids"] = {"collision": JSON.parse_string(JSON.stringify(r))}
+	var st2 := CosmosStation.new()
+	st2.setup(rec)
+	tree.root.add_child(st2)
+	check(st2.push_out(st2.to_global(inside), 0.5) != Vector3.ZERO and st2.push_out(st2.to_global(Vector3(0, 4000, 0)), 0.5) != Vector3.ZERO,
+		"built again: its edits back")
+	check_eq((st2._solids as Array).size(), (st._solids as Array).size(), "the same number of parts")
+	st.free()
+	st2.free()
+
+
+func test_hangar_and_dungeon() -> void:
+	# A port's camera boxes and footprints: one box where both are the same.
+	var h := CosmosHangar.new()
+	h._boxes = [[Vector3(5, 1, 5), Vector3(1, 1, 1)]]
+	h._blocks = [[4.0, 4.0, 6.0, 6.0], [10.0, 10.0, 11.0, 11.0]]
+	var s := SolidsEdit.boxes(h)
+	check_eq(s.map(func(x): return x["use"]), ["both", "walk"], "a box both, a footprint for the feet")
+	var xf: Transform3D = s[1]["xf"]
+	xf.origin += Vector3(2, 0, 0)
+	s[1]["xf"] = xf
+	s[0]["use"] = "cam"
+	SolidsEdit.set_boxes(h, s)
+	check_eq(h._blocks, [[12.0, 10.0, 13.0, 11.0]], "the footprint moved, the camera-only box off the feet's list")
+	check_eq(h._boxes.size(), 1, "the camera's box kept")
+	check_eq(h._cells_n, -1, "its cells made again")
+	h.free()
+	# A dungeon's blocks: axis-aligned, in its grid.
+	var d := CosmosDungeon.new()

+	d._grid = CosmosSolids.grid_of(d._solids)

+	ds[0]["xf"] = dx

+	check(d.push(Vector3(1, 0.1, 1), 0.4) == Vector3.ZERO and d.push(Vector3(21, 0.1, 1), 0.4) != Vector3.ZERO, "moved, in its grid")
+	d.free()
+
+
+## The tab itself, bound to a stand-in for the Live Editor: a click in the world

files.explanation: Tests: every visible control on every screen has a tooltip (~1,600).

hunks.diff:
@@ -1,0 +1,494 @@ 
+extends TestCase
+## Every control you can use has a tooltip: each screen is built (the title menu
+## and its settings pages, Mods, Patch Notes, the Mod Editor, Talos and each of
+## its tools, the Live Editor's tabs over a game, the game's HUD, the Automaton,
+## the Station Menu) and walked; a visible button, field, slider, list or tab
+## bar with no tooltip fails with its path. Help lives in tooltips (no helper
+## text on screen), so nothing you can click goes without one.
+##
+## Covered: its own tooltip_text (or PinTips' "tip" / "tip_fn" meta); a spin
+## box's own field (internal) through the spin box; an ItemList / TabBar whose
+## every item has its own tooltip; a control that lets the mouse through
+## (mouse_filter not STOP) under one that has a tooltip - Godot shows the
+## parent's then.
+
+var _old_system := ""
+var _old_data := {}
+## The controls seen so far on the screen being walked (path -> true): the report's count.
+static var seen := {}
+
+
+func setup() -> void:
+	_old_system = Galaxy.current_system
+	LiveEdits.load_all()
+	_old_data = LiveEdits.data.duplicate(true)
+
+
+func teardown() -> void:
+	Galaxy.current_system = _old_system
+	Cosmos.arrive_from = ""
+	LiveEdits.data = _old_data
+	LiveEdits.dirty = false
+	EditTarget.mod_id = ""
+	Engine.time_scale = 1.0
+	tree.paused = false
+
+
+static func _interactive(c: Control) -> bool:
+	return c is BaseButton or c is LineEdit or c is TextEdit or c is SpinBox or c is Slider \
+		or c is ItemList or c is Tree or c is TabBar or c is TabContainer
+
+
+static func _own_tip(c: Control) -> bool:
+	if c.tooltip_text.strip_edges() != "" or c.has_meta("tip_fn"):
+		return true
+	if c.has_meta("tip") and str(c.get_meta("tip")) != "":
+		return true
+	if c is ItemList:
+		var il := c as ItemList
+		if il.item_count == 0:
+			return false
+		for i in il.item_count:
+			if il.get_item_tooltip(i) == "":
+				return false
+		return true
+	if c is TabBar:
+		var tb := c as TabBar
+		if tb.tab_count == 0:
+			return false
+		for i in tb.tab_count:
+			if tb.get_tab_tooltip(i) == "":
+				return false
+		return true
+	if c is TabContainer:
+		var tb2 := (c as TabContainer).get_tab_bar()
+		if tb2.tab_count == 0:
+			return false
+		for i in tb2.tab_count:
+			if tb2.get_tab_tooltip(i) == "":
+				return false
+		return true
+	return false
+
+
+static func _covered(c: Control) -> bool:
+	if _own_tip(c):
+		return true
+	var n: Control = c
+	while n.mouse_filter != Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP or n == c and c.mouse_filter != Control.MOUSE_FILTER_STOP:
+		if n.top_level:
+			return false
+		n = n.get_parent_control()
+		if n == null:
+			return false
+		if _own_tip(n):
+			return true
+	return false
+
+
+## The visible controls under `root` you can use with no tooltip, into `out`
+## (path relative to root -> a description), keyed so revisits don't repeat.
+static func scan(root: Node, out: Dictionary) -> void:
+	_walk(root, root, out)
+
+
+static func _walk(root: Node, n: Node, out: Dictionary) -> void:
+	if n is CanvasItem and not (n as CanvasItem).visible:
+		return
+	if n is Window and not (n as Window).visible:
+		return
+	if n is Control and _interactive(n) and (n as Control).is_visible_in_tree():
+		seen[str(n.get_path())] = true
+	if n is Control and _interactive(n) and (n as Control).is_visible_in_tree() and not _covered(n):
+		var c := n as Control
+		var what: String = c.get_class()
+		var t = c.get("text")
+		if t is String and t != "":
+			what += " \"%s\"" % t.left(30)
+		elif c.get("placeholder_text") is String and c.placeholder_text != "":
+			what += " (%s)" % c.placeholder_text.left(30)
+		var sc: Script = c.get_script()
+		if sc and sc.resource_path != "":
+			what += " [%s]" % sc.resource_path.get_file()
+		out[str(root.get_path_to(c))] = what
+	for k in n.get_children():
+		_walk(root, k, out)
+
+
+func _report(screen: String, out: Dictionary) -> void:
+	print("  tooltips: %s - %d controls, %d without a tooltip" % [screen, seen.size(), out.size()])
+	seen.clear()
+	if out.is_empty():
+		return
+	var lines: Array = []
+	for p in out:
+		lines.append("    %s  %s" % [out[p], p])
+	lines.sort()
+	check(false, "%s: %d controls without a tooltip:\n%s" % [screen, out.size(), "\n".join(lines)])
+
+
+func _frames(n := 2) -> void:
+	for i in n:
+		await tree.process_frame
+
+
+# --- The title screen ---------------------------------------------------------
+
+func test_title_menu_and_settings() -> void:
+	var m: Control = load("res://scenes/ui/main_menu.tscn").instantiate()
+	tree.root.add_child(m)
+	await _frames(3)
+	var out := {}
+	scan(m, out)
+	m._open_settings()
+	await _frames()
+	for i in m.SETTINGS_TABS.size():
+		m.show_settings_tab(i)
+		await _frames()
+		scan(m, out)
+	m._close_settings()
+	m._open_crt()
+	await _frames()
+	scan(m, out)
+	m._close_crt()
+	m._open_slots("load")
+	await _frames()
+	scan(m, out)
+	m._close_slots()
+	_report("title menu", out)
+	# The Archive (every book of the game), each book.
+	out = {}
+	var a: Archive = Archive.open(m, "guide")
+	await _frames(3)
+	for b in Archive.BOOKS:
+		a.open_book(str(b["id"]))
+		await _frames()
+		scan(a, out)
+	_report("Archive", out)
+	a.get_parent().get_parent().queue_free()
+	m.queue_free()
+	await _frames()
+
+
+# --- Mods, Patch Notes, the Mod Editor -----------------------------------------
+
+func test_mods_screen() -> void:
+	var id := Mods.create("Tooltip Test Mod")
+	var host := Control.new()
+	host.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	tree.root.add_child(host)
+	var s: Control = load("res://scripts/ui/mods_screen.gd").open_over(host)
+	await _frames()
+	var out := {}
+	scan(s, out)
+	_report("mods screen", out)
+	host.queue_free()
+	Mods.remove(id)
+	await _frames()
+
+
+func test_patch_notes() -> void:
+	var host := Control.new()
+	host.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
+	tree.root.add_child(host)
+	var notes: Control = load("res://scripts/editor/patcher.gd").open_over(host)
+	await _frames(3)
